	public class WpfChartImageService : IChartImageService
	{
		public DXImage GetImage(IChartBase chart, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			DocumentModel documentModel = chart.DocumentModel;
			IChartControllerFactoryService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).GetService<IChartControllerFactoryService>();
			ModelControllerFactoryBase modelControllerFactoryBase = ((service != null) ? service.CreateFactory(chart) : null);
			if (modelControllerFactoryBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.DisableHistory();
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).BeginUpdate();
			((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.SuppressRaiseOperationComplete = true;
			documentModel.DeferredChanges.SkipChangeActions = true;
			try
			{
				IChartBase val = ((ICloneable<IChartBase>)(object)chart).Clone();
				try
				{
					if (val.Controller == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					bounds = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.LayoutUnitsToPixels(bounds, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY);
					ContentPresenter chartContainer = CreateChartTree(val, bounds, modelControllerFactoryBase);
					Rect bounds2 = new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), new System.Windows.Size(bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
					return ConvertChartTreeToImage(chartContainer, bounds2, Math.Min(300f, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.Dpi));
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).EndUpdate();
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.EnableHistory();
			}
		}

		private ContentPresenter CreateChartTree(IChartBase chart, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, ModelControllerFactoryBase factory)
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			ModelRect bounds2 = new ModelRect(0.0, 0.0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
			chart.Controller.RenderChart(factory.CreateRenderContext(bounds2, contentPresenter));
			return contentPresenter;
		}

		private DXImage ConvertChartTreeToImage(ContentPresenter chartContainer, Rect bounds, float dpi)
		{
			int correctedWidth = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidth(bounds.Width, dpi);
			int correctedHeight = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeight(bounds.Height, dpi);
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(correctedWidth, correctedHeight, dpi, dpi, PixelFormats.Default);
			chartContainer.Measure(bounds.Size);
			chartContainer.Arrange(bounds);
			chartContainer.ApplyTemplate();
			chartContainer.UpdateLayout();
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(chartContainer);
			BitmapEncoder bitmapEncoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
			MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			bitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderTargetBitmap));
			bitmapEncoder.Save(stream);
			return DXImage.FromStream(stream);
		}
	}

	public class PictureImageService : IPictureImageService
	{
		private const float targetDpi = 300f;

		public DXImage GetImage(Picture picture, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			InternalSheetBase sheet = ((FloatingObjectBase<PictureInfo>)(object)picture).DrawingObject.Sheet;
			if (sheet.Properties.PrintSetup.BlackAndWhite)
			{
				return HeaderFooterExporter.GetGrayscaleImage(picture.Image.DXImage, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)sheet.Workbook).LayoutUnitConverter);
			}
			DXImage dXImage = picture.Image.DXImage;
			if (dXImage is DXMetafile image)
			{
				int correctedSize = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(bounds.Width, 300f);
				int correctedSize2 = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(bounds.Height, 300f);
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(correctedSize, correctedSize2);
				using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics();
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, correctedSize, correctedSize2));
				return dXBitmap;
			}
			return dXImage.Clone();
		}
	}

		public void ShowPrintPreview(ISpreadsheetControl control)

		}

		public void ShowRibbonPrintPreview(ISpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			ShowPrintPreviewCore(control, showRibbonPreview: true);
		}

		private void ShowPrintPreviewCore(ISpreadsheetControl control, bool showRibbonPreview)
		{
			SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = control as SpreadsheetControl;
			string themeName = spreadsheetControl.GetValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty) as string;
			Window owner = ((spreadsheetControl != null) ? LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)spreadsheetControl) : null);
			if (showRibbonPreview)
			{
				SpreadsheetPrintHelper.ShowRibbonPrintPreviewDialog(owner, spreadsheetControl, themeName);
			}
			else
			{
				PrintHelper.ShowPrintPreviewDialog(owner, (IBasePrintable)(object)control.InnerControl, null, null, themeName);
			}
		}
	}

		internal void ShowRibbonPrintPreviewDialog(Window owner)
		{
			spreadsheet.DocumentModel.PrintInfoProvider.Activate();

			SetThemeName((Window)(object)enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow).DataContext = new EnhancedPrintPreviewViewModel(spreadsheet, (LegacyPrintableComponentLink)DocumentSource, (IPageSetupFormProvider)(object)enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow);

			RemoveUnsupportedCommandsInternal(enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow.PreviewControl);
			AddSettingsCommand(enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow.PreviewControl.CommandProvider.RibbonActions, ((FrameworkElement)(object)enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow).DataContext);
			((ThemedWindow)enhancedPrintPreviewRibbonWindow).ShowDialog();
		}

			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (picture.RenderAsShape())
			{
				return RenderInDoumentLayoutUnit(((SpreadsheetUndoableIndexBasedObject<PictureInfo>)(object)picture).DocumentModel, bounds, (System.Drawing.Rectangle actualBounds) => RenderPictureAsShape(picture, actualBounds));
			}
			OfficeImage image = picture.Image;
			if (ShapeImageServiceExtensions.AllowedToExportImageStream((IShapeImageService)(object)this, image.RawFormat))
			{
				Stream imageStream = OfficeImageExtensions.GetImageStream(image);
				if (imageStream != null)
				{
					return new ImageResult(imageStream, bounds);
				}
			}
			PictureImageService pictureImageService = new PictureImageService();
			DXImage image2 = pictureImageService.GetImage(picture, bounds);
			return new ImageResult(image2, bounds);
		}

		private ImageResult RenderPictureAsShape(Picture picture, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			ContainerVisual visual = PictureRenderer.CreateVisual(picture, bounds.Size.ToSize(), renderEffects: true);
			float rotationAngleInDegrees = ((FloatingObjectBase<PictureInfo>)(object)picture).GetRotationAngleInDegrees();
			return GetImageCore(visual, rotationAngleInDegrees, ((FloatingObjectBase<PictureInfo>)(object)picture).DrawingObject.Transform2D, bounds);
		}

		private ImageResult GetImageCore(ContainerVisual visual, float rotationAngle, Transform2D transform2D, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_016e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0174: Expected O, but got Unknown
			visual.Transform = CreateTransform(bounds, rotationAngle, transform2D);
			Rect descendantBounds = visual.DescendantBounds;
			if (descendantBounds.IsEmpty || descendantBounds.Width == 0.0 || descendantBounds.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			descendantBounds = visual.Transform.TransformBounds(new Rect(descendantBounds.X, descendantBounds.Y, descendantBounds.Width, descendantBounds.Height));
			visual.Offset = new Vector(0.0 - descendantBounds.X, 0.0 - descendantBounds.Y);
			int pixelWidth = (int)Math.Ceiling(HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidthD(descendantBounds.Width, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX));
			int pixelHeight = (int)Math.Ceiling(HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeightD(descendantBounds.Height, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY));
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(pixelWidth, pixelHeight, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY, PixelFormats.Default);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(visual);
			BitmapEncoder bitmapEncoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
			MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			bitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderTargetBitmap));
			bitmapEncoder.Save(stream);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rectangle = descendantBounds.ToRectangle();
			if (converter != null)
			{
				rectangle = new System.Drawing.Rectangle(converter.ToModelUnits(rectangle.X), converter.ToModelUnits(rectangle.Y), converter.ToModelUnits(rectangle.Width), converter.ToModelUnits(rectangle.Height));
			}
			return new ImageResult(DXImage.FromStream(stream), rectangle);
		}

		private static Transform CreateTransform(System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, float rotationAngle, Transform2D transform2D)
		{
			System.Windows.Point center = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Width / 2, bounds.Height / 2);
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix transformMatrix = DrawingTransformHelper.GetTransformMatrix(center, rotationAngle, transform2D.FlipH, transform2D.FlipV);
			return new MatrixTransform(transformMatrix);
		}

		private ImageResult RenderInDoumentLayoutUnit(DocumentModel documentModel, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, Func<System.Drawing.Rectangle, ImageResult> action)
		{
			if (documentModel.CompatibilityOptions.EnhancedLayout)
			{
				documentModel.SetCustomLayoutUnit(DocumentLayoutUnit.Document, ((DpiSupport)(object)documentModel).ScreenDpi);
				converter = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
				try
				{
					bounds = new System.Drawing.Rectangle(converter.ToLayoutUnits(bounds.X), converter.ToLayoutUnits(bounds.Y), converter.ToLayoutUnits(bounds.Width), converter.ToLayoutUnits(bounds.Height));
					return action(bounds);
				}
				finally
				{
					converter = null;
					documentModel.ResetCustomLayoutUnit();
				}
			}
			return action(bounds);
		}

		ImageResult IShapeFeedbackImageService.GetFeedbackImage(Picture picture, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (picture.RenderAsShape())
			{
				return RenderPictureAsShape(picture, bounds);
			}
			PictureImageService pictureImageService = new PictureImageService();

		}

		System.Drawing.Rectangle IShapeActualBoundsService.GetActualBounds(ModelShapeBase shape, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point offset = GetOffset(bounds);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle correctedBounds = GetCorrectedBounds(bounds);
			ContainerVisual visual = ShapeRenderer.CreateVisual(shape, correctedBounds.Size.ToSize(), renderEffects: true);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle actualBoundsCore = GetActualBoundsCore(visual, correctedBounds, shape.ShapeProperties.Transform2D);
			actualBoundsCore.Offset(offset);
			return actualBoundsCore;
		}

		System.Drawing.Rectangle IShapeActualBoundsService.GetActualBounds(GroupShape shape, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
			GroupShapeRenderer.Render(shape, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height), containerVisual.Children, renderEffects: true, imageServiceMode: true, RenderUnsupportedItems);
			return GetActualBoundsCore(containerVisual, bounds, shape.GroupShapeProperties.Transform2D);
		}

		System.Drawing.Rectangle IShapeActualBoundsService.GetActualBounds(Picture picture, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			ContainerVisual visual = PictureRenderer.CreateVisual(picture, bounds.Size.ToSize(), renderEffects: true);
			return GetActualBoundsCore(visual, bounds, picture.ShapeProperties.Transform2D);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Rectangle GetActualBoundsCore(ContainerVisual visual, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, Transform2D transform2D)
		{
			visual.Transform = CreateTransform(bounds, transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees() % 360f, transform2D);
			Rect descendantBounds = visual.DescendantBounds;
			if (descendantBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return new System.Drawing.Rectangle(bounds.Location, System.Drawing.Size.Empty);
			}
			descendantBounds = visual.Transform.TransformBounds(new Rect(descendantBounds.X, descendantBounds.Y, descendantBounds.Width, descendantBounds.Height));
			return descendantBounds.ToRectangle();
		}

		private System.Drawing.Point GetOffset(System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			return new System.Drawing.Point((bounds.Width < 0) ? bounds.Width : 0, (bounds.Height < 0) ? bounds.Height : 0);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Rectangle GetCorrectedBounds(System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			return new System.Drawing.Rectangle(bounds.Location, new System.Drawing.Size(Math.Abs(bounds.Width), Math.Abs(bounds.Height)));
		}
	}
	public class WpfSupportedChartsService : ISupportedChartsService
	{
		public bool IsChartSupported(Chart chart)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			foreach (IChartView item in (SimpleCollection<IChartView>)(object)chart.Views)
			{
				ChartViewType viewType = item.ViewType;
				if ((int)viewType == 9 || (int)viewType == 15 || (int)viewType == 16 || (int)viewType == 8)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((int)viewType == 4)
				{
					Bar3DChartView val = (Bar3DChartView)item;
					if ((int)((BarChartViewBase)val).BarDirection == 1 || (int)((BarChartViewBase)val).Grouping == 1 || (int)((BarChartViewBase)val).Grouping == 2)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class WpfSparklineImageService : ISparklineImageService
	{
		public DXImage GetImage(SparklineGroup sparklineGroup, ModelSparkline sparkline, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			DXImage image = null;
			Dispatcher dispatcher = System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
			if (dispatcher != null && dispatcher.Thread != Thread.CurrentThread)
			{
				System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(delegate
				{
					image = CreateImage(sparklineGroup, sparkline, bounds, layoutUnitConverter);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				image = CreateImage(sparklineGroup, sparkline, bounds, layoutUnitConverter);
			}
			return image;
		}

		private DXImage CreateImage(SparklineGroup sparklineGroup, ModelSparkline sparkline, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			SparklineEdit val = new SparklineEditBuilder().Build(() => (SparklineEdit)(object)new SpreadsheetSparklineEdit(), sparklineGroup, sparkline, bounds, layoutUnitConverter);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bounds = layoutUnitConverter.LayoutUnitsToPixels(bounds, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY);
			int correctedWidth = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidth(bounds.Width, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX);
			int correctedHeight = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeight(bounds.Height, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY);
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(correctedWidth, correctedHeight, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY, PixelFormats.Default);
			System.Windows.Controls.Panel panel = new Canvas();
			panel.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)val);
			((UIElement)(object)val).Measure(bounds.Size.ToSize());
			((UIElement)(object)val).Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height));
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(panel);
			BitmapEncoder bitmapEncoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
			MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			bitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderTargetBitmap));
			bitmapEncoder.Save(stream);
			return DXImage.FromStream(stream);
		}
	}

	public static class ExternalImageLoader
	{
		private static readonly bool imagesIsAvailable;

		private static readonly string SmallImageSuffix;

		private static readonly string LargeImageSuffix;

		private static readonly string ExtraLargeImageSuffix;

		private static readonly string SvgImageSuffix;

		private static readonly ThreadLocal<Dictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image>> imageCacheStorage;

		private static Dictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image> ImageCache => imageCacheStorage.Value;

		static ExternalImageLoader()
		{
			SmallImageSuffix = "_16x16.png";
			LargeImageSuffix = "_32x32.png";
			ExtraLargeImageSuffix = "_48x48.png";
			SvgImageSuffix = ".svg";
			imageCacheStorage = new ThreadLocal<Dictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image>>(() => new Dictionary<string, System.Drawing.Image>(Environment.ProcessorCount));
			try
			{
				imagesIsAvailable = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly("DevExpress.Images.v23.2", "DevExpress.Images.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", false) != null;
			}
			catch
			{
				imagesIsAvailable = false;
			}
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Image LoadSmallImage(string imageName)
		{
			return LoadImageCore(imageName, SmallImageSuffix);
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Image LoadLargeImage(string imageName)
		{
			return LoadImageCore(imageName, LargeImageSuffix);
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Image LoadExtraLargeImage(string imageName)
		{
			return LoadImageCore(imageName, ExtraLargeImageSuffix);
		}

		private static System.Drawing.Image LoadImageCore(string imageName, string suffix)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			imageName += suffix;
			if (ImageCache.TryGetValue(imageName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = GetResourceImage(imageName, (ImageType)1);
			ImageCache.Add(imageName, value);
			return value;
		}

		private static System.Drawing.Image GetResourceImage(string name, ImageType imageType = (ImageType)1)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!imagesIsAvailable)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Stream resourceByFileName = ImageResourceCache.Default.GetResourceByFileName(name, imageType);
			if (resourceByFileName != null)
			{
				lock (resourceByFileName)
				{
					if (resourceByFileName.CanSeek)
					{
						resourceByFileName.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
					}
					return System.Drawing.Image.FromStream(resourceByFileName);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static SvgImage LoadSvgImage(string name)
		{
			return LoadSvgImage("Spreadsheet", name);
		}

		private static SvgImage LoadSvgImage(string category, string name)
		{
			if (!imagesIsAvailable)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ImageResourceCache.Default.GetSvgImageByFileNameAndCategory(name + SvgImageSuffix, category);
		}
	}
}

	public class WorksheetDisplayArea
	{
		private const string invalidLimitMessage = "The number of visible columns or rows cannot be less or equal to 0.";

		private readonly InnerSpreadsheetControl innerControl;

		internal DocumentModel Workbook => ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)innerControl).DocumentModel;

		protected internal WorksheetDisplayArea(InnerSpreadsheetControl innerControl)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)innerControl, "innerControl");
			this.innerControl = innerControl;
		}

		private Worksheet GetSheet(string name)
		{
			IWorksheet sheetByName = Workbook.GetSheetByName(name);
			Worksheet val = (Worksheet)(object)((sheetByName is Worksheet) ? sheetByName : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return val;
		}

		private Worksheet GetSheet(int index)
		{
			IWorksheet sheetByIndex = Workbook.GetSheetByIndex(index);
			Worksheet val = (Worksheet)(object)((sheetByIndex is Worksheet) ? sheetByIndex : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return val;
		}

		public int GetColumnCount(string worksheetName)
		{
			return GetSheet(worksheetName).MaxColumnCount;
		}

		public int GetColumnCount(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return GetSheet(worksheetIndex).MaxColumnCount;
		}

		public int GetRowCount(string worksheetName)
		{
			return GetSheet(worksheetName).MaxRowCount;
		}

		public int GetRowCount(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			return GetSheet(worksheetIndex).MaxRowCount;
		}

		public void SetSize(string worksheetName, int maxColumnCount, int maxRowCount)
		{
			SetSheetDisplayLimits(maxColumnCount, maxRowCount, GetSheet(worksheetName));
		}

		public void SetSize(int worksheetIndex, int maxColumnCount, int maxRowCount)
		{
			SetSheetDisplayLimits(maxColumnCount, maxRowCount, GetSheet(worksheetIndex));
		}

		private void SetSheetDisplayLimits(int maxColumnCount, int maxRowCount, Worksheet sheet)
		{
			if (maxColumnCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("The number of visible columns or rows cannot be less or equal to 0.");
			}
			if (maxRowCount <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("The number of visible columns or rows cannot be less or equal to 0.");
			}
			bool flag = sheet.MaxColumnCount != maxColumnCount || sheet.MaxRowCount != maxRowCount;
			sheet.MaxColumnCount = maxColumnCount;
			sheet.MaxRowCount = maxRowCount;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)innerControl).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				CorrectScrollPosition(maxColumnCount, maxRowCount, sheet);
				innerControl.ResetDocumentLayout();
				innerControl.Owner.Redraw();
			}
			finally
			{
				((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)innerControl).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void CorrectScrollPosition(int maxColumnCount, int maxRowCount, Worksheet sheet)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CellPosition scrolledTopLeftCell = ((ModelWorksheetViewInfo)sheet.ActiveView).ScrolledTopLeftCell;
			if (((CellPosition)(ref scrolledTopLeftCell)).Row >= maxRowCount || ((CellPosition)(ref scrolledTopLeftCell)).Column >= maxColumnCount)
			{
				int num = Math.Min(((CellPosition)(ref scrolledTopLeftCell)).Row, maxRowCount - 1);
				int num2 = Math.Min(((CellPosition)(ref scrolledTopLeftCell)).Column, maxColumnCount - 1);
				sheet.ScrollTo(num, num2);
			}
		}

		public void Reset(string worksheetName)
		{
			SetSize(worksheetName, IndicesChecker.MaxColumnCount, IndicesChecker.MaxRowCount);
		}

		public void Reset(int worksheetIndex)
		{
			SetSize(worksheetIndex, IndicesChecker.MaxColumnCount, IndicesChecker.MaxRowCount);
		}
	}

	[Flags]
	public enum NameBoxItemDisplayMode
	{
		Default = 0,
		ExcludeTableNames = 1,

	public class CellData : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private WeakReference control;

		private CellPosition position;

		private RectangleGeometry clip;

		[Description("Identifies a worksheet cell which is rendered.")]
		public Cell Cell => GetApiCell();

		[Description("Gets or sets the settings that specify how the text should be rendered - font, size, color and other parameters.")]
		public TextSettings TextSettings { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets settings used for rendering visual elements specific to conditional formatting highlighting - DataBar and Icon.")]
		public ConditionalFormattingSettings ConditionalFormattingSettings { get; set; }

		[Description("Gets or sets the rectangular geometry used to define the outline of the cell content.")]
		public RectangleGeometry Clip
		{
			get
			{
				return clip;
			}
			set
			{
				if (clip != value)
				{
					clip = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Clip");
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Occurs every time the CellData.Clip property has changed its value.")]
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal CellData(WorksheetControl control, CellPosition position, TextSettings settings, RectangleGeometry clip)
			: this(control, position, settings, clip, null)
		{
		}//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		internal CellData(WorksheetControl control, CellPosition position, TextSettings settings, RectangleGeometry clip, ConditionalFormattingSettings conditionalFormattingSettings)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.control = new WeakReference(control);
			this.position = position;
			this.clip = clip;
			TextSettings = settings;
			ConditionalFormattingSettings = conditionalFormattingSettings;
		}

		private Cell GetApiCell()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (control == null || !control.IsAlive)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorksheetControl worksheetControl = control.Target as WorksheetControl;
			return worksheetControl.GetApiCell(position);
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

		static SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl);
			IsExpandedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsExpanded", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)d).OnIsExpandedChanged();
			}));
			SpreadsheetControlProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SpreadsheetControl", typeof(ISpreadsheetControl), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)d).OnSpreadsheetChanged(e.OldValue as SpreadsheetControl, e.NewValue as SpreadsheetControl);
			}));
			OkCommandPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("OkCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata());
			OkCommandProperty = OkCommandPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CancelCommandPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("CancelCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata());
			CancelCommandProperty = CancelCommandPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FunctionCommandPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("FunctionCommand", typeof(ICommand), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata());
			FunctionCommandProperty = FunctionCommandPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowNameBoxProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowNameBox", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)d).OnShowNameBoxChanged();
			}));
			ShowFormulaBarButtonsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowFormulaBarButtons", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)d).OnShowFormulaBarButtonsChanged();
			}));
			ShowFormulaBarEditorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowFormulaBarEditor", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)d).OnShowFormulaBarEditorChanged();
			}));
			NameBoxItemDisplayModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NameBoxItemDisplayMode", typeof(NameBoxItemDisplayMode), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(NameBoxItemDisplayMode.Default, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)d).OnNameBoxItemDisplayModeChanged();
			}));
		}

		public SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl>(this);
			CreateController();
			base.SizeChanged += SpreadsheetFormulaBarControlSizeChanged;
			base.Loaded += SpreadsheetFormulaBarControlLoaded;
			base.Unloaded += SpreadsheetFormulaBarControlUnloaded;
			InitializeCommands();
		}

		private void SpreadsheetFormulaBarControlUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnSubcribeControlsEvents();
		}

		private void SpreadsheetFormulaBarControlLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetSpreadsheetToController(Control);
			SubcribeControlsEvents();
			SetRowHeight(MinResizeHeight);
			UpdateButtonsWidth();
			UpdateEditorWidth();
			UpdateNameBoxWidth();
			SetOkCancelButtonsEnabled(isEnabled: false);
			SetFunctionButtonEnabled();
			if (editor != null)
			{
				scrollBar.SmallChange = editor.GetLineHeight();
				editor.Text = Controller.OwnersText;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeCommands()
		{
			OkCommand = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.OkCommand;
			CancelCommand = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.CancelCommand;
			FunctionCommand = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.FunctionCommand;
		}

		private void CreateController()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Controller = new FormulaBarController((IFormulaBarControllerOwner)(object)this);
			SubcribeControllerEvents();
		}

		private void SubcribeControllerEvents()
		{
			Controller.SelectionChanged += OnControllerSelectionChanged;
		}

		private void OnControllerSelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (editor != null)
			{
				editor.Text = Controller.OwnersText;
			}
			if (scrollBar != null)
			{
				scrollBar.Value = 0.0;
			}
		}

		private void SpreadsheetFormulaBarControlSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsExpanded)
			{
				ExpandHeight = GetActualHeight() - horizontalThumb.ActualHeight;
			}
		}

		private void SetSpreadsheetToController(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet)
		{
			if (Controller != null && spreadsheet != null && spreadsheet.DocumentModel.ActiveSheet != null)
			{
				Controller.SpreadsheetControl = (ISpreadsheetControl)(object)spreadsheet;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UnSubcribeControlsEvents();
			editor = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType((FrameworkElement)this, typeof(FormulaBarEditor), (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null) as FormulaBarEditor;
			root = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType((FrameworkElement)this, typeof(Grid), (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null) as Grid;
			nameBox = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType((FrameworkElement)this, typeof(SpreadsheetNameBoxControl), (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null) as SpreadsheetNameBoxControl;
			if (nameBox != null)
			{
				nameBox.ItemDisplayMode = NameBoxItemDisplayMode;
				if (SpreadsheetControl != null)
				{
					nameBox.SpreadsheetControl = SpreadsheetControl;
				}
			}
			if (scrollBar != null)
			{
				scrollBar.ValueChanged -= OnScrollBarValueChanged;
			}
			scrollBar = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType((FrameworkElement)this, typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar), (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null) as System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar;
			scrollBar.ValueChanged += OnScrollBarValueChanged;
			formulaBarEditorContainer = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_FormulaBarEditorContainer") as Grid;
			horizontalThumb = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_HorizontalThumb") as Thumb;
			verticalThumb = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_VerticalThumb") as Thumb;
			okButton = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_OkButton") as System.Windows.Controls.Button;
			cancelButton = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_CancelButton") as System.Windows.Controls.Button;
			functionButton = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_FunctionButton") as System.Windows.Controls.Button;
			SetButtonToolTips();
			SetNameBoxMinWidth();
			SetSpreadsheetToController(Control);
			if (Control != null)
			{
				editor.InitializeSpreadsheet(Control);
			}
		}

		private void SetButtonToolTips()
		{
			okButton.ToolTip = XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_FormulaBarOkButtonTooltip);
			cancelButton.ToolTip = XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_FormulaBarCancelButtonTooltip);
			functionButton.ToolTip = XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_FormulaBarInsertFunctionButtonTooltip);
		}

		private void SetNameBoxMinWidth()
		{
			NameBoxMinWidth = GetNameBoxColumn().MinWidth;
		}

		private void OnScrollBarValueChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
		{
			if (editor != null)
			{
				double num = editor.ScrollViewer.ExtentHeight / (double)editor.LineCount;
				double offset = Math.Round(e.NewValue / num) * num;
				editor.ScrollToVerticalOffset(offset);
			}
		}

		private void SubcribeControlsEvents()
		{
			if (verticalThumb != null)
			{
				verticalThumb.DragDelta += OnVerticalDragDelta;
			}
			if (horizontalThumb != null)
			{
				horizontalThumb.DragDelta += OnHorizontalDragDelta;
				horizontalThumb.DragCompleted += OnHorizontalDragCompleted;
			}
			if (editor != null)
			{
				editor.Rollback += OnEditorRollback;
				editor.GotFocus += OnEditorGotFocus;
				editor.ActivateEditor += OnActivateEditor;
				editor.DeactivateEditor += OnDeactivateEditor;
				if (Controller != null)
				{
					editor.SelectionChanged += Controller.OnOwnerSelectionChanged;
				}
			}
			if (okButton != null)
			{
				okButton.Command = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.OkCommand;
			}
			if (cancelButton != null)
			{
				cancelButton.Command = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.CancelCommand;
			}
			if (functionButton != null)
			{
				functionButton.Command = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.FunctionCommand;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorGotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetOkCancelButtonsEnabled(isEnabled: true);
			RaiseFormulaBarEnter();
			CheckInplaceEditorActive();
		}

		private void CheckInplaceEditorActive()
		{
			if (Control != null)
			{
				InnerSpreadsheetControl innerControl = Control.InnerControl;
				if (innerControl != null && !innerControl.IsInplaceEditorActive)
				{
					SetOkCancelButtonsEnabled(isEnabled: false);
					Control.Focus();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnHorizontalDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			isDrag = false;
		}

		private void UnSubcribeControlsEvents()
		{
			if (verticalThumb != null)
			{
				verticalThumb.DragDelta -= OnVerticalDragDelta;
			}
			if (horizontalThumb != null)
			{
				horizontalThumb.DragDelta -= OnHorizontalDragDelta;
				horizontalThumb.DragCompleted -= OnHorizontalDragCompleted;
			}
			if (editor != null)
			{
				editor.Rollback -= OnEditorRollback;
				editor.GotFocus -= OnEditorGotFocus;
				editor.ActivateEditor -= OnActivateEditor;
				editor.DeactivateEditor -= OnDeactivateEditor;
				if (Controller != null)
				{
					editor.SelectionChanged -= Controller.OnOwnerSelectionChanged;
				}
			}
			if (okButton != null)
			{
				okButton.Command = null;
			}
			if (cancelButton != null)
			{
				cancelButton.Command = null;
			}
			if (functionButton != null)
			{
				functionButton.Command = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnActivateEditor(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetOkCancelButtonsEnabled(isEnabled: true);
		}

		private void OnDeactivateEditor(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetOkCancelButtonsEnabled(isEnabled: false);
		}

		private void SetOkCancelButtonsEnabled(bool isEnabled)
		{
			okCancelButtonsEnabled = isEnabled;
			CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
		}

		private void SetFunctionButtonEnabled()
		{
			if (functionButton != null)
			{
				functionButton.IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorRollback(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseRollback();
		}

		private void OnVerticalDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			ResizeFormulaBarWidth(e.HorizontalChange);
		}

		private void ResizeFormulaBarWidth(double delta)
		{
			if (formulaBarEditorContainer != null)
			{
				double value = formulaBarEditorContainer.ColumnDefinitions[0].Width.Value;
				double val = value + delta;
				formulaBarEditorContainer.ColumnDefinitions[0].Width = new GridLength(Math.Min(base.ActualWidth - verticalThumb.ActualWidth, Math.Max(verticalThumb.ActualWidth, val)), GridUnitType.Pixel);
			}
		}

		private void OnHorizontalDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			isDrag = true;
			ResizeFormulaBarHeight(e.VerticalChange);
		}

		private void ResizeFormulaBarHeight(double delta)
		{
			double num = GetActualHeight() + delta;
			IsExpanded = num > MinResizeHeight;
			SetRowHeight(Math.Max(num, MinResizeHeight));
		}

		private double GetActualHeight()
		{
			if (root == null)
			{
				return base.ActualHeight;
			}
			return base.ActualHeight - root.Margin.Top - root.Margin.Bottom;
		}

		private void OnShowFormulaBarEditorChanged()
		{
			UpdateFormulaBarLayout();
		}

		private void OnShowFormulaBarButtonsChanged()
		{
			UpdateFormulaBarLayout();
		}

		private void OnShowNameBoxChanged()
		{
			UpdateFormulaBarLayout();
		}

		private void UpdateFormulaBarLayout()
		{
			if (!ShowNameBox && !ShowFormulaBarButtons && !ShowFormulaBarEditor)
			{
				base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				return;
			}
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			UpdateEditorWidth();
			UpdateButtonsWidth();
			UpdateNameBoxWidth();
		}

		private void UpdateEditorWidth()
		{
			ColumnDefinition editorColumn = GetEditorColumn();
			if (editorColumn != null)
			{
				GridLength width = (ShowFormulaBarEditor ? new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star) : new GridLength(editorColumn.MinWidth));
				editorColumn.Width = width;
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateButtonsWidth()
		{
			ColumnDefinition buttonsColumn = GetButtonsColumn();
			if (buttonsColumn != null)
			{
				GridLength width = (ShowFormulaBarButtons ? new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto) : new GridLength(buttonsColumn.MinWidth));
				buttonsColumn.Width = width;
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateNameBoxWidth()
		{
			if (ShowNameBox)
			{
				if (!ShowFormulaBarButtons && !ShowFormulaBarEditor)
				{
					SetNameBoxWidth(NameBoxMinWidth, new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star), new GridLength(0.0));
				}
				else if (ShowFormulaBarButtons && !ShowFormulaBarEditor)
				{
					SetNameBoxWidth(NameBoxMinWidth, new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Star), new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto));
				}
				else
				{
					SetNameBoxWidth(NameBoxMinWidth, new GridLength(NameBoxMinWidth), new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SetNameBoxWidth(0.0, new GridLength(0.0), new GridLength(0.0));
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private ColumnDefinition GetEditorColumn()
		{
			if (formulaBarEditorContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return formulaBarEditorContainer.ColumnDefinitions[3];
		}

		private ColumnDefinition GetButtonsColumn()
		{
			if (formulaBarEditorContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return formulaBarEditorContainer.ColumnDefinitions[2];
		}

		private ColumnDefinition GetNameBoxColumn()
		{
			if (formulaBarEditorContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return formulaBarEditorContainer.ColumnDefinitions[0];
		}

		private ColumnDefinition GetHorizontalResizeThumbColumn()
		{
			if (formulaBarEditorContainer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return formulaBarEditorContainer.ColumnDefinitions[1];
		}

		private void SetNameBoxWidth(double nameBoxMinWidth, GridLength nameBoxWidth, GridLength thumbWidth)
		{
			ColumnDefinition nameBoxColumn = GetNameBoxColumn();
			ColumnDefinition horizontalResizeThumbColumn = GetHorizontalResizeThumbColumn();
			if (nameBoxColumn != null && horizontalResizeThumbColumn != null)
			{
				nameBoxColumn.MinWidth = nameBoxMinWidth;
				nameBoxColumn.Width = nameBoxWidth;
				horizontalResizeThumbColumn.Width = thumbWidth;
			}
		}

		private void OnIsExpandedChanged()
		{
			if (!isDrag)
			{
				if (IsExpanded)
				{
					SetRowHeight(Math.Max(MinResizeHeight, GetExpandHeight()));
				}
				else
				{
					SetRowHeight(MinResizeHeight);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetRowHeight(double height)
		{
			if (root != null)
			{
				if (height > MinResizeHeight)
				{
					double num = height - MinResizeHeight;
					int lineHeight = editor.GetLineHeight();
					height = (int)Math.Round(num / (double)lineHeight) * lineHeight;
					height += MinResizeHeight;
				}
				root.RowDefinitions[0].Height = new GridLength(height, GridUnitType.Pixel);
			}
		}

		private double GetExpandHeight()
		{
			if (!base.IsLoaded)
			{
				return defaultExpandHeight;
			}
			if (!(ExpandHeight > MinResizeHeight + horizontalThumb.ActualHeight))
			{
				return defaultExpandHeight;
			}
			return ExpandHeight;
		}

		private void OnSpreadsheetChanged(SpreadsheetControl oldValue, SpreadsheetControl newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				RemoveFormulaBarService(oldValue);
				UnSubcribeEvents(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				RegistrateFormulaBarService(newValue);
				SubcribeEvents(newValue);
				SetSpreadsheetToController(newValue);
				SetButtonsCommandTarget(newValue);
				if (editor != null)
				{
					editor.InitializeSpreadsheet(newValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnNameBoxItemDisplayModeChanged()
		{
			if (nameBox != null)
			{
				nameBox.ItemDisplayMode = NameBoxItemDisplayMode;
			}
		}

		private void SubcribeEvents(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet)
		{
			spreadsheet.InnerControlInitialized += OnInnerControlInitialized;
			spreadsheet.internalOkCommandCanExecute += SpreadsheetOnOkCancelCommandCanExecute;
			spreadsheet.internalOkCommandExecuted += SpreadsheetOnOkCommandExecuted;
			spreadsheet.internalCancelCommandCanExecute += SpreadsheetOnOkCancelCommandCanExecute;
			spreadsheet.internalCancelCommandExecuted += SpreadsheetOnCancelCommandExecuted;
			spreadsheet.internalFunctionCommandCanExecute += SpreadsheetOnFunctionCommandCanExecute;
			spreadsheet.internalFunctionCommandExecuted += SpreadsheetOnFunctionCommandExecuted;
		}

		private void UnSubcribeEvents(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet)
		{
			spreadsheet.InnerControlInitialized -= OnInnerControlInitialized;
			spreadsheet.internalOkCommandCanExecute -= SpreadsheetOnOkCancelCommandCanExecute;
			spreadsheet.internalOkCommandExecuted -= SpreadsheetOnOkCommandExecuted;
			spreadsheet.internalCancelCommandCanExecute -= SpreadsheetOnOkCancelCommandCanExecute;
			spreadsheet.internalCancelCommandExecuted -= SpreadsheetOnCancelCommandExecuted;
			spreadsheet.internalFunctionCommandCanExecute -= SpreadsheetOnFunctionCommandCanExecute;
			spreadsheet.internalFunctionCommandExecuted -= SpreadsheetOnFunctionCommandExecuted;
		}

		private void SetButtonsCommandTarget(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet)
		{
			if (okButton != null)
			{
				okButton.CommandTarget = spreadsheet;
			}
			if (cancelButton != null)
			{
				cancelButton.CommandTarget = spreadsheet;
			}
			if (functionButton != null)
			{
				functionButton.CommandTarget = spreadsheet;
			}
		}

		private void SpreadsheetOnOkCommandExecuted(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseButtonOkClick();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void SpreadsheetOnCancelCommandExecuted(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseButtonCancelClick();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void SpreadsheetOnFunctionCommandExecuted(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseButtonFunctionsClick();
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void SpreadsheetOnOkCancelCommandCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = okCancelButtonsEnabled;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void SpreadsheetOnFunctionCommandCanExecute(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			e.CanExecute = true;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void OnInnerControlInitialized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetSpreadsheetToController(Control);
		}

		private void RegistrateFormulaBarService(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet)
		{
			spreadsheet.AddService(typeof(IFormulaBarControl), this);
		}

		private void RemoveFormulaBarService(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet)
		{
			spreadsheet.RemoveService(typeof(IFormulaBarControl));
		}

		internal void SubscribeFunctionArgumentsControlEvents(RoutedEventHandler onOkClick, RoutedEventHandler onCancelClick, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventHandler onEditorKeyDown)
		{
			okButton.Command = null;
			cancelButton.Command = null;
			functionButton.Command = null;
			okButton.Click += onOkClick;
			cancelButton.Click += onCancelClick;
			editor.KeyDown += onEditorKeyDown;
		}

		internal void UnSubscribeFunctionArgumentsControlEvents(RoutedEventHandler onOkClick, RoutedEventHandler onCancelClick, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventHandler onEditorKeyDown)
		{
			okButton.Click -= onOkClick;
			cancelButton.Click -= onCancelClick;
			editor.KeyDown -= onEditorKeyDown;
			okButton.Command = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.OkCommand;
			cancelButton.Command = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.CancelCommand;
			functionButton.Command = SpreadsheetFormulaBarCommands.FunctionCommand;
		}

		void IFormulaBarControl.SetEnabled(bool value)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseButtonOkClick()
		{
			if (onButtonOkClick != null)
			{
				onButtonOkClick(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseButtonFunctionsClick()
		{
			if (onButtonFunctionsClick != null)
			{
				onButtonFunctionsClick(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseButtonCancelClick()
		{
			if (onButtonCancelClick != null)
			{
				onButtonCancelClick(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseRollback()
		{
			if (onRollback != null)
			{
				onRollback(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseFormulaBarEnter()
		{
			if (onFormulaBarEnter != null)
			{
				onFormulaBarEnter(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseFormulaBarKeyDown(PortableKeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (onFormulaBarKeyDown != null)
			{
				onFormulaBarKeyDown.Invoke((object)this, e);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FormulaBarCommand : ICommand
	{
		public Action Predicate { get; protected set; }

		public event EventHandler CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
			}
			remove
			{
			}
		}

		public FormulaBarCommand(Action predicate)
		{
			Predicate = predicate;
		}

		public bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return Predicate != null;
		}

		public void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			Predicate.DynamicInvoke();
		}
	}

			SetPropertyValue(EnableLegacyPdfExportProperty, base.Source.EnableLegacyPdfExport);
			SetPropertyValue(EnableLegacyPrintLayoutProperty, base.Source.EnableLegacyPrintLayout);

		}

			KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulasProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulas", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetCellOptions)d).OnKeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulasChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			}));
		}

		private void OnAutoFitMergedCellRowHeightChanged(bool value)
		{
			UpdateSourceProperty(delegate
			{
				base.Source.AutoFitMergedCellRowHeight = value;
			});
		}

		private void OnKeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulasChanged(bool value)
		{
			UpdateSourceProperty(delegate
			{
				base.Source.KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulas = value;
			});
		}

		protected override void UpdateSourceProperties()
		{
			((BaseOptions)base.Source).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				base.Source.AutoFitMergedCellRowHeight = AutoFitMergedCellRowHeight;
				base.Source.KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulas = KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulas;
			}
			finally
			{
				((BaseOptions)base.Source).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			if (propertyName == "AutoFitMergedCellRowHeight")
			{
				SetCurrentValue(AutoFitMergedCellRowHeightProperty, value);
			}
			else if (propertyName == "KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulas")
			{
				SetCurrentValue(KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulasProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateAllProperties()
		{
			SetPropertyValue(AutoFitMergedCellRowHeightProperty, base.Source.AutoFitMergedCellRowHeight);
			SetPropertyValue(KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulasProperty, base.Source.KeepCellAlignmentOnShowFormulas);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SpreadsheetOptionsBase<T> : FrameworkContentElement, ILogicalChildrenContainer where T : SpreadsheetNotificationOptions
	{
		private readonly List<object> logicalChildren = new List<object>();

		private T source;

		private Locker updateLocker = new Locker();

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => (IEnumerator)new MergedEnumerator(new IEnumerator[2]
		{
			base.LogicalChildren,
			logicalChildren.GetEnumerator()
		});

		protected T Source => source;

		protected Locker UpdateLocker => updateLocker;

		protected void UpdateSourceProperty(Action action)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (source != null)
			{
				((SpreadsheetNotificationOptions)source).Changed -= new BaseOptionChangedEventHandler(OnSourcePropertyChanged);
				updateLocker.DoLockedAction(action);
				((SpreadsheetNotificationOptions)source).Changed += new BaseOptionChangedEventHandler(OnSourcePropertyChanged);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void Invalidate()
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (source != null)
			{
				((SpreadsheetNotificationOptions)source).Changed -= new BaseOptionChangedEventHandler(OnSourcePropertyChanged);
			}
			source = default(T);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetSource(T source)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			if (this.source != null)
			{
				((SpreadsheetNotificationOptions)this.source).Changed -= new BaseOptionChangedEventHandler(OnSourcePropertyChanged);
			}
			this.source = source;
			UpdateSourceProperties();
			UpdateAllProperties();
			((SpreadsheetNotificationOptions)this.source).Changed += new BaseOptionChangedEventHandler(OnSourcePropertyChanged);
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateSourceProperties();

		protected object GetDefaultValue(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			return property.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected void SetPropertyValue(DependencyProperty dependencyProperty, object value)
		{
			if (!object.Equals(GetValue(dependencyProperty), value))
			{
				SetCurrentValue(dependencyProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private void OnSourcePropertyChanged(object sender, BaseOptionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!updateLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				string name = e.Name;
				object newValue = e.NewValue;
				if (name == string.Empty && newValue == null && e.OldValue == null)
				{
					UpdateAllProperties();
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateProperty(name, newValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateProperty(string propertyName, object value);

		protected abstract void UpdateAllProperties();

		public void Reset()
		{
			object obj = source;
			if (obj != null)
			{
				((BaseOptions)obj).Reset();
			}
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.AddLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			if (!(child is DependencyObject current) || LogicalTreeHelper.GetParent(current) == null)
			{
				logicalChildren.Add(child);
				AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		void ILogicalChildrenContainer.RemoveLogicalChild(object child)
		{
			logicalChildren.Remove(child);
			RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		protected void AddChild(object child)
		{
			((ILogicalChildrenContainer)this).AddLogicalChild(child);
		}

		protected void RemoveChild(object child)
		{
			((ILogicalChildrenContainer)this).RemoveLogicalChild(child);
		}

		protected void OnInnerOptionsChanged<TInnerSource>(SpreadsheetOptionsBase<TInnerSource> oldValue, SpreadsheetOptionsBase<TInnerSource> newValue, Func<T, TInnerSource> getSource) where TInnerSource : SpreadsheetNotificationOptions
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Invalidate();
				RemoveChild(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null && Source != null)
			{
				AddChild(newValue);
				newValue.SetSource(getSource(Source));
			}
		}
	}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty StartSizeProperty;

		[Description("Gets or sets the start size of the PivotTable Field List. This is a dependency property.")]
		public System.Windows.Size StartSize
		{
			get

				return (System.Windows.Size)GetValue(StartSizeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StartSizeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListOptions()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListOptions);
			StartPositionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("StartPosition", typeof(SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition.CenterSpreadsheetControl, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListOptions)d).OnStartPositionChanged((SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition)e.NewValue);
			}));
			StartLocationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("StartLocation", typeof(System.Windows.Point), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListOptions)d).OnStartLocationChanged((System.Windows.Point)e.NewValue);
			}));
			StartSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("StartSize", typeof(System.Windows.Size), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListOptions)d).OnStartSizeChanged((System.Windows.Size)e.NewValue);
			}));
		}

		private void OnStartPositionChanged(SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition value)
		{
			UpdateSourceProperty(delegate
			{
				base.Source.StartPosition = (SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition)value;
			});
		}

		private void OnStartLocationChanged(System.Windows.Point value)
		{
			UpdateSourceProperty(delegate
			{
				base.Source.StartLocation = value.ToDrawingPoint();
			});
		}

		private void OnStartSizeChanged(System.Windows.Size value)
		{
			UpdateSourceProperty(delegate
			{
				base.Source.StartSize = value.ToDrawingSize();
			});
		}

		protected override void UpdateSourceProperties()
		{
			((BaseOptions)base.Source).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				base.Source.StartPosition = (SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition)StartPosition;
				base.Source.StartLocation = StartLocation.ToDrawingPoint();
				base.Source.StartSize = StartSize.ToDrawingSize();
			}
			finally
			{
				((BaseOptions)base.Source).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "StartPosition":
				SetCurrentValue(StartPositionProperty, (SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition)value);
				break;
			case "StartLocation":
				SetCurrentValue(StartLocationProperty, ((System.Drawing.Point)value).ToPoint());
				break;
			case "StartSize":
				SetCurrentValue(StartSizeProperty, ((System.Drawing.Size)value).ToSize());
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateAllProperties()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			SetPropertyValue(StartPositionProperty, (SpreadsheetPivotTableFieldListStartPosition)base.Source.StartPosition);
			SetPropertyValue(StartLocationProperty, base.Source.StartLocation.ToPoint());
			SetPropertyValue(StartSizeProperty, base.Source.StartSize.ToSize());
		}
	}

		public SpreadsheetBehaviorOptions()
		{
			SetCurrentValue(WorksheetProperty, new SpreadsheetWorksheetBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(RowProperty, new SpreadsheetRowBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(ColumnProperty, new SpreadsheetColumnBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(DrawingProperty, new SpreadsheetDrawingBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(SelectionProperty, new SpreadsheetSelectionBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(CommentProperty, new SpreadsheetCommentBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(GroupProperty, new SpreadsheetGroupBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(ProtectionProperty, new SpreadsheetProtectionBehaviorOptions());
			SetCurrentValue(DataValidationProperty, new SpreadsheetDataValidationBehaviorOptions());
		}

		protected internal override void Invalidate()
		{
			Worksheet.Invalidate();
			Row.Invalidate();
			Column.Invalidate();
			Drawing.Invalidate();
			Selection.Invalidate();
			Comment.Invalidate();
			Group.Invalidate();
			Protection.Invalidate();
			DataValidation.Invalidate();
			base.Invalidate();
		}

		protected internal override void SetSource(SpreadsheetBehaviorOptions source)
		{
			base.SetSource(source);
			Worksheet.SetSource(source.Worksheet);
			Row.SetSource(source.Row);
			Column.SetSource(source.Column);
			Drawing.SetSource(source.Drawing);
			Selection.SetSource(source.Selection);
			Comment.SetSource(source.Comment);
			Group.SetSource(source.Group);
			Protection.SetSource(source.Protection);
			DataValidation.SetSource(source.DataValidation);
		}

			finally
			{
				((BaseOptions)base.Source).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Undo":
				SetCurrentValue(UndoProperty, value);
				break;
			case "Pictures":
				SetCurrentValue(PicturesProperty, value);
				break;
			case "Charts":
				SetCurrentValue(ChartsProperty, value);
				break;
			case "Sparklines":
				SetCurrentValue(SparklinesProperty, value);
				break;
			case "Shapes":
				SetCurrentValue(ShapesProperty, value);
				break;
			case "Formulas":
				SetCurrentValue(FormulasProperty, value);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateAllProperties()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SetPropertyValue(UndoProperty, base.Source.Undo);
			SetPropertyValue(PicturesProperty, base.Source.Pictures);
			SetPropertyValue(ChartsProperty, base.Source.Charts);
			SetPropertyValue(SparklinesProperty, base.Source.Sparklines);
			SetPropertyValue(ShapesProperty, base.Source.Shapes);
			SetPropertyValue(FormulasProperty, base.Source.Formulas);
		}

		protected internal override void Invalidate()
		{
			Behavior.Invalidate();
			DocumentCapabilities.Invalidate();
			Save.Invalidate();
			Export.Invalidate();
			Import.Invalidate();
			View.Invalidate();
			PivotTableFieldList.Invalidate();
			FormulaAutoComplete.Invalidate();
			DataSourceLoading.Invalidate();
			Cells.Invalidate();
			Print.Invalidate();
			Copy.Invalidate();
			Clipboard.Invalidate();
			Compatibility.Invalidate();
			base.Invalidate();
		}

		protected internal override void SetSource(DocumentOptions source)
		{
			base.SetSource(source);
			Behavior.SetSource(source.InnerBehavior);
			DocumentCapabilities.SetSource(source.DocumentCapabilities);
			Save.SetSource(source.Save);
			Export.SetSource(source.Export);
			Import.SetSource(source.Import);
			View.SetSource(source.InnerView);
			PivotTableFieldList.SetSource(source.InnerPivotTableFieldList);
			FormulaAutoComplete.SetSource(source.InnerFormulaAutoComplete);
			DataSourceLoading.SetSource(source.DataSourceLoading);
			Cells.SetSource(source.Cells);
			Print.SetSource(source.InnerPrint);
			Copy.SetSource(source.Copy);
			Clipboard.SetSource(source.Clipboard);
			Compatibility.SetSource(source.Compatibility);
		}

		protected override void UpdateSourceProperties()
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((BaseOptions)base.Source).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				base.Source.Culture = Culture;
				base.Source.CalculationEngineType = CalculationEngineType;
				base.Source.Events.RaiseOnModificationsViaAPI = RaiseEventsOnModificationsViaAPI;
			}
			finally
			{
				((BaseOptions)base.Source).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			switch (propertyName)
			{
			case "Culture":
				SetCurrentValue(CultureProperty, value);
				break;
			case "CalculationEngineType":
				SetCurrentValue(CalculationEngineTypeProperty, value);
				break;
			case "RaiseOnModificationsViaAPI":
				SetCurrentValue(RaiseEventsOnModificationsViaAPIProperty, value);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateAllProperties()
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SetPropertyValue(CultureProperty, base.Source.Culture);
			SetPropertyValue(CalculationEngineTypeProperty, base.Source.CalculationEngineType);
			SetPropertyValue(RaiseEventsOnModificationsViaAPIProperty, base.Source.Events.RaiseOnModificationsViaAPI);
		}
	}

		}

				SetCurrentValue(AllowRotateProperty, value);
				break;
			case "AllowStagger":
				SetCurrentValue(AllowStaggerProperty, value);
				break;
			case "MinIndent":
				SetCurrentValue(MinIndentProperty, value);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateAllProperties()
		{
			SetPropertyValue(AllowHideProperty, base.Source.AllowHide);
			SetPropertyValue(AllowRotateProperty, base.Source.AllowRotate);
			SetPropertyValue(AllowStaggerProperty, base.Source.AllowStagger);
			SetPropertyValue(MinIndentProperty, base.Source.MinIndent);
		}

		private class ReraiseEventField
		{
			private static readonly Action<RoutedEventArgs, Delegate, object> invokeHandler = ReflectionHelper.CreateInstanceMethodHandler<RoutedEventArgs, Action<RoutedEventArgs, Delegate, object>>((RoutedEventArgs)null, "InvokeHandler", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, (int?)null, (Type[])null, true);

			private readonly List<Delegate> handlers = new List<Delegate>();

			public void Add(Delegate handler)
			{
				handlers.Add(handler);
			}

			public void Remove(Delegate handler)
			{
				handlers.Remove(handler);
			}

			public void RaiseHandlers(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				foreach (Delegate handler in handlers)
				{
					if (e.Handled)
					{
						break;
					}
					invokeHandler(e, handler, sender);
				}
			}

			public static ReraiseEventField operator +(ReraiseEventField field, Delegate value)
			{
				field.Add(value);
				return field;
			}

			public static ReraiseEventField operator -(ReraiseEventField field, Delegate value)
			{
				field.Remove(value);
				return field;
			}
		}

		private sealed class WpfInnerSpreadsheetControl : InnerSpreadsheetControl
		{
			public WpfInnerSpreadsheetControl(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl)
				: base((IInnerSpreadsheetControlOwner)(object)spreadsheetControl)
			{
			}

			protected internal override void RaiseRangeCopying(RangeCopyingEventArgs args)
			{
				if (!args.Cancel && !SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.QueryAllowCopying())
				{
					args.Cancel = true;
				}
				((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)this).RaiseRangeCopying(args);
			}

			protected internal override void RaiseCopiedRangePasting(CopiedRangePastingEventArgs args)
			{
				if (!args.Cancel && !SafeClipboardWpf.Instance.QueryAllowPasting())
				{
					args.Cancel = true;
				}
				((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)this).RaiseCopiedRangePasting(args);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeClipboard()
		{
			if (clipboardBehavior == null)
			{
				BehaviorCollection behaviors = Interaction.GetBehaviors((DependencyObject)this);
				clipboardBehavior = new ClipboardWithDelayedRenderingBehavior();
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)behaviors).Add((Behavior)(object)clipboardBehavior);
			}
		}

		private void FinalizeClipboard()
		{
			if (clipboardBehavior != null)
			{
				BehaviorCollection behaviors = Interaction.GetBehaviors((DependencyObject)this);
				((FreezableCollection<Behavior>)(object)behaviors).Remove((Behavior)(object)clipboardBehavior);
				clipboardBehavior = null;
			}
		}

		private static void OnBarManagerChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = (SpreadsheetControl)d;
			spreadsheetControl.OnBarManagerChanged((BarManager)e.OldValue, (BarManager)e.NewValue);
		}

		private static void OnRibbonChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = (SpreadsheetControl)d;
			spreadsheetControl.OnRibbonChanged((RibbonControl)e.OldValue, (RibbonControl)e.NewValue);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeBarManagerEvents(BarManager barManager)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)barManager).Loaded += OnBarManagerLoaded;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnsubscribeBarManagerEvents(BarManager barManager)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)barManager).Loaded -= OnBarManagerLoaded;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SubscribeRibbonEvents(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			ribbon.Loaded += OnRibbonLoaded;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UnsubscribeRibbonEvents(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			ribbon.Loaded -= OnRibbonLoaded;
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnBarManagerChanged(BarManager oldValue, BarManager newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				commandManager.UnsubscribeBarItemsEvents(oldValue);
				UnsubscribeBarManagerEvents(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				SubscribeBarManagerEvents(newValue);
			}
			commandManager.UpdateBarItemsDefaultValues();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnRibbonChanged(RibbonControl oldValue, RibbonControl newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeRibbonEvents(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				SubscribeRibbonEvents(newValue);
			}
			commandManager.UpdateRibbonItemsDefaultValues();
		}

		private void OnBarManagerLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			commandManager.UpdateBarItemsDefaultValues();
			UnsubscribeBarManagerEvents(BarManager);
			OnUpdateUI(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnRibbonLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			commandManager.UpdateRibbonItemsDefaultValues();
			UnsubscribeRibbonEvents(Ribbon);
			OnUpdateUI(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void OnUpdateUI(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				commandManager.UpdateBarItemsState();
				commandManager.UpdateRibbonItemsState();
			}
			catch (Exception e2)
			{
				if (!HandleException(e2))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalUpdateBarManager()
		{
			ForceElementNameBinding(this, BarManagerProperty);
			if (BarManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BarItem item in (Collection<BarItem>)(object)BarManager.Items)
			{
				ForceBarItemElementNameBinding(item);
			}
		}

		private void ForceBarItemElementNameBinding(BarItem item)
		{
			ForceElementNameBinding((DependencyObject)(object)item, BarItem.CommandProperty);
			ForceElementNameBinding((DependencyObject)(object)item, BarItem.CommandParameterProperty);
			ForceElementNameBinding((DependencyObject)(object)item, BarItem.CommandTargetProperty);
			if (item is ISpreadsheetControlDependencyPropertyOwner spreadsheetControlDependencyPropertyOwner)
			{
				ForceElementNameBinding((DependencyObject)(object)item, spreadsheetControlDependencyPropertyOwner.DependencyProperty);
			}
			BarEditItem val = (BarEditItem)(object)((item is BarEditItem) ? item : null);
			if (val != null && val.EditSettings != null && val.EditSettings is ISpreadsheetControlDependencyPropertyOwner spreadsheetControlDependencyPropertyOwner2)
			{
				ForceElementNameBinding((DependencyObject)(object)val.EditSettings, spreadsheetControlDependencyPropertyOwner2.DependencyProperty);
			}
		}

		internal void ForceElementNameBinding(DependencyObject o, DependencyProperty p)
		{
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = BindingOperations.GetBindingExpression(o, p);
			if (bindingExpression != null && bindingExpression.Status == BindingStatus.PathError)
			{
				System.Windows.Data.Binding parentBinding = bindingExpression.ParentBinding;
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(o, p);
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(o, p, parentBinding);
			}
		}

		private BaseEditSettings GetActualCustomCellInplaceEditorSettings(CustomCellInplaceEditorType type, List<string> values, Func<ValueObject> createValueObject)

		private BaseEditSettings CreateCustomCellInplaceEditorSettings(CustomCellInplaceEditorType type, List<string> values)
		{

		}

		private ComboBoxEditSettings CreateComboBoxSettings(List<string> values)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ComboBoxEditSettings val = new ComboBoxEditSettings();

		}

			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ShowMessage(message, System.Windows.Forms.Application.ProductName, (PortableMessageBoxIcon)64);
		}

		PortableDialogResult ISpreadsheetControl.ShowDataValidationDialog(string message, string title, DataValidationErrorStyle errorStyle)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(title))
			{
				title = System.Windows.Forms.Application.ProductName;
			}
			IMessageBoxService service = GetService<IMessageBoxService>();
			if (service != null)
			{
				return service.ShowDataValidationDialog(message, title, (DataValidationErrorStyle)errorStyle);
			}
			if ((int)errorStyle == 0)
			{
				MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult = CompatibilityMessageBox.Show(message, title, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
				if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.OK)
				{
					return (PortableDialogResult)7;
				}
				return (PortableDialogResult)messageBoxResult;
			}
			if ((int)errorStyle != 1)
			{
				return (PortableDialogResult)CompatibilityMessageBox.Show(message, title, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Asterisk);
			}
			return (PortableDialogResult)CompatibilityMessageBox.Show(message, title, MessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
		}

		PortableDialogResult ISpreadsheetControl.ShowSortWarningDialog()
		{
			SortWarningControl sortWarningControl = new SortWarningControl();
			SortWarningDXDialog sortWarningDXDialog = new SortWarningDXDialog(XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SortWarningFormTitle));
			SpreadsheetFormHelper.SetupDXWindow((DXWindow)(object)sortWarningDXDialog, this, SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight, WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner, ResizeMode.NoResize, ClearCopiedRanges);
			((ContentControl)(object)sortWarningDXDialog).Content = sortWarningControl;
			((Window)(object)sortWarningDXDialog).ShowDialog();
			if (sortWarningDXDialog.DialogResult.HasValue && sortWarningDXDialog.DialogResult.Value)
			{
				if (sortWarningControl.ExpandSelection)
				{
					return (PortableDialogResult)6;
				}
				return (PortableDialogResult)7;
			}
			return (PortableDialogResult)2;
		}

		bool ISpreadsheetControl.ShowInsertHFPictureDialog(bool isHeader)
		{
			InsertHFPictureWarningControl content = new InsertHFPictureWarningControl(isHeader);
			InsertHFPictureWarningDXDialog insertHFPictureWarningDXDialog = new InsertHFPictureWarningDXDialog(System.Windows.Forms.Application.ProductName);
			SpreadsheetFormHelper.SetupDXWindow((DXWindow)(object)insertHFPictureWarningDXDialog, this, SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight, WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner, ResizeMode.NoResize, ClearCopiedRanges);
			((ContentControl)(object)insertHFPictureWarningDXDialog).Content = content;
			((Window)(object)insertHFPictureWarningDXDialog).ShowDialog();
			if (insertHFPictureWarningDXDialog.DialogResult.HasValue)
			{
				return insertHFPictureWarningDXDialog.DialogResult.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool ISpreadsheetControl.ShowOkCancelMessage(string message)
		{
			IMessageBoxService service = GetService<IMessageBoxService>();
			if (service != null)
			{
				return service.ShowOkCancelMessage(message);

			return CompatibilityMessageBox.Show(message, System.Windows.Forms.Application.ProductName, MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation) == MessageBoxResult.OK;
		}

		private void ShowModelessDialog(System.Windows.Controls.UserControl form, DialogClosedDelegate onDialogClosed, string title, Func<bool> onOkClickDelegate = null)
		{
			ModelessDXDialog dialog = new ModelessDXDialog(title, (DialogButtons)1);
			SetupDXDialog(dialog, form, onDialogClosed, onOkClickDelegate);
			ShowModelessDialog(dialog);
		}

		private void ShowModelessDialog(ModelessDXDialog dialog)
		{
			dialog.Show();
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				((UIElement)(object)dialog).Focus();
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void ShowDXDialog(System.Windows.Controls.UserControl form, DialogClosedDelegate onDialogClosed, string title, Func<bool> onOkClickDelegate = null)
		{
			CustomDXDialog customDXDialog = new CustomDXDialog(title, (DialogButtons)1);
			SetupDXDialog(customDXDialog, form, onDialogClosed, onOkClickDelegate);
			((Window)(object)customDXDialog).ShowDialog();
		}

		private void SetupDXDialog(CustomDXDialog dialog, System.Windows.Controls.UserControl form, DialogClosedDelegate onDialogClosed, Func<bool> onOkClickDelegate = null, bool clearCopiedRanges = true)
		{
			Action extraAction = (clearCopiedRanges ? ((Action)delegate
			{
				ClearCopiedRanges();
			}) : null);
			SpreadsheetFormHelper.SetupDXDialog(dialog, form, this, onDialogClosed, onOkClickDelegate, extraAction);
		}

		internal void ShowDXWindow(DXWindow window, string title, SizeToContent sizeToContent, WindowStartupLocation startupLocation, ResizeMode resizeMode)
		{
			SpreadsheetFormHelper.SetupDXWindow(window, this, sizeToContent, startupLocation, resizeMode, ClearCopiedRanges);
			((Window)(object)window).Title = title;
			((Window)(object)window).Show();
		}

		private void ClearCopiedRanges()
		{
			DocumentModel.ClearCopiedRange();
		}
