		private void AskPasswordConfirmation(IPasswordSource source, Action applyChanges)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.Password))
			{
				applyChanges();
				return;
			}
			ConfirmPasswordViewModel viewModel = new ConfirmPasswordViewModel();
			ConfirmPasswordControl form = new ConfirmPasswordControl(viewModel);
			DialogClosedDelegate onDialogClosed = (DialogClosedDelegate)delegate(bool? dialogResult)
			{
				//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (dialogResult.HasValue && dialogResult.Value)
				{
					if (((PasswordViewModelBase)viewModel).Password == source.Password)
					{
						applyChanges();
					}
					else
					{
						ShowWarningMessage(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)168));
					}
					((PasswordViewModelBase)viewModel).Dispose();
				}
			};
			ShowDXDialog(form, onDialogClosed, XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_ConfirmPasswordFormTitle));
		}

		private void ShowInsertSymbolForm(InsertSymbolViewModel viewModel)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CharacterMapControl val = new CharacterMapControl();
			((FrameworkElement)val).HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
			((FrameworkElement)val).VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Stretch;
			CharacterMapControl control = val;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)control).Margin = new Thickness(12.0, 12.0, 12.0, 12.0);
			((DispatcherObject)(object)control).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				control.FontName = viewModel.FontName;
			});
			control.CharDoubleClick += delegate
			{
				OnCharacterMapControlCharClick(viewModel, control.Selection.ToString(), control.FontName);
			};
			control.ServiceProvider = this;
			((UIElement)(object)control).UpdateLayout();
			InsertSymbolDXDialog insertSymbolDXDialog = new InsertSymbolDXDialog(XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_InsertSymbolFromSelectionFormTitle));
			SetupDXDialog(insertSymbolDXDialog, (System.Windows.Controls.UserControl)(object)control, null);
			insertSymbolDXDialog.InsertButtonClick += delegate
			{
				OnCharacterMapControlCharClick(viewModel, control.Selection.ToString(), control.FontName);
			};
			((Window)(object)insertSymbolDXDialog).ShowDialog();
		}

		private void OnCharacterMapControlCharClick(InsertSymbolViewModel viewModel, string text, string fontName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontName))
			{
				viewModel.UnicodeChar = text[0];
				viewModel.FontName = fontName;
				viewModel.ApplyChanges();
			}
		}

		private void OnPreProcessInput(object sender, PreProcessInputEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				Comment selectedComment = GetSelectedComment();

				{

				}

		}

		private Comment GetSelectedComment()
		{
			Worksheet activeSheet = ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).DocumentModel.ActiveSheet;
			SheetViewSelection selection = activeSheet.Selection;
			if (!selection.IsCommentSelected)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((UndoableCollection<Comment>)(object)activeSheet.Comments)[selection.SelectedCommentIndex];
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled || IsKeyboardProcessForbidden() || e.Key == Key.ImeProcessed || (e.Key == Key.Tab && !AcceptsTab) || (e.Key == Key.Return && !AcceptsReturn) || (e.Key == Key.Escape && !AcceptsEscape))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				PortableKeyEventArgs e2 = ((base.FlowDirection == System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight) ? KeyEventArgsExtensions.ToPortable(e) : ConvertToRightToLeft(e));
				if (InnerControl != null && !PopupMenuManager.IsAnyPopupOpened && !InnerControl.IsInplaceEditorActive)
				{
					InnerControl.OnKeyDown(e2);
					e.Handled = e2.Handled;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception e3)
			{
				if (!HandleException(e3))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsKeyboardProcessForbidden()
		{
			InnerSpreadsheetControl obj = InnerControl;
			bool? obj2;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj2 = null;
			}
			else
			{
				InnerCellInplaceEditor inplaceEditor = obj.InplaceEditor;
				obj2 = ((inplaceEditor != null) ? new bool?(inplaceEditor.IsFormulaPresenterActive) : ((bool?)null));
			}
			if (obj2 ?? false)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!ribbonContainer.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !formulaBarContainer.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				return !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private PortableKeyEventArgs ConvertToRightToLeft(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (e.Key == Key.Left)
			{
				return new PortableKeyEventArgs((PortableKeys)(0x27 | GetModKeys()));
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Right)
			{
				return new PortableKeyEventArgs((PortableKeys)(0x25 | GetModKeys()));
			}
			return KeyEventArgsExtensions.ToPortable(e);
		}

		private static int GetModKeys()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (KeyboardHelper.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				num |= 0x10000;
			}
			if (KeyboardHelper.IsControlPressed)
			{
				num |= 0x20000;
			}
			if (KeyboardHelper.IsAltPressed)
			{
				num |= 0x40000;
			}
			return num;
		}

		void IGestureClient.OnManipulationStarting(ManipulationStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DocumentCapabilityExtensions.IsAllowed(Options.Behavior.Touch))
			{
				e.Mode = ManipulationModes.None;
				return;
			}
			panX = 0;
			panY = 0;
			e.Mode = ManipulationModes.Translate;
			if (DocumentCapabilityExtensions.IsAllowed(Options.Behavior.Zoom))
			{
				e.Mode |= ManipulationModes.Scale;
			}
		}

		bool IGestureClient.ShouldProcessGesture(TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = e.GetTouchPoint(ViewControl).Position;
			if (GetHitTest(position) != SpreadsheetHitTestType.Worksheet)
			{
				return false;
			}
			System.Drawing.Point point = position.ToDrawingPoint();
			SpreadsheetHitTestResult val = ActiveView.CalculatePageHitTest(point);
			if (val != null && (val.HeaderBox != null || val.PictureBox != null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ActiveView.SelectionLayout.CalculateHotZone(point) != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IGestureClient.OnManipulationDelta(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e, ManipulationTypes type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case ManipulationTypes.VerticalPan:
				OnVerticalPan(e);
				break;
			case ManipulationTypes.HorizontalPan:
				OnHorizontalPan(e);
				break;
			case ManipulationTypes.Zoom:
				OnZoom(e);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void OnHorizontalPan(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{

			num2 = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(num2, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX);
			((ScrollByPhysicalOffsetCommandBase)val).PhysicalOffset = num2;
			((Command)val).Execute();
			if (((ScrollByPhysicalOffsetCommandBase)val).ExecutedSuccessfully)
			{

		}

		private void OnVerticalPan(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)

		private void OnZoom(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			double x = e.DeltaManipulation.Scale.X;
			if (x != 1.0 && !e.IsInertial)
			{
				x = Math.Min(1.15, Math.Max(0.85, x));
				SpreadsheetView activeView = ActiveView;
				activeView.ZoomFactor *= (float)x;
			}
		}

		}

		private ToolTipControlInfo CalculateToolTipInfo(object activeObject, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IHyperlinkViewInfo actualViewInfo = HyperlinkToolTipCalculator.GetActualViewInfo(activeObject);
			if (actualViewInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string actualText = HyperlinkToolTipCalculator.GetActualText(actualViewInfo);
			ToolTipControlInfo val = new ToolTipControlInfo((object)actualViewInfo, actualText);
			val.Position = PointExtensions.ToRootVisualSafe(point, (object)this);
			return val;
		}

		private void SafePrint(Action action)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			try
			{
				action();
			}
			catch (InvalidPrinterException ex)
			{
				ShowMessage(ex.Message, System.Windows.Forms.Application.ProductName, (PortableMessageBoxIcon)16);
			}
		}

		public void ShowPrintDialog()
		{
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			LegacyPrintableComponentLink link = new LegacyPrintableComponentLink((IBasePrintable)(object)InnerControl);
			try
			{
				link.CreateDocument();
				if (((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).Document.PageCount > 0)
				{
					SafePrint(delegate
					{
						string themeName = GetValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty) as string;
						link.Print(themeName);
					});
				}
				else
				{
					ShowWarningMessage(PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)118));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (link != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)link).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Print()
		{
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			LegacyPrintableComponentLink link = new LegacyPrintableComponentLink((IBasePrintable)(object)InnerControl);
			try
			{
				link.CreateDocument();
				if (((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).Document.PageCount > 0)
				{
					SafePrint(delegate
					{
						link.PrintDirect();
					});
				}
				else
				{
					ShowWarningMessage(PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)118));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (link != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)link).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Print(PrinterSettings printerSettings)
		{
			//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!PrintingHelper.Validate(printerSettings, InnerControl.ErrorHandler))
			{
				return;
			}
			LegacyPrintableComponentLink link = new LegacyPrintableComponentLink((IBasePrintable)(object)InnerControl);
			try
			{
				link.CreateDocument();
				if (((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).Document.PageCount > 0)
				{
					PrintDocumentEventHandler printEventHandler = PrintingHelper.GetPrintEventHandler((PrintingSystemBase)(object)link.PrintingSystem, printerSettings);
					((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).StartPrint += printEventHandler;
					SafePrint(delegate
					{
						link.PrintDirect();
					});
					((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).StartPrint -= printEventHandler;
				}
				else
				{
					ShowWarningMessage(PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)118));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (link != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)link).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ExecutePrinterAction(Action<LegacyPrintableComponentLink> action)
		{
			using LegacyPrintableComponentLink legacyPrintableComponentLink = new LegacyPrintableComponentLink((IBasePrintable)(object)InnerControl);
			legacyPrintableComponentLink.CreateDocument();
			if (((PrintingSystemBase)legacyPrintableComponentLink.PrintingSystem).Document.PageCount > 0)
			{
				action(legacyPrintableComponentLink);
			}
		}

		public SpreadsheetControl()
		{
			SetSpreadsheet(this, this);
			CommandProvider = new CommandProvider(this);
			MenuCustomizations = new ObservableCollection<SpreadsheetMenuCustomization>();
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<SpreadsheetControl>(this);
			accessor = new SpreadsheetControlAccessor(this);
			commandManager = new SpreadsheetControlBarCommandManager(this);
			innerControl = CreateInnerControl();
			threadIdleHandler = new ThreadIdleWeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl>(this, OnApplicationIdleHandler);
			preProcessInputEventHandler = new PreProcessInputWeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl>(this, delegate(SpreadsheetControl owner, object sender, PreProcessInputEventArgs args)
			{
				owner.OnPreProcessInput(sender, args);
			});
			ChartLayoutGalleryGroups = new ObservableCollection<ChartLayoutGalleryGroupInfo>();
			ChartLayoutGalleryGroups.Add(new ChartLayoutGalleryGroupInfo());
			TableStyleGalleryGroups = new TableStyleGalleryGroups();
			TableStylePopupGalleryGroups = new TableStylePopupGalleryGroups();
			PivotTableStyleGalleryGroups = new PivotTableStyleGalleryGroups();
			PivotTableStylePopupGalleryGroups = new PivotTableStylePopupGalleryGroups();
			ChartStyleGalleryGroups = new ChartStyleGalleryGroups();
			BeginInitializeInnerControl(keepContent: false);
			SubscribeOwnEvents();
			SubscribeInnerEvents();
			InnerControl.EndInitialize(true);
			AddCommandFactoryService();
			AddChartServices();
			AddShapeService();
			AddSparklineService();
			AddDIBCreationService();
			CreateLayoutUnitHandler();
			CreateToolTipController();
			PostponedActionHelper = new PostponedActionHelper();
			SetCurrentValue(OptionsProperty, new SpreadsheetControlOptions());
		}

		private void OnActiveSheetNameChanged()
		{
			if (IsInnerControlInitialized)
			{
				SetActiveSheetByName();
			}
			else
			{
				PostponeAction(new Action(SetActiveSheetByName), null);
			}
		}

		private void OnActiveSheetIndexChanged()
		{
			if (IsInnerControlInitialized)
			{
				SetActiveSheetByIndex();
			}
			else
			{
				PostponeAction(new Action(SetActiveSheetByIndex), null);
			}
		}

		private void SetActiveSheetByIndex()
		{
			List<IWorksheet> sheets = GetSheets();
			int count = ((SimpleCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection).Count;
			if (ActiveSheetIndex >= 0 && ActiveSheetIndex < count)
			{
				((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).DocumentModel.ActiveSheetIndex = ActiveSheetIndex;
			}
		}

		private void SetActiveSheetByName()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ActiveSheetName))
			{
				InternalSheetBase val = ((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[ActiveSheetName];
				if (val != null)
				{
					((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).DocumentModel.ActiveSheetIndex = ((SimpleCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection).IndexOf(val);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnActiveViewZoomChanged(int zoom)
		{
			if (IsInnerControlInitialized)
			{
				SetActiveViewZoom(zoom);
				return;
			}
			PostponeAction(new Action<int>(SetActiveViewZoom), new object[1] { zoom });
		}

		private void SetActiveViewZoom(int zoom)
		{
			InnerControl.ActiveView.ZoomFactor = (float)((double)zoom / 100.0);
		}

		private void OnOptionsChanged(SpreadsheetControlOptions oldValue, SpreadsheetControlOptions newValue)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string currentFileName = newValue?.Save.CurrentFileName ?? string.Empty;
			DocumentFormat currentFormat = newValue?.Save.CurrentFormat ?? DocumentFormat.Undefined;
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				currentFileName = oldValue.Save.CurrentFileName;
				currentFormat = oldValue.Save.CurrentFormat;
				oldValue.Invalidate();
				((ILogicalOwner)this).RemoveChild((object)oldValue);
			}
			DocumentOptions options = ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).Options;
			if (newValue != null && options != null)
			{
				((ILogicalOwner)this).AddChild((object)newValue);
				newValue.SetSource(options);
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					newValue.Save.CurrentFileName = currentFileName;
					newValue.Save.CurrentFormat = currentFormat;
				}
			}
		}

		public ICommand GetCommand(SpreadsheetCommandId id)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SpreadsheetWrappedCommand(this, id);
		}

		private void SetViewScrollbarVisibility(SetViewScrollbarVisibilityDelegate action, SpreadsheetElementVisibility visibility)
		{
			bool flag = CalculateScrollbarVisibility(visibility);
			if (ViewControl != null)
			{
				action(flag);
				return;
			}
			PostponeAction(action, new object[1] { flag });
		}

		private bool CalculateScrollbarVisibility(SpreadsheetElementVisibility visibility)
		{
			return visibility switch
			{
				SpreadsheetElementVisibility.Default => true, 
				SpreadsheetElementVisibility.Hidden => false, 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		public Rect GetCellBounds(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			if (InnerControl == null)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			System.Drawing.Rectangle cellBounds = InnerControl.GetCellBounds(columnIndex, rowIndex);
			if (cellBounds == System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty)
			{
				return Rect.Empty;
			}
			double num = 96.0 / (double)DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX;
			double num2 = 96.0 / (double)DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY;
			Rect rect = new Rect((double)cellBounds.X * num, (double)cellBounds.Y * num2, Math.Max(0.0, (double)cellBounds.Width * num), Math.Max(0.0, (double)cellBounds.Height * num2));
			System.Windows.Point point = ViewControl.TranslatePoint(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), this);
			System.Windows.Point location = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + rect.X, point.Y + rect.Y);
			location.Offset(-1.0 * num, -1.0 * num2);
			return new Rect(location, rect.Size);
		}

		private void OnDocumentSourceChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (IsInnerControlInitialized)
			{
				ProcessDocumentSource(newValue);
				return;
			}
			PostponedActionHelper.EnqueuePostponed(new Action<object>(ProcessDocumentSource), new object[1] { newValue });
		}

		private void ProcessDocumentSource(object source)
		{
			try
			{
				if (source == null)
				{
					CreateNewDocument();
					return;
				}
				string text = source as string;
				Uri result;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					if (text.IndexOf("://") != -1 && Uri.TryCreate(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out result))
					{
						LoadDocument(result);
					}
					else
					{
						LoadDocument(text);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (source is SpreadsheetDocumentSource source2)
				{
					LoadDocument(source2);
					return;
				}
				if (source is Stream stream)
				{
					LoadDocument(stream);
					return;
				}
				result = source as Uri;
				if (result != null)
				{
					LoadDocument(result);
				}
				else if (source is byte[] buffer)
				{
					LoadDocument(buffer);
				}
			}
			catch (SpreadsheetUnsupportedFormatException)
			{
				if (InnerControl != null)
				{
					((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).CreateNewDocument();
					string text2 = source as string;
					text2 = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) ? string.Empty : text2);
					((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).RaiseInvalidFormatException((Exception)new ArgumentException("Cannot recognize the format of data being loaded. Try to load a document from a stream using a SpreadsheetDocumentSource instance with the explicitly specified document format."), text2);
					if (((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)InnerControl).Options.Import.ThrowExceptionOnInvalidDocument)
					{
						throw;
					}
					return;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void LoadDocument(SpreadsheetDocumentSource source)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			LoadDocument(source.Stream, source.Format);
		}

		private void LoadDocument(Uri uri)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			StreamProvider val = new StreamProvider();
			Stream stream = val.GetStream((object)uri);
			if (stream == null)
			{
				CreateNewDocument();
				return;
			}
			using (stream)
			{
				LoadDocument(stream);
			}
		}

		{

				//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(DocumentModel)sender).LayoutUnitChanged -= h.Handler;
			}, (Func<WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, EventArgs, EventHandler>, EventHandler>)((WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, EventArgs, EventHandler> h) => h.OnEvent));
		}

			//IL_0045: Expected O, but got Unknown

		private void SpreadsheetControlUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			FinalizeMouse();
			FinalizeClipboard();
			ReleaseChartGalleryGroups();
			TableStyleGalleryGroups.Release();
			TableStylePopupGalleryGroups.Release();
			PivotTableStyleGalleryGroups.Release();
			PivotTableStylePopupGalleryGroups.Release();
			ChartStyleGalleryGroups.Release();
			CommandProvider?.Release();
			if (IsInnerControlInitialized && InnerControl != null)
			{
				InnerControl.HidePivotTableFieldsPanel();
			}
			if (InputManager.Current != null)
			{
				InputManager.Current.PreProcessInput -= ((WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, PreProcessInputEventArgs, PreProcessInputEventHandler>)preProcessInputEventHandler).Handler;
			}
			ComponentDispatcher.ThreadIdle -= ((WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, EventArgs, EventHandler>)threadIdleHandler).Handler;
			threadIdleSubscribeCount = Math.Max(0, threadIdleSubscribeCount - 1);
		}

		private void SpreadsheetControlLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInnerControlInitialized)
			{
				InnerControl.ResetPivotTableFieldsPanelVisibility();
			}
			if (InputManager.Current != null)
			{
				InputManager.Current.PreProcessInput -= ((WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, PreProcessInputEventArgs, PreProcessInputEventHandler>)preProcessInputEventHandler).Handler;
				InputManager.Current.PreProcessInput += ((WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, PreProcessInputEventArgs, PreProcessInputEventHandler>)preProcessInputEventHandler).Handler;
			}
			if (threadIdleSubscribeCount <= 0)
			{
				ComponentDispatcher.ThreadIdle += ((WeakEventHandler<SpreadsheetControl, EventArgs, EventHandler>)threadIdleHandler).Handler;
				threadIdleSubscribeCount++;
			}
			CommandProvider?.Initialize();
			InitializeMouse();
			InitializeClipboard();
			InitializeChartGalleryGroups();
			TableStyleGalleryGroups.Initialize(this);
			TableStylePopupGalleryGroups.Initialize(this);
			PivotTableStyleGalleryGroups.Initialize(this);
			PivotTableStylePopupGalleryGroups.Initialize(this);
			ChartStyleGalleryGroups.Initialize(this);
		}

		private void InitializeChartGalleryGroups()
		{
			foreach (ChartLayoutGalleryGroupInfo chartLayoutGalleryGroup in ChartLayoutGalleryGroups)
			{
				chartLayoutGalleryGroup.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		private void ReleaseChartGalleryGroups()
		{
			foreach (ChartLayoutGalleryGroupInfo chartLayoutGalleryGroup in ChartLayoutGalleryGroups)
			{
				chartLayoutGalleryGroup.Release();
			}
		}

		private void EndInitialization()
		{
			if (!IsInnerControlInitialized)
			{
				CreateGetureHelper();
				IsInnerControlInitialized = true;
				InitializeByTheme();
				DoInitializationOnLoadedCore();
				InitializeHeaderSize();
				UpdatePlatformSpecificProperties();
				UpdatePivotTableFieldsPanelVisibility();
				InternalUpdateBarManager();
				RaiseInnerControlInitialized();
				ExecutePostponedActions();
				keepContentOnControlInitialized = false;
			}
			Redraw();
		}

		private System.Drawing.Rectangle GetViewBounds(bool isLayoutView)
		{
			if (ViewControl == null)
			{
				return new System.Drawing.Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0);
			System.Drawing.Size viewport = ViewControl.GetViewport();
			double num = (isLayoutView ? HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidthD((double)viewport.Width, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX) : ((double)viewport.Width));
			double num2 = (isLayoutView ? HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeightD((double)viewport.Height, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY) : ((double)viewport.Height));
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rectangle = new System.Drawing.Rectangle((int)point.X, (int)point.Y, (int)num, (int)num2);
			if (ActiveView != null)
			{
				return ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)ActiveView.DocumentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits(rectangle, DpiX, DpiY);
			}
			return Units.PixelsToDocuments(rectangle, DpiX, DpiY);
		}

		private System.Windows.Input.Cursor GetSpecificCursor()
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(this);
			Rect scrollBarBounds = GetScrollBarBounds(VerticalScrollBar);
			Rect scrollBarBounds2 = GetScrollBarBounds(HorizontalScrollBar);
			if (scrollBarBounds.Contains(position) || scrollBarBounds2.Contains(position))
			{
				return System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
			}
			return ViewControl.GetResizeThumbCursor(position);
		}

		}

		private void ResizeViewCore()
		{
			System.Drawing.Rectangle viewBounds = ViewBounds;
			viewBounds.X = 0;
			viewBounds.Y = 0;
			SpreadsheetView activeView = ActiveView;
			if (activeView != null)

		{

			if (InnerControl != null)

				InnerControl.BackgroundThreadUIUpdater = new BeginInvokeBackgroundThreadUIUpdater(new ControlThreadSyncService(this));

				}
			}

		protected internal void DoInitializationOnPresenterLoaded()
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				EndInitialize();
				if (keepContentOnControlInitialized)
				{
					SetActiveViewZoom(ActiveViewZoom);
				}
				commandManager.UpdateBarItemsDefaultValues();
				commandManager.UpdateRibbonItemsDefaultValues();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
			UpdateUI += OnUpdateUI;
			OnUpdateUI(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Point GetPhysicalPoint(System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			if (DocumentModel == null)
			{
				return new System.Drawing.Point(0, 0);
			}
			int num = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits(point.X, DpiX);
			int num2 = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)DocumentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits(point.Y, DpiY);
			num = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(num, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX) - ViewBounds.Left;
			num2 = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(num2, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY) - ViewBounds.Top;
			return new System.Drawing.Point(num, num2);
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldDrawSelection()
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!base.IsEnabled || InnerControl.ForbidDrawSelection())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)Options.Behavior.Selection.ShowSelectionMode == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				return true;
			}

			{

			}
			return false;
		}

			ICellInplaceEditor inplaceEditor = (ICellInplaceEditor)(object)GetInplaceEditor();
			val.Add(inplaceEditor);
			if (formulaBarShouldFocused)
			{
				service.InplaceEditor.CurrentEditable = true;
			}
			else
			{
				inplaceEditor.CurrentEditable = true;
			}
			return (ICellInplaceEditor)(object)val;
		}

		internal SpreadsheetMenuType GetMenuType(SpreadsheetHitTestResult hitTestResult)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (hitTestResult.HeaderBox != null)
			{
				return GetHeaderMenuType(hitTestResult.HeaderBox.BoxType);
			}
			if (DocumentModel.GetActiveSheetCore().Selection.IsDrawingSelected)
			{
				return GetDrawingMenuType();
			}
			Worksheet activeSheet = DocumentModel.ActiveSheet;
			if (activeSheet == null)
			{
				return SpreadsheetMenuType.None;
			}
			if (activeSheet.TryGetPivotTable(activeSheet.Selection.ActiveCell) != null)
			{
				return SpreadsheetMenuType.PivotTable;
			}
			return SpreadsheetMenuType.Cell;
		}

		private SpreadsheetMenuType GetHeaderMenuType(HeaderBoxType headerBoxType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)headerBoxType == 0 || (int)headerBoxType == 3)
			{
				return SpreadsheetMenuType.ColumnHeading;
			}
			if ((int)headerBoxType == 1 || (int)headerBoxType == 4)
			{
				return SpreadsheetMenuType.RowHeading;
			}
			return SpreadsheetMenuType.SelectAllButton;
		}

		private SpreadsheetMenuType GetDrawingMenuType()
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SheetViewSelectionBase selection = DocumentModel.GetActiveSheetCore().Selection;
			if (selection.IsDrawingMultiSelection)
			{
				return SpreadsheetMenuType.DrawingObjects;
			}
			Chartsheet activeChartsheet = DocumentModel.ActiveChartsheet;
			if (activeChartsheet != null)
			{
				ChartsheetProtectionOptions protection = activeChartsheet.Properties.Protection;
				if (((SheetProtectionOptionsBase)protection).SheetLocked && protection.ContentLocked)
				{
					return SpreadsheetMenuType.None;
				}
				return GetMenuTypeChart(activeChartsheet.GetInnerDrawingObjectType());
			}
			DrawingObjectType drawingType = selection.CurrentContainer.GetDrawingObject(selection.SelectedDrawingIndexes[0]).DrawingType;
			return GetMenuTypeChart(drawingType);
		}

		private SpreadsheetMenuType GetMenuTypeChart(DrawingObjectType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)type != 1 && (int)type != 9)
			{
				return SpreadsheetMenuType.Picture;
			}
			return SpreadsheetMenuType.Chart;
		}

		public Cell GetCellFromPoint(PointF clientPoint)
		{
			if (InnerControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			WorksheetControl worksheetControl = ViewControl.WorksheetControl;
			System.Windows.Point point = TransformToVisual(worksheetControl).Transform(clientPoint.ToPoint());
			double scaleFactor = worksheetControl.ScaleFactor;
			if (scaleFactor != 1.0)
			{
				ScaleTransform scaleTransform = new ScaleTransform(scaleFactor, scaleFactor);
				point = scaleTransform.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y));
			}
			return InnerControl.GetCellFromPoint(GetPhysicalPoint(point.ToDrawingPoint()));
		}

		public SpreadsheetWrappedCommand(SpreadsheetControl control, SpreadsheetCommandId id)

			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		public bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			SpreadsheetCommand command = Command;
			if (command == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((Command)command).CanExecute();
		}

		public void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			SpreadsheetCommand command = Command;
			if (command != null)
			{
				((Command)command).Execute();
			}
		}
	}

		private SpreadsheetControl XpfControl => (SpreadsheetControl)(object)((SpreadsheetMouseHandlerStrategyBase)this).Control;

		public XpfResizeColumnMouseHandlerStateStrategy(ContinueResizeColumnsMouseHandlerState state)
			: base(state)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


		protected internal override void BeginVisualFeedback()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void DrawReversibleLine(int coordinate)
		{
			if (!drawLineLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				XpfControl.ViewControl.ShowResizeFeedback(canShow: true);
				XpfControl.ViewControl.DrawReversibleLine(coordinate, isVertical: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void EndVisualFeedback()
		{
			drawLineLocker.LockOnce();
			XpfControl.ViewControl.ShowResizeFeedback(canShow: false);
		}

		protected internal override void HideVisualFeedback()
		{
		}

		protected internal override void ShowVisualFeedback()
		{
		}
	}

		public CommandProvider(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)control, "control");
			this.control = control;
			CreateCommands();
		}

		internal void Initialize()
		{
			if (!isInitialized)
			{
				SubscribeControlEvents();
				isInitialized = true;
			}
		}

		internal void Release()
		{
			UnsubscribeControlEvents();
			isInitialized = false;
		}

		private void SubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			control.UpdateUI += OnUpdateUI;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			control.UpdateUI -= OnUpdateUI;
		}

		private void OnUpdateUI(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
			UpdateRibbonPageCategoriesState();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && control != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeControlEvents();
			}
		}

	public class SpreadsheetControlProvider : FrameworkElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty SpreadsheetControlProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SpreadsheetControl", typeof(SpreadsheetControl), typeof(SpreadsheetControlProvider), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnSpreadsheetControlChanged));

		public SpreadsheetControl SpreadsheetControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (SpreadsheetControl)GetValue(SpreadsheetControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SpreadsheetControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected static void OnSpreadsheetControlChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is SpreadsheetControlProvider spreadsheetControlProvider)
			{
				spreadsheetControlProvider.OnSpreadsheetControlChanged((SpreadsheetControl)e.OldValue, (SpreadsheetControl)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSpreadsheetControlChanged(SpreadsheetControl oldValue, SpreadsheetControl newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)newValue.InnerControl).RaiseUpdateUI();
			}
		}

		public SpreadsheetControlProvider()
		{
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}
	}
	public class SpreadsheetControlScrollBehavior : ScrollBehaviorBase
	{
		private const double OffsetPerRow = 10.0;

		private int scrollTickCounterVertical;

		private int scrollTickCounterHorizontal;

		public static int ScrollEventScarcity { get; set; } = 7;

		private static SpreadsheetControl GetSpreadsheetControl(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (SpreadsheetControl)d;
		}

		public override bool CanScrollDown(DependencyObject source)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanScrollLeft(DependencyObject source)
		{
			IScrollBarAdapter horizontalScrollBarAdapter = GetHorizontalScrollBarAdapter(source);
			if (horizontalScrollBarAdapter != null)
			{
				return horizontalScrollBarAdapter.Value > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CanScrollRight(DependencyObject source)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanScrollUp(DependencyObject source)
		{
			IScrollBarAdapter verticalScrollBarAdapter = GetVerticalScrollBarAdapter(source);
			if (verticalScrollBarAdapter != null)
			{
				return verticalScrollBarAdapter.Value > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool CheckHandlesMouseWheelScrolling(DependencyObject source)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void MouseWheelDown(DependencyObject source, int lineCount)
		{
		}

		public override void MouseWheelLeft(DependencyObject source, int lineCount)
		{
		}

		public override void MouseWheelRight(DependencyObject source, int lineCount)
		{
		}

		public override void MouseWheelUp(DependencyObject source, int lineCount)
		{
		}

		public override bool PreventMouseScrolling(DependencyObject source)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private static IScrollBarAdapter GetVerticalScrollBarAdapter(DependencyObject source)
		{
			SpreadsheetView activeView = GetSpreadsheetControl(source).ActiveView;
			if (activeView == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((OfficeScrollControllerBase)(object)activeView.VerticalScrollController).ScrollBarAdapter;
		}

		private static IScrollBarAdapter GetHorizontalScrollBarAdapter(DependencyObject source)
		{
			SpreadsheetView activeView = GetSpreadsheetControl(source).ActiveView;
			if (activeView == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((OfficeScrollControllerBase)(object)activeView.HorizontalScrollController).ScrollBarAdapter;
		}

		private static void Scroll(IScrollBarAdapter adapter, double offset)
		{
			if (adapter != null)
			{
				adapter.Maximum = Math.Max(adapter.Maximum, adapter.Value + adapter.LargeChange - 1 + (int)offset);
				adapter.Value += (int)offset;
				adapter.ApplyValuesToScrollBar();
			}
		}

		public override void ScrollToHorizontalOffset(DependencyObject source, double offset)
		{
			if (ScrollEventScarcity <= 0 || ++scrollTickCounterHorizontal % ScrollEventScarcity == 0)
			{
				scrollTickCounterHorizontal = 0;
				Scroll(GetHorizontalScrollBarAdapter(source), Math.Ceiling(offset / 10.0));
			}
		}

		public override void ScrollToVerticalOffset(DependencyObject source, double offset)
		{
			if (ScrollEventScarcity <= 0 || ++scrollTickCounterVertical % ScrollEventScarcity == 0)
			{
				scrollTickCounterVertical = 0;
				Scroll(GetVerticalScrollBarAdapter(source), (double)(-Math.Sign(offset)) * Math.Ceiling(Math.Abs(offset) / 10.0));
			}
		}
	}

		public SpreadsheetCommandId CommandId => id;

		protected internal SpreadsheetControl Spreadsheet => spreadsheet;

		public bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => IsVisible);
			}
			protected set
			{
				SetProperty(() => IsVisible, value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => IsChecked);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(() => IsChecked, value, OnIsCheckedChanged);
			}
		}

		public object EditValue
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => EditValue);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(() => EditValue, value, OnEditValueChanged);
			}
		}

		private bool CanExecuteInProcess => canExecuteCount > 0;

		public event EventHandler CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				onCanExecuteChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onCanExecuteChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onCanExecuteChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onCanExecuteChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public SpreadsheetUICommand()
		{
		}

		protected internal SpreadsheetUICommand(SpreadsheetCommandId id)
			: this(null, id)
		{
		}//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		internal SpreadsheetUICommand(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet, SpreadsheetCommandId id)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.spreadsheet = spreadsheet;
			this.id = id;
		}

		protected void IncCanExecuteCount()
		{
			canExecuteCount++;
		}

		protected void DecCanExecuteCount()
		{
			if (canExecuteCount == 0)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
			}
			canExecuteCount--;
		}

		private void OnIsCheckedChanged()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!CanExecuteInProcess)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(spreadsheet, CommandId, IsChecked);
			}
		}

		private void OnEditValueChanged()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!CanExecuteInProcess)
			{
				ExecuteCommand(spreadsheet, CommandId, EditValue);
			}
		}

		public bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (spreadsheet == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IncCanExecuteCount();
			try
			{
				SpreadsheetCommand val = spreadsheet.CreateCommand(CommandId);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ICommandUIState val2 = ((Command)val).CreateDefaultCommandUIState();
				((Command)val).UpdateUIState(val2);
				IsChecked = val2.Checked;
				IsVisible = val2.Visible;
				EditValue = val2.EditValue;
				return val2.Enabled;
			}
			finally
			{
				DecCanExecuteCount();
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (onCanExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				onCanExecuteChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			Execute(null, parameter);
		}

		public virtual void Execute(object invoker, object parameter)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = ObtainSpreadsheetControl(parameter);
			if (spreadsheetControl != null)
			{
				BarSplitButtonEditItem val = (BarSplitButtonEditItem)((invoker is BarSplitButtonEditItem) ? invoker : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					ExecuteCommand(spreadsheetControl, CommandId, val.EditValue);
				}
				else
				{
					ExecuteCommand(spreadsheetControl, CommandId, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ExecuteCommand(SpreadsheetControl control, SpreadsheetCommandId commandId, object parameter)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			try
			{
				if (control.ViewControl != null)
				{
					control.ViewControl.ClearMeasureCache();
				}
				control.CommandManager.ExecuteParametrizedCommand(CommandId, parameter);
			}
			catch (Exception e)
			{
				if (!control.HandleException(e))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual SpreadsheetControl ObtainSpreadsheetControl(object parameter)
		{
			if (spreadsheet != null)
			{
				return spreadsheet;
			}
			if (parameter is SpreadsheetControl result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (parameter is SpreadsheetControlAccessor spreadsheetControlAccessor)
			{
				return spreadsheetControlAccessor.SpreadsheetControl;
			}
			if (!(parameter is SpreadsheetControlProvider spreadsheetControlProvider))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return spreadsheetControlProvider.SpreadsheetControl;
		}
	}
	public class SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering : IClipboard
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private sealed class NativeClipboardOperation
		{
			private readonly SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering owner;

			private readonly bool? emptyClipboard;

			public NativeClipboardOperation(SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering owner)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			public NativeClipboardOperation(SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering owner, bool emptyClipboard)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				this.emptyClipboard = emptyClipboard;
			}

			public void Procceed()
			{
				Win32.OpenClipboard(owner.clipboardOwnerHandler);
				owner.skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD = true;
				Win32.EmptyClipboard();
				try
				{
					string[] dataFormatsForCopy = owner.dataProvider.DataFormatsForCopy;
					string[] array = dataFormatsForCopy;
					foreach (string str in array)
					{
						int enumValue = owner.formatCodeTable.GetEnumValue(str, -1, caseSensitive: true);
						Win32.SetClipboardData(enumValue, IntPtr.Zero);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					Win32.CloseClipboard();
					owner.skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD = false;
					owner.isOwner = true;
				}
			}

			public void Render()
			{
				Win32.OpenClipboard(owner.clipboardOwnerHandler);
				try
				{
					string[] dataFormatsAfterCloseDocument = owner.dataProvider.DataFormatsAfterCloseDocument;
					string[] array = dataFormatsAfterCloseDocument;
					foreach (string str in array)
					{
						int enumValue = owner.formatCodeTable.GetEnumValue(str, -1, caseSensitive: true);
						if (owner.isOwner)
						{
							RenderFormat(owner, enumValue, owner.clipboardOwnerHandler);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					Win32.CloseClipboard();
					if (emptyClipboard == true)
					{
						owner.isOwner = false;
					}
				}
			}

			internal static void RenderFormat(SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering owner, int formatCode, IntPtr ownerHandle)
			{
				object obj = owner.GetData(formatCode);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					obj = "\0";
					Clear(ownerHandle);
				}
				byte[] array = DataToByteArray(obj);
				if (array != null)
				{
					RenderFormat(formatCode, array);
				}
			}

			private static byte[] DataToByteArray(object data)
			{
				//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (data is byte[])
				{
					return (byte[])data;
				}
				if (data is MemoryStream)
				{
					return ((MemoryStream)data).ToArray();
				}
				if (data is ChunkedMemoryStream)
				{
					return ((ChunkedMemoryStream)data).ToArray();
				}
				if (data is string)
				{
					return Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes((string)data);
				}
				return null;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private static void RenderFormat(int formatCode, byte[] bytes)
			{
				int num = bytes.Length;
				IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
				IntPtr intPtr2 = IntPtr.Zero;
				try
				{
					intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(num);
					if (!(intPtr == IntPtr.Zero))
					{
						intPtr2 = Win32.GlobalLock(intPtr);
						if (intPtr2 == IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							HandleAllocationFail(intPtr, intPtr2);
							return;
						}
						Marshal.Copy(bytes, 0, intPtr2, num);
						Win32.GlobalUnlock(intPtr);
						Win32.SetClipboardData(formatCode, intPtr);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					HandleAllocationFail(intPtr, intPtr2);
				}
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			internal static void Clear(IntPtr ownerHandle)
			{
				Win32.OpenClipboard(ownerHandle);
				Win32.EmptyClipboard();
				Win32.CloseClipboard();
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private static void HandleAllocationFail(IntPtr hClipboardMemoryData, IntPtr pointer)
			{
				if (pointer != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Win32.GlobalUnlock(hClipboardMemoryData);
				}
				if (hClipboardMemoryData != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Marshal.FreeHGlobal(hClipboardMemoryData);
				}
			}
		}

		private const int WM_RENDERFORMAT = 773;

		private const int WM_RENDERALLFORMATS = 774;

		private const int WM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD = 775;

		private string FormatUnicodeText = OfficeDataFormats.UnicodeText;

		private string FormatBitmap = OfficeDataFormats.Bitmap;

		private const int CF_DIB = 8;

		private const int CF_UnicodeText = 13;

		private readonly IntPtr clipboardOwnerHandler;

		private TranslationTable<int> formatCodeTable = new TranslationTable<int>();

		private ICopiedRangeDataForClipboard dataProvider;

		private CopiedRangeProvider copiedRange;

		private EventHandler onChangedOutside;

		private bool skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD;

		private bool isOwner;

		public event EventHandler ChangedOutside
		{
			add
			{
				onChangedOutside = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onChangedOutside, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onChangedOutside = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onChangedOutside, value);
			}
		}

		public SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering(IntPtr clipboardOwnerHandler, ICopiedRangeDataForClipboard dataProvider)
		{
			this.clipboardOwnerHandler = clipboardOwnerHandler;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseChangedOutside()
		{
			onChangedOutside?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			NativeClipboardOperation.Clear(clipboardOwnerHandler);
		}

		public void LeaveCopiedDataInClipboard()
		{
			if (!isOwner)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD = true;
				OnRenderAllFormats(emptyClipboard: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD = false;
				isOwner = false;
			}
		}

		public void SetData(ICopiedRangeDataForClipboard dataProvider, CopiedRangeProvider copiedRange)
		{
			this.dataProvider = dataProvider;
			this.copiedRange = copiedRange;
			formatCodeTable = CreateFormatCodeTable(dataProvider);
			NativeClipboardOperation nativeClipboardOperation = new NativeClipboardOperation(this);
			PortableClipboard.PerformCopy((Action)nativeClipboardOperation.Procceed, (string)null, (bool?)null);
		}

		private TranslationTable<int> CreateFormatCodeTable(ICopiedRangeDataForClipboard dataProvider)
		{
			TranslationTable<int> translationTable = new TranslationTable<int>();
			string[] dataFormatsForCopy = dataProvider.DataFormatsForCopy;
			foreach (string text in dataFormatsForCopy)
			{
				if (string.Equals(text, FormatUnicodeText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					translationTable.Add(13, FormatUnicodeText);
				}
				else if (string.Equals(text, FormatBitmap, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					translationTable.Add(8, FormatBitmap);
				}
				else
				{
					RegisterFormatCode(text, translationTable);
				}
			}
			return translationTable;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public bool IsClipboardMessage(int msg)
		{
			if (msg != 773 && msg != 774)
			{
				return msg == 775;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool HandleWndProc(int msg, int wParam)
		{
			switch (msg)
			{
			case 773:
				OnRenderFormat(wParam);
				break;
			case 774:
				OnRenderAllFormats();
				break;
			case 775:
				OnClipboardChangedOutside();
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnRenderFormat(int clipboardFormat)
		{
			if (isOwner)
			{
				NativeClipboardOperation.RenderFormat(this, clipboardFormat, clipboardOwnerHandler);
			}
		}

		private object GetData(int clipboardFormat)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected O, but got Unknown
			copiedRange.SetFilteredDataProvider((IPasteFilteredDataProvider)new PasteFilteredDataProvider());
			try
			{
				string stringValue = formatCodeTable.GetStringValue(clipboardFormat, -1);
				return dataProvider.GetData(stringValue, copiedRange);
			}
			finally
			{
				copiedRange.ResetFilteredDataProvider();
			}
		}

		private void OnClipboardChangedOutside()
		{
			if (skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD)
			{
				skipNextWM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD = false;
				return;
			}
			isOwner = false;
			RaiseChangedOutside();
		}

		private void OnRenderAllFormats(bool emptyClipboard)
		{
			if (emptyClipboard)
			{
				Clear();
			}
			if (isOwner)
			{
				NativeClipboardOperation nativeClipboardOperation = new NativeClipboardOperation(this, emptyClipboard);
				PortableClipboard.PerformCopy((Action)nativeClipboardOperation.Render, (string)null, (bool?)null);
			}
		}

		private void OnRenderAllFormats()
		{
			OnRenderAllFormats(emptyClipboard: false);
			isOwner = false;
		}

		private void RegisterFormatCode(string formatString, TranslationTable<int> result)
		{
			int key = Win32.RegisterClipboardFormat(formatString);
			result.Add(key, formatString);
		}
	}

	public class SpreadsheetSvgImageExtension : SvgImageSourceExtension
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			IProvideValueTarget provideValueTarget = (IProvideValueTarget)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IProvideValueTarget));
			if (provideValueTarget != null && provideValueTarget.TargetObject is ImageSelectorExtension)
			{
				return this;
			}
			SvgImage val = ExternalImageLoader.LoadSvgImage(Name);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateImageSource(val);
		}

		private object CreateImageSource(SvgImage image)
		{
			System.Windows.Size size = ((BaseSvgImageSourceExtension)this).Size ?? new System.Windows.Size(image.Width, image.Height);
			return WpfSvgRenderer.CreateImageSource(image, size, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (string)null, ((BaseSvgImageSourceExtension)this).AutoSize, ((BaseSvgImageSourceExtension)this).UsePalette);
		}
	}

	public static class BeginGroupHelper
	{
		public static bool GetBeginGroup(BarItem item)
		{
			BarItemLinkCollection parentLinks = GetParentLinks(item);
			if (parentLinks == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BarItemLinkBase val = ((((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)item.Links).Count > 0) ? ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)item.Links)[0] : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)parentLinks).IndexOf(val);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)parentLinks)[num] is BarItemLinkSeparator;
		}

		public static void SetBeginGroup(BarItem item, bool value)
		{
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				return;
			}
			BarItemLinkBase val = ((((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)item.Links).Count > 0) ? ((Collection<BarItemLinkBase>)(object)item.Links)[0] : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}

			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}

				if (num > 0)

				}

		}

		public XpfSpreadsheetContentMenuBuilder(ISpreadsheetControl control, IMenuBuilderUIFactory<SpreadsheetCommand, SpreadsheetCommandId> uiFactory)
			: base(control, uiFactory)
		{
		}

		public override IDXPopupMenu<SpreadsheetCommandId> CreatePopupMenu()
		{
			SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo spreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo = (SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo)((CommandBasedPopupMenuBuilder<SpreadsheetCommand, SpreadsheetCommandId>)this).CreatePopupMenu();
			SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = (SpreadsheetControl)(object)((SpreadsheetMenuBuilder)this).Control;
			spreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo.MenuController = spreadsheetControl.GetMenuController();
			return spreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo;
		}
	}

	public class XpfICommandAdapter : ICommand
	{
		private readonly Command command;

		public event EventHandler CanExecuteChanged;

		public XpfICommandAdapter(Command command)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)command, "command");
			this.command = command;
		}

		public bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return command.CanExecute();
		}

		public void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			command.Execute();
		}

		private void FakeMethod()
		{
			this.CanExecuteChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}
	}
	public static class MenuItemHelper
	{
		internal static string ValidateMenuCaption(string caption)
		{
			return caption.Replace("&", string.Empty);
		}

		public static ICommand WrapCommand(SpreadsheetCommand command)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((ControlCommand<ISpreadsheetControl, SpreadsheetCommandId, XtraSpreadsheetStringId>)(object)command).Id == new SpreadsheetCommandId(0))
			{
				return new XpfICommandAdapter((Command)(object)command);
			}
			return new SpreadsheetUICommand(((ControlCommand<ISpreadsheetControl, SpreadsheetCommandId, XtraSpreadsheetStringId>)(object)command).Id);
		}

		public static ImageSource GetGlyph(SpreadsheetCommand command)
		{
			if (!(((ControlCommand<ISpreadsheetControl, SpreadsheetCommandId, XtraSpreadsheetStringId>)(object)command).Control is SpreadsheetControl control))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (AllowUseSvgImages(control))
			{
				SvgImage svgImage = ((Command)command).SvgImage;
				if (svgImage == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(svgImage.Width * ScreenHelper.ScaleX, svgImage.Height * ScreenHelper.ScaleX);
				return WpfSvgRenderer.CreateImageSource(svgImage, size, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (string)null, true, true);
			}
			System.Drawing.Image image = ((Command)command).Image;
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ImageHelper.CreatePlatformImage(image).Source;
		}

		public static bool AllowUseSvgImages(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool? flag = (bool?)control.GetValue(SpreadsheetControl.UseDefaultSvgImagesProperty);
			if (!flag.HasValue)
			{
				return ApplicationThemeHelper.UseDefaultSvgImages;
			}
			return flag.Value;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CommandMenuBuilderInfo<T> : IDXPopupMenu<T>, IDXMenuItemBase<T> where T : struct
	{
		private readonly List<IDXMenuItemBase<T>> items;

		private string caption;

		private T id;

		private bool beginGroup;

		private bool isVisible = true;

		private bool isEnabled = true;

		internal List<IDXMenuItemBase<T>> Items => items;

		public BarManagerMenuController MenuController { get; set; }

		public string Caption
		{
			get
			{
				return caption;
			}
			set
			{
				caption = value;
			}
		}

		public T Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		public int ItemsCount => Items.Count;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return isVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				isVisible = value;
			}
		}

		public bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				return isEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				isEnabled = value;
			}
		}

		public bool BeginGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return beginGroup;
			}
			set
			{
				beginGroup = value;
			}
		}

		protected CommandMenuBuilderInfo()
		{
			items = new List<IDXMenuItemBase<T>>();
		}

		public void AddItem(IDXMenuItemBase<T> item)
		{
			Items.Add(item);
		}
	}
	public class SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo : CommandMenuBuilderInfo<SpreadsheetCommandId>
	{
	}
	public class XpfSpreadsheetMenuBuilderUIFactory : IMenuBuilderUIFactory<SpreadsheetCommand, SpreadsheetCommandId>
	{
		public IDXMenuCheckItemCommandAdapter<SpreadsheetCommandId> CreateMenuCheckItemAdapter(SpreadsheetCommand command)
		{
			return new SpreadsheetMenuCheckItemCommandSLAdapter(command);
		}

		public virtual IDXMenuItemCommandAdapter<SpreadsheetCommandId> CreateMenuItemAdapter(SpreadsheetCommand command)
		{
			return new SpreadsheetMenuItemCommandSLAdapter(command);
		}

		public virtual IDXPopupMenu<SpreadsheetCommandId> CreatePopupMenu()
		{
			return new SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo();
		}

		public IDXPopupMenu<SpreadsheetCommandId> CreateSubMenu()
		{
			return new SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo();
		}
	}

		public static string GetName(SpreadsheetCommandId commandId)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (nameTable.TryGetValue(commandId, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.Services
{
	public class ChartControllerFactoryService : IChartControllerFactoryService
	{
		ModelControllerFactoryBase IChartControllerFactoryService.CreateFactory(IChartBase chart)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ChartEx val = (ChartEx)(object)((chart is ChartEx) ? chart : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				SeriesExLayout layout = val.Layout;
				return (layout - 4) switch
				{
					0 => null, 
					2 => new TreeMapModelControllerFactory(), 
					1 => new SunburstModelControllerFactory(), 
					_ => new XpfChartsModelControllerFactory(), 
				};
			}
			return new XpfChartsModelControllerFactory();
		}
	}
	public static class OfficeChartsWpfExtensions
	{
		public static void ActivateWpfCharts(this OfficeCharts instance)
		{
			OfficeChartFactory.Register((IOfficeChartFactory)new WpfSpreadsheetOfficeChartFactory());
		}
	}
	public interface ISpreadsheetContextMenuService
	{
		bool ShowContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control);

		BarManagerMenuController GetMenuController(SpreadsheetControl control);
	}
	public class SpreadsheetContextMenuService : ISpreadsheetContextMenuService
	{
		private SpreadsheetPopupMenu menu;

		private BarManagerMenuController menuController;

		private SpreadsheetPopupMenu Menu => menu;

		internal BarManagerMenuController MenuController => menuController;

		public SpreadsheetContextMenuService(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			menu = new SpreadsheetPopupMenu(control);
			((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)menu).Init();
			menuController = new BarManagerMenuController((PopupMenu)(object)Menu);
		}

		private void ShowContentContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			System.Windows.Point mousePosition = GetMousePosition(control.ViewControl.WorksheetControl);
			SpreadsheetHitTestResult val = control.InnerControl.ActiveView.CalculatePageHitTest(mousePosition.ToDrawingPoint());
			if (val != null && val.IsValid((DocumentLayoutDetailsLevel)2))
			{
				ShowContextMenu(control, control.GetMenuType(val));
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetMousePosition(WorksheetControl worksheet)
		{
			System.Windows.Point position = Mouse.GetPosition(worksheet);
			return worksheet.GetPointConsideringScale(position);
		}

		private void ShowTabSelectorContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			ShowContextMenu(control, SpreadsheetMenuType.SheetTab);
		}

		internal void ShowAutoFilterContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			point = CorrectAutoFilterPoint(control, point);
			ShowContextMenu(control, SpreadsheetMenuType.AutoFilter, point);
		}

		internal void ShowPivotTableAutoFilterContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			point = CorrectAutoFilterPoint(control, point);
			ShowContextMenu(control, SpreadsheetMenuType.PivotTableAutoFilter, point);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CorrectAutoFilterPoint(SpreadsheetControl control, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			double num = 96.0 / (double)DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi;
			point = new System.Windows.Point(point.X * num, point.Y * num);
			point = control.ViewControl.TransformToVisual(control).Transform(point);
			point.Offset(HotZonePainter.AutoFilterImageOffset, HotZonePainter.AutoFilterImageOffset);
			return point;
		}

		private void ShowContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control, SpreadsheetMenuType menuType)
		{
			ShowContextMenu(control, menuType, Mouse.GetPosition(control));
		}

		private void ShowContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control, SpreadsheetMenuType menuType, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (menuType != SpreadsheetMenuType.None)
			{
				Menu.MenuType = menuType;
				Menu.MenuBuilderInfo = CreateMenuBuilderInfo(control, menuType);
				((Popup)(object)Menu).PlacementTarget = control;
				((Popup)(object)Menu).Placement = PlacementMode.Relative;
				((Popup)(object)Menu).HorizontalOffset = point.X;
				((Popup)(object)Menu).VerticalOffset = point.Y;
				((Popup)(object)Menu).IsOpen = true;
			}
		}

		private SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo CreateMenuBuilderInfo(SpreadsheetControl control, SpreadsheetMenuType menuType)
		{
			return (SpreadsheetMenuBuilderInfo)((CommandBasedPopupMenuBuilder<SpreadsheetCommand, SpreadsheetCommandId>)(menuType switch
			{
				SpreadsheetMenuType.AutoFilter => new XpfSpreadsheetAutoFilterMenuBuilder((ISpreadsheetControl)(object)control, new XpfSpreadsheetMenuBuilderUIFactory()), 
				SpreadsheetMenuType.PivotTable => new XpfSpreadsheetPivotTableMenuBuilder((ISpreadsheetControl)(object)control, new XpfSpreadsheetMenuBuilderUIFactory()), 
				SpreadsheetMenuType.PivotTableAutoFilter => new XpfSpreadsheetPivotTableAutoFilterMenuBuilder((ISpreadsheetControl)(object)control, new XpfSpreadsheetMenuBuilderUIFactory()), 
				SpreadsheetMenuType.SheetTab => new XpfSpreadsheetTabSelectorMenuBuilder((ISpreadsheetControl)(object)control, new XpfSpreadsheetMenuBuilderUIFactory()), 
				_ => new XpfSpreadsheetContentMenuBuilder((ISpreadsheetControl)(object)control, new XpfSpreadsheetMenuBuilderUIFactory()), 
			})).CreatePopupMenu();
		}

		bool ISpreadsheetContextMenuService.ShowContextMenu(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			SpreadsheetHitTestType hitTest = control.GetHitTest(Mouse.GetPosition(control.ViewControl));
			bool result = false;
			switch (hitTest)
			{
			case SpreadsheetHitTestType.Worksheet:
				ShowContentContextMenu(control);
				result = true;
				break;
			case SpreadsheetHitTestType.TabSelector:
				ShowTabSelectorContextMenu(control);
				result = true;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		BarManagerMenuController ISpreadsheetContextMenuService.GetMenuController(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			return MenuController;
		}
	}
}

	{
		public override void RegisterChartPlatformServices(System.ComponentModel.Design.IServiceContainer container)

		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.Extensions.Internal
{
	public static class PointExtensions
	{
		public static System.Drawing.Point ToDrawingPoint(this System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Drawing.Point((int)point.X, (int)point.Y);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point ToPoint(this System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point ToPoint(this PointF point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y);
		}
	}
	public static class SizeExtensions
	{
		public static System.Drawing.Size ToDrawingSize(this System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			return new System.Drawing.Size((int)size.Width, (int)size.Height);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Size ToSize(this System.Drawing.Size size)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0, size.Width), Math.Max(0, size.Height));
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.Automation
{
	public static class AutomationHelper
	{
		public static void SetupUIElement(FrameworkElement root, string name, SpreadsheetControlStringId automationNameId)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(root, name);
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				SetupUIElement(frameworkElement, XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(automationNameId));
			}
		}

		public static void SetupUIElement(FrameworkElement root, string name, SpreadsheetControlStringId automationNameId, SpreadsheetControlStringId automationHelpTextId)
		{
			FrameworkElement element = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(root, name);
			SetupUIElement(element, automationNameId, automationHelpTextId);
		}

		public static void SetupUIElement(UIElement element, SpreadsheetControlStringId automationNameId, SpreadsheetControlStringId automationHelpTextId)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				SetupUIElement(element, XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(automationNameId));
				element.SetValue(AutomationProperties.HelpTextProperty, XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(automationHelpTextId));
			}
		}

		public static void SetupUIElement(UIElement element, string automationName)
		{
			element.SetValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, automationName);
		}
	}

	public class AutoFilterImageCache
	{
		private string[] imageNames = new string[6] { "DropDown", "Filtered", "Ascending", "Descending", "FilteredAndAscending", "FilteredAndDescending" };

		private ImageSource[] imageSources;

		public AutoFilterImageCache()
		{
			ResetCache();
		}

		public void ResetCache()
		{
			imageSources = new ImageSource[imageNames.Length];
		}

		public ImageSource GetImageSource(int imageIndex)
		{
			ImageSource imageSource = imageSources[imageIndex];
			if (imageSource != null)
			{
				return imageSource;
			}
			string text = imageNames[imageIndex];
			Stream manifestResourceStream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.Images.AutoFilter." + text + ".png");
			if (manifestResourceStream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXImage image = DXImage.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
			imageSource = image.ToImageSource();
			imageSources[imageIndex] = imageSource;
			return imageSource;
		}

		public ImageSource GetImageSource(IFilterHotZone hotZone)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = ((!(hotZone is AutoFilterColumnHotZone)) ? CalculatePivotTableFilterImageIndex((PivotTableFilterHotZone)(object)((hotZone is PivotTableFilterHotZone) ? hotZone : null)) : CalculateAutoFilterImageIndex((AutoFilterColumnHotZone)(object)((hotZone is AutoFilterColumnHotZone) ? hotZone : null)));
			return GetImageSource(num);
		}

		public int CalculateAutoFilterImageIndex(AutoFilterColumnHotZone hotZone)
		{
			SortCondition sortCondition = hotZone.SortCondition;
			if (hotZone.FilterColumn.IsNonDefault)
			{
				if (sortCondition == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (!sortCondition.Descending)
				{
					return 4;
				}
				return 5;
			}
			if (sortCondition == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!sortCondition.Descending)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			return 3;
		}

		public int CalculatePivotTableFilterImageIndex(PivotTableFilterHotZone hotZone)
		{
			if (hotZone.IsFilterApplied)
			{
				if (!hotZone.IsSortApplied)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (!hotZone.SortTypeDescending)
				{
					return 4;
				}
				return 5;
			}
			if (!hotZone.IsSortApplied)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!hotZone.SortTypeDescending)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			return 3;
		}
	}
