	public class CellControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextSettingsProperty;

		private bool updateFormattedText;

		private FormattedText fText;

		private System.Windows.Point textTopLeft;

		private int rightOffset = 2;

		public TextSettings TextSettings
		{
			get
			{
				return (TextSettings)GetValue(TextSettingsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextSettingsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal SpreadsheetPropertiesProvider SpreadsheetProvider => GetValue(SpreadsheetViewControl.SpreadsheetProviderProperty) as SpreadsheetPropertiesProvider;

		private double ScaleFactor => SpreadsheetProvider.ScaleFactor;

		internal int PatchWidth => 1;

		static CellControl()
		{
			TextSettingsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TextSettings", typeof(TextSettings), typeof(CellControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellControl)d).OnTextSettingsChanged();
			}));
		}

		public CellControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<CellControl>(this);
		}

		private void OnTextSettingsChanged()
		{
			updateFormattedText = true;
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (double.IsInfinity(constraint.Width) || double.IsInfinity(constraint.Height))
			{
				FormattedText formattedText = CreateFormattedText();
				return new System.Windows.Size(formattedText.Width / ScaleFactor, formattedText.Height / ScaleFactor);
			}
			return constraint;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			base.ClipToBounds = true;
			if (updateFormattedText)
			{
				updateFormattedText = false;
				UpdateFormattedText();
			}
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, null, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, base.ActualWidth, base.ActualHeight));
			drawingContext.PushTransform(new ScaleTransform(1.0 / ScaleFactor, 1.0 / ScaleFactor));
			try
			{
				if (TextSettings.RichText.Count > 0)
				{
					DrawRichText(drawingContext, TextSettings.RichText);
				}
				else
				{
					if (fText == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (RotatedTextUtils.IsRotated(TextSettings.TextRotation))
					{
						if (TextSettings.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap)
						{
							DrawRotatedString(drawingContext, fText, textTopLeft);
						}
						else
						{
							DrawRotatedMultilineString(drawingContext);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						drawingContext.DrawText(fText, textTopLeft);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				drawingContext.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void DrawRichText(DrawingContext drawingContext, List<TextSettings> richText)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			double num3 = base.VisualOffset.X * ScaleFactor;
			foreach (TextSettings item in richText)
			{
				fText = CreateFormattedText(item.Text, item, item.TextWrapping, 1.0);
				Rect textBounds = item.TextBounds;
				double y;
				if (textBounds.Y < 0.0)
				{
					if (num2 == double.MinValue)
					{
						num2 = CalcTopRenderPositionFromAlignment(TextSettings.TextBounds.Y, fText.Height);
					}
					y = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					y = textBounds.Y;
				}
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(textBounds.X - num3, y);
				double num4 = point.Y + fText.Baseline;
				if (Math.Abs(num - num4) > 1.0)
				{
					num = num4;
				}
				else
				{
					point.Y = num - fText.Baseline;
				}
				if (RotatedTextUtils.IsRotated(item.TextRotation))
				{
					DrawRotatedStringCore(drawingContext, fText, point);
					continue;
				}
				drawingContext.DrawText(fText, point);
				if (item.HasUnderline)
				{
					SolidColorBrush brush = new SolidColorBrush(item.Foreground);
					drawingContext.DrawRectangle(brush, null, item.UnderlineBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawRotatedString(DrawingContext drawingContext, FormattedText text, System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			System.Drawing.Size nonRotatedSize = new System.Drawing.Size((int)text.Width, (int)text.Height);
			Rect textBounds = TextSettings.TextBounds;
			textBounds.Scale(ScaleFactor, ScaleFactor);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds = WinFormsCompatibilityExtensions.ToWinFormsRectangle(textBounds);
			System.Drawing.Point position2 = WinFormsCompatibilityExtensions.ToWinFormsPoint(position);
			DXStringFormat stringFormat = GetStringFormat();
			position = WinFormsCompatibilityExtensions.FromWinForms(RotatedTextUtils.ArrangeRotatedTextToBounds(bounds, nonRotatedSize, position2, TextSettings.TextRotation, stringFormat));
			DrawRotatedStringCore(drawingContext, text, position);
		}

		private void DrawRotatedStringCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, FormattedText text, System.Windows.Point position)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawRotatedString(text, position, -TextSettings.TextRotation, TextSettings.VerticalAlignment, TextSettings.TextAlignment);
		}

		private void DrawRotatedMultilineString(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			DXStringFormat stringFormat = GetStringFormat();
			if (stringFormat == null)
			{
				DrawRotatedStringCore(drawingContext, fText, textTopLeft);
				return;
			}
			string[] textLines = GetTextLines(stringFormat);
			FormattedText maxLine = GetMaxLine(textLines);
			System.Windows.Point point = CalcTopLeftRenderPointFromAlignment(maxLine);
			System.Drawing.Size rotatedFormattedTextSize = GetRotatedFormattedTextSize(maxLine);
			double a = RotatedTextUtils.ConvertDegreesToRadian(TextSettings.TextRotation);
			double num = (double)(int)maxLine.Height / Math.Sin(a);
			int num2 = Math.Sign(TextSettings.TextRotation);
			if (stringFormat.Alignment == DXStringAlignment.Far)
			{
				num2 *= -1;
			}
			if (stringFormat.Alignment == DXStringAlignment.Center)
			{
				point.X -= (int)(num * (double)(textLines.Length - 1)) / 2;
			}
			else if (num2 < 0)
			{
				point.X -= (int)(num * (double)(textLines.Length - 1));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < textLines.Length; i++)
			{
				FormattedText text = CreateFormattedText(textLines[i], TextSettings, TextWrapping.NoWrap, ScaleFactor);
				System.Drawing.Size rotatedFormattedTextSize2 = GetRotatedFormattedTextSize(text);
				int num3 = (rotatedFormattedTextSize.Height - rotatedFormattedTextSize2.Height) / 2;
				int num4 = 0;
				if (stringFormat.LineAlignment == DXStringAlignment.Near)
				{
					num4 = num3;
				}
				else if (stringFormat.LineAlignment == DXStringAlignment.Far)
				{
					num4 = -num3;
				}
				if (stringFormat.Alignment == DXStringAlignment.Center)
				{
					num3 = 0;
				}
				System.Windows.Point position = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + (double)(int)(num * (double)i), point.Y + (double)(num4 + num3 * num2));
				DrawRotatedStringCore(drawingContext, text, position);
			}
		}

		private string[] GetTextLines(DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SpreadsheetGdiMeasurer val = new SpreadsheetGdiMeasurer((DocumentLayoutUnitConverter)new DocumentLayoutUnitDocumentConverter(), false, false);
			SpreadsheetTextFormatter val2 = new SpreadsheetTextFormatter(DXGraphicsUnit.Document, (IMeasurer)(object)val);
			int maxHeight = (int)TextSettings.TextBounds.Height;
			int height = TextSettings.Font.Height;
			int value = RotatedTextUtils.GetMaxRotatedWidth(height, maxHeight, TextSettings.TextRotation) + PatchWidth;
			value = new DocumentLayoutUnitPixelsConverter(DocumentModelDpi.DpiX, DocumentModelDpi.DpiY).LayoutUnitsToDocuments(value);
			return val2.FormatMultilineText(fText.Text, SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXFont(TextSettings.Font), (float)value, 2.1474836E+09f, stringFormat);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Size GetRotatedFormattedTextSize(FormattedText text)
		{
			System.Drawing.Size nonRotatedSize = new System.Drawing.Size((int)text.Width, (int)text.Height);
			return RotatedTextUtils.ApplyRotationRelativeHorizon(nonRotatedSize, TextSettings.TextRotation);
		}

		private DXStringFormat GetStringFormat()
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XlHorizontalAlignment xlHorizontalAlignment = TextInfoCalculator.GetXlHorizontalAlignment(TextSettings.TextAlignment);
			XlVerticalAlignment xlVerticalAlignment = TextInfoCalculator.GetXlVerticalAlignment(TextSettings.VerticalAlignment);
			int key = StringFormatProvider.CalculateAlignmentHash(xlHorizontalAlignment, xlVerticalAlignment, wrapText: true);
			StringFormatProvider.StringFormats.TryGetValue(key, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		private FormattedText GetMaxLine(string[] lines)
		{
			double num = -2147483648.0;
			FormattedText result = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
			{
				FormattedText formattedText = CreateFormattedText(lines[i], TextSettings, TextWrapping.NoWrap, ScaleFactor);
				if (formattedText.Width > num)
				{
					num = formattedText.Width;
					result = formattedText;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateFormattedText()
		{
			if (TextSettings != null && TextSettings.RichText.Count == 0)
			{
				fText = CreateFormattedText();
				textTopLeft = CalcTopLeftRenderPointFromAlignment(fText);
			}
			else
			{
				fText = null;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CalcTopLeftRenderPointFromAlignment(FormattedText fText)
		{
			Rect textBounds = TextSettings.TextBounds;
			TextAlignment textAlignment = TextSettings.TextAlignment;
			double x = (TextSettings.EnhancedLayout ? CalcLeftRenderPositionForEnhancedLayout(textAlignment, textBounds) : CalcLeftRenderPositionForOldLayout(textAlignment, textBounds));
			double y = CalcTopRenderPositionFromAlignment(textBounds.Y, fText.Height);
			return new System.Windows.Point(x, y);
		}

		private double CalcTopRenderPositionFromAlignment(double textBounds_Y, double textHeight)
		{
			double num = textBounds_Y * ScaleFactor;
			switch (TextSettings.VerticalAlignment)
			{
			case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
				num += base.ActualHeight * ScaleFactor - textHeight;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Center:
				num += base.ActualHeight / 2.0 * ScaleFactor - textHeight / 2.0;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcLeftRenderPositionForEnhancedLayout(TextAlignment textAlignment, Rect textBounds)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = base.VisualOffset.X * ScaleFactor;
			double num3 = textBounds.X * ScaleFactor;
			if (textAlignment == TextAlignment.Left)
			{
				num = Math.Max(0.0, num3 - num2);
			}
			if (TextSettings.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap || RotatedTextUtils.IsRotated(TextSettings.TextRotation))
			{
				switch (textAlignment)
				{
				case TextAlignment.Right:
					num = num3 + textBounds.Width * ScaleFactor - num2;
					break;
				case TextAlignment.Center:
					num = textBounds.Width / 2.0 * ScaleFactor + num3 - num2;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (TextSettings.TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap && textAlignment == TextAlignment.Center)
			{
				num += 0.5;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcLeftRenderPositionForOldLayout(TextAlignment textAlignment, Rect textBounds)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = textBounds.X * ScaleFactor;
			double num3 = (double)rightOffset * ScaleFactor;
			if (textAlignment == TextAlignment.Left)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num3, num2 - num3);
			}
			if (TextSettings.TextWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap || RotatedTextUtils.IsRotated(TextSettings.TextRotation))
			{
				switch (textAlignment)
				{
				case TextAlignment.Right:
					num = Math.Min(base.ActualWidth * ScaleFactor - num3, num2 + textBounds.Width * ScaleFactor);
					break;
				case TextAlignment.Center:
					num = (base.ActualWidth * ScaleFactor + num2) / 2.0 - 1.0;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (TextSettings.TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap && textAlignment == TextAlignment.Center)
			{
				num += 0.5;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private FormattedText CreateFormattedText()
		{
			return CreateFormattedText(TextSettings.Text, TextSettings, TextSettings.TextWrapping, ScaleFactor);
		}

		private FormattedText CreateFormattedText(string text, TextSettings textSettings, TextWrapping textWrapping, double scale)
		{
			if (textWrapping == TextWrapping.NoWrap)
			{
				text = SingleLineTextHelper.GetSingleLine(text);
			}
			Typeface typeface = new Typeface(textSettings.FontFamily, textSettings.FontStyle, textSettings.FontWeight, textSettings.FontStretch);
			double size = FontSizeSaver.GetSize(textSettings.FontSize);
			size *= scale;
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, base.FlowDirection, typeface, size, new SolidColorBrush(textSettings.Foreground), null, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			formattedText.SetTextDecorations(textSettings.TextDecorations);
			if (textWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap)
			{
				formattedText.MaxTextWidth = textSettings.TextBounds.Width * scale + (double)PatchWidth * scale;
			}
			formattedText.TextAlignment = textSettings.TextAlignment;
			formattedText.Trimming = textSettings.TextTrimming;
			if (!double.IsNaN(base.Height))
			{
				formattedText.MaxTextHeight = FontSizeSaver.GetSize(base.Height * scale);
			}
			return formattedText;
		}
	}
	public static class FontSizeSaver
	{
		public static double GetSize(double value)
		{
			return Math.Max(0.009999999776482582, value);
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public class FloatingObjectsContainer : WorksheetPaintPanel, IDrawingBoxVisitor, IDocumentLayoutVisitor<List<int>>
	{
		internal abstract class DrawingBoxHelperBase<T> where T : DrawingBox
		{
			private readonly FloatingObjectsContainer parentPanel;

			private readonly T drawingBox;

			protected FloatingObjectsContainer ParentPanel => parentPanel;

			protected UIElementCollection Children => parentPanel.Children;

			protected List<int> MeasuredItems => parentPanel.measuredItems;

			protected abstract Dictionary<int, int> CachedIndexes { get; }

			protected abstract List<int> FreeContainerIndexes { get; }

			protected DocumentModel DocumentModel => parentPanel.DocumentModel;

			protected T DrawingBox => drawingBox;

			protected DrawingBoxHelperBase(FloatingObjectsContainer parentPanel, T drawingBox)
			{
				this.parentPanel = parentPanel;
				this.drawingBox = drawingBox;
			}

			public void Arrange()
			{
				int currentDrawingId = ParentPanel.currentDrawingId;
				UIElement container = GetContainer(currentDrawingId);
				if (container != null)
				{
					Rect rect = ((DrawingBox)drawingBox).Bounds.ToRect();
					MeasureContainer(currentDrawingId, rect, container);
					Transform2D transform2D = ((DrawingBox)drawingBox).Drawing.DrawingObject.Transform2D;
					System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds = ParentPanel.currentPane.Bounds;
					container.Clip = ((!bounds.IsEmpty) ? GetClip(bounds.ToRect(), rect, transform2D) : null);
					DrawingTransformHelper.ApplyTransform(container, rect, transform2D);
					container.Arrange(rect);
				}
			}

			protected virtual Geometry GetClip(Rect pageBounds, Rect bounds, Transform2D transform2D)
			{
				RectangleGeometry pageGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(pageBounds);
				RectangleGeometry boxGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(bounds);
				return CreateClipGeometry(pageGeometry, boxGeometry, bounds, transform2D);
			}

			protected Geometry CreateClipGeometry(RectangleGeometry pageGeometry, RectangleGeometry boxGeometry, Rect bounds, Transform2D transform2D)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = RectExtension.Center(bounds);
				float rotationAngleInDegrees = transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees();
				bool flipH = transform2D.FlipH;
				bool flipV = transform2D.FlipV;
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform(flipH ? (-1.0) : 1.0, flipV ? (-1.0) : 1.0, point.X, point.Y));
				transformGroup.Children.Add(new RotateTransform(rotationAngleInDegrees, point.X, point.Y));
				boxGeometry.Transform = transformGroup;
				Geometry geometry = Geometry.Combine(pageGeometry, boxGeometry, GeometryCombineMode.Intersect, Transform.Identity);
				TransformGroup transformGroup2 = new TransformGroup();
				transformGroup2.Children.Add(new RotateTransform(0f - rotationAngleInDegrees, point.X, point.Y));
				transformGroup2.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform(flipH ? (-1.0) : 1.0, flipV ? (-1.0) : 1.0, point.X, point.Y));
				transformGroup2.Children.Add(new TranslateTransform(0.0 - bounds.X, 0.0 - bounds.Y));
				geometry.Transform = transformGroup2;
				return geometry;
			}

			protected UIElement GetContainer(int drawingId)
			{
				if (CachedIndexes.ContainsKey(drawingId))
				{
					int index = CachedIndexes[drawingId];
					return Children[index];
				}
				int containerIndex = GetContainerIndex();
				CachedIndexes.Add(drawingId, containerIndex);
				return Children[containerIndex];
			}

			private int GetContainerIndex()
			{
				if (FreeContainerIndexes.Count > 0)
				{
					int result = FreeContainerIndexes[0];
					FreeContainerIndexes.RemoveAt(0);
					return result;
				}
				return Children.Add(CreateContainer());
			}

			protected virtual UIElement CreateContainer()
			{
				return new ContentPresenter();
			}

			protected virtual bool MeasureContainer(int drawingId, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				if (!MeasuredItems.Contains(drawingId))
				{
					MeasureContainerCore(drawingBox, bounds, container);
					MeasuredItems.Add(drawingId);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected abstract void MeasureContainerCore(T drawingBox, Rect bounds, UIElement container);
		}

		private class PictureBoxHelper : DrawingBoxHelperBase<PictureBox>
		{
			protected override Dictionary<int, int> CachedIndexes => base.ParentPanel.cachedImageIndexes;

			protected override List<int> FreeContainerIndexes => base.ParentPanel.freeImageContainerIndexes;

			public PictureBoxHelper(FloatingObjectsContainer parentPanel, PictureBox drawingBox)
				: base(parentPanel, drawingBox)
			{
			}

			protected override UIElement CreateContainer()
			{
				return new DrawingVisualHost();
			}

			protected override void MeasureContainerCore(PictureBox pictureBox, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				DrawingVisualHost drawingVisualHost = (DrawingVisualHost)container;
				Visual visual = PictureRenderer.CreateVisual(pictureBox.Picture, bounds.Size, renderEffects: true);
				drawingVisualHost.Items.Clear();
				drawingVisualHost.Items.Add(visual);
				drawingVisualHost.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, ((DrawingBox)pictureBox).Drawing.ZOrder);
				drawingVisualHost.Measure(bounds.Size);
			}

			protected override Geometry GetClip(Rect pageBounds, Rect bounds, Transform2D transform2D)
			{
				RectangleGeometry pageGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(pageBounds);
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = null;
				ContainerVisual visual = GetVisual();
				if (visual != null)
				{
					Rect descendantBounds = visual.DescendantBounds;
					if (!descendantBounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						descendantBounds.Offset(bounds.X, bounds.Y);
						rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(descendantBounds);
					}
				}
				if (rectangleGeometry == null)
				{
					rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(bounds);
				}
				return CreateClipGeometry(pageGeometry, rectangleGeometry, bounds, transform2D);
			}

			private ContainerVisual GetVisual()
			{
				int currentDrawingId = base.ParentPanel.currentDrawingId;
				if (!(GetContainer(currentDrawingId) is DrawingVisualHost drawingVisualHost) || drawingVisualHost.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return drawingVisualHost.Items[0] as ContainerVisual;
			}
		}

		internal class ChartBoxHelper : DrawingBoxHelperBase<ChartBox>
		{
			protected override Dictionary<int, int> CachedIndexes => base.ParentPanel.cachedChartIndexes;

			protected override List<int> FreeContainerIndexes => base.ParentPanel.freeChartContainerIndexes;

			public ChartBoxHelper(FloatingObjectsContainer parentPanel, ChartBox drawingBox)
				: base(parentPanel, drawingBox)
			{
			}

			protected override bool MeasureContainer(int drawingId, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				int drawingIndex = ((DrawingBox)base.DrawingBox).DrawingIndex;
				List<int> measuredChartIndexes = base.ParentPanel.measuredChartIndexes;
				if (!base.MeasureContainer(drawingId, bounds, container) && !measuredChartIndexes.Contains(drawingIndex))
				{
					measuredChartIndexes.Add(drawingIndex);
				}
				return true;
			}

			protected override void MeasureContainerCore(ChartBox box, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				IChartBase chart = box.Chart;
				if (TryMeasureChart(chart, ((DrawingBox)box).DrawingIndex, bounds, container))
				{
					((ContentPresenter)container).ContentTemplate = null;
					container.SetValue(System.Windows.Controls.Panel.ZIndexProperty, ((IDrawingObject)chart).ZOrder);
					container.Measure(bounds.Size);
				}
			}

			private bool TryMeasureChart(IChartBase chart, int drawingIndex, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				List<int> measuredChartIndexes = base.ParentPanel.measuredChartIndexes;
				if (measuredChartIndexes.Contains(drawingIndex))
				{
					return MeasureClonedChart(chart, bounds, container);
				}
				measuredChartIndexes.Add(drawingIndex);
				return TryMeasureChartCore(chart, bounds, container);
			}

			private bool MeasureClonedChart(IChartBase chart, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).History.DisableHistory();
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).BeginUpdate();
				base.ParentPanel.isChartCloneInProcess = true;
				try
				{
					IChartBase val = ((ICloneable<IChartBase>)(object)chart).Clone();
					try
					{
						return TryMeasureChartCore(val, bounds, container);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.DocumentModel.ApplyChanges((DocumentModelChangeActions)8388608);
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).EndUpdate();
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.DocumentModel).History.EnableHistory();
					base.ParentPanel.isChartCloneInProcess = false;
				}
			}

			internal static bool TryMeasureChartCore(IChartBase chart, Rect bounds, UIElement container)
			{
				IChartControllerFactoryService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)chart.DocumentModel).GetService<IChartControllerFactoryService>();
				ModelControllerFactoryBase modelControllerFactoryBase = ((service != null) ? service.CreateFactory(chart) : null);
				if (modelControllerFactoryBase == null || chart.Controller == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ModelRect bounds2 = new ModelRect(0.0, 0.0, bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
				chart.Controller.RenderChart(modelControllerFactoryBase.CreateRenderContext(bounds2, container));
				return true;
			}
		}

		public FloatingObjectsContainer()
		{
			RenderOptions.SetBitmapScalingMode(this, BitmapScalingMode.HighQuality);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (base.LayoutInfo == null)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			measuredChartIndexes = new List<int>();
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			base.LayoutInfo.Visit<List<int>>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<List<int>>)this, list);
			HideInvisibleDrawingObjects(list);
			return finalSize;
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<List<int>>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, List<int> visibleDrawingObjects)
		{
			ChunkedList<Page> pages = layout.Pages;
			if (pages != null && pages.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < pages.Count; i++)
				{
					visibleDrawingObjects.AddRange(ArrangeObjects((IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)pages[i], i));
				}
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<List<int>>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, List<int> visibleDrawingObjects)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)((SheetBase)layout.Sheet).SheetType == 2)
			{
				visibleDrawingObjects.AddRange(ArrangeObjects((IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)((ChartsheetLayout)layout).PaneForHotZonesCaching, 0));
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (Pane pane in ((WorksheetLayout)layout).Panes)
			{
				visibleDrawingObjects.AddRange(ArrangeObjects((IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)pane, num++));
			}
		}

		private List<int> ArrangeObjects(IDocumentLayoutPane layoutPane, int pageIndex)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			currentPane = layoutPane;
			try
			{
				foreach (DrawingBox drawingBox in layoutPane.DrawingBoxes)
				{
					currentDrawingId = GenerateDrawingId(drawingBox, pageIndex);
					list.Add(currentDrawingId);
					drawingBox.Visit((IDrawingBoxVisitor)(object)this);
				}
				return list;
			}
			finally
			{
				currentPane = null;
			}
		}

		internal int GenerateDrawingId(DrawingBox drawingBox, int pageIndex)
		{
			DrawingObject drawingObject = drawingBox.Drawing.DrawingObject;
			int id = drawingObject.Properties.Id;
			int sheetId = ((SheetBase)drawingObject.Sheet).SheetId;
			return sheetId * 65536 + pageIndex * 4096 + id;
		}

		private void HideInvisibleDrawingObjects(List<int> visibleDrawingObjects)
		{
			Action<UIElement> invalidateContainer = delegate(UIElement element)
			{
				((ContentPresenter)element).Content = null;
			};
			Action<UIElement> invalidateContainer2 = delegate(UIElement element)
			{
				((DrawingVisualHost)element).Items.Clear();
			};
			Action<UIElement> invalidateContainer3 = delegate(UIElement element)
			{
				if (element is DrawingVisualHost drawingVisualHost)
				{
					drawingVisualHost.Items.Clear();
				}
				else
				{
					((PlaceholderPanel)element).Content = null;
				}
			};
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedImageIndexes, freeImageContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer2);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedChartIndexes, freeChartContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedChartExIndexes, freeChartExContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedSlicerIndexes, freeSlicerContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedTimelineIndexes, freeTimelineContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedFormControlIndexes, freeFormControlContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer3);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedSmartArtGraphicIndexes, freeSmartArtGraphicContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedShapeIndexes, freeShapeContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer2);
			HideInvisibleDrawings(visibleDrawingObjects, cachedGroupShapeIndexes, freeGroupShapeContainerIndexes, invalidateContainer2);
		}

		private void HideInvisibleDrawings(List<int> visibleDrawingObjects, Dictionary<int, int> cachedIndexes, List<int> freeContainerIndexes, Action<UIElement> invalidateContainer)
		{
			List<int> list = cachedIndexes.Keys.Except(visibleDrawingObjects).ToList();
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				int num = cachedIndexes[item];
				UIElement uIElement = base.Children[num];
				uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				invalidateContainer(uIElement);
				cachedIndexes.Remove(item);
				measuredItems.Remove(item);
				freeContainerIndexes.Add(num);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearCache(bool deleteChildren)
		{
			if (!isChartCloneInProcess)
			{
				if (deleteChildren)
				{
					cachedImageIndexes.Clear();
					freeImageContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedChartIndexes.Clear();
					freeChartContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedChartExIndexes.Clear();
					freeChartExContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedSlicerIndexes.Clear();
					freeSlicerContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedTimelineIndexes.Clear();
					freeTimelineContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedFormControlIndexes.Clear();
					freeFormControlContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedSmartArtGraphicIndexes.Clear();
					freeSmartArtGraphicContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedShapeIndexes.Clear();
					freeShapeContainerIndexes.Clear();
					cachedGroupShapeIndexes.Clear();
					freeGroupShapeContainerIndexes.Clear();
					base.Children.Clear();
				}
				if (measuredItems != null)
				{
					measuredItems.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		public void ShowFormulaList(AutoCompleteSuggestedObjects suggestedObjects, int selectedIndex)
		{
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = 4;
			ListItemCollection items = edit.ListBox.Items;
			items.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				((CollectionBase)(object)items).Clear();
				foreach (AutoCompleteSuggestedObject suggestedObject in suggestedObjects)
				{
					items.Add((object)new FormulaAutoCompleteListBoxItem(suggestedObject.Name, suggestedObject, GetImage(suggestedObject.ObjectType)));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				items.EndUpdate();
			}
			if (((CollectionBase)(object)items).Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = parent is XpfCellInplaceEditor;
			if (flag)
			{
				fontSizeInplaceEditor = (parent as XpfCellInplaceEditor).FontSize;

			}
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edit.ListBox).MaxHeight = GetItemHeight() * (double)visibleItemCount + (double)num;
			if (edit.ListBox.SelectedIndex == selectedIndex)

		private void ShowItemDescription(AutoCompleteSuggestedObject newSelectedItem)
		{
			if (newSelectedItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string currentItemDescription = GetCurrentItemDescription(newSelectedItem);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentItemDescription))
			{
				HideItemDescription();
				return;
			}
			ListBoxEditItem itemByValue = GetItemByValue(newSelectedItem.Name);
			if (itemByValue == null)
			{
				HideItemDescription();
				return;
			}
			double y = FrameworkElementExtensions.GetPosition((FrameworkElement)(object)itemByValue).Y;
			double num = GetItemHeight() * (double)(visibleItemCount - 1);
			itemToolTip.Content = currentItemDescription;
			itemToolTip.PlacementTarget = (UIElement)(object)edit.ListBox;
			itemToolTip.Placement = PlacementMode.Right;
			if (y < 0.0)
			{
				itemToolTip.VerticalOffset = 0.0;
			}
			else if (y > num)
			{
				itemToolTip.VerticalOffset = num;
			}
			else
			{
				itemToolTip.VerticalOffset = y;
			}
			PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(itemToolTip, true);
		}

		private void HideItemDescription()
		{
			PopupControlService.Instance.UpdateState(itemToolTip, false);
		}

		public void ShowParameterDescription(string description)

			parameterToolTip.Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;

		}

		private string GetCurrentItemDescription(AutoCompleteSuggestedObject suggestedObject)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)suggestedObject.ObjectType == 0)
			{
				return FunctionDescriptionProvider.GetFunctionDescription(((AutoCompleteSuggestedFunction)suggestedObject).Function, documentModel);
			}
			if ((int)suggestedObject.ObjectType == 1)
			{
				return ((AutoCompleteSuggestedDefinedName)suggestedObject).DefinedName.Comment;
			}
			if ((int)suggestedObject.ObjectType == 2)
			{
				return ((AutoCompleteSuggestedTable)suggestedObject).Table.Comment;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public ListBoxEditItem GetItemByValue(string itemFunctionName)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator((DependencyObject)(object)edit.ListBox);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				DependencyObject current = val.Current;
				if (current != null && current.GetType() == typeof(ListBoxEditItem) && (((ContentControl)((current is ListBoxEditItem) ? current : null)).Content as FormulaAutoCompleteListBoxItem).FunctionName == itemFunctionName)
				{
					return (ListBoxEditItem)(object)((current is ListBoxEditItem) ? current : null);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public double GetItemHeight()
		{
			return defaultItemHeight;
		}

		public void MovePreviousItem()
		{
			int selectedIndex = Math.Max(0, edit.ListBox.SelectedIndex - 1);
			edit.ListBox.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
		}

		public void MoveNextItem()
		{
			int selectedIndex = Math.Min(((CollectionBase)(object)edit.ListBox.Items).Count - 1, edit.ListBox.SelectedIndex + 1);
			edit.ListBox.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
		}

		private void OnOperationStarted(object sender, OperationStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BarItem)base.AssociatedObject).Content = e.DisplayName;
			base.AssociatedObject.EditValue = 0;
			UpdateVisibility(isProgressStarted: true);
			suspendedElement = ContextLayoutManagerHelper.SuspendLayout((UIElement)Spreadsheet.ViewControl);
			Spreadsheet.UpdateCommandUI();
			Refresh();
		}

		private void OnProgressTracking(object sender, ProgressTrackingEventArgs e)
		{

			Refresh();
		}

		private void OnOperationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateVisibility(isProgressStarted: false);
			suspendedElement?.Dispose();
			Spreadsheet.UpdateCommandUI();
			Refresh();
		}

		private void UpdateVisibility(bool isProgressStarted)
		{
			((BarItem)base.AssociatedObject).IsVisible = Spreadsheet.StatusBarShowProgress && isProgressStarted;
		}

		{
			DispatcherHelper.UpdateLayoutAndDoEvents();
		}

			CopiesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Copies", typeof(short), typeFromHandle);
			CollateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Collate", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle);
			PagesFromProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PagesFrom", typeof(int?), typeFromHandle);
			PagesToProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PagesTo", typeof(int?), typeFromHandle);
			MinPageCountProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinPageCount", typeof(int), typeFromHandle);
			MaxPageCountProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxPageCount", typeof(int), typeFromHandle);
		}

		public override void Print()
		{
			if (CanPrint())
			{
				PrintOptionsViewModel printOptionsViewModel = PrintOptionsViewModel.Create(base.Document.PrintingSystem);
				printOptionsViewModel.PagePreviewIndex = base.CurrentPageNumber - 1;
				SetPrintingSettings(printOptionsViewModel);
				CloseActiveEditingFieldEditor();
				ShowPrintDialog(printOptionsViewModel);
			}
		}

		private void SetPrintingSettings(PrintOptionsViewModel viewModel)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				PrinterSettings printerSettings = ((IPrintForm)viewModel).Document.PrinterSettings;
				PrintPreviewPrinterSettingsHelper.SetSettings(((IPrintForm)viewModel).Document, Copies, Collate, PagesFrom, PagesTo, MinPageCount, MaxPageCount);
			}
		}
	}

		private void UpdateBorderInfo()
		{
			//IL_00f5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UpdateDiagonalCheckButtonState();
			previewControl.TopBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(TopColor, TopBorderStyle);
			previewControl.BottomBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(BottomColor, BottomBorderStyle);
			previewControl.LeftBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(LeftColor, LeftBorderStyle);
			previewControl.RightBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(RightColor, RightBorderStyle);
			previewControl.DiagonalDownBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(DiagonalColor, DiagonalDownBorderStyle);
			previewControl.DiagonalUpBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(DiagonalColor, DiagonalUpBorderStyle);
			previewControl.VerticalInsideBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(VerticalColor, VerticalBorderStyle);
			previewControl.HorizontalInsideBorderInfo = CreateBorderPen(HorizontalColor, HorizontalBorderStyle);
			previewControl.RangeType = RangeType;
		}

		private void UpdateDiagonalCheckButtonState()
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (DiagonalDownBorderStyle.HasValue && (int)DiagonalDownBorderStyle.Value != 0 && !HasSpecialCase(DiagonalDownBorderStyle.Value))
			{
				ShowDiagonalDownBorder = true;
			}
			if (DiagonalUpBorderStyle.HasValue && (int)DiagonalUpBorderStyle.Value != 0 && !HasSpecialCase(DiagonalUpBorderStyle.Value))
			{
				ShowDiagonalUpBorder = true;
			}
		}

		private bool HasSpecialCase(XlBorderLineStyle style)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)style != 19)
			{
				return (int)style == 18;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private XlBorderLineStyle GetNonNullBorderStyle(XlBorderLineStyle? borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (borderStyle.HasValue)
			{
				return borderStyle.Value;
			}
			if (DrawNullBorders)
			{
				return (XlBorderLineStyle)19;
			}
			return (XlBorderLineStyle)0;
		}

		private FormatBorderInfo CreateBorderPen(System.Drawing.Color color, XlBorderLineStyle? borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XlBorderLineStyle nonNullBorderStyle = GetNonNullBorderStyle(borderStyle);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = ((!HasSpecialCase(nonNullBorderStyle)) ? new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(color.ToWpfColor()), GetThickness(nonNullBorderStyle)) : new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 211, 211, 211)), GetThickness(nonNullBorderStyle)));
			double[] dashes = ToDoubleArray(LinePatternProvider.GetPattern(nonNullBorderStyle));
			pen.DashStyle = new System.Windows.Media.DashStyle(dashes, 0.0);
			return new FormatBorderInfo(pen, nonNullBorderStyle);
		}

		public static double GetThickness(XlBorderLineStyle borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ((int)borderStyle == 6) ? 1 : BorderInfo.LinePixelThicknessTable[borderStyle];
		}

		public static double[] ToDoubleArray(float[] p)
		{
			double[] array = new double[p.Length];
			p.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

			DrawDiagonalDownBorder(dc);
			DrawDiagonalUpBorder(dc);
			if ((int)RangeType == 1 || (int)RangeType == 3)
			{
				DrawVerticalInsideBorder(dc);
			}
			if ((int)RangeType == 2 || (int)RangeType == 3)
			{
				DrawHorizontalInsideBorder(dc);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLeftBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (LeftBorderInfo != null)
			{
				DrawBorder(from: new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, BorderOffset), to: new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset), dc: dc, info: LeftBorderInfo, offset: 2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRightBorder(DrawingContext dc)

			}
		}

			}
		}

		public static void DrawBorder(DrawingContext dc, FormatBorderInfo info, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to, int offset)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen borderPen = info.BorderPen;
			if (info.IsDouble)
			{
				DrawDoubleLine(dc, borderPen, from, to, offset);
			}
			else if (info.IsSlantDashDot)
			{
				DrawSlantLine(dc, borderPen, from, to);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawLine(dc, borderPen, from, to);
			}
		}

					DrawDiagonalBorderCore(dc, new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset - 2, BorderOffset), new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset - 2.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset), DiagonalDownBorderInfo, offset4);

			}

		private void DrawDiagonalBorderCore(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Point firstPoint, System.Windows.Point secondPoint, FormatBorderInfo DiagonalBorderInfo, int offset)
		{

			}
		}

		private void DrawAngleMarkers(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray), 1.0);
			DrawTopLeftMarker(dc, pen);
			DrawTopRightMarker(dc, pen);
			DrawBottomLeftMarker(dc, pen);
			DrawBottomRightMarker(dc, pen);
			if ((int)RangeType == 2 || (int)RangeType == 3)
			{
				DrawLeftCenterMarker(dc, pen);
				DrawRightCenterMarker(dc, pen);
			}
			if ((int)RangeType == 1 || (int)RangeType == 3)
			{
				DrawTopCenterMarker(dc, pen);
				DrawBottomCenterMarker(dc, pen);
			}
		}

		private void DrawTopLeftMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(4.0, BorderOffset);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, 4.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
		}

		private void DrawTopRightMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - 4.0, BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(to: new System.Windows.Point(point.X - 5.0, BorderOffset), dc: dc, pen: pen, from: point);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, 4.0);
			DrawLine(to: new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, point.Y + 5.0), dc: dc, pen: pen, from: point);
		}

		private void DrawBottomRightMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - 4.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(to: new System.Windows.Point(point.X - 5.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset), dc: dc, pen: pen, from: point);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight - 4.0);
			DrawLine(to: new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, point.Y - 5.0), dc: dc, pen: pen, from: point);
		}

		private void DrawBottomLeftMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(4.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight - 4.0);
			DrawLine(to: new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, point.Y - 5.0), dc: dc, pen: pen, from: point);
		}

		private void DrawLeftCenterMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0 - 4.0);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(4.0, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0 + 4.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
		}

		private void DrawRightCenterMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0 - 4.0);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - 4.0, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0 + 4.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth - (double)BorderOffset, base.ActualHeight / 2.0);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
		}

		private void DrawTopCenterMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0 - 4.0, BorderOffset);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, 4.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0 + 4.0, BorderOffset);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
		}

		private void DrawBottomCenterMarker(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0 - 4.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, base.ActualHeight - 4.0);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
			point = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0 + 4.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(base.ActualWidth / 2.0, base.ActualHeight - (double)BorderOffset);
			DrawLine(dc, pen, point, to);
		}

		public static void PatchPoints(ref System.Windows.Point from, ref System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			double num = 0.5;
			bool flag = IsLineVertical(from, to);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(to.X - num, to.Y - num);
			from = new System.Windows.Point(from.X - num, from.Y - num);
		}

		public static bool IsLineVertical(System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			return from.Y != to.Y;
		}

		public static void DrawDoubleLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to, int offset)
		{
			PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			DrawLineCore(dc, pen, from, to);
			if (IsLineVertical(from, to))
			{
				from = new System.Windows.Point(from.X + (double)offset, from.Y);
				to = new System.Windows.Point(to.X + (double)offset, to.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				from = new System.Windows.Point(from.X, from.Y + (double)offset);
				to = new System.Windows.Point(to.X, to.Y + (double)offset);
			}
			DrawLineCore(dc, pen, from, to);
		}

		public static void DrawSlantLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			dc.PushTransform(DrawSlantLineHelper.GetTransform(from, to));
			DrawLineCore(dc, pen, from, to);
			dc.Pop();
		}

		public static void DrawLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			if (pen.Thickness == 1.0 || pen.Thickness == 3.0)
			{
				PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			}
			DrawLineCore(dc, pen, from, to);
		}

		public static void DrawLineCore(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			dc.DrawLine(pen, from, to);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new FormatBorderPreviewControlAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	public class FormulaBarEditor : XpfCellInplaceEditorBase
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ScrollViewerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScrollViewerProperty;

		private EventHandler onActivateEditor;

		private EventHandler onDeactivateEditor;

		private EventHandler onRollback;

		protected override bool KeepOpenFormulaPresenter => true;

		protected override bool AllowFocusSpreadsheet => base.IsKeyboardFocused;

		protected override bool IsSheetEditor => false;

		public ScrollViewer ScrollViewer
		{
			get
			{
				return (ScrollViewer)GetValue(ScrollViewerProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(ScrollViewerPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler ActivateEditor
		{
			add
			{
				onActivateEditor = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onActivateEditor, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onActivateEditor = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onActivateEditor, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler DeactivateEditor
		{
			add
			{
				onDeactivateEditor = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onDeactivateEditor, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onDeactivateEditor = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onDeactivateEditor, value);
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler Rollback
		{
			add
			{
				onRollback = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onRollback, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onRollback = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onRollback, value);
			}
		}

		static FormulaBarEditor()
		{
			ScrollViewerPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ScrollViewer", typeof(ScrollViewer), typeof(FormulaBarEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ScrollViewerProperty = ScrollViewerPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.UseIndependentThemeStyleKey<FormulaBarEditor>();
		}

		public FormulaBarEditor()
		{
			base.IsEnabled = false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseActivateEditor()
		{
			if (onActivateEditor != null)
			{
				onActivateEditor(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseDeactivateEditor()
		{
			if (onDeactivateEditor != null)
			{
				onDeactivateEditor(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void RaiseRollback()
		{
			if (onRollback != null)
			{
				onRollback(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Decimal)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		protected override ICellInplaceEditor GetMainEditor()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override void SetWrapText(bool value)
		{
		}

		protected override void SetIsVisible(bool value)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void Activate()
		{
			RaiseActivateEditor();
		}

		protected internal override void Deactivate()
		{
			base.Deactivate();
			RaiseDeactivateEditor();
		}

		internal int GetLineHeight()
		{
			if (base.LineCount >= 1)
			{
				return (int)Math.Round(base.ExtentHeight / (double)base.LineCount);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal void InitializeSpreadsheet(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl)
		{
			base.IsEnabled = true;
			spreadsheetControl.InnerControlInitialized -= InnerControlInitialized;
			base.Control = spreadsheetControl;
			spreadsheetControl.InnerControlInitialized += InnerControlInitialized;
			base.WorksheetControl = LayoutHelper.FindElementByType((FrameworkElement)spreadsheetControl, typeof(WorksheetControl), (Func<FrameworkElement, bool>)null) as WorksheetControl;
			OnFormulaEditorLoaded();
		}

		private void InnerControlInitialized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnFormulaEditorLoaded();
		}

	public class FormulaRangesControl : WorksheetPaintControl, IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>
	{
		private const int smallBorderWidthInPixels = 1;

		private const int borderWidthInPixels = 2;

		private const int cornerWidthInPixels = 5;

		private int smallBorderWidth;

		private int borderWidth;

		private int cornerWidth;

		private double cornerOffset;

		private double cornerOffset2;

		public FormulaRangesControl()
		{
			RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, EdgeMode.Aliased);
			Initialize();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			smallBorderWidth = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidth(1, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			borderWidth = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidth(2, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			cornerWidth = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidth(5, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			cornerOffset = (double)cornerWidth / 2.0 + ((double)smallBorderWidth + 1.0) / 2.0;
			cornerOffset2 = cornerOffset - (double)((smallBorderWidth + 1) % 2);
			cornerWidth += smallBorderWidth;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (base.Spreadsheet != null && base.Spreadsheet.IsEnabled && base.LayoutInfo != null)
			{
				base.LayoutInfo.Visit<DrawingContext>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>)this, dc);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			foreach (Page page in layout.Pages)
			{
				FormulaReferencedRanges referencedRanges = GetReferencedRanges(page.Sheet);
				if (referencedRanges != null && ((List<FormulaReferencedRange>)(object)referencedRanges).Count > 0)
				{
					Func<CellRange, System.Drawing.Rectangle> getRangeBounds = (CellRange range) => ((object)((CellRangeBase)range).Worksheet != page.Sheet) ? System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty : page.CalculateRangeBounds(range);
					DrawFormulaRanges(dc, referencedRanges, getRangeBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			WorksheetLayout worksheetLayout = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layout is WorksheetLayout) ? layout : null);
			if (worksheetLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet worksheet = ((TileLayout)worksheetLayout).Worksheet;
			FormulaReferencedRanges referencedRanges = GetReferencedRanges(worksheet);
			if (referencedRanges == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			worksheetLayout.Panes.ForEach((Action<Pane>)delegate(Pane p)
			{
				Func<CellRange, System.Drawing.Rectangle> getRangeBounds = (CellRange range) => ((object)((CellRangeBase)range).Worksheet != worksheet) ? System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty : worksheetLayout.GetAbsoluteBounds(range, p);
				DrawFormulaRanges(dc, referencedRanges, getRangeBounds);
			});
		}

		private FormulaReferencedRanges GetReferencedRanges(Worksheet sheet)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (sheet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormulaReferencedRanges val = new FormulaReferencedRanges();
			foreach (int selectedDrawingIndex in ((SheetViewSelectionBase)sheet.Selection).SelectedDrawingIndexes)
			{
				IDrawingObject obj = ((SimpleCollection<IDrawingObject>)(object)((InternalSheetBase)sheet).DrawingObjects)[selectedDrawingIndex];
				IChartBase val2 = (IChartBase)(object)((obj is IChartBase) ? obj : null);
				if (val2 != null && val2.IsSupported)
				{
					((List<FormulaReferencedRange>)(object)val).AddRange((IEnumerable<FormulaReferencedRange>)val2.GetAllReferencedRanges(sheet));
				}
			}
			if (((List<FormulaReferencedRange>)(object)val).Count > 0)
			{
				return val;
			}
			if (!base.Spreadsheet.InnerControl.IsInplaceEditorActive)
			{
				return null;
			}
			InnerCellInplaceEditor inplaceEditor = base.Spreadsheet.InnerControl.InplaceEditor;
			return inplaceEditor.ReferencedRanges;
		}

		private void DrawFormulaRanges(DrawingContext dc, FormulaReferencedRanges referencedRanges, Func<CellRange, System.Drawing.Rectangle> getRangeBounds)
		{
			int count = ((List<FormulaReferencedRange>)(object)referencedRanges).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FormulaReferencedRange val = ((List<FormulaReferencedRange>)(object)referencedRanges)[i];
				DrawFormulaRange(dc, val.CellRange, val.Color, val.IsReadOnly, getRangeBounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawFormulaRange(DrawingContext dc, CellRangeBase range, System.Drawing.Color color, bool isReadOnly, Func<CellRange, System.Drawing.Rectangle> getRangeBounds)
		{
			CellUnion val = (CellUnion)(object)((range is CellUnion) ? range : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				foreach (CellRangeBase innerCellRange in val.InnerCellRanges)
				{
					DrawFormulaRange(dc, innerCellRange, color, isReadOnly, getRangeBounds);
				}
				return;
			}
			CellRange val2 = (CellRange)(object)((range is CellRange) ? range : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				DrawFormulaRangeCore(dc, val2, color.ToWpfColor(), isReadOnly, getRangeBounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawFormulaRangeCore(DrawingContext dc, CellRange range, System.Windows.Media.Color color, bool isReadOnly, Func<CellRange, System.Drawing.Rectangle> getRangeBounds)
		{
			System.Drawing.Rectangle rectangle = getRangeBounds(range);
			if (rectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect rect = rectangle.ToRect();
			Rect cellOuterBorder = GetCellOuterBorder(rect, borderWidth);
			System.Windows.Media.Color color2 = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(16, color.R, color.G, color.B);
			Rect rectangle2 = rect;
			double num = (0.0 - (double)(smallBorderWidth + 1)) / 2.0;
			rectangle2.Inflate(num, num);
			if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty && !(rectangle2.Width <= 1.0) && !(rectangle2.Height <= 1.0))
			{
				rectangle2.Size = new System.Windows.Size(rectangle2.Width - 1.0, rectangle2.Height - 1.0);
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(base.SpreadsheetProvider.SkinBackColor);
				solidColorBrush.Freeze();
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(solidColorBrush, smallBorderWidth);
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(color2);
				dc.DrawRectangle(brush, pen, rectangle2);
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen2 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(color), borderWidth);
				dc.DrawRectangle(null, pen2, cellOuterBorder);
				if (!isReadOnly)
				{
					DrawFormulaRangeCorner(dc, CalculateTopLeftCorner(rect), color, pen);
					DrawFormulaRangeCorner(dc, CalculateTopRightCorner(rect), color, pen);
					DrawFormulaRangeCorner(dc, CalculateBottomRightCorner(rect), color, pen);
					DrawFormulaRangeCorner(dc, CalculateBottomLeftCorner(rect), color, pen);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawFormulaRangeCorner(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Color color, System.Windows.Media.Pen whitePen)
		{
			dc.DrawRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(color), whitePen, bounds);
		}

		private Rect CalculateTopLeftCorner(Rect bounds)
		{
			return new Rect(bounds.Left - cornerOffset, bounds.Top - cornerOffset, cornerWidth, cornerWidth);
		}

		private Rect CalculateTopRightCorner(Rect bounds)
		{
			return new Rect(bounds.Right - cornerOffset2 - 1.0, bounds.Top - cornerOffset, cornerWidth, cornerWidth);
		}

		private Rect CalculateBottomRightCorner(Rect bounds)
		{
			return new Rect(bounds.Right - cornerOffset2 - 1.0, bounds.Bottom - cornerOffset2 - 1.0, cornerWidth, cornerWidth);
		}

		private Rect CalculateBottomLeftCorner(Rect bounds)
		{
			return new Rect(bounds.Left - cornerOffset, bounds.Bottom - cornerOffset2 - 1.0, cornerWidth, cornerWidth);
		}
	}

		private void UpdateSelectedHeaderFooter(HeaderFooterType odd, HeaderFooterType first, HeaderFooterType even)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (OnOddTab)
			{
				selectedHeaderFooter = odd;
			}
			else if (OnFirstTab)
			{
				selectedHeaderFooter = first;
			}
			else
			{
				selectedHeaderFooter = even;
			}
			object dataContext = base.DataContext;
			HeaderFooterViewModel val = (HeaderFooterViewModel)((dataContext is HeaderFooterViewModel) ? dataContext : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				btnFormatPicture.IsEnabled = val.ContainsKey(selectedHeaderFooter);
			}
		}

	public class PageMarginsDrawingControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		public System.Windows.Media.Color TopMarginColor { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color BottomMarginColor { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color LeftMarginColor { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color RightMarginColor { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color HeaderMarginColor { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Color FooterMarginColor { get; set; }

		public bool IsCenterHorizontally { get; set; }

		public bool IsCenterVertically { get; set; }

		public bool Portrait { get; set; }

		public bool Landscape { get; set; }

		internal void Invalidate()
		{
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			base.OnRender(dc);
			DrawMargins(dc);
		}

		private void DrawMargins(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Black), 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen2 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(GetNotEmptyColor(TopMarginColor)), 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen3 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(GetNotEmptyColor(BottomMarginColor)), 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen4 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(GetNotEmptyColor(LeftMarginColor)), 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen5 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(GetNotEmptyColor(RightMarginColor)), 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen6 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(GetNotEmptyColor(HeaderMarginColor)), 1.0);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen7 = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(GetNotEmptyColor(FooterMarginColor)), 1.0);
			if (Portrait)
			{
				DrawCellsPortraitOrientation(dc, pen);
				DrawTopMarginPortraitOrientation(dc, pen2);
				DrawBottomMarginPortraitOrientation(dc, pen3);
				DrawLeftMarginPortraitOrientation(dc, pen4);
				DrawRightMarginPortraitOrientation(dc, pen5);
				DrawHeaderMarginPortraitOrientation(dc, pen6);
				DrawFooterMarginPortraitOrientation(dc, pen7);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawCellsLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen);
				DrawTopMarginLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen2);
				DrawBottomMarginLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen3);
				DrawLeftMarginLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen4);
				DrawRightMarginLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen5);
				DrawHeaderMarginLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen6);
				DrawFooterMarginLandscapeOrientation(dc, pen7);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color GetNotEmptyColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			if (color.A == 0 && color.R == 0 && color.G == 0 && color.B == 0)
			{
				return Colors.Black;
			}
			return color;
		}

		private void DrawCellsPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			int num = (int)MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.TopPointLeftMargins.X;
			int num2 = (int)MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.LeftPointTopMargins.Y;
			if (IsCenterHorizontally && !IsCenterVertically)
			{
				num = 30;
			}
			else if (IsCenterVertically && !IsCenterHorizontally)
			{
				num2 = 30;
			}
			else if (IsCenterHorizontally && IsCenterVertically)
			{
				num = 30;
				num2 = 30;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
				{
					DrawLine(dc, pen, new System.Windows.Point(num + j * 10, num2), new System.Windows.Point(num + j * 10, num2 + 70));
				}
				DrawLine(dc, pen, new System.Windows.Point(num, num2 + i * 5), new System.Windows.Point(num + 40, num2 + i * 5));
			}
		}

		private void DrawHeaderMarginPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.LeftPointHeaderMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.RightPointHeaderMargins);
		}

		private void DrawFooterMarginPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.LeftPointFooterMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.RightPointFooterMargins);
		}

		private void DrawTopMarginPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.LeftPointTopMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.RightPointTopMargins);
		}

		private void DrawBottomMarginPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.LeftPointBottomMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.RightPointBottomMargins);
		}

		private void DrawLeftMarginPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.TopPointLeftMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.BottomPointLeftMargins);
		}

		private void DrawRightMarginPortraitOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.TopPointRightMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerPortraitOrientation.BottomPointRightMargins);
		}

		private void DrawCellsLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			int num = (int)MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.TopPointLeftMargins.X;
			int num2 = (int)MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.LeftPointTopMargins.Y;
			if (IsCenterHorizontally && !IsCenterVertically)
			{
				num = 30;
			}
			else if (IsCenterVertically && !IsCenterHorizontally)
			{
				num2 = 30;
			}
			else if (IsCenterHorizontally && IsCenterVertically)
			{
				num = 30;
				num2 = 30;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
				{
					DrawLine(dc, pen, new System.Windows.Point(num + j * 10, num2), new System.Windows.Point(num + j * 10, num2 + 40));
				}
				DrawLine(dc, pen, new System.Windows.Point(num, num2 + i * 5), new System.Windows.Point(num + 70, num2 + i * 5));
			}
		}

		private void DrawHeaderMarginLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.LeftPointHeaderMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.RightPointHeaderMargins);
		}

		private void DrawFooterMarginLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.LeftPointFooterMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.RightPointFooterMargins);
		}

		private void DrawTopMarginLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.LeftPointTopMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.RightPointTopMargins);
		}

		private void DrawBottomMarginLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.LeftPointBottomMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.RightPointBottomMargins);
		}

		private void DrawLeftMarginLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.TopPointLeftMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.BottomPointLeftMargins);
		}

		private void DrawRightMarginLandscapeOrientation(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			DrawLine(dc, pen, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.TopPointRightMargins, MarginsLayoutManagerLandscapeOrientation.BottomPointRightMargins);
		}

		private void DrawLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			DrawLineCore(dc, pen, from, to, isDouble: false);
		}

		private void DrawLineCore(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to, bool isDouble)
		{
			if (!isDouble && (pen.Thickness == 1.0 || pen.Thickness == 3.0))
			{
				PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			}
			dc.DrawLine(pen, from, to);
		}

		private void PatchPoints(ref System.Windows.Point from, ref System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			double num = 0.5;
			bool flag = IsLineVertical(from, to);
			to = new System.Windows.Point(to.X - num, to.Y - num);
			from = new System.Windows.Point(from.X - num, from.Y - num);
		}

		private bool IsLineVertical(System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			return from.Y != to.Y;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new PageMarginsDrawingControlAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			((BaseEdit)this).OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Key == Key.Return && controller.IsCollapsed)
			{
				RaiseCollapseButtonClick();
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.F4)
			{
				int num = (int)Controller.PositionType;
				int num2 = Enum.GetNames(typeof(ReferenceEditPositionType)).Length;
				Controller.PositionType = (ReferenceEditPositionType)(num % num2 + 1);
				((TextEditBase)this).Text = Controller.GetEditValue();
			}
			else
			{
				PortableKeyEventArgs e2 = KeyEventArgsExtensions.ToPortable(e);
				Controller.OnKeyDown(e2);
				KeyEventArgsExtensions.CopyFrom(e, e2);
			}
		}

		private ReferenceEditController CreateController(ISpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new ReferenceEditController((IReferenceEditControllerOwner)(object)this, spreadsheetControl);
		}

		private void SubscribeControllerEvents()
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Controller != null)
			{
				Controller.TextChanged += new TextChangedEventHandler(OnControllerTextChanged);
				Controller.SelectionChanged += new ReferenceEditSelectionChangedEventHandler(OnControllerSelectionChanged);
				Controller.CollapsedChanged += OnControllerCollapsedChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeControllerEvents()
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Controller != null)
			{
				Controller.TextChanged -= new TextChangedEventHandler(OnControllerTextChanged);
				Controller.SelectionChanged -= new ReferenceEditSelectionChangedEventHandler(OnControllerSelectionChanged);
				Controller.CollapsedChanged -= OnControllerCollapsedChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnControllerTextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			allowRaiseEditValueChanged = false;
			((TextEditBase)this).Text = e.Text;
			allowRaiseEditValueChanged = true;
		}

		private void OnControllerSelectionChanged(object sender, ReferenceEditSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Selection.Clear();
			Selection.AddRange(e.ReferenceEditSelection);
		}

		private void OnControllerCollapsedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			allowRaiseEditValueChanged = false;
			RaiseCollapsedChanged();
			allowRaiseEditValueChanged = true;
			if (!IsCollapsed)
			{
				SetReferenceEditFocus();
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetReferenceEditFocus()
		{
			((UIElement)this).Focus();
			((TextEdit)this).SelectionStart = ((TextEditBase)this).Text.Length;
			((TextEdit)this).SelectionLength = 0;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (controller != null)
			{
				controller.Dispose();
				controller = null;
			}
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IReferenceEditControllerOwner.get_Text()
		{
			return ((TextEditBase)this).Text;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void IReferenceEditControllerOwner.set_Text(string value)
		{
			((TextEditBase)this).Text = value;
		}

			//IL_0043: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{

		}

		private void ResizeThumbDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			double actualWidth = scrollBarContainer.ActualWidth;
			double horizontalChange = e.HorizontalChange;
			double actualWidth2 = scrollBarContainer.ColumnDefinitions[0].ActualWidth;
			double actualWidth3 = scrollBarContainer.ColumnDefinitions[1].ActualWidth;
			actualWidth2 += horizontalChange;
			actualWidth2 = Math.Max(Math.Min(actualWidth2, actualWidth - actualWidth3), 0.0);
			SetTabSelectorContainerWidth(actualWidth2);
			UpdateScrollBarPosition();
		}

		private void OnScrollBarContainerSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ScrollBarPosition == 0.0)
			{
				UpdateScrollBarPositionCore(0.7 * e.NewSize.Width);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateScrollBarPosition();
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal void Invalidate(IDocumentLayout documentLayout, RefreshAction refreshAction, int currentTransactionVersion)
		{
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = owner;
			bool? obj;
			if (spreadsheetControl == null)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				DocumentModel documentModel = spreadsheetControl.DocumentModel;
				obj = ((documentModel != null) ? new bool?(documentModel.PrintInfoProvider.IsActive) : ((bool?)null));
			}
			if ((!obj) ?? true)
			{
				LayoutInfo = documentLayout;
				if (transactionVersion != currentTransactionVersion && !WorksheetControl.IsMeasureInProcess)
				{
					transactionVersion = currentTransactionVersion;
					ClearMeasureCache();
				}
				if (clearDrawingObjectsCache)
				{
					worksheetControl?.ClearDrawingObjectsCache(deleteChildren: true);
					clearDrawingObjectsCache = false;
				}
				Invalidate(refreshAction);
			}
		}

		{
			System.Windows.Point point = TransformToVisual(worksheetControl).Transform(pointRelativelySpreadsheetControl);
			point = worksheetControl.GetPointConsideringScale(point);
			if (new Rect(0.0, 0.0, HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidthD(worksheetControl.ActualWidth, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX), HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeightD(worksheetControl.ActualHeight, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY)).Contains(point))
			{
				return SpreadsheetHitTestType.Worksheet;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point2 = TransformToVisual(tabselector).Transform(pointRelativelySpreadsheetControl);
			if (ShowTabSelector && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(tabselector.GetTabNameByPoint(point2)))
			{
				return SpreadsheetHitTestType.TabSelector;
			}
			return SpreadsheetHitTestType.None;
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Size GetHeaderSize()
		{
			return new System.Drawing.Size((int)worksheetControl.HeaderWidth, (int)worksheetControl.HeaderHeight);
		}

		internal System.Windows.Media.Color GetGridLinesColor()
		{
			if (worksheetControl == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			return worksheetControl.GetGridLinesColor();
		}

			if (ActiveView != null && Control.DocumentModel != null && Control.DocumentModel.ActiveSheet != null)

				num = Control.ActiveView.ZoomFactor;
			}

		}

			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
