	public class VisualFeedbackControl : ContentPresenter
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LineBrushProperty;

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush LineBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(LineBrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LineBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private VisualFeedbackState State { get; set; }

		private Rect ContentRect { get; set; }

		static VisualFeedbackControl()
		{
			LineBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LineBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(VisualFeedbackControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black));
		}

		public VisualFeedbackControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<VisualFeedbackControl>(this);
			RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, EdgeMode.Aliased);
		}

		public void BeginDrawFeedback(VisualFeedbackState state)
		{
			State = state;
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		public void EndDrawFeedback()
		{
			State = null;
			ContentRect = default(Rect);
			base.Content = null;
			InvalidateMeasure();
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (State != null)
			{
				State.PenBrush = LineBrush;
				State.DrawFeedback(dc, this);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawContent(object content, Rect rect)
		{
			ContentRect = rect;
			base.Content = content;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (IsContentRectEmpty())
			{
				return base.MeasureOverride(constraint);
			}
			if (base.Content is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.Measure(ContentRect.Size);
			}
			return constraint;
		}

		private bool IsContentRectEmpty()
		{
			if (ContentRect.Width != 0.0)
			{
				return ContentRect.Height == 0.0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			if (IsContentRectEmpty())
			{
				return base.ArrangeOverride(arrangeBounds);
			}
			if (base.Content is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.Arrange(ContentRect);
			}
			return arrangeBounds;
		}
	}

					Rect fillBounds = new Rect(((PageGridItem)(ref val)).Near, ((PageGridItem)(ref val2)).Near, ((PageGridItem)(ref val)).Extent, ((PageGridItem)(ref val2)).Extent);
					DrawCellBackgroundFromBrush(dc, documentModel, fill, fillBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawCellBackgroundFromBrush(DrawingContext dc, DocumentModel documentModel, DisplayGradientFill fill, Rect fillBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = CreateGradientBrush(documentModel, fill, fillBounds);
			if (brush != System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent)
			{
				dc.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(brush, fillBounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawCellBackground(DrawingContext dc, Page page, CellTextBoxBase box)
		{
			DocumentModel documentModel = page.DocumentLayout.DocumentModel;
			DisplayFill fill = box.GetFill((IDocumentModelSkinColorProvider)(object)documentModel);
			System.Drawing.Rectangle fillBounds = box.GetFillBounds(page);
			if (!(fillBounds == System.Drawing.Rectangle.Empty))
			{
				Rect rect = ExpandFillBounds(fillBounds.ToRect());
				DisplayGradientFill gradientFill = fill.GradientFill;
				if (gradientFill == null)
				{
					DrawCellBackgroundFromPatternFill(dc, fill.PatternFill, rect);
					return;
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = CreateGradientBrush(documentModel, gradientFill, fillBounds.ToRect());
				dc.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(brush, rect);
			}
		}

		private void DrawCellBackgroundFromPatternFill(DrawingContext dc, DisplayPatternFill fill, Rect fillBounds)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(fill.BackColor))
			{
				dc.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(CreateBrush(fill.BackColor), fillBounds);
			}
			if (fill.ShouldUseForeColor)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = CreatePatternBrush(fill.PatternType, fill.ForeColor.ToWpfColor());
				dc.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(brush, fillBounds);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateBrush(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			return new SolidColorBrush(color.ToWpfColor());
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateGradientBrush(DocumentModel documentModel, DisplayGradientFill fill, Rect fillBounds)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (fill == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
			}
			IGradientFillInfo gradientFillInfo = GetGradientFillInfo(documentModel, fill);
			IGradientStopCollection gradientStops = gradientFillInfo.GradientStops;
			if (gradientStops.Count <= 0 || (int)gradientFillInfo.Type == 1)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new System.Windows.Media.GradientStopCollection();
			int count = gradientStops.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				GradientStop gradientStop = GetGradientStop(documentModel, gradientStops, i);
				gradientStopCollection.Add(gradientStop);
			}
			System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection);
			System.Windows.Point[] array = CalculateLinearBrushPoints(fillBounds, gradientFillInfo.Degree);
			linearGradientBrush.MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = array[0];
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = array[1];
			linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private IGradientFillInfo GetGradientFillInfo(DocumentModel documentModel, DisplayGradientFill gradientFill)
		{
			if (gradientFill.IsDifferential)
			{
				return (IGradientFillInfo)(object)((UniqueItemsCache<DifferentialFormat>)(object)documentModel.Cache.DifferentialFormatCache)[gradientFill.OwnerFormatCacheIndex];
			}
			return (IGradientFillInfo)(object)((UniqueItemsCache<CellFormatBase>)(object)documentModel.Cache.CellFormatCache)[gradientFill.OwnerFormatCacheIndex];
		}

		private static GradientStop GetGradientStop(DocumentModel documentModel, IGradientStopCollection stops, int index)
		{
			GradientStopInfo info = stops.GetInfo(documentModel.Cache.GradientStopInfoCache, index);
			return new GradientStop(info.GetColor(documentModel).ToWpfColor(), info.Position);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point[] CalculateLinearBrushPoints(Rect bounds, double degree)
		{
			double a = Math.PI * degree / 180.0;
			bool flag = degree > 180.0;
			a = Math.Atan(Math.Tan(a) * bounds.Width / bounds.Height);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point((bounds.Left + bounds.Right) / 2.0, (bounds.Top + bounds.Bottom) / 2.0);
			double num = Math.Sqrt(bounds.Width * bounds.Width + bounds.Height * bounds.Height);
			double num2 = bounds.Width / num;
			double num3 = bounds.Height / num;
			if (a > -Math.PI / 2.0 && a < 0.0)
			{
				flag = !flag;
			}
			double val = Math.Abs(num / 2.0 * (num2 * Math.Cos(a) + num3 * Math.Sin(a)));
			double val2 = Math.Abs(num / 2.0 * (num2 * Math.Cos(a) - num3 * Math.Sin(a)));
			double num4 = Math.Max(val, val2);
			double num5 = num4 * Math.Cos(a);
			double num6 = num4 * Math.Sin(a);
			System.Windows.Point[] array = new System.Windows.Point[2];
			if (flag)
			{
				array[0] = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + num5, point.Y + num6);
				array[1] = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - num5, point.Y - num6);
			}
			else
			{
				array[1] = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + num5, point.Y + num6);
				array[0] = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - num5, point.Y - num6);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CreatePatternBrush(XlPatternType patternType, System.Windows.Media.Color foreColor)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return PatternFillProvider.GetPatternFillBrush(patternType, foreColor);
		}
	}
	public static class PatternFillProvider
	{
		private struct TileInfo
		{
			private int length;

			private bool containsLine;

			internal int Length
			{
				get
				{
					return length;
				}
				set
				{
					length = value;
				}
			}

			internal bool ContainsLine
			{
				get
				{
					return containsLine;
				}
				set
				{
					containsLine = value;
				}
			}

			internal TileInfo(int length, bool containsLine)
			{
				this.length = length;
				this.containsLine = containsLine;
			}
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush GetPatternFillBrush(XlPatternType type, System.Windows.Media.Color foreColor)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DrawingBrush drawingBrush = new DrawingBrush();
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			TileInfo tileInfo = PopulateTile(type, geometryGroup);
			GeometryDrawing value = CreateDrawing(foreColor, geometryGroup, tileInfo.ContainsLine);
			DrawingGroup drawingGroup = new DrawingGroup();
			drawingGroup.SetValue(RenderOptions.EdgeModeProperty, EdgeMode.Aliased);
			drawingGroup.Children.Add(value);
			drawingBrush.Drawing = drawingGroup;
			drawingBrush.Stretch = Stretch.None;
			drawingBrush.ViewportUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			drawingBrush.Viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, tileInfo.Length, tileInfo.Length);
			drawingBrush.TileMode = TileMode.Tile;
			drawingBrush.Freeze();
			return drawingBrush;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush GetPatternFillBrushStyleGallery(XlPatternType type, System.Windows.Media.Color foreColor, System.Windows.Media.Color backColor)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DrawingBrush drawingBrush = new DrawingBrush();
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup2 = new GeometryGroup();
			TileInfo tileInfo = PopulateTile(type, geometryGroup2);
			PopulateGroupBackground(geometryGroup);
			GeometryDrawing value = CreateDrawingBackground(backColor, geometryGroup);
			GeometryDrawing value2 = CreateDrawing(foreColor, geometryGroup2, tileInfo.ContainsLine);
			DrawingGroup drawingGroup = new DrawingGroup();
			drawingGroup.SetValue(RenderOptions.EdgeModeProperty, EdgeMode.Aliased);
			drawingGroup.Children.Add(value);
			drawingGroup.Children.Add(value2);
			drawingBrush.Drawing = drawingGroup;
			drawingBrush.Stretch = Stretch.None;
			drawingBrush.ViewportUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			drawingBrush.Viewport = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, tileInfo.Length, tileInfo.Length);
			drawingBrush.TileMode = TileMode.Tile;
			drawingBrush.Freeze();
			return drawingBrush;
		}

		private static TileInfo PopulateTile(XlPatternType type, GeometryGroup group)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (type - 2)
			{
			case 16:
				return PopulateTile_HatchPercent10(group);
			case 15:
				return PopulateTile_HatchPercent20(group);
			case 2:
				return PopulateTile_Percent25(group);
			case 14:
				return PopulateTile_Percent30(group);
			case 0:
				return PopulateTile_Percent50(group);
			case 1:
				return PopulateTile_Percent70(group);
			case 11:
				return PopulateTile_LightDownwardDiagonal(group);
			case 12:
				return PopulateTile_LightUpwardDiagonal(group);
			case 5:
				return PopulateTile_DarkDownwardDiagonal(group);
			case 6:
				return PopulateTile_DarkUpwardDiagonal(group);
			case 10:
				return PopulateTile_LightVertical(group);
			case 9:
				return PopulateTile_LightHorizontal(group);
			case 4:
				return PopulateTile_DarkVertical(group);
			case 3:
				return PopulateTile_DarkHorizontal(group);
			case 8:
				return PopulateTile_Trellis(group);
			case 13:
				return PopulateTile_SmallGrid(group);
			case 7:
				return PopulateTile_SmallCheckerBoard(group);
			default:
				Exceptions.ThrowInternalException();
				return default(TileInfo);
			}
		}

		private static LineGeometry CreatePoint(int x, int y)
		{
			return new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(x, y), new System.Windows.Point(x + 1, y + 1));
		}

		private static LineGeometry CreateLine(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
		{
			if (x1 != x2)
			{
				x2++;
			}
			if (y1 != y2)
			{
				y2++;
			}
			return new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(x1, y1), new System.Windows.Point(x2, y2));
		}

		private static RectangleGeometry CreateRectangle(int x, int y, int width, int height)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(x, y, width, height);
			return new RectangleGeometry(rect);
		}

		private static GeometryDrawing CreateDrawing(System.Windows.Media.Color foreColor, GeometryGroup group, bool isNeedDrawLine)
		{
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(foreColor);
			solidColorBrush.Freeze();
			if (!isNeedDrawLine)
			{
				return new GeometryDrawing(solidColorBrush, null, group);
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(solidColorBrush, 1.0);
			pen.Freeze();
			return new GeometryDrawing(null, pen, group);
		}

		private static GeometryDrawing CreateDrawingBackground(System.Windows.Media.Color backColor, GeometryGroup group)
		{
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(backColor);
			solidColorBrush.Freeze();
			return new GeometryDrawing(solidColorBrush, null, group);
		}

	public class WorksheetCommentPanel : WorksheetPaintPanel, IDocumentLayoutVisitor, IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>
	{
		private static CommentTextSettings textSettings;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommentLineBrushProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommentLineWidthProperty;

		private int childIndex;

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush CommentLineBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Brush)GetValue(CommentLineBrushProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommentLineBrushProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public double CommentLineWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(CommentLineWidthProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CommentLineWidthProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static WorksheetCommentPanel()
		{
			textSettings = CreateTextSetting();
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(WorksheetCommentPanel);
			CommentLineBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommentLineBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeFromHandle);
			CommentLineWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommentLineWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle);
		}

		public WorksheetCommentPanel()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<WorksheetCommentPanel>(this);
		}

		internal static CommentTextSettings CreateTextSetting()
		{
			return TextInfoCalculator.CalculateCommentTextSettings(Comment.DefaultFont, Comment.DefaultForeColor);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (base.LayoutInfo == null)
			{
				HideChildren();
				return finalSize;
			}
			base.LayoutInfo.Visit((IDocumentLayoutVisitor)(object)this);
			HideChildren();
			return finalSize;
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor.Visit(DocumentLayout layout)
		{
			foreach (Page page in base.LayoutInfo.Pages)
			{
				ArrangeComments(page.CommentBoxes, page.Bounds.ToRect());
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor.Visit(ISheetLayout layout)
		{
			WorksheetLayout val = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layout is WorksheetLayout) ? layout : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Pane pane in val.Panes)
			{
				ArrangeComments(pane.CommentBoxes, ((PaneBase)pane).Bounds.ToRect());
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeComments(List<CommentBox> comments, Rect paneBounds)
		{
			foreach (CommentBox comment in comments)
			{
				ArrangeComment(comment, paneBounds);
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeComment(CommentBox comment, Rect paneBounds)
		{
			if (comment.CanDraw())
			{
				Rect rect = comment.Bounds.ToRect();
				rect.Offset(-1.0, -1.0);
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = ClipGeometryProvider.GetRectangleGeometry(paneBounds, rect);
				if (!(rectangleGeometry.Bounds == Rect.Empty))
				{
					CommentItem child = GetChild();
					child.Text = comment.GetNormalizedPlainText();
					child.Background = new SolidColorBrush(comment.FillColor.ToWpfColor());
					child.TextSettings = textSettings;
					child.Cursor = base.SpreadsheetControl.Cursor;
					child.Clip = rectangleGeometry;
					child.Measure(rect.Size);
					child.Arrange(rect);
				}
			}
		}

		private CommentItem GetChild()
		{
			if (childIndex >= base.Children.Count)
			{
				CommentItem element = new CommentItem();
				base.Children.Add(element);
			}
			return base.Children[childIndex++] as CommentItem;
		}

		private void HideChildren()
		{
			for (int i = childIndex; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Children[i].Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			}
			childIndex = 0;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (base.LayoutInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			dc.PushTransform(new TranslateTransform(-1.0, -1.0));
			try
			{
				HotZonePainter item = new HotZonePainter(dc);
				Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter> tuple = new Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>(dc, item);
				base.LayoutInfo.Visit<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>)this, tuple);
			}
			finally
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter> param)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < layout.Pages.Count; i++)
			{
				DrawComments(param.Item1, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)layout.Pages[i], param.Item2);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter> param)
		{
			WorksheetLayout val = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layout is WorksheetLayout) ? layout : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Pane pane in val.Panes)
			{
				DrawComments(param.Item1, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)pane, param.Item2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawComments(DrawingContext dc, IDocumentLayoutPane layoutPane, HotZonePainter hotZonePainter)
		{
			((DocumentItemLayout)base.SpreadsheetProvider.ActiveView.CommentLayout).Update(layoutPane);
			dc.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(layoutPane.Bounds.ToRect()));
			try
			{
				foreach (CommentBox commentBox in layoutPane.CommentBoxes)
				{
					DrawCommentLine(dc, commentBox);
				}
				DrawHotZones(hotZonePainter);
			}
			finally
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void DrawCommentLine(DrawingContext dc, CommentBox box)
		{
			if (box.CanDraw())
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(CommentLineBrush, CommentLineWidth);
				System.Windows.Point point = box.GetIndicatorLineStartPoint().ToPoint();
				System.Windows.Point point2 = box.GetIndicatorLineEndPoint().ToPoint();
				dc.DrawLine(pen, point, point2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawHotZones(HotZonePainter hotZonePainter)
		{
			CommentLayoutItemCollection items = base.SpreadsheetProvider.ActiveView.CommentLayout.Items;
			foreach (CommentLayoutItem item in (List<CommentLayoutItem>)(object)items)
			{
				hotZonePainter.DrawHotZones(item.ResizeHotZones);

	public class DragFloatingObjectFeedbackParams
	{
		private Rect actualBounds = Rect.Empty;

		private Rect bounds = Rect.Empty;

		private float angle;

		private bool isDragState;

		private bool flipV;

		private bool flipH;

		private bool isPicture;

		public Rect Bounds => bounds;

		public float Angle => angle;

		public bool IsDragState => isDragState;

		public bool FlipV => flipV;

		public bool FlipH => flipH;

		public Rect ActualBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return actualBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isPicture && Angle == 0f)
				{
					actualBounds = new Rect(bounds.X, bounds.Y, value.Width, value.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					actualBounds = new Rect(value.X + bounds.X, value.Y + bounds.Y, value.Width, value.Height);
				}
			}
		}

		public DragFloatingObjectFeedbackParams(Rect bounds, float angle, bool isDragState, Transform2D transform2D, bool isPicture)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.angle = angle;
			this.isDragState = isDragState;
			flipV = transform2D.FlipV;
			flipH = transform2D.FlipH;
			this.isPicture = isPicture;
		}

		public void Update(Rect newBounds, float newAngle, bool isDragState)
		{
			if (angle != newAngle || !bounds.Equals(newBounds))
			{
				if (!ActualBounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					UpdateActualBounds(newBounds);
				}
				this.isDragState = isDragState;
				bounds = newBounds;
				angle = newAngle;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateActualBounds(Rect newBounds)
		{
			double num = newBounds.X - bounds.X;
			double num2 = newBounds.Y - bounds.Y;
			double num3 = newBounds.Width - bounds.Width;
			double num4 = newBounds.Height - bounds.Height;
			actualBounds = new Rect(actualBounds.X + num, actualBounds.Y + num2, actualBounds.Width + num3, actualBounds.Height + num4);
		}
	}

		internal void Invalidate(RefreshAction refreshAction)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SetScale(ScaleFactor);
			SetGroupSize();
			SetHeadersSize();
			if ((refreshAction & 2) != 0)
			{
				selectionControl.InvalidateVisual();
				shapeSelectionControl.InvalidateVisual();
			}
			if ((refreshAction & 4) != 0 || (refreshAction & 8) != 0)
			{
				horizontalHeadersControl.Invalidate();
				verticalHeadersControl.Invalidate();
			}
			if ((refreshAction & 8) != 0 || (refreshAction & 1) != 0)
			{
				backgroundControl.InvalidateVisual();
				chartsheetBackgroundControl.InvalidateVisual();
				lineControl.InvalidateVisual();
				if (!worksheetPanel.IsMeasureInProcess)
				{
					worksheetPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				diagonalBorderControl.InvalidateVisual();
				groupControl.Invalidate();
				floatingObjectsContainer.InvalidateArrange();
				indicatorControl.InvalidateVisual();
				sparklinePanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			formulaRangesControl.InvalidateVisual();
			commentPanel.InvalidateVisual();
			dataValidationPanel.InvalidateVisual();
			commentInplaceEditor.InvalidateVisual();
			SetCliping(new System.Windows.Size(base.ActualWidth * (1.0 / ScaleFactor), base.ActualHeight * (1.0 / ScaleFactor)));
		}

		private void SetGroupSize()
		{
			IDocumentLayout layoutInfo = LayoutInfo;
			GroupItemsPage val = ((layoutInfo != null) ? layoutInfo.Groups : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = val.GroupItemsOffset.ToSize();
				GroupWidth = size.Width;
				GroupHeight = size.Height;
			}
		}

		private void SetHeadersSize()
		{
			if (LayoutInfo != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Size size = ((LayoutInfo.Headers != null) ? LayoutInfo.Headers.HeadersOffset.ToSize() : new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0));
				HeaderWidth = size.Width;
				HeaderHeight = size.Height;
			}
		}

		private void SetScale(double factor)
		{
			ScaleTransform renderTransform = new ScaleTransform(factor, factor);
			base.RenderTransform = renderTransform;
			ScaleTransform renderTransform2 = new ScaleTransform(1.0 / factor + 0.05, 1.0);
			horizontalGroupBackgroundControl.RenderTransform = renderTransform2;
			topWorksheetBorder.RenderTransform = renderTransform2;
			ScaleTransform renderTransform3 = new ScaleTransform(1.0, 1.0 / factor + 0.05);
			verticalGroupBackgroundControl.RenderTransform = renderTransform3;
			leftWorksheetBorder.RenderTransform = renderTransform3;
		}

		private void SetCliping(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			base.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), size));
			double x = GroupWidth + HeaderWidth;
			double y = GroupHeight + HeaderHeight;
			Rect rect = new Rect(x, y, size.Width, size.Height);
			commentPanel.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
		}

		internal void ShowInplaceEditor(InplaceEditorBoundsInfo boundsInfo, System.Windows.Size measuredSize, TextAlignment alignment)
		{
			Rect rect = boundsInfo.EditorBounds.ToRect();
			double num = rect.X;
			double num2 = measuredSize.Width - 1.0;
			double num3 = measuredSize.Height - 1.0;
			double top = rect.Top;
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case TextAlignment.Right:
				num = num + rect.Width - num2;
				num2 -= 2.0;
				break;
			case TextAlignment.Center:
				num = num + rect.Width / 2.0 - num2 / 2.0 - 1.0;
				break;
			}
			if (!SpreadsheetProvider.EnhancedLayout)
			{
				num += 1.0;
			}
			double num4 = 1.0 / HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSizeD(ScaleFactor, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			num *= num4;
			top *= num4;
			num2 *= num4;
			num3 *= num4;
			cellEditorContainer.SetValue(Canvas.LeftProperty, num);
			cellEditorContainer.SetValue(Canvas.TopProperty, top);
			cellEditorContainer.Width = num2;
			cellEditorContainer.Height = num3;
		}

		private DataTemplate GetConditionalFormattingDataBarTemplate(VariantValue cellValue, DataBarConditionalFormatting formatting, System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds, ref ConditionalFormattingSettings cfSettings)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ConditionalFormattingDataBarEvaluationResult val = formatting.Evaluate(cellValue);
			if (((ConditionalFormattingDataBarEvaluationResult)(ref val)).Length < 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICondFmtDataBarPainterCalculator painterCalculator = CondFmtDataBarPainterCalculator.GetPainterCalculator(formatting, val, bounds, 1);
			if (painterCalculator == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			painterCalculator.Process();
			System.Drawing.Rectangle bar = painterCalculator.Bar;
			bool flag = ((ConditionalFormattingDataBarEvaluationResult)(ref val)).Value >= 0.0;
			System.Drawing.Color color = ((flag || formatting.IsNegativeColorSameAsPositive) ? formatting.Color : formatting.NegativeValueColor);
			if (bar.Width > 0 && bar.Height > 0 && !DXColor.IsEmpty(color))
			{
				if (formatting.GradientFill)
				{
					bool flag2 = (int)formatting.AxisPosition == 0 || painterCalculator.IsLeftToRight == flag;
					IGradientColorCalculator calculator = DataBarGradientColorCalculatorBase.GetCalculator(flag2);
					calculator.Prepare(color);
					cfSettings.DataBarFillBrush = new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush(calculator.StartColor.ToWpfColor(), calculator.EndColor.ToWpfColor(), 0.0);
				}
				else
				{
					cfSettings.DataBarFillBrush = new SolidColorBrush(color.ToWpfColor());
				}
			}
			if (formatting.IsBorderColorAssigned)
			{
				System.Drawing.Color color2 = (flag ? formatting.BorderColor : formatting.NegativeValueBorderColor);
				if (!DXColor.IsEmpty(color2))
				{
					cfSettings.DataBarBorderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(color2.ToWpfColor());
				}
			}
			System.Drawing.Point axisTop = painterCalculator.AxisTop;
			if (!axisTop.IsEmpty && !DXColor.IsEmpty(formatting.AxisColor))
			{
				cfSettings.AxisBrush = new SolidColorBrush(formatting.AxisColor.ToWpfColor());
				double num = (double)bounds.X - 1.5;
				double num2 = bounds.Y;
				cfSettings.AxisStart = new System.Windows.Point((double)axisTop.X - num, (double)axisTop.Y - num2);
				cfSettings.AxisEnd = new System.Windows.Point((double)axisTop.X - num, (double)bounds.Bottom - num2);
			}
			if (bar.Width > 0 && bar.Height > 0)
			{
				cfSettings.DataBarBounds = new Rect(bar.X - bounds.X + 1, bar.Y - bounds.Y, bar.Width, bar.Height);
			}
			return ConditionalFormattingDataBarTemplate;
		}

		private DataTemplate GetConditionalFormattingIconTemplate(Worksheet sheet, CellPosition cellPosition, VariantValue cellValue, IconSetConditionalFormatting formatting, ConditionalFormattingSettings cfSettings)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IconSetType iconSet = formatting.IconSet;
			if ((int)iconSet == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = formatting.EvaluateIconIndex(sheet, cellPosition, cellValue);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (formatting.IsCustom)
			{
				ConditionalFormattingCustomIcon icon = formatting.GetIcon(num);
				iconSet = icon.IconSet;
				if ((int)iconSet == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = icon.IconIndex;
			}
			cfSettings.Image = ConditionalFormattingIconSet.GetImage(iconSet, num).ToImageSource(DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi != 96f);
			return ConditionalFormattingIconTemplate;
		}

		internal System.Windows.Point GetPointConsideringScale(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			double correctedSizeD = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSizeD(ScaleFactor, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			if (correctedSizeD == 1.0)
			{
				return point;
			}
			ScaleTransform scaleTransform = new ScaleTransform(correctedSizeD, correctedSizeD);
			return scaleTransform.Transform(point);
		}

		void IDrawingBoxVisitor.Visit(ChartBox box)
		{
			if (FloatingObjectState == null)
			{

		void IDrawingBoxVisitor.Visit(PictureBox box)
		{
			if (FloatingObjectState == null)
			{
				Picture picture = box.Picture;
				if (!(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((SpreadsheetUndoableIndexBasedObject<PictureInfo>)(object)picture).DocumentModel).GetService<IShapeImageService>() is IShapeFeedbackImageService shapeFeedbackImageService))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ObjectParams.IsDragState)
				{
					ImageResult feedbackImage = shapeFeedbackImageService.GetFeedbackImage(picture, ((DrawingBox)box).Bounds);
					if (feedbackImage == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					FloatingObjectState = CreateShapeDragState(feedbackImage);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawingVisualHost host = new DrawingVisualHost();
					Action<Rect> render = delegate(Rect rect)
					{
						PictureRenderer.Render(picture, rect, host.Items, renderEffects: false);
					};
					FloatingObjectState = new ResizeShapeVisualFeedbackState(host, render, ObjectParams);
				}
			}
			BeginShowDragFloatingObjectVisualFeedback();
		}

		void IDrawingBoxVisitor.Visit(ShapeBox box)
		{
			if (FloatingObjectState == null)
			{
				ModelShapeBase shape = box.Shape;
				if (!(((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((SpreadsheetUndoableIndexBasedObject<ModelShapeInfo>)(object)shape).DocumentModel).GetService<IShapeImageService>() is IShapeFeedbackImageService shapeFeedbackImageService))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ObjectParams.IsDragState)
				{
					bool renderUnsupportedItems = shapeFeedbackImageService.RenderUnsupportedItems;
					try
					{
						shapeFeedbackImageService.RenderUnsupportedItems = ((SpreadsheetUndoableIndexBasedObject<ModelShapeInfo>)(object)shape).DocumentModel.ViewOptions.ShowPlaceholders;
						ImageResult feedbackImage = shapeFeedbackImageService.GetFeedbackImage(shape, ((DrawingBox)box).Bounds);
						if (feedbackImage == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						FloatingObjectState = CreateShapeDragState(feedbackImage);
					}
					finally
					{
						shapeFeedbackImageService.RenderUnsupportedItems = renderUnsupportedItems;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DrawingVisualHost host = new DrawingVisualHost();
					Action<Rect> render = delegate(Rect rect)
					{
						ShapeRenderer.Render(shape, rect, host.Items, renderEffects: false);
					};
					FloatingObjectState = new ResizeShapeVisualFeedbackState(host, render, ObjectParams);
				}
			}
			BeginShowDragFloatingObjectVisualFeedback();
		}

				Stretch = Stretch.Fill
			};

			return new DragShapeVisualFeedbackState(content, ObjectParams);
		}

		void IDrawingBoxVisitor.Visit(FormControlBox box)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			FormControlBase formControl = box.FormControl;
			if ((int)formControl.FormControlType == 9)
			{
				VisitUnsupportedDrawingObject((DrawingBox)(object)box, (XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2438);
				return;
			}
			if (FloatingObjectState == null)
			{
				DrawingVisualHost host = new DrawingVisualHost();
				Action<Rect> render = delegate(Rect rect)
				{
					FormControlBase obj = formControl;
					ScrollBarFormControl val = (ScrollBarFormControl)(object)((obj is ScrollBarFormControl) ? obj : null);
					bool horizontalWithoutHistory = false;
					try
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							horizontalWithoutHistory = val.Horizontal;
							val.SetHorizontalWithoutHistory(box.Horizontal);
						}
						FormControlVisualRenderer.Render(formControl, rect.Size, host.Items);
					}
					finally
					{
						if (val != null)
						{
							val.SetHorizontalWithoutHistory(horizontalWithoutHistory);
						}
					}
				};
				FloatingObjectState = new ResizeShapeVisualFeedbackState(host, render, ObjectParams);
			}
			BeginShowDragFloatingObjectVisualFeedback();
		}

		}

		static WorksheetDataValidationPanel()

			DataValidationMessageBorderWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataValidationMessageBorderWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle);
			DataValidationMessageBorderBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataValidationMessageBorderBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeFromHandle);
			DataValidationMessageBackgroudBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataValidationMessageBackgroudBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeFromHandle);

		public WorksheetDataValidationPanel()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<WorksheetDataValidationPanel>(this);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (base.LayoutInfo != null)
			{
				HotZonePainter item = new HotZonePainter(dc, null, base.Owner.AutoFilterImageCache, DataValidationBackgroundBrush, DataValidationBorderColor);
				Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter> tuple = new Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>(dc, item);
				base.LayoutInfo.Visit<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>)this, tuple);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter> param)
		{
			foreach (Page page in layout.Pages)
			{
				DrawDataValidation(param.Item1, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)page, param.Item2);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter>>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, Tuple<DrawingContext, HotZonePainter> param)
		{
			WorksheetLayout val = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layout is WorksheetLayout) ? layout : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Panes.ForEach((Action<Pane>)delegate(Pane p)
				{
					DrawDataValidation(param.Item1, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)p, param.Item2);
				});
			}
		}

		private void DrawDataValidation(DrawingContext dc, IDocumentLayoutPane layoutPane, HotZonePainter hotZonePainter)
		{
			DataValidationLayout dataValidationLayout = base.SpreadsheetProvider.ActiveView.DataValidationLayout;
			((DocumentItemLayout)dataValidationLayout).Update(layoutPane);
			RectangleGeometry clipGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(layoutPane.Bounds.ToRect());
			dc.PushClip(clipGeometry);
			try
			{
				DrawDataValidationHotZone(dataValidationLayout.HotZone, hotZonePainter);
				DrawDataValidationInvalidCircle(dc, dataValidationLayout.InvalidDataRectangles);
			}
			finally
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
			DrawDataValidationMessage(dc, dataValidationLayout.MessageLayout);
		}

		private void DrawDataValidationHotZone(DataValidationHotZone hotZone, HotZonePainter hotZonePainter)
		{
			if (hotZone != null)
			{
				hotZonePainter.DrawHotZone((HotZone)(object)hotZone);
			}
		}

		private void DrawDataValidationInvalidCircle(DrawingContext dc, List<System.Drawing.Rectangle> rectangles)
		{
			if (rectangles == null || rectangles.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(DataValidationCircleBrush, DataValidationCircleWidth);
			foreach (System.Drawing.Rectangle rectangle in rectangles)
			{
				double num = rectangle.Width / 2;
				double num2 = rectangle.Height / 2;
				double x = (double)rectangle.Left + num - 1.0;
				double y = (double)rectangle.Top + num2 - 1.0;
				dc.DrawEllipse(null, pen, new System.Windows.Point(x, y), num, num2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawDataValidationMessage(DrawingContext dc, DataValidationMessageLayout messageLayout)
		{
			if (messageLayout != null && !messageLayout.BoundsMessage.IsEmpty)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(DataValidationMessageBorderBrush, DataValidationMessageBorderWidth - 0.5);
				Rect rectangle = messageLayout.BoundsMessage.ToRect();
				rectangle.Offset(-0.5, -0.5);
				dc.DrawRectangle(DataValidationMessageBackgroudBrush, pen, rectangle);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(messageLayout.Title))
				{
					System.Drawing.Rectangle boundsTitle = messageLayout.BoundsTitle;
					dc.DrawText(GetFontStyle(messageLayout.Title, messageLayout.TitleFontInfo, isTitle: true, boundsTitle.Width), boundsTitle.Location.ToPoint());
				}
				System.Drawing.Rectangle boundsText = messageLayout.BoundsText;
				dc.DrawText(GetFontStyle(messageLayout.Text, messageLayout.TextFontInfo, isTitle: false, boundsText.Width), boundsText.Location.ToPoint());
			}
		}

		private FormattedText GetFontStyle(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, bool isTitle, int drawTextMaxWidth)
		{
			FontWeight weight = (isTitle ? FontWeights.Bold : FontWeights.Normal);
			double value = TextInfoCalculator.CalculateFontSize(fontInfo.Size);
			Typeface typeface = new Typeface(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(fontInfo.Name), FontStyles.Normal, weight, FontStretches.Normal);
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, base.FlowDirection, typeface, FontSizeSaver.GetSize(value), DataValidationMessageForeBrush, null, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			formattedText.MaxTextWidth = drawTextMaxWidth;
			formattedText.Trimming = TextTrimming.None;
			return formattedText;
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetDiagonalBorderControl : WorksheetPaintControl
	{
		private List<DiagonalBorderInfo> borderInfos;

		{
			borderInfos = new List<DiagonalBorderInfo>();

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.LayoutInfo == null || borderInfos.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			float zoomFactor = 1f / (float)base.SpreadsheetProvider.ScaleFactor;
			DocumentModel documentModel = base.Spreadsheet.DocumentModel;
			BorderLinePainter painter = (documentModel.EnhancedLayout ? new BorderLinePainter(dc, ((TileLayout)(WorksheetLayout)base.LayoutInfo).LineThicknessTable, zoomFactor, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnitConverter) : new BorderLinePainter(dc, ((DocumentLayout)base.LayoutInfo).LineThicknessTable, zoomFactor, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnitConverter));

				System.Windows.Media.Color diagonalBorderColor = borderInfo.DiagonalBorderColor;
				Rect bounds = borderInfo.Bounds;
				DrawDiagonalDownBorder(painter, borderInfo.DiagonalDownBorderLineStyle, diagonalBorderColor, bounds);
				DrawDiagonalUpBorder(painter, borderInfo.DiagonalUpBorderLineStyle, diagonalBorderColor, bounds);
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldAddBorder(XlBorderLineStyle downLineStyle, XlBorderLineStyle upLineStyle)

	public class GroupPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutInfoProperty;

		private int childIndex;

		protected internal WorksheetControl Owner { get; private set; }

		public ControlTemplate HeaderTemplate { get; set; }

		public ControlTemplate ButtonTemplate { get; set; }

		public double LineThickness { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush LineBrush { get; set; }

		public double DotThickness { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Brush DotBrush { get; set; }

		public IDocumentLayout LayoutInfo
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return (IDocumentLayout)GetValue(LayoutInfoProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutInfoProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static GroupPanel()
		{
			LayoutInfoProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LayoutInfo", typeof(IDocumentLayout), typeof(GroupPanel));
		}

		public GroupPanel()
		{
			RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, EdgeMode.Aliased);
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<WorksheetControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (LayoutInfo == null)
			{
				HideChildren();
				return finalSize;
			}
			GroupItemsPage groups = LayoutInfo.Groups;
			if (groups == null || groups.Buttons == null)
			{
				HideChildren();
				return finalSize;
			}
			List<OutlineLevelBox> buttons = groups.Buttons;
			foreach (OutlineLevelBox item in buttons)
			{
				GroupItem child = GetChild();
				child.Text = item.Text;
				child.SetSelectedType(item.OutlineLevelBoxSelectType);
				child.IsExpanded = item.IsExpandedButton;
				child.IsCollapsed = item.IsCollapsedButton;
				child.Template = (item.IsHeaderButton ? HeaderTemplate : ButtonTemplate);
				Rect rect = item.Bounds.ToRect();
				if (item.IsHeaderButton)
				{
					rect = CalculateHeaderButtonBounds(rect, item.IsRowButton);
				}
				child.Measure(rect.Size);
				child.Arrange(rect);
			}
			HideChildren();
			return finalSize;
		}

		private Rect CalculateHeaderButtonBounds(Rect originalBounds, bool isRowButton)
		{
			Rect result = originalBounds;
			if (isRowButton)
			{
				double height = CalculateHeaderButtonOffset(Owner?.HeaderHeight, originalBounds.Height);
				result.Inflate(0.0, height);
				result.Offset(-1.0, 0.0);
			}
			else
			{
				double width = CalculateHeaderButtonOffset(Owner?.HeaderWidth, originalBounds.Width);
				result.Inflate(width, 0.0);
				result.Offset(0.0, -1.0);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double CalculateHeaderButtonOffset(double? headerSize, double buttonSize)
		{
			if (!headerSize.HasValue)
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return (headerSize.Value - buttonSize) / 2.0 + 1.0;
		}

		private GroupItem GetChild()
		{
			if (childIndex >= base.Children.Count)
			{
				GroupItem groupItem = new GroupItem();
				groupItem.Focusable = false;
				base.Children.Add(groupItem);
			}
			return base.Children[childIndex++] as GroupItem;
		}

		private void HideChildren()
		{
			for (int i = childIndex; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Children[i].Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			}
			childIndex = 0;
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (LayoutInfo != null && LayoutInfo.Groups != null)
			{
				GroupItemsPage groups = LayoutInfo.Groups;
				DrawDots(dc, groups.Dots);
				DrawLines(dc, groups.Lines);
			}
		}

		private void DrawDots(DrawingContext dc, List<System.Drawing.Point> dots)
		{
			foreach (System.Drawing.Point dot in dots)
			{
				double num = Math.Floor(DotThickness / 2.0);
				dc.DrawRectangle(rectangle: new Rect((double)dot.X - num, (double)dot.Y - num, DotThickness, DotThickness), brush: DotBrush, pen: null);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLines(DrawingContext dc, List<OutlineLevelLine> lines)
		{
			foreach (OutlineLevelLine line in lines)
			{
				DrawLine(dc, line.LinePoint1, line.LinePoint2);
				DrawLine(dc, line.TailPoint1, line.TailPoint2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Drawing.Point point1, System.Drawing.Point point2)
		{
			Rect lineBounds = GetLineBounds(point1, point2);
			dc.DrawRectangle(LineBrush, null, lineBounds);
		}

		private Rect GetLineBounds(System.Drawing.Point point1, System.Drawing.Point point2)
		{
			double num = Math.Ceiling(LineThickness / 2.0) - 1.0;
			if (point1.X == point2.X)
			{
				return RectangleExtensions.GetSaveRect((double)point1.X - num, point1.Y, LineThickness, point2.Y - point1.Y);
			}
			return RectangleExtensions.GetSaveRect(point1.X, (double)point1.Y - num, point2.X - point1.X, LineThickness);
		}
	}

	public class WorksheetIndicatorControl : WorksheetPaintControl, IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CommentIndicatorBrushProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NumberIndicatorBrushProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IndicatorWidthProperty;

		private List<Rect> indicatorBounds;

		private int widthInLayoutUnits;

		private int offsetInLayoutUnits;

			NumberIndicatorBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NumberIndicatorBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeFromHandle);

		public WorksheetIndicatorControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<WorksheetIndicatorControl>(this);
			RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, EdgeMode.Aliased);
			indicatorBounds = new List<Rect>();
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (base.Owner != null && base.LayoutInfo != null)
			{
				widthInLayoutUnits = LayoutConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits((int)Math.Ceiling(HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidthD(IndicatorWidth, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi)), DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
				offsetInLayoutUnits = LayoutConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits(1, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
				base.LayoutInfo.Visit<DrawingContext>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>)this, dc);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			foreach (Page page in base.LayoutInfo.Pages)
			{
				DrawIndicators(dc, page);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			foreach (Rect indicatorBound in indicatorBounds)
			{
				DrawCommentIndicator(dc, indicatorBound);
			}
		}

		private void DrawIndicators(DrawingContext dc, Page page)
		{
			foreach (IndicatorBox indicatorBox in page.IndicatorBoxes)
			{
				DrawIndicator(dc, indicatorBox);
			}
		}

		private void DrawIndicator(DrawingContext dc, IndicatorBox box)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = LayoutConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits((int)Math.Ceiling(HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidthD(IndicatorWidth, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi)), DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			int num2 = LayoutConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnits(1, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			IndicatorType type = box.Type;
			Rect bounds = box.ClipBounds.ToRect();
			if ((int)type == 0)
			{
				DrawCommentIndicator(dc, bounds);
			}
			else if ((int)type == 1)
			{
				DrawNumberFormattingIndicator(dc, bounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawCommentIndicator(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right - (double)offsetInLayoutUnits, bounds.Top - (double)offsetInLayoutUnits);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X - (double)widthInLayoutUnits, point.Y);
			System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + (double)widthInLayoutUnits);
			System.Windows.Point[] points = new System.Windows.Point[3] { point2, point, point3 };
			DrawTriangle(dc, CommentIndicatorBrush, points);
		}

		private void DrawNumberFormattingIndicator(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left - (double)offsetInLayoutUnits, bounds.Top - (double)offsetInLayoutUnits);
			System.Windows.Point point2 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X + (double)widthInLayoutUnits, point.Y);
			System.Windows.Point point3 = new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y + (double)widthInLayoutUnits);
			System.Windows.Point[] points = new System.Windows.Point[3] { point, point2, point3 };
			DrawTriangle(dc, NumberIndicatorBrush, points);
		}

		private void DrawTriangle(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Point[] points)
		{
			PolyLineSegment polyLineSegment = new PolyLineSegment(points, isStroked: false);
			polyLineSegment.Freeze();
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure();
			pathFigure.StartPoint = points[0];
			pathFigure.Segments.Add(polyLineSegment);
			pathFigure.Freeze();
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			pathGeometry.Figures.Add(pathFigure);
			pathGeometry.Freeze();
			dc.DrawGeometry(brush, null, pathGeometry);
		}

		internal void AddIndicatorBounds(Rect rect)
		{
			indicatorBounds.Add(rect);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			indicatorBounds.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetLineControl : WorksheetPaintControl, IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, float>>
	{

		public System.Windows.Media.Color GridLinesColor
		{
			get

				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)GetValue(GridLinesColorProperty);
			}
			set
			{

			}
		}

		private float DpiX => DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX;

		private float DpiY => DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY;

		static WorksheetLineControl()
		{
			FrozenSeparatorBrushProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FrozenSeparatorBrush", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Brush), typeof(WorksheetLineControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));
			GridLinesColorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("GridLinesColor", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color), typeof(WorksheetLineControl), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Colors.Black, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

		public WorksheetLineControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<WorksheetLineControl>(this);
			RenderOptions.SetEdgeMode(this, EdgeMode.Aliased);
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (base.LayoutInfo != null)
			{
				float zoomFactor = TileBorderPaintHelper.CalculateDpiZoomFactor(base.SpreadsheetProvider.ScaleFactor);
				DrawLines(dc, zoomFactor);
				DrawFrozenPanelSeparators(dc, zoomFactor);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLines(DrawingContext dc, float zoomFactor)
		{
			Tuple<DrawingContext, float> tuple = new Tuple<DrawingContext, float>(dc, zoomFactor);
			base.LayoutInfo.Visit<Tuple<DrawingContext, float>>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, float>>)this, tuple);
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, float>>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, Tuple<DrawingContext, float> param)
		{
			DocumentModel documentModel = base.Spreadsheet.DocumentModel;
			Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, int> lineThicknessTable = layout.LineThicknessTable;
			BorderLinePainter painter = new BorderLinePainter(param.Item1, lineThicknessTable, param.Item2, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnitConverter);
			foreach (Page page in layout.Pages)
			{
				DrawLines(painter, page, page.HorizontalGridBorders);
				DrawLines(painter, page, page.VerticalGridBorders);
				DrawLines(painter, page, page.VerticalBorders);
				DrawLines(painter, page, page.HorizontalBorders);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<Tuple<DrawingContext, float>>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, Tuple<DrawingContext, float> param)
		{
			WorksheetLayout tileLayout = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layout is WorksheetLayout) ? layout : null);
			if (tileLayout != null)
			{
				WpfCellBorderTileLayoutPainter borderPainter = TileBorderPaintHelper.CreatePainter(tileLayout, param.Item1, param.Item2);
				tileLayout.Panes.ForEach((Action<Pane>)delegate(Pane pane)
				{
					((CellBorderPainterBase)borderPainter).DrawBorders((IPane)(object)pane, (TileLayout)(object)tileLayout);
				});
			}
		}

		private void DrawLines(BorderLinePainter painter, Page page, List<PageBorderCollection> borders)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < borders.Count; i++)
			{
				DrawLinesCore(painter, page, borders[i]);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLinesCore(BorderLinePainter painter, Page page, PageBorderCollection lines)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<BorderLineBox> boxes = lines.Boxes;
			int count = boxes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				BorderLineBox val = boxes[i];
				DrawLine(painter, val, lines.GetBounds(page, val).ToRect());
			}
		}

		private void DrawLine(BorderLinePainter painter, BorderLineBox box, Rect bounds)
		{
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DocumentModel documentModel = base.Spreadsheet.DocumentModel;
			ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = documentModel.Cache.ColorModelInfoCache[((BorderLineBox)(ref box)).ColorIndex];
			System.Drawing.Color color = colorModelInfo.ToRgb(documentModel.StyleSheet.Palette, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).OfficeTheme.Colors);
			if (DXColor.IsEmpty(color))
			{
				color = documentModel.SkinForeColor;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color borderColor = color.ToWpfColor();
			if (bounds.Width < bounds.Height)
			{
				DrawVerticalBorder(painter, bounds, ((BorderLineBox)(ref box)).LineStyle, borderColor);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawHorizontalBorder(painter, bounds, ((BorderLineBox)(ref box)).LineStyle, borderColor);
			}
		}

		private void DrawVerticalBorder(BorderLinePainter painter, Rect bounds, XlBorderLineStyle lineStyle, System.Windows.Media.Color borderColor)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			painter.DrawLineByStyle(bounds.TopLeft, bounds.BottomLeft, lineStyle, borderColor);
		}

		private void DrawHorizontalBorder(BorderLinePainter painter, Rect bounds, XlBorderLineStyle lineStyle, System.Windows.Media.Color borderColor)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			painter.DrawLineByStyle(bounds.TopLeft, bounds.TopRight, lineStyle, borderColor);
		}

		private void DrawFrozenPanelSeparators(DrawingContext dc, float zoomFactor)
		{
			SheetBase sheet = base.LayoutInfo.Sheet;
			Worksheet val = (Worksheet)(object)((sheet is Worksheet) ? sheet : null);
			if (val == null || !val.IsFrozen())
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point split = default(System.Windows.Point);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(GetSeparatorPenBrush(), GetSeparatorThickness(zoomFactor));
			pen.Freeze();
			if (!base.LayoutInfo.IsTile)
			{
				Page val2 = base.LayoutInfo.Pages[0];
				split = new System.Windows.Point(val2.Bounds.Right, val2.Bounds.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				IDocumentLayout layoutInfo = base.LayoutInfo;
				WorksheetLayout val3 = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layoutInfo is WorksheetLayout) ? layoutInfo : null);
				if (val3 != null)
				{
					split = ((PaneBase)val3.Panes.ScrollablePane).Bounds.Location.ToPoint();
				}
			}
			DrawFrozenPanelSeparatorsCore(dc, pen, split, zoomFactor, val);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSeparatorPenBrush()
		{
			return FrozenSeparatorBrush;
		}

		private float GetSeparatorThickness(float zoomFactor)
		{
			float num = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.Spreadsheet.DocumentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(1f, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			return num * zoomFactor;
		}

		private void DrawFrozenPanelSeparatorsCore(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen separatorPen, System.Windows.Point split, float zoomFactor, Worksheet sheet)
		{
			if (sheet.IsOnlyColumnsFrozen())
			{
				DrawVerticalSeparator(dc, separatorPen, split, zoomFactor);
				return;
			}
			if (sheet.IsOnlyRowsFrozen())
			{
				DrawHorizontalSeparator(dc, separatorPen, split, zoomFactor);
				return;
			}
			DrawVerticalSeparator(dc, separatorPen, split, zoomFactor);
			DrawHorizontalSeparator(dc, separatorPen, split, zoomFactor);
		}

		private void DrawHorizontalSeparator(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen separatorPen, System.Windows.Point split, float zoomFactor)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double y = split.Y;
			double num2 = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidthD(base.ActualWidth, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX) * (double)zoomFactor;
			dc.DrawLine(separatorPen, new System.Windows.Point(num, y), new System.Windows.Point(num + num2, y));
		}

		private void DrawVerticalSeparator(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen separatorPen, System.Windows.Point split, float zoomFactor)
		{
			double x = split.X;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeightD(base.ActualHeight, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY) * (double)zoomFactor;
			dc.DrawLine(separatorPen, new System.Windows.Point(x, num), new System.Windows.Point(x, num + num2));
		}
	}
	public static class LinePatternProvider
	{
		private static Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, float[]> patterns;

		static LinePatternProvider()
		{
			PopulatePatterns();
		}

		public static float[] GetPattern(XlBorderLineStyle style)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			float[] value = null;
			if (patterns.TryGetValue(style, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return new float[1] { 1f };
		}

		private static void PopulatePatterns()
		{
			patterns = new Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, float[]>();
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)3, CreateDashPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)4, CreateDottedPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)7, CreateHairPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)8, CreateMediumDashedPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)9, CreateDashDotPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)10, CreateMediumDashDotPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)12, CreateMediumDashDotDotPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)13, CreateDashDotPattern());
			patterns.Add((XlBorderLineStyle)11, CreateDashDotDotPattern());
		}

		private static float[] CreateDashPattern()
		{
			return new float[2] { 2f, 2f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateDottedPattern()
		{
			return new float[2] { 1f, 3f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateHairPattern()
		{
			return new float[2] { 0f, 2f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateMediumDashedPattern()
		{
			return new float[2] { 7f, 5f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateDashDotPattern()
		{
			return new float[4] { 7f, 4f, 2f, 4f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateDashDotDotPattern()
		{
			return new float[6] { 7f, 4f, 2f, 4f, 2f, 4f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateMediumDashDotPattern()
		{
			return new float[4] { 6f, 5f, 1f, 5f };
		}

		private static float[] CreateMediumDashDotDotPattern()
		{
			return new float[6] { 6f, 5f, 1f, 5f, 1f, 5f };
		}
	}
	public static class PatternBrushProvider
	{
		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush GetBrush(XlBorderLineStyle style, System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (style - 3)
			{
			case 4:
				return CreateHairBrush(color);
			case 0:
				return CreateDashedBrush(color);
			case 5:
				return CreateMediumDashedBrush(color);
			case 1:
				return CreateDottedBrush(color);
			case 6:
			case 7:
			case 10:
				return CreateDashDotBrush(color);
			case 8:
			case 9:
				return CreateDashDotDotBrush(color);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateHairBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			Canvas canvas = new Canvas();
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path();
			SolidColorBrush stroke = new SolidColorBrush(color);
			path.Stroke = stroke;
			path.Data = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0));
			canvas.Children.Add(path);
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path path2 = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path();
			path2.Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
			path2.Data = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(2.0, 0.0));
			canvas.Children.Add(path2);
			VisualBrush visualBrush = CreateBrush(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 2.0));
			visualBrush.Visual = canvas;
			return visualBrush;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateDashDotBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color)

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateDashDotDotBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color color)

			canvas.Children.Add(path2);

			path3.Stroke = solidColorBrush;

			path4.Stroke = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent;
			path4.Data = new LineGeometry(new System.Windows.Point(15.0, 0.0), new System.Windows.Point(18.0, 0.0));
			canvas.Children.Add(path4);

		private static VisualBrush CreateBrush(Rect viewPort)
		{
			VisualBrush visualBrush = new VisualBrush();
			visualBrush.TileMode = TileMode.Tile;
			visualBrush.Stretch = Stretch.Fill;
			visualBrush.Viewport = viewPort;
			visualBrush.ViewportUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			return visualBrush;
		}

	public class BorderLinePainter
	{
		private readonly DrawingContext drawingContext;

		private readonly Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, float> lineThicknessTable;

		private readonly Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, int> lineThicknessTableOldLayout;

		private readonly float zoomFactor;

		private readonly DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter;

		public BorderLinePainter(DrawingContext drawingContext, Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, float> lineThicknessTable, float zoomFactor, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)drawingContext, "drawingContext");
			this.drawingContext = drawingContext;
			this.lineThicknessTable = lineThicknessTable;
			this.zoomFactor = zoomFactor;
			this.layoutUnitConverter = layoutUnitConverter;
		}

		public BorderLinePainter(DrawingContext drawingContext, Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, int> lineThicknessTable, float zoomFactor, DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)drawingContext, "drawingContext");
			this.drawingContext = drawingContext;
			lineThicknessTableOldLayout = lineThicknessTable;
			this.zoomFactor = zoomFactor;
			this.layoutUnitConverter = layoutUnitConverter;
		}

		public virtual void DrawLineTileLayout(XlBorderLineStyle style, System.Windows.Media.Color color, int linePosition, int start, int end)
		{
		}

		public void DrawLineByStyle(System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end, XlBorderLineStyle style, System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)style != 0)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen();
				pen.Thickness = GetLineThickness(style) * zoomFactor;
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = PatternBrushProvider.GetBrush(style, color);
				if (brush != null)
				{
					pen.Brush = brush;
					DrawPatternLine(pen, start, end, (int)style == 13);
					return;
				}
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(color);
				solidColorBrush.Freeze();
				pen.Brush = solidColorBrush;
				DrawSolidLine(pen, start, end, (int)style == 6);
			}
		}

		private float GetLineThickness(XlBorderLineStyle style)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (lineThicknessTable == null)
			{
				return lineThicknessTableOldLayout[style];
			}
			return lineThicknessTable[style];
		}

		private void DrawPatternLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end, bool isSlantDashDot)
		{
			TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
			if (start.X == end.X)
			{
				RotateTransform rotateTransform = new RotateTransform();
				rotateTransform.Angle = 90.0;
				rotateTransform.CenterX = start.X;
				transformGroup.Children.Add(rotateTransform);
			}
			transformGroup.Children.Add(new ScaleTransform(zoomFactor, zoomFactor));
			linePen.Brush.Transform = transformGroup;
			if (isSlantDashDot)
			{
				DrawSlantLine(linePen, start, end);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawLineCore(linePen, start, end);
			}
		}

		private void DrawSolidLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end, bool isDoubleLine)
		{
			if (isDoubleLine)
			{
				DrawDoubleSolidLine(linePen, start, end);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawLineCore(linePen, start, end);
			}
		}

		private void DrawDoubleSolidLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			double thickness = linePen.Thickness;
			thickness /= 3.0;
			float num = PixelsToUnits(1f, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY);
			if (thickness < (double)num)
			{
				thickness = num;
			}
			linePen.Thickness = thickness;
			DrawDoubleSolidLineCore(linePen, start, end);
		}

		protected virtual void DrawDoubleSolidLineCore(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			if (start.X == end.X)
			{
				DrawVerticalDoubleSolidLine(linePen, start, end);
			}
			else if (start.Y == end.Y)
			{
				DrawHorizontalDoubleSolidLine(linePen, start, end);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawDiagonalDoubleSolidLine(linePen, start, end);
			}
		}

		private void DrawVerticalDoubleSolidLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			double num = linePen.Thickness * 2.0;
			DrawLineCore(linePen, start, end);
			DrawLineCore(linePen, new System.Windows.Point(start.X + num, start.Y), new System.Windows.Point(end.X + num, end.Y));
		}

		private void DrawHorizontalDoubleSolidLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			double num = linePen.Thickness * 2.0;
			DrawLineCore(linePen, start, end);
			DrawLineCore(linePen, new System.Windows.Point(start.X, start.Y + num), new System.Windows.Point(end.X, end.Y + num));
		}

		protected void DrawDiagonalDoubleSolidLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			double num = start.X - end.X;
			double num2 = start.Y - end.Y;
			double num3 = Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
			if (num3 != 0.0)
			{
				double num4 = num / num3;
				double num5 = num2 / num3;
				double num6 = linePen.Thickness * num5;
				double num7 = linePen.Thickness * num4;
				System.Windows.Point start2 = new System.Windows.Point(Math.Round(start.X - num6), Math.Round(start.Y + num7));
				System.Windows.Point end2 = new System.Windows.Point(Math.Round(end.X - num6), Math.Round(end.Y + num7));
				DrawLineCore(linePen, start2, end2);
				System.Windows.Point start3 = new System.Windows.Point(Math.Round(start.X + num6), Math.Round(start.Y - num7));
				System.Windows.Point end3 = new System.Windows.Point(Math.Round(end.X + num6), Math.Round(end.Y - num7));
				DrawLineCore(linePen, start3, end3);
			}
		}

		private float PixelsToUnits(float val, float dpi)
		{
			return layoutUnitConverter.PixelsToLayoutUnitsF(val, dpi);
		}

		private void DrawSlantLine(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			drawingContext.PushTransform(DrawSlantLineHelper.GetTransform(start, end));
			DrawLineCore(linePen, start, end);
			drawingContext.Pop();
		}

		private void DrawLineCore(System.Windows.Media.Pen linePen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawLineSnapToPixels(linePen, start, end);
		}
	}

			System.Windows.Point start2 = new System.Windows.Point(start, linePosition);

		}

	public static class DrawSlantLineHelper
	{
		public static SkewTransform GetTransform(System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			SkewTransform skewTransform = new SkewTransform();
			if (start.Y == end.Y)
			{
				skewTransform.AngleX = -45.0;
				skewTransform.CenterY = start.Y;
			}
			else if (start.X == end.X)
			{
				skewTransform.AngleY = -45.0;
				skewTransform.CenterX = start.X;
			}
			return skewTransform;
		}
	}
	public static class TileBorderPaintHelper
	{
		public static float CalculateDpiZoomFactor(double documentZoomFactor)
		{
			return 1f / (float)HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSizeD(documentZoomFactor, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
		}

		public static WpfCellBorderTileLayoutPainter CreatePainter(WorksheetLayout tileLayout, DrawingContext dc, float zoomFactor)
		{
			Dictionary<XlBorderLineStyle, float> lineThicknessTable = ((TileLayout)tileLayout).LineThicknessTable;
			DocumentLayoutUnitConverter layoutUnitConverter = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)((InternalSheetBase)((TileLayout)tileLayout).Worksheet).Workbook).LayoutUnitConverter;
			HorizontalBorderLineTileLayoutPainter horizontalLinePainter = new HorizontalBorderLineTileLayoutPainter(dc, lineThicknessTable, zoomFactor, layoutUnitConverter);
			VerticalBorderLineTileLayoutPainter verticalLinePainter = new VerticalBorderLineTileLayoutPainter(dc, lineThicknessTable, zoomFactor, layoutUnitConverter);
			return new WpfCellBorderTileLayoutPainter(tileLayout, horizontalLinePainter, verticalLinePainter);
		}
	}

	public class WorksheetPaintControl : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		protected internal IDocumentLayout LayoutInfo => Owner?.LayoutInfo;

		protected internal SpreadsheetPropertiesProvider SpreadsheetProvider => GetValue(SpreadsheetViewControl.SpreadsheetProviderProperty) as SpreadsheetPropertiesProvider;

		protected internal WorksheetControl Owner { get; private set; }

		protected internal SpreadsheetControl Spreadsheet { get; private set; }

		public WorksheetPaintControl()
		{
			base.Loaded += WorksheetPaintControlLoaded;
		}

		protected void WorksheetPaintControlLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Owner = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<WorksheetControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			Spreadsheet = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<SpreadsheetControl>((DependencyObject)this);
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected Rect GetCellOuterBorder(Rect bounds, int borderWidth)
		{
			double num = ((double)borderWidth - 1.0) / 2.0;
			bounds.X -= num;
			bounds.Y -= num;
			bounds.Width = Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Width + (double)borderWidth - 2.0);
			bounds.Height = Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Height + (double)borderWidth - 2.0);
			return bounds;
		}

		protected Rect GetCellInnerBorder(Rect bounds, int borderWidth)
		{
			double num = ((double)borderWidth - 1.0) / 2.0;
			bounds.X += num;
			bounds.Y += num;
			bounds.Width = Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Width - (double)borderWidth);
			bounds.Height = Math.Max(0.0, bounds.Height - (double)borderWidth);
			return bounds;
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[ComVisible(false)]
	public struct LayoutCellKey : IComparable<LayoutCellKey>, IEquatable<LayoutCellKey>
	{
		private readonly long m_value;

		public int RowIndex => (int)(m_value & 0xFFFFF);

		public int ColumnIndex => (int)((m_value >> 20) & 0x3FFF);

		public int PaneIndex => (int)(m_value >> 34);

		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		public LayoutCellKey(int columnIndex, int rowIndex, int paneIndex)
		{
			m_value = ((long)paneIndex << 34) + ((long)columnIndex << 20) + rowIndex;
		}

		[DebuggerStepThrough]
		public LayoutCellKey(CellPosition cellPosition, int paneIndex)
			: this(((CellPosition)(ref cellPosition)).Column, ((CellPosition)(ref cellPosition)).Row, paneIndex)
		{
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is LayoutCellKey layoutCellKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return m_value == layoutCellKey.m_value;
		}

		public bool Equals(LayoutCellKey other)
		{
			return m_value == other.m_value;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return m_value.GetHashCode();
		}

		public int CompareTo(LayoutCellKey other)
		{
			if (m_value < other.m_value)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (m_value > other.m_value)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			foreach (CellLayout value in cachedCells.Values)

		private void HideFreeCells()
		{
			List<int> list = cachedCells.Values.Select((CellLayout c) => c.Index).ToList();
			for (int num = 0; num < base.Children.Count; num++)
			{
				if (!list.Contains(num))
				{
					base.Children[num].Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			try
			{
				isMeasureInProcess = true;
				finalSize = base.MeasureOverride(finalSize);
				if (base.LayoutInfo == null || base.Owner == null)
				{
					return finalSize;
				}
				ClearDiagonalBorders();
				ClearIndicatorBounds();
				ClearSparklines();
				UpdateFreeIndexes(base.LayoutInfo);
				List<LayoutCellKey> list = new List<LayoutCellKey>();
				base.LayoutInfo.Visit<List<LayoutCellKey>>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<List<LayoutCellKey>>)this, list);
				ValidateCache(list);
				cacheState = CacheState.Valid;
				return finalSize;
			}
			finally
			{
				isMeasureInProcess = false;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFreeIndexes(IDocumentLayout layout)

				return;
			}
			CellPosition topLeftCell = ((ModelWorksheetViewInfo)activeSheet.ActiveView).TopLeftCell;
			CellPosition bottomRight = layout.GetBottomRight();
			List<LayoutCellKey> list = new List<LayoutCellKey>();
			foreach (LayoutCellKey key in cachedCells.Keys)
			{
				int columnIndex = key.ColumnIndex;
				int rowIndex = key.RowIndex;
				if (columnIndex < ((CellPosition)(ref topLeftCell)).Column || columnIndex > ((CellPosition)(ref bottomRight)).Column || rowIndex < ((CellPosition)(ref topLeftCell)).Row || rowIndex > ((CellPosition)(ref bottomRight)).Row)
				{
					freeIndexes.Add(cachedCells[key].Index);
					list.Add(key);
				}
			}
			foreach (LayoutCellKey item in list)
			{
				cachedCells.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		private Rect PrepareTextBounds(DXStringFormat stringFormat, Rect textBounds, Rect cellBounds, double textCenterX)
		{
			if (stringFormat != null && stringFormat.Alignment == DXStringAlignment.Center)
			{
				double val = textBounds.Width + textBounds.X - textCenterX;
				double val2 = 0.0 - textBounds.X + textCenterX;
				double num = Math.Max(val, val2);
				textBounds.X = textCenterX - num;
				textBounds.Width = num * 2.0;
			}
			textBounds.Offset(cellBounds.X, cellBounds.Y);
			return textBounds;
		}
