		private TextSettings PrepareTileTextSettings(LayoutTileCell layoutCell, Rect cellBounds, Rect textBounds)
		{
			LayoutCellTextFormat textFormat = layoutCell.TextFormat;
			TextSettings textSettings = TextInfoCalculator.PrepareTextInfo(textFormat.Text, layoutCell.DisplayFormat.FontInfo, textFormat.StringFormat, textFormat.TextColor, Foreground);
			double x = textBounds.X - cellBounds.X;
			double y = textBounds.Y - cellBounds.Y;
			textSettings.TextBounds = new Rect(x, y, textBounds.Width, textBounds.Height);
			if (layoutCell.HasRichText)
			{
				PrepareRichTextSettings(textSettings, layoutCell, textFormat);
			}
			textSettings.EnhancedLayout = true;
			return textSettings;
		}

		private void PrepareRichTextSettings(TextSettings settings, LayoutTileCell layoutCell, LayoutCellTextFormat textFormat)
		{
			RichTextContent richTextContent = textFormat.RichTextContent;
			if (richTextContent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (richTextContent.FromNumberFormat)
			{
				foreach (RichTextPart part in richTextContent.Parts)
				{
					TextSettings textSettings = TextInfoCalculator.PrepareRichTextInfo(part.Text, layoutCell.DisplayFormat.FontInfo, textFormat.TextColor, Foreground, 1.0 / base.Owner.ScaleFactor);
					Rect textBounds = part.Bounds.ToRect();
					textBounds.Y = -1.0;
					textBounds.X = (textBounds.X + settings.TextBounds.X) * base.Owner.ScaleFactor;
					textSettings.TextBounds = textBounds;
					settings.RichText.Add(textSettings);
				}
				return;
			}
			foreach (RichTextPart part2 in richTextContent.Parts)
			{
				double correctedSizeD = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSizeD(1.0, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
				TextSettings textSettings2 = TextInfoCalculator.PrepareRichTextInfo(part2.Text, part2.FontInfo, part2.Color, Foreground, correctedSizeD);
				int x = layoutCell.TextFormat.TextBounds.X;
				int y = layoutCell.TextFormat.TextBounds.Y;
				textSettings2.TextBounds = GetUnscaledBounds(part2.Bounds, x, y, correctedSizeD);
				textSettings2.HasUnderline = part2.HasUnderline;
				if (textSettings2.HasUnderline)
				{
					textSettings2.UnderlineBounds = GetUnscaledBounds(part2.UnderlineBounds, x, y, correctedSizeD);
				}
				settings.RichText.Add(textSettings2);
			}
		}

		private Rect GetUnscaledBounds(RectangleF bounds, int offsetX, int offsetY, double zoomFactor)
		{
			return new Rect((double)bounds.X / zoomFactor + (double)offsetX * base.Owner.ScaleFactor, (double)bounds.Y / zoomFactor + (double)offsetY * base.Owner.ScaleFactor, (double)bounds.Width / zoomFactor, (double)bounds.Height / zoomFactor);
		}

		}

		}

			XlBorderLineStyle borderDiagonalStyle = GetBorderDiagonalStyle(diagonalBorders, diagonalBorders.HasDown);
			XlBorderLineStyle borderDiagonalStyle2 = GetBorderDiagonalStyle(diagonalBorders, diagonalBorders.HasUp);
			if (base.Owner.DiagonalBorderControl.ShouldAddBorder(borderDiagonalStyle, borderDiagonalStyle2))
			{
				Rect bounds = box.GetFillBounds(page).ToRect();
				DocumentModel documentModel = page.DocumentLayout.DocumentModel;
				System.Windows.Media.Color color = GetBorderDiagonalColor(diagonalBorders.Color, documentModel).ToWpfColor();
				base.Owner.DiagonalBorderControl.AddBorderInfo(bounds, borderDiagonalStyle, borderDiagonalStyle2, color);
			}
		}

		private XlBorderLineStyle GetBorderDiagonalStyle(DisplayDiagonalBorders borders, bool hasDiagonal)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!hasDiagonal)
			{
				return (XlBorderLineStyle)0;
			}
			return borders.Style;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color GetBorderDiagonalColor(System.Drawing.Color borderColor, DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			if (!DXColor.IsEmpty(borderColor))
			{
				return borderColor;
			}
			return documentModel.SkinForeColor;
		}

		private bool IsInplaceEditorOpenInThisCell(CellPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return !base.Owner.ValidateInplaceEditorPosition(position);
		}

		private bool ShouldMeasureCell(ICell cell)
		{
			if (!cell.HasFormula || !((ModelWorksheetViewInfo)cell.Worksheet.ActiveView).ShowFormulas)
			{
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cell.Text);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void MeasureCell(Page page, CellTextBoxBase box, ICell cell, List<LayoutCellKey> visibleCells, int pageIndex)
		{
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rect rect = box.GetBounds(page).ToRect();
			Rect clipRect = box.GetClipBounds(page).ToRect();
			rect.Intersect(clipRect);
			if (!(rect == Rect.Empty))
			{
				Action<LayoutCellKey> cacheCellContent = delegate(LayoutCellKey cellKey)
				{
					CacheCell(page, box, cell, rect, clipRect, cellKey);
				};
				MeasureCellContentCore(new LayoutCellKey(((ICellBase)cell).Position, pageIndex), page.Bounds.ToRect(), rect, visibleCells, cacheCellContent);
			}
		}

		private void MeasureCellContentCore(LayoutCellKey cellKey, Rect pageBounds, Rect contentBounds, List<LayoutCellKey> visibleCells, Action<LayoutCellKey> cacheCellContent)
		{
			if (cachedCells.TryGetValue(cellKey, out var value))
			{
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = ClipGeometryProvider.GetRectangleGeometry(pageBounds, contentBounds);
				Rect rect = rectangleGeometry.Rect;
				if (rect.Width <= 0.0 || rect.Height <= 0.0)
				{
					return;
				}
				value.ArrangeRect = contentBounds;
				CellPresenter cellPresenter = base.Children[value.Index] as CellPresenter;
				if (cellPresenter.Content is CellData cellData)
				{
					cellData.Clip = rectangleGeometry;
				}
				cellPresenter.InvalidateVisual();
			}
			else
			{
				cacheCellContent(cellKey);
			}
			visibleCells.Add(cellKey);
		}

		private void CacheCell(Page page, CellTextBoxBase box, ICell cell, Rect cellBounds, Rect clipBounds, LayoutCellKey cacheCellKey)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0165: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DocumentLayout documentLayout = page.DocumentLayout;
			CellForegroundDisplayFormat val = documentLayout.DisplayFormatBuilder.CreateForegroundFormatForWpf(page, box, errorTextProvider, (IDocumentModelSkinColorProvider)(object)documentLayout.DocumentModel, false, false);
			string text = val.Text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			TextSettings textSettings = CalculateTextInfo(val, box.DisplayFormat.Alignment, cellBounds, clipBounds);
			if (textSettings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CellData cellData = new CellData(base.Owner, ((ICellBase)cell).Position, textSettings, ClipGeometryProvider.GetRectangleGeometry(page.Bounds.ToRect(), cellBounds));
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = ((base.Owner.CellTemplateSelector != null) ? base.Owner.CellTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(cellData, base.SpreadsheetControl) : null);
			int index = 0;
			CellPresenter cellContainer = GetCellContainer(cacheCellKey, ref index);
			cellContainer.Content = cellData;
			if (dataTemplate != null)
			{
				cellContainer.ContentTemplate = dataTemplate;
			}
			else
			{
				Worksheet sheet = page.Sheet;
				PaintedConditionalFormattingsInfo paintedCFInfo = box.DisplayFormat.PaintedCFInfo;
				ConditionalFormattingSettings cfSettings = new ConditionalFormattingSettings();
				DataTemplate conditionalFormattingTemplate = base.Owner.GetConditionalFormattingTemplate(cell, ((PaintedConditionalFormattingsInfo)(ref paintedCFInfo)).GetIconSet(sheet), ((PaintedConditionalFormattingsInfo)(ref paintedCFInfo)).GetDataBar(sheet), val.Bounds, ref cfSettings);
				cellContainer.ContentTemplate = ((conditionalFormattingTemplate == null) ? base.Owner.CellTemplate : conditionalFormattingTemplate);
				cellData.ConditionalFormattingSettings = cfSettings;
				if (!((PaintedConditionalFormattingsInfo)(ref paintedCFInfo)).ShowValues)
				{
					cellData.TextSettings.Text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			double textWidth = val.Bounds.Width;
			double width = cellBounds.Width;
			VariantValue value = cell.Value;
			cellContainer.ShowCellToolTip = CanShowToolTip(textWidth, width, text, ((VariantValue)(ref value)).Type);
			cellContainer.Measure(cellBounds.Size);
			cachedCells.Add(cacheCellKey, new CellLayout(index, cellBounds));
		}

		private TextSettings CalculateTextInfo(CellForegroundDisplayFormat displayFormat, DisplayAlignment alignment, Rect cellRect, Rect clipRect)
		{
			DXStringFormat stringFormat = GetStringFormat(alignment);
			if (stringFormat == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect rect = displayFormat.Bounds.ToRect();
			if (rect == Rect.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TextSettings textSettings = TextInfoCalculator.PrepareTextInfo(displayFormat, stringFormat, Foreground);
			double x = rect.X - cellRect.X;
			double y = rect.Y - cellRect.Y;
			textSettings.TextBounds = new Rect(x, y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			return textSettings;
		}

		private DXStringFormat GetStringFormat(DisplayAlignment alignment)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int key = StringFormatProvider.CalculateAlignmentHash(alignment.Horizontal, alignment.Vertical, alignment.WrapText);
			if (StringFormats.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CellPresenter GetCellContainer(LayoutCellKey cellKey, ref int index)
		{
			if (cachedCells.TryGetValue(cellKey, out var value))
			{
				return base.Children[value.Index] as CellPresenter;
			}
			if (freeIndexes.Count != 0)
			{
				index = freeIndexes[0];
				freeIndexes.RemoveAt(0);
			}
			else
			{
				CellPresenter element = new CellPresenter
				{
					FlowDirection = System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight
				};
				base.Children.Add(element);
				index = base.Children.Count - 1;
			}
			CellPresenter cellPresenter = base.Children[index] as CellPresenter;
			cellPresenter.CellToolTip = base.Owner.GetCellToolTip();
			InvalidateCellPresenter(cellPresenter);
			return cellPresenter;
		}

		private bool CanShowToolTip(double textWidth, double cellWidth, string text, VariantValueType valueType)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.SpreadsheetProvider.ShowCellToolTipMode == ShowCellToolTipMode.Auto)
			{
				if (!(textWidth >= cellWidth))
				{
					return IsPlaceHolder(text, valueType);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return base.SpreadsheetProvider.ShowCellToolTipMode == ShowCellToolTipMode.Always;
		}

		private bool IsPlaceHolder(string text, VariantValueType valueType)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)valueType != 5 && (int)valueType != 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return text[0] == '#';
		}

		private void ValidateCache(List<LayoutCellKey> visibleCells)
		{
			List<LayoutCellKey> list = cachedCells.Keys.Except(visibleCells).ToList();
			foreach (LayoutCellKey item in list)
			{
				int index = cachedCells[item].Index;
				CellPresenter cellPresenter = base.Children[index] as CellPresenter;
				cellPresenter.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
				InvalidateCellPresenter(cellPresenter);
				freeIndexes.Add(index);
				cachedCells.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearCache(bool deleteChildren = false)
		{
			if (cacheState == CacheState.ClearedDeleteChildren || (cacheState == CacheState.Cleared && !deleteChildren))
			{
				return;
			}
			cachedCells.Clear();
			if (deleteChildren)
			{
				freeIndexes.Clear();
				base.Children.Clear();
				cacheState = CacheState.ClearedDeleteChildren;
				return;
			}
			freeIndexes = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				freeIndexes.Add(i);
				CellPresenter presenter = base.Children[i] as CellPresenter;
				InvalidateCellPresenter(presenter);
			}
			cacheState = CacheState.Cleared;
		}

		private void InvalidateCellPresenter(CellPresenter presenter)
		{
			presenter.Content = null;
			presenter.ContentTemplate = null;
		}
	}
	public static class ClipGeometryProvider
	{
		public static RectangleGeometry GetRectangleGeometry(Rect pageRect, Rect objectRect)
		{
			Rect rect = Rect.Intersect(pageRect, objectRect);
			if (rect.Width <= 0.0 || rect.Height <= 0.0)
			{
				return new RectangleGeometry(Rect.Empty);
			}
			double x = rect.X - objectRect.X;
			double y = rect.Y - objectRect.Y;
			Rect rect2 = new Rect(x, y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
			return new RectangleGeometry(rect2);
		}
	}

	public class HeadersPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty LayoutInfoProperty;

		private int childIndex;

		protected internal SpreadsheetPropertiesProvider SpreadsheetProvider => GetValue(SpreadsheetViewControl.SpreadsheetProviderProperty) as SpreadsheetPropertiesProvider;

		public System.Windows.Controls.Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Controls.Orientation)GetValue(OrientationProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IDocumentLayout LayoutInfo
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return (IDocumentLayout)GetValue(LayoutInfoProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(LayoutInfoProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate ItemTemplate { get; set; }

		static HeadersPanel()
		{
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(System.Windows.Controls.Orientation), typeof(HeadersPanel));
			LayoutInfoProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LayoutInfo", typeof(IDocumentLayout), typeof(HeadersPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((HeadersPanel)d).OnLayoutInfoChanged();
			}));
		}

		public HeadersPanel()
		{
			base.Loaded += HeadersPanelLoaded;
		}

		private void HeadersPanelLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateArrange();
		}

		private void OnLayoutInfoChanged()
		{
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (LayoutInfo == null)
			{
				return finalSize;
			}
			HeaderPage headers = LayoutInfo.Headers;
			if (headers != null)
			{
				headers.Update();
			}
			GroupItemsPage groups = LayoutInfo.Groups;
			if (groups != null && headers != null)
			{
				bool shouldDrawSelection = SpreadsheetProvider.ShouldDrawSelection;
				System.Windows.Size offset = groups.GroupItemsOffset.ToSize();
				if (Orientation == System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal)
				{
					ArrangeHeaders(headers.ColumnBoxes, offset, shouldDrawSelection);
					ArrangeHiddenIndicators(headers.ColumnHiddenIndicators, offset);
				}
				else
				{
					ArrangeHeaders(headers.RowBoxes, offset, shouldDrawSelection);
					ArrangeHiddenIndicators(headers.RowHiddenIndicators, offset);
				}
			}
			HideChildren();
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void ArrangeHeaders(List<HeaderTextBox> boxes, System.Windows.Size offset, bool shouldDrawSelectedItems)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			for (int i = 0; i < boxes.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderTextBox val = boxes[i];
				HeaderBoxSelectType selectType = val.SelectType;
				bool isSelected = ((shouldDrawSelectedItems && ((int)selectType == 2 || (int)selectType == 3)) ? true : false);
				ArrangeItem(val.Text, isSelected, val.ViewBounds.ToRect(), offset);
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeHiddenIndicators(List<System.Drawing.Rectangle> hiddenIndicators, System.Windows.Size offset)
		{
			if (hiddenIndicators == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (System.Drawing.Rectangle hiddenIndicator in hiddenIndicators)
			{
				ArrangeItem(null, isSelected: false, hiddenIndicator.ToRect(), offset);
			}
		}

		private void ArrangeItem(string text, bool isSelected, Rect bounds, System.Windows.Size offset)
		{
			HeaderItem child = GetChild();
			child.Text = text;
			child.IsSelected = isSelected;
			child.Measure(bounds.Size);
			Rect finalRect = Rect.Offset(bounds, 0.0 - offset.Width, 0.0 - offset.Height);
			child.Arrange(finalRect);
		}

		private void HideChildren()
		{
			for (int i = childIndex; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				base.Children[i].Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			}
			childIndex = 0;
		}

		private HeaderItem GetChild()
		{
			if (childIndex >= base.Children.Count)
			{
				HeaderItem headerItem = new HeaderItem
				{
					Focusable = false
				};
				headerItem.Template = ItemTemplate;
				base.Children.Add(headerItem);
			}
			return base.Children[childIndex++] as HeaderItem;
		}
	}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor.Visit(DocumentLayout layout)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < layout.Pages.Count; i++)
			{
				Draw((IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)layout.Pages[i]);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor.Visit(ISheetLayout layout)
		{
			WorksheetLayout val = (WorksheetLayout)(object)((layout is WorksheetLayout) ? layout : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Pane pane in val.Panes)
			{
				Rect rect = ((PaneBase)pane).GetBorderBounds(clipPanePadding).ToRect();
				drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(rect));
				try
				{
					Draw((IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)pane);
				}
				finally
				{
					drawingContext.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private void Draw(IDocumentLayoutPane layoutPane)
		{
			DrawPivotTableItems(layoutPane);
			DrawSparklineSelection(layoutPane);
			DrawPrintRange(layoutPane);
			DrawSelection(layoutPane);
			DrawCutCopyRange(layoutPane);
			DrawAutoFilters(layoutPane);
			DrawReferenceSelection(layoutPane);
		}

			HotZonePainter hotZonePainter = new HotZonePainter(drawingContext, null, base.Owner.AutoFilterImageCache, base.Owner.GetDataValidationBackgroundBrush(), base.Owner.GetDataValidationBorderColor());
			hotZonePainter.DrawHotZones(pivotTableLayout.HotZones);
		}

		public void Draw(PageSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			IsMultiSelection = ((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Layout.IsMultiSelection;
			Geometry activeCellGeometry = GetActiveCellGeometry(item);
			foreach (RangeSelectionLayoutItem innerItem in item.InnerItems)
			{
				Geometry selectionGeometry = GetSelectionGeometry(innerItem);
				CombinedGeometry geometry = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, selectionGeometry, activeCellGeometry);
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(SelectionBrush, null, geometry);
			}
			if (SelectionActiveCellBrush != null)
			{
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(SelectionActiveCellBrush, null, activeCellGeometry);
			}
			if (!SelectionHideInnerBorder)
			{
				Geometry selectionBorderGeometry = GetSelectionBorderGeometry(item);
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(base.Spreadsheet.DocumentModel.SkinBackColor.ToWpfColor());
				solidColorBrush.Freeze();
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(solidColorBrush, smallBorderWidth);
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(null, pen, selectionBorderGeometry);
			}
			((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item.BorderItem).Draw((ISelectionPainter)(object)this);
		}

		private Geometry GetSelectionGeometry(RangeSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry();
			Rect rect = ((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.ToRect();
			rect.Offset(-0.5, -0.5);
			rectangleGeometry.Rect = rect;
			return rectangleGeometry;
		}

		private Geometry GetSelectionBorderGeometry(PageSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			GeometryGroup geometryGroup = new GeometryGroup();
			geometryGroup.FillRule = FillRule.Nonzero;
			double num = (0.0 - (double)(smallBorderWidth + 1)) / 2.0;
			foreach (RangeSelectionLayoutItem innerItem in item.InnerItems)
			{
				if (!((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)innerItem).Bounds.IsEmpty)
				{
					RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry();
					Rect rect = ((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)innerItem).Bounds.ToRect();
					rect.Inflate(num, num);
					if (!rect.IsEmpty)
					{
						rect.Size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width - 1.0), Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height - 1.0));
						rectangleGeometry.Rect = rect;
						geometryGroup.Children.Add(rectangleGeometry);
					}
				}
			}
			return geometryGroup;
		}

		private Geometry GetActiveCellGeometry(PageSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect rect = ((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.ToRect();
			rect.Offset(0.5, 0.5);
			rect.Size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, rect.Width - 2.0), Math.Max(0.0, rect.Height - 2.0));
			return new RectangleGeometry(rect);
		}

		public void Draw(RangeSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
		}

		public void Draw(RangeBorderSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rect rect = ((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.ToRect();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen selectionBorderPen = GetSelectionBorderPen();
			if (IsMultiSelection)
			{
				double num = (double)(-smallBorderWidth) - (double)(smallBorderWidth + 1) / 2.0;
				rect.Inflate(num, num);
				if (rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return;
				}
				rect.Size = new System.Windows.Size(rect.Width - 1.0, rect.Height - 1.0);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(null, selectionBorderPen, rect);
			}
			else
			{
				rect = GetCellOuterBorder(rect, largeBorderWidth);
				drawingContext.PushClip(GetSelectionBorderClip(item));
				try
				{
					double num2 = (double)largeBorderWidth / 2.0;
					double y = rect.Top - num2;
					double y2 = rect.Bottom + num2;
					if (item.IsLeftSideVisible)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawLine(selectionBorderPen, new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left, y), new System.Windows.Point(rect.Left, y2));
					}
					if (item.IsRightSideVisible)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawLine(selectionBorderPen, new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right, y), new System.Windows.Point(rect.Right, y2));
					}
					double x = rect.Left - num2;
					double x2 = rect.Right + num2;
					y = rect.Top;
					y2 = rect.Bottom;
					if (item.IsTopSideVisible)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawLine(selectionBorderPen, new System.Windows.Point(x, y), new System.Windows.Point(x2, y));
					}
					if (item.IsBottomSideVisible)
					{
						drawingContext.DrawLine(selectionBorderPen, new System.Windows.Point(x, y2), new System.Windows.Point(x2, y2));
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					drawingContext.Pop();
				}
			}
			SelectionBorderBounds = rect;
			DrawHotZones(item.HotZones);
		}

		private Geometry GetSelectionBorderClip(RangeBorderSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rect rect = ((RangeSelectionLayoutItemBase)item).Bounds.ToRect();
			rect.Inflate(largeBorderWidth, largeBorderWidth);
			Rect rect2 = item.ClipBound.ToRect();
			double num = (rect2.Width + 1.0) % 2.0 / 2.0;
			rect2.Offset(num, num);
			rect2.Inflate(smallBorderWidth, smallBorderWidth);
			CombinedGeometry combinedGeometry = new CombinedGeometry();
			combinedGeometry.Geometry1 = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
			combinedGeometry.Geometry2 = new RectangleGeometry(rect2);
			combinedGeometry.GeometryCombineMode = GeometryCombineMode.Exclude;
			return combinedGeometry;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen GetSelectionBorderPen()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen();
			pen.Brush = SelectionBorderBrush;
			pen.Thickness = (IsMultiSelection ? smallBorderWidth : largeBorderWidth);
			return pen;
		}

		{

	public class HotZonePainter : IHotZoneVisitor
	{
		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush HotZoneRotationGradientBrush = CreateHotZoneRotationGradientBrush();

		internal static int AutoFilterImageOffset = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(-1, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush HotZoneGradientBrush = CreateHotZoneGradientBrush();

		private static System.Windows.Media.Pen HotZoneLinePen = CreateHotZoneLinePen();

		private static System.Windows.Media.Pen pivotExpandCollapseLinePen = CreatepivotExpandCollapseLinePen();

		private const int fillHandleOffsetInPixels = 1;

		private readonly DrawingContext drawingContext;

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush selectionBorderBrush;

		private readonly AutoFilterImageCache autoFilterImageCache;

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Brush autoFilterBackgroundBrush;

		private readonly System.Windows.Media.Color dataValidationBorderColor;

		private int fillHandleOffset;

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateHotZoneRotationGradientBrush()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(225, 0, 128, 0));
			brush.Freeze();
			return brush;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush CreateHotZoneGradientBrush()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, 112, 128, 144));
			brush.Freeze();
			return brush;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Pen CreateHotZoneLinePen()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Gray, 1.0);
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Pen CreatepivotExpandCollapseLinePen()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(75, 75, 75)), 1.0);
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		public HotZonePainter(DrawingContext drawingContext)
			: this(drawingContext, null)
		{
		}

		public HotZonePainter(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush selectionBorderBrush)
			: this(drawingContext, selectionBorderBrush, null, null)
		{
		}

		public HotZonePainter(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush selectionBorderBrush, AutoFilterImageCache autoFilterImageCache, System.Windows.Media.Brush autoFilterBackgroundBrush)
			: this(drawingContext, selectionBorderBrush, autoFilterImageCache, autoFilterBackgroundBrush, Colors.Transparent)
		{
		}

		public HotZonePainter(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Media.Brush selectionBorderBrush, AutoFilterImageCache autoFilterImageCache, System.Windows.Media.Brush autoFilterBackgroundBrush, System.Windows.Media.Color dataValidationBorderColor)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)drawingContext, "drawingContext");
			this.drawingContext = drawingContext;
			this.selectionBorderBrush = selectionBorderBrush;
			this.autoFilterImageCache = autoFilterImageCache;
			this.autoFilterBackgroundBrush = autoFilterBackgroundBrush;
			this.dataValidationBorderColor = dataValidationBorderColor;
			Initialize();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			fillHandleOffset = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSize(1, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
		}

		protected internal void DrawHotZones(HotZoneCollection hotZones)
		{
			foreach (HotZone item in (List<HotZone>)(object)hotZones)
			{
				DrawHotZone(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal void DrawHotZone(HotZone zone)
		{
			zone.Visit((IHotZoneVisitor)(object)this);
		}

		private void DrawEllipticHotZone(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Brush fillBrush)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawEllipseSnapToPixels(fillBrush, HotZoneLinePen, CalcCenter(bounds), bounds.Width / 2.0, bounds.Height / 2.0);
		}

		private void DrawRectangularHotZone(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Brush fillBrush)
		{
			drawingContext.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(fillBrush, HotZoneLinePen, bounds);
		}

		internal static System.Windows.Point CalcCenter(Rect bounds)
		{
			return RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(bounds.ToRectangle()).ToPoint();
		}

		public void Visit(DrawingObjectRotationHotZone hotZone)
		{
			System.Windows.Point start = RectangleUtils.CenterPoint(((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds).ToPoint();
			System.Windows.Point end = hotZone.LineEnd.ToPoint();
			drawingContext.DrawLineSnapToPixels(HotZoneLinePen, start, end);
			DrawEllipticHotZone(((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds.ToRect(), HotZoneRotationGradientBrush);
		}

		public void Visit(IResizeHotZone hotZone)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Rect bounds = hotZone.Bounds.ToRect();
			if ((int)hotZone.Type == 1)
			{
				DrawEllipticHotZone(bounds, HotZoneGradientBrush);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawRectangularHotZone(bounds, HotZoneGradientBrush);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(RangeDragHotZone hotZone)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(RangeResizeHotZone hotZone)
		{
			Rect rectangle = ((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds.ToRect();
			double num = (rectangle.Width + 1.0) % 2.0 / 2.0;
			rectangle.Offset(num, num);
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(selectionBorderBrush, null, rectangle);
		}

		public void Visit(FormulaRangeDragHotZone hotZone)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(FormulaRangeResizeHotZone hotZone)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(IFilterHotZone hotZone)
		{
			int num = 0;
			Rect bounds = hotZone.BoundsHotZone.ToRect();
			num = ((!(hotZone is AutoFilterColumnHotZone)) ? autoFilterImageCache.CalculatePivotTableFilterImageIndex((PivotTableFilterHotZone)(object)((hotZone is PivotTableFilterHotZone) ? hotZone : null)) : autoFilterImageCache.CalculateAutoFilterImageIndex((AutoFilterColumnHotZone)(object)((hotZone is AutoFilterColumnHotZone) ? hotZone : null)));
			DrawAutoFilterImage(bounds, num);
		}

		public void Visit(DataValidationHotZone hotZone)
		{
			Rect bounds = ((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds.ToRect();
			if (bounds.Width != 0.0 && bounds.Height != 0.0)
			{
				DrawAutoFilterImage(bounds, 0);
				DrawDataValidationBorder(bounds);
			}
		}

		private void DrawDataValidationBorder(Rect bounds)
		{
			bounds = RectangleExtensions.GetSaveRect(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width - 1.0, bounds.Height - 1.0);
			bounds.Offset(-0.5, -0.5);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(dataValidationBorderColor);
			brush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, 1.0);
			drawingContext.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(pen, bounds);
		}

		private void DrawAutoFilterImage(Rect bounds, int imageIndex)
		{
			ImageSource imageSource = autoFilterImageCache.GetImageSource(imageIndex);
			if (imageSource != null)
			{
				bounds.Offset(AutoFilterImageOffset, AutoFilterImageOffset);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(autoFilterBackgroundBrush, bounds);
				double num = (bounds.Width - imageSource.Width) / 2.0;
				double num2 = (bounds.Height - imageSource.Height) / 2.0;
				Rect rectangle = new Rect(bounds.X + num, bounds.Y + num2, imageSource.Width, imageSource.Height);
				drawingContext.DrawImage(imageSource, rectangle);
			}
		}

		void IHotZoneVisitor.Visit(CommentDragHotZone hotZone)
		{
		}

		void IHotZoneVisitor.Visit(PivotTableExpandCollapseHotZone hotZone)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(dataValidationBorderColor), 1.0);
			pen.Freeze();
			System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds = ((HotZone)hotZone).Bounds;
			Rect saveRect = RectangleExtensions.GetSaveRect(bounds.Left + 1, bounds.Top + 1, bounds.Width - 1, bounds.Height - 1);
			drawingContext.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(autoFilterBackgroundBrush, bounds.ToRect());
			drawingContext.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(pen, saveRect);
			double y = bounds.Y + bounds.Height / 2;
			drawingContext.DrawLineSnapToPixels(pivotExpandCollapseLinePen, new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Left + 2, y), new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Right - 2, y));
			if (hotZone.IsCollapsed)
			{
				double x = bounds.X + bounds.Width / 2;
				drawingContext.DrawLineSnapToPixels(pivotExpandCollapseLinePen, new System.Windows.Point(x, bounds.Top + 2), new System.Windows.Point(x, bounds.Bottom - 2));
			}
		}
	}
	public class WorksheetShapeSelectionControl : WorksheetPaintControl, IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>
	{
		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			base.OnRender(dc);
			if (base.LayoutInfo != null)
			{
				base.SpreadsheetProvider.ActiveView.SelectionLayout.UpdatePictureSelection();
				base.LayoutInfo.Visit<DrawingContext>((IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>)this, dc);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>.Visit(DocumentLayout layout, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			foreach (Page page in layout.Pages)
			{
				DrawPictureSelection(dc, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)page);
			}
		}

		void IDocumentLayoutVisitor<DrawingContext>.Visit(ISheetLayout layout, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)((SheetBase)layout.Sheet).SheetType == 2)
			{
				DrawPictureSelection(dc, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)((ChartsheetLayout)layout).PaneForHotZonesCaching);
				return;
			}
			((WorksheetLayout)layout).Panes.ForEach((Action<Pane>)delegate(Pane p)
			{
				DrawPictureSelection(dc, (IDocumentLayoutPane)(object)p);
			});
		}

		private void DrawPictureSelection(DrawingContext drawingContext, IDocumentLayoutPane layoutPane)
		{
			SpreadsheetView activeView = base.SpreadsheetProvider.ActiveView;
			PictureSelectionLayoutItemCollection pictureSelection = activeView.SelectionLayout.GetPictureSelection();
			Rect pageRect = (layoutPane.Bounds.IsEmpty ? Rect.Empty : layoutPane.Bounds.ToRect());
			for (int i = 0; i < ((List<PictureSelectionLayoutItem>)(object)pictureSelection).Count; i++)
			{
				PictureSelectionLayoutItem val = ((List<PictureSelectionLayoutItem>)(object)pictureSelection)[i];
				val.Update(layoutPane);
				DrawPictureSelectionCore(drawingContext, val, pageRect);
			}
		}

		private void DrawPictureSelectionCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, PictureSelectionLayoutItem item, Rect pageRect)
		{
			Rect rect = item.Bounds.ToRect();
			bool flag = !pageRect.IsEmpty;
			if (flag)
			{
				drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(pageRect));
			}
			try
			{
				System.Windows.Point center = HotZonePainter.CalcCenter(rect);
				bool flag2 = NeedPushTransform(item);
				if (flag2)
				{
					PushTransform(drawingContext, center, item.Angle, item.FlipH, item.FlipV);
				}
				System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.LightBlue, 1.0);
				pen.Freeze();
				try
				{
					drawingContext.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(pen, rect);
					DrawHotZones(drawingContext, item.HotZones);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						drawingContext.Pop();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					drawingContext.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NeedPushTransform(PictureSelectionLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.Angle == 0f && !item.FlipH)
			{
				return item.FlipV;
			}
			return true;
		}

	public abstract class WpfSparklineDataCalculatorBase
	{
		private readonly SparklineGroup sparklineGroup;

		private readonly CellRangeBase sourceDataRange;

		private double minValue;

		private double maxValue;

		public double MinValue => minValue;

		public double MaxValue => maxValue;

		protected SparklineGroup Group => sparklineGroup;

		protected bool DisplayBlanksAsSpan => (int)sparklineGroup.DisplayBlanksAs == 1;

		protected bool CurrentCellIsVisible { get; private set; }

		protected WpfSparklineDataCalculatorBase(SparklineGroup sparklineGroup, CellRangeBase sourceDataRange)
		{
			this.sparklineGroup = sparklineGroup;
			this.sourceDataRange = sourceDataRange;
			minValue = double.NaN;
			maxValue = double.NaN;
		}

		public WpfSparklineDataProvider Calculate()
		{
			WpfSparklineExtendedData data = CreateExtendedData();
			return new WpfSparklineDataProvider(data);
		}

		protected abstract WpfSparklineExtendedData CreateExtendedData();

		protected IEnumerator<ICellBase> GetValueCellsEnumerator(bool showHiddenData, bool reverseOrder)
		{
			return GetCellsEnumerator(sourceDataRange, showHiddenData, reverseOrder);
		}

		protected IEnumerator<ICellBase> GetArgumentCellsEnumerator()
		{
			return GetCellsEnumerator(sparklineGroup.DateRange, showHiddenData: true, reverseOrder: false);
		}

		private IEnumerator<ICellBase> GetCellsEnumerator(CellRangeBase range, bool showHiddenData, bool reverseOrder)
		{
			List<CellRange> innerRanges = new List<CellRange>(range.GetAreasEnumerable());
			Func<CellRange, List<Row>> rowsStrategy = GetRowsStrategy(range.Worksheet, showHiddenData);
			if (reverseOrder)
			{
				return GetCellsEnumeratorReverse(innerRanges, rowsStrategy);
			}
			return GetCellsEnumerator(innerRanges, rowsStrategy);
		}

		private IEnumerator<ICellBase> GetCellsEnumerator(List<CellRange> innerRanges, Func<CellRange, List<Row>> getRows)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < innerRanges.Count; i++)
			{
				CellRange innerRange = innerRanges[i];
				List<Row> rowList = getRows(innerRange);
				for (int columnIndex = innerRange.LeftColumnIndex; columnIndex <= innerRange.RightColumnIndex; columnIndex++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < rowList.Count; j++)
					{
						Row val = rowList[j];
						CurrentCellIsVisible = !val.IsHidden;
						yield return (ICellBase)(object)((ICellCollectionGeneric<ICell>)(object)val.Cells).TryGetCell(columnIndex);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerator<ICellBase> GetCellsEnumeratorReverse(List<CellRange> innerRanges, Func<CellRange, List<Row>> getRows)
		{
			for (int i = innerRanges.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			{
				CellRange innerRange = innerRanges[i];
				List<Row> rowList = getRows(innerRange);
				for (int columnIndex = innerRange.RightColumnIndex; columnIndex >= innerRange.LeftColumnIndex; columnIndex--)
				{
					for (int j = rowList.Count - 1; j >= 0; j--)
					{
						yield return (ICellBase)(object)((ICellCollectionGeneric<ICell>)(object)rowList[j].Cells).TryGetCell(columnIndex);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Func<CellRange, List<Row>> GetRowsStrategy(ICellTable cellTable, bool showHiddenData)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IRowCollection rows = ((Worksheet)cellTable).Rows;
			if (showHiddenData)
			{
				return (CellRange range) => GetRows(rows, range.TopRowIndex, range.BottomRowIndex);
			}
			return (CellRange range) => GetVisibleRows(rows, range.TopRowIndex, range.BottomRowIndex);
		}

		private List<Row> GetRows(IRowCollection rows, int topRowIndex, int bottomRowIndex)
		{
			return new List<Row>(rows.GetAllRowsWithFake(topRowIndex, bottomRowIndex, false));
		}

		private List<Row> GetVisibleRows(IRowCollection rows, int topRowIndex, int bottomRowIndex)
		{
			List<Row> list = new List<Row>();
			foreach (IIndexRange item in rows.RowsVisibility.GetRowsIndexesRangeEnumerable(topRowIndex, bottomRowIndex, true))
			{
				list.AddRange(rows.GetAllRowsWithFake(item.StartIndex, item.EndIndex, false));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected double GetCellValue(ICellBase cell)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (cell != null)
			{
				VariantValue value = cell.Value;
				if (!((VariantValue)(ref value)).IsEmpty)
				{
					WorkbookDataContext dataContext = ((ICellTable)cell.Sheet).Workbook.DataContext;
					value = cell.Value;
					VariantValue val = ((VariantValue)(ref value)).ToNumeric(dataContext);
					if (!((VariantValue)(ref val)).IsNumeric)
					{
						return 0.0;
					}
					return ((VariantValue)(ref val)).NumericValue;
				}
			}
			if ((int)sparklineGroup.DisplayBlanksAs != 0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		protected void UpdateMinMax(double value)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(value))
			{
				minValue = (double.IsNaN(minValue) ? value : Math.Min(minValue, value));
				maxValue = (double.IsNaN(maxValue) ? value : Math.Max(maxValue, value));
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfSparklineExtendedDataCalculator : WpfSparklineDataCalculatorBase
	{
		private delegate void PopulateData(double argument, List<double> values, Action<SparklinePoint> add);

		private readonly Dictionary<double, List<double>> uniqueArgValues;

		private double minArg;

		private double maxArg;

		public WpfSparklineExtendedDataCalculator(SparklineGroup sparklineGroup, CellRangeBase sourceDataRange)
			: base(sparklineGroup, sourceDataRange)
		{
			uniqueArgValues = new Dictionary<double, List<double>>();
			minArg = double.NaN;
			maxArg = double.NaN;
		}

		protected override WpfSparklineExtendedData CreateExtendedData()
		{
			PopulateUniqueArgValues();
			List<SparklinePoint> data = new List<SparklinePoint>();
			Action<SparklinePoint> addStategy = GetAddStategy(data);
			Func<double, double> convertStrategy = GetConvertStrategy();
			PopulateData populateDataStratgy = GetPopulateDataStratgy();
			List<double> list = new List<double>(uniqueArgValues.Keys);
			list.Sort();
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				double num = list[i];
				List<double> list2 = uniqueArgValues[num];
				bool isFirstOrLastArg = i == 0 || i == count - 1;
				if (!base.DisplayBlanksAsSpan || HasNonBlankValues(list2, isFirstOrLastArg))
				{
					populateDataStratgy(convertStrategy(Math.Floor(num)), list2, addStategy);
				}
			}
			return new WpfSparklineExtendedData(data);
		}

		private void PopulateUniqueArgValues()
		{
			bool showHidden = base.Group.ShowHidden;
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = double.NaN;
			IEnumerator<ICellBase> valueCellsEnumerator = GetValueCellsEnumerator(showHiddenData: true, reverseOrder: false);
			IEnumerator<ICellBase> argumentCellsEnumerator = GetArgumentCellsEnumerator();
			while (valueCellsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ICellBase current = valueCellsEnumerator.Current;
				double cellValue = GetCellValue(current);
				UpdateMinMax(cellValue);
				if (!showHidden && !base.CurrentCellIsVisible)
				{
					argumentCellsEnumerator.MoveNext();
					num++;
				}
				else if (argumentCellsEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					num2 = GetArgumentCellValue(argumentCellsEnumerator.Current);
					if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && (showHidden || base.CurrentCellIsVisible))
					{
						minArg = (double.IsNaN(minArg) ? num2 : Math.Min(minArg, num2));
						maxArg = (double.IsNaN(maxArg) ? num2 : Math.Max(maxArg, num2));
						if (uniqueArgValues.ContainsKey(num2))
						{
							uniqueArgValues[num2].Add(cellValue);
							continue;
						}
						uniqueArgValues.Add(num2, new List<double> { cellValue });
					}
				}
				else if (num > 0 && !double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					uniqueArgValues[num2].Add(cellValue);
					num--;
				}
			}
		}

		protected Action<SparklinePoint> GetAddStategy(List<SparklinePoint> data)
		{
			if (base.Group.RightToLeft)
			{
				return delegate(SparklinePoint point)
				{
					data.Insert(0, point);
				};
			}
			return delegate(SparklinePoint point)
			{
				data.Add(point);
			};
		}

		private double GetArgumentCellValue(ICellBase cell)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (cell != null)
			{
				VariantValue value = cell.Value;
				if (((VariantValue)(ref value)).IsNumeric)
				{
					value = cell.Value;
					return ((VariantValue)(ref value)).NumericValue;
				}
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		private bool HasNonBlankValues(List<double> argumentValues, bool isFirstOrLastArg)
		{
			argumentValues.RemoveAll((double val) => double.IsNaN(val));
			bool flag = argumentValues.Count > 0;
			if (!flag && isFirstOrLastArg)
			{
				argumentValues.Add(double.NaN);
				return true;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private Func<double, double> GetConvertStrategy()
		{
			if (base.Group.RightToLeft)
			{
				double middlePoint = (maxArg - minArg) / 2.0 + 1.0;
				return (double arg) => (arg != middlePoint) ? (2.0 * middlePoint - arg) : middlePoint;
			}
			return (double arg) => arg;
		}

		private unsafe PopulateData GetPopulateDataStratgy()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			SparklineGroupType type = base.Group.Type;
			switch ((int)type)
			{
			case 0:
				return PopulateDataForLineSparkline;
			case 1:
			case 2:
				return PopulateDataForBarSparkline;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Unknown sparkline type" + ((object)(*(SparklineGroupType*)(&type))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString());
			}
		}

		private void PopulateDataForLineSparkline(double argument, List<double> values, Action<SparklinePoint> add)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				add(new SparklinePoint(argument, value));
			}
		}

		private void PopulateDataForBarSparkline(double argument, List<double> values, Action<SparklinePoint> add)
		{
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Expected O, but got Unknown
			double? num = null;
			double? num2 = null;
			foreach (double value in values)
			{
				if (value >= 0.0)
				{
					num = (num.HasValue ? Math.Max(num.Value, value) : value);
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = (num2.HasValue ? Math.Min(num2.Value, value) : value);
				}
			}
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				add(new SparklinePoint(argument, num.Value));
			}
			if (num2.HasValue)
			{
				add(new SparklinePoint(argument, num2.Value));
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfSparklineDataCalculator : WpfSparklineDataCalculatorBase
	{
		public static SparklineMinMaxValues GetMinMaxValues(SparklineGroup sparklineGroup, CellRangeBase sourceDataRange)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SparklineDataCalculator val = new SparklineDataCalculator(sparklineGroup, sourceDataRange);
			return val.GetMinMaxValuesCore();
		}

		public WpfSparklineDataCalculator(SparklineGroup sparklineGroup, CellRangeBase sourceDataRange)
			: base(sparklineGroup, sourceDataRange)
		{
		}

		protected override WpfSparklineExtendedData CreateExtendedData()
		{
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<SparklinePoint> list = new List<SparklinePoint>();
			IEnumerator<ICellBase> valueCellsEnumerator = GetValueCellsEnumerator(base.Group.ShowHidden, base.Group.RightToLeft);
			if (valueCellsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (true)
				{
					double cellValue = GetCellValue(valueCellsEnumerator.Current);
					UpdateMinMax(cellValue);
					bool flag = valueCellsEnumerator.MoveNext();
					if (!base.DisplayBlanksAsSpan || num == 0 || !flag || !double.IsNaN(cellValue))
					{
						list.Add(new SparklinePoint((double)num, cellValue));
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return new WpfSparklineExtendedData(list);
		}

		private SparklineMinMaxValues GetMinMaxValuesCore()
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IEnumerator<ICellBase> valueCellsEnumerator = GetValueCellsEnumerator(base.Group.ShowHidden, base.Group.RightToLeft);
			while (valueCellsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				double cellValue = GetCellValue(valueCellsEnumerator.Current);
				UpdateMinMax(cellValue);
			}
			return new SparklineMinMaxValues(base.MinValue, base.MaxValue);
		}
	}
	public class WpfSparklineDataProvider
	{
		public WpfSparklineExtendedData Data { get; private set; }

		public List<SparklinePoint> SortedPoints { get; private set; }

		public WpfSparklineRangeData DataArgumentRange { get; private set; }

		public WpfSparklineDataProvider(WpfSparklineExtendedData data)
		{
			Data = data;
			SortedPoints = FilterValidPoints(data.Points);
			FilterPointsWithRange();
		}

		private List<SparklinePoint> FilterValidPoints(IList<SparklinePoint> points)
		{
			List<SparklinePoint> list;
			if (points != null)
			{
				list = new List<SparklinePoint>(points.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
				{
					SparklinePoint val = points[i];
					if (SparklineMathUtils.IsValidDouble(val.Argument))
					{
						list.Add(val);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list = new List<SparklinePoint>();
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void FilterPointsWithRange()
		{
			if (SortedPoints.Count == 0)
			{
				DataArgumentRange = new WpfSparklineRangeData();
			}
			else if (SortedPoints.Count == 1)
			{
				DataArgumentRange = new WpfSparklineRangeData(SortedPoints[0].Argument, SortedPoints[0].Argument);
			}
			else if (SortedPoints.Count == 2)
			{
				DataArgumentRange = new WpfSparklineRangeData(SortedPoints[0].Argument, SortedPoints[1].Argument);
			}
			else
			{
				DataArgumentRange = new WpfSparklineRangeData(SortedPoints[0].Argument, SortedPoints[SortedPoints.Count - 1].Argument);
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfSparklineRangeData
	{
		private double min;

		private double max;

		public double Min => min;

		public double Max => max;

		public double Delta => Max - Min;

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(Min))
				{
					return !double.IsNaN(Max);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public WpfSparklineRangeData()
		{
			Invalidate();
		}

		public WpfSparklineRangeData(double min, double max)
		{
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
		}

		internal void Extend(double value)
		{
			if (SparklineMathUtils.IsValidDouble(value))
			{
				if (double.IsNaN(min))
				{
					min = value;
				}
				else if (min > value)
				{
					min = value;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(max))
				{
					max = value;
				}
				else if (max < value)
				{
					max = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Invalidate()
		{
			min = double.NaN;
			max = double.NaN;
		}

		public void Set(double min, double max)
		{
			this.min = min;
			this.max = max;
		}

		public bool InRange(double value)
		{
			if (value >= min)
			{
				return value <= max;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (IsValid)
			{
				return $"SparklineRange [{min}:{max}]";
			}
			return "Invalid SparklineRange";
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public class GridLengthConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return (parameter != null && parameter.ToString() == "Star") ? new GridLength((double)value, GridUnitType.Star) : new GridLength((double)value);
		}

	public class BoolToGridLengthConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ((bool)value) ? GetGridLengthFromString(parameter) : new GridLength(0.0);
		}

		private GridLength GetGridLengthFromString(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				return new GridLength(0.0);
			}
			string text = parameter.ToString();
			if (text.Contains("*"))
			{
				double value = double.Parse(text.Substring(0, text.IndexOf('*')));
				return new GridLength(value, GridUnitType.Star);
			}
			if (text == "Auto")
			{
				return new GridLength(1.0, GridUnitType.Auto);
			}
			return new GridLength(double.Parse(text));
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}

	public class NoneToNullFilterOperatorConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private Dictionary<string, GenericFilterOperator> filterOperatorTable;

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)(GenericFilterOperator)value == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (string key in filterOperatorTable.Keys)
			{
				if (filterOperatorTable[key] == (GenericFilterOperator)value)
				{
					return key;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (string key in filterOperatorTable.Keys)
			{
				if (key == value.ToString())
				{
					return filterOperatorTable[key];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void PopuplateFilterOperatorTable(bool IsDateTimeFilter)
		{
			Dictionary<string, GenericFilterOperator> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, GenericFilterOperator>();
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)485), (GenericFilterOperator)0);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)486), (GenericFilterOperator)1);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)487), (GenericFilterOperator)2);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)496), (GenericFilterOperator)7);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)497), (GenericFilterOperator)8);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)498), (GenericFilterOperator)9);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)499), (GenericFilterOperator)10);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)500), (GenericFilterOperator)11);
			dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)501), (GenericFilterOperator)12);
			if (IsDateTimeFilter)
			{
				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)492), (GenericFilterOperator)3);
				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)493), (GenericFilterOperator)4);
				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)494), (GenericFilterOperator)5);
				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)495), (GenericFilterOperator)6);
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)488), (GenericFilterOperator)3);
				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)489), (GenericFilterOperator)4);

				dictionary.Add(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)491), (GenericFilterOperator)6);
			}
			filterOperatorTable = dictionary;
		}

	public abstract class FormControlRenderer
	{
		internal static SolidColorBrush ElementBrush = CreateElementBrush();

		internal static System.Windows.Media.Pen BorderPen = CreateBorderPen();

		private readonly FormControlBase formControl;

		protected FormControlBase FormControl => formControl;

		protected virtual string DefaultFontName => "Segoe UI";

		protected virtual float DefaultFontSize => 8f;

		protected FormControlRenderer(FormControlBase formControl)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)formControl, "formControl");
			this.formControl = formControl;
		}

		private static SolidColorBrush CreateElementBrush()
		{
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(FormControlDrawingDataProvider.BaseElementColor.ToWpfColor());
			solidColorBrush.Freeze();
			return solidColorBrush;
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Pen CreateBorderPen()
		{
			SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(FormControlDrawingDataProvider.BaseBorderColor.ToWpfColor());
			solidColorBrush.Freeze();
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(solidColorBrush, FormControlDrawingDataProvider.BorderThicknessInPixels);
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}

		public void Draw(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds)
		{
			Rect rect = Rect.Inflate(bounds, 1.0, 1.0);
			dc.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(rect));
			try
			{
				DrawCore(dc, bounds);
			}
			finally
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
		}

		protected abstract void DrawCore(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds);

		protected void DrawTriangle(DrawingContext dc, Rect buttonBounds, FormControlButtonAlignment buttonAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PointF[] points = FormControlViewInfoCalculator.CalculateTrianglePoints(PdfExportExtensions.ToRectangleF(buttonBounds), buttonAlignment);
			PathGeometry geometry = CreateGeometry(points, closed: true);
			dc.DrawGeometry(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black, null, geometry);
		}

		protected PathGeometry CreateGeometry(PointF[] points, bool closed)
		{
			int num = points.Length;
			if (num < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LineSegment[] array = new LineSegment[num - 1];
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i - 1] = new LineSegment(points[i].ToPoint(), isStroked: true);
			}
			PathFigure pathFigure = new PathFigure(points[0].ToPoint(), array, closed);
			pathFigure.Freeze();
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry(new PathFigure[1] { pathFigure });
			pathGeometry.Freeze();
			return pathGeometry;
		}

		protected void DrawText(DrawingContext dc, TextProperties textProperties, Rect textBounds, TextAlignment horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment)
		{
			FormattedText fText = CalculateFormattedText(textProperties);
			DrawText(dc, fText, textBounds, horizontalAlignment, verticalAlignment, TextTrimming.None);
		}

		protected void DrawText(DrawingContext dc, FormattedText fText, Rect textBounds, TextAlignment horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment, TextTrimming trimming)
		{
			if (textBounds.Width != 0.0 && textBounds.Height != 0.0)
			{
				fText.MaxTextWidth = textBounds.Width;
				fText.MaxTextHeight = textBounds.Height;
				fText.TextAlignment = horizontalAlignment;
				fText.Trimming = trimming;
				double y = CalculateTextVerticalPosition(textBounds, fText.Height, verticalAlignment);
				System.Windows.Point origin = new System.Windows.Point(textBounds.Left, y);
				dc.DrawText(fText, origin);
			}
		}

		protected FormattedText CalculateFormattedText(TextProperties textProperties)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FormControlTextInfo val = FormControlViewInfoCalculator.CalculateTextInfo(textProperties, DefaultFontName, DefaultFontSize);
			double emSize = TextInfoCalculator.CalculateFontSize(((FormControlTextInfo)(ref val)).Size, 96f);
			TypefaceResolver typefaceResolver = new TypefaceResolver();
			bool fontBold = (((FormControlTextInfo)(ref val)).Style & DXFontStyle.Bold) != 0;
			bool fontItalic = (((FormControlTextInfo)(ref val)).Style & DXFontStyle.Italic) != 0;
			Typeface typeface = typefaceResolver.GetTypeface(((FormControlTextInfo)(ref val)).Name, fontBold, fontItalic);
			return new FormattedText(((FormControlTextInfo)(ref val)).Text, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight, typeface, emSize, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black);
		}

		private double CalculateTextVerticalPosition(Rect bounds, double textHeight, VerticalAlignment alignment)
		{
			return alignment switch
			{
				VerticalAlignment.Top => bounds.Top, 
				VerticalAlignment.Center => bounds.Height / 2.0 - textHeight / 2.0, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid alignment {alignment}"), 
			};
		}

		protected System.Windows.Media.Pen CreateBorderPen(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(brush, FormControlDrawingDataProvider.BorderThicknessInPixels);
			pen.Freeze();
			return pen;
		}
	}
	public class ButtonFormControlRenderer : FormControlRenderer
	{
		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush borderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(FormControlDrawingDataProvider.ButtonBorderColor.ToWpfColor());

		protected override string DefaultFontName => "Calibri";

		protected override float DefaultFontSize => 11f;

		public ButtonFormControlRenderer(ButtonFormControl formControl)
			: base((FormControlBase)(object)formControl)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawCore(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds)
		{
			dc.DrawRectangle(FormControlRenderer.ElementBrush, null, bounds);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = CreateBorderPen(borderBrush);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, bounds.BottomLeft, bounds.BottomRight);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, bounds.BottomRight, bounds.TopRight);
			if (base.FormControl.HasTextProperties)
			{
				DrawText(dc, base.FormControl.TextProperties, bounds, TextAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment.Center);
			}
		}
	}

				System.Windows.Size size = new System.Windows.Size(formattedText.Width, formattedText.Height);

			}
		}

	{
		private static System.Windows.Media.Brush thumbBrush = new SolidColorBrush(FormControlDrawingDataProvider.ScrollbarThumbColor.ToWpfColor());

		public ListBoxFormControlRenderer(ListBoxFormControl formControl)
			: base((FormControlBase)(object)formControl)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawCore(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds)
		{
			dc.DrawRectangle(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White, null, bounds);
			float listBoxScrollbarWidthInPixels = FormControlDrawingDataProvider.ListBoxScrollbarWidthInPixels;
			Rect rect = new Rect(bounds.Right - (double)listBoxScrollbarWidthInPixels, bounds.Top, listBoxScrollbarWidthInPixels, bounds.Height);
			dc.DrawRectangle(FormControlRenderer.ElementBrush, null, rect);
			DrawVerticalLayout(dc, rect);
			dc.DrawRectangle(null, FormControlRenderer.BorderPen, bounds);
		}

		private void DrawVerticalLayout(DrawingContext dc, Rect bounds)
		{
			double val = FormControlDrawingDataProvider.ScrollbarThumbWidthInPixels;
			double width = bounds.Width;
			Rect buttonBounds = new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top, width, width);
			DrawTriangle(dc, buttonBounds, (FormControlButtonAlignment)0);
			Rect buttonBounds2 = new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom - width, width, width);
			DrawTriangle(dc, buttonBounds2, (FormControlButtonAlignment)1);
			val = Math.Min(val, bounds.Bottom - width);
			if (val > 0.0)
			{
				dc.DrawRectangle(rectangle: new Rect(bounds.Left, bounds.Top + width, bounds.Width, val), brush: thumbBrush, pen: null);
			}
		}
	}

			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
