	public class GroupShapeRenderer : IDrawingObjectVisitor
	{
		private class ReflectionContainer
		{
			private readonly ContainerVisual childContainer;

			private readonly ContainerVisual currentContainer;

			public VisualCollection ChildVisuals => childContainer.Children;

			public VisualCollection CurrentVisuals => currentContainer.Children;

			public ReflectionContainer()
			{
				childContainer = new ContainerVisual();
				currentContainer = new ContainerVisual();
			}

			public ContainerVisual Combine(ContainerVisual reflectionShadow)
			{
				ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
				if (reflectionShadow != null)
				{
					containerVisual.Children.Add(ShapeRenderer.Clone(reflectionShadow));
				}
				containerVisual.Children.Add(currentContainer);
				containerVisual.Children.Add(childContainer);
				return containerVisual;
			}
		}

		private struct GroupFill
		{
			public static GroupFill Empty = new GroupFill(null, Rect.Empty);

			public System.Windows.Media.Brush Fill { get; private set; }

			public Rect Bounds { get; private set; }

			public System.Windows.Media.Matrix Transform { get; set; }

			public bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (Fill == null && Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						return Transform.IsIdentity;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public GroupFill(System.Windows.Media.Brush fill, Rect bounds)
			{
				this = default(GroupFill);
				Fill = fill;
				Bounds = bounds;
				Transform = System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Identity;
			}
		}

		private class GroupFillStack
		{
			private readonly Stack<GroupFill> groupFills;

			public GroupFill Current => groupFills.Peek();

			public bool GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode { get; set; }

			public GroupFillStack()
			{
				groupFills = new Stack<GroupFill>();
				groupFills.Push(GroupFill.Empty);
			}

			public void Pop()
			{
				groupFills.Pop();
			}

			public void Push(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo)
			{
				GroupFill item = CalculateFill(groupShapeInfo);
				groupFills.Push(item);
			}

			private GroupFill CalculateFill(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo)
			{
				IDrawingFill fill = groupShapeInfo.Shape.GroupShapeProperties.Fill;
				if (ShouldCreateGroupFill(fill))
				{
					return CalculateFillCore(fill, groupShapeInfo.RotationAngle, groupShapeInfo.TransformedBounds);
				}
				GroupFill current = Current;
				if (!current.IsEmpty)
				{
					Rect bounds = groupShapeInfo.Bounds;
					System.Windows.Media.Matrix trans = System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Multiply(default(System.Windows.Media.Matrix), groupShapeInfo.Transform);
					trans.Translate(bounds.X, bounds.Y);
					trans = System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Multiply(trans, current.Transform);
					current.Transform = trans;
				}
				return current;
			}

			private GroupFill CalculateFillCore(IDrawingFill fill, float rotationAngle, Rect transformedBounds)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush fill2;
				if (GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode)
				{
					fill2 = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White;
				}
				else
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color styleColor = System.Drawing.Color.Empty.ToWpfColor();
					WPFShapeFillRenderVisitor wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor = new WPFShapeFillRenderVisitor(styleColor, null, transformedBounds, ShapePreset.None, rotationAngle, null);
					fill.Visit(wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor);
					fill2 = wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor.Result;
				}
				return new GroupFill(fill2, transformedBounds);
			}

			private bool ShouldCreateGroupFill(IDrawingFill fill)
			{
				if (fill == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DrawingFillType fillType = fill.FillType;
				if (fillType != DrawingFillType.None && fillType != DrawingFillType.Group)
				{
					return fillType != DrawingFillType.Automatic;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private readonly GroupShapeInfoProvider provider;

		private readonly Stack<VisualCollection> containers;

		private readonly Stack<GroupShapeInfo> parentGroups;

		private readonly GroupFillStack groupFills;

		private readonly bool renderUnsupportedItems;

		private VisualCollection CurrentContainer => containers.Peek();

		private GroupShapeInfo CurrentParentGroup => parentGroups.Peek();

		public bool RenderEffects { get; private set; }

		public bool ImageServiceMode { get; private set; }

		public static void Render(GroupShape groupShape, Rect bounds, VisualCollection container, bool renderEffects, bool imageServiceMode, bool renderUnsupportedItems)
		{
			GroupShapeRenderer groupShapeRenderer = new GroupShapeRenderer(renderUnsupportedItems);
			groupShapeRenderer.RenderEffects = renderEffects;
			groupShapeRenderer.ImageServiceMode = imageServiceMode;
			groupShapeRenderer.Render(groupShape, bounds, container);
		}

		public GroupShapeRenderer(bool renderUnsupportedItems)
		{
			provider = new GroupShapeInfoProvider();
			containers = new Stack<VisualCollection>();
			parentGroups = new Stack<GroupShapeInfo>();
			groupFills = new GroupFillStack();
			this.renderUnsupportedItems = renderUnsupportedItems;
		}

		public void Render(GroupShape groupShape, Rect bounds, VisualCollection container)
		{
			provider.Calculate(groupShape, bounds);
			groupFills.GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode = groupShape.GroupShapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode;
			RenderCore(provider.GetNextGroupInfo(), container);
		}

		private void RenderCore(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo, VisualCollection container)
		{
			try
			{
				containers.Push(container);
				parentGroups.Push(groupShapeInfo);
				groupFills.Push(groupShapeInfo);
				foreach (IDrawingObject drawingObjectsByZOrderCollection in groupShapeInfo.Shape.DrawingObjectsByZOrderCollections)
				{
					drawingObjectsByZOrderCollection.Visit((IDrawingObjectVisitor)(object)this);
				}
				if (RenderEffects && groupShapeInfo.ShapeInfos.Count > 0)
				{
					RenderGroupEffects(groupShapeInfo);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				groupFills.Pop();
				parentGroups.Pop();
				containers.Pop();
			}
		}

		private void RenderGroupEffects(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo)
		{
			ReflectionContainer reflectionContainer = null;
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = null;
			RotationInfo rotationInfo = groupShapeInfo.CreateRotationInfo();
			List<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos = groupShapeInfo.ShapeInfos;
			for (int i = 0; i < shapeInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				ShapeInfo shapeInfo = shapeInfos[i];
				DrawingRendererBase renderer = shapeInfo.Renderer;
				Rect transformedGeometryBoundsWithEffects = shapeInfo.GetTransformedGeometryBoundsWithEffects(rotationInfo.Transform);
				shapeInfo.PrepareVisitor(groupShapeInfo.Shape);
				Rect boundsWithOffset = shapeInfo.GetBoundsWithOffset();
				ProcessMainVisual(shapeInfo, boundsWithOffset);
				if (renderer.EffectVisitor.HasShadow)
				{
					if (containerVisual == null)
					{
						containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
					}
					PopulateShadowContainer(shapeInfo, boundsWithOffset, containerVisual);
				}
				if (renderer.EffectVisitor.HasReflection)
				{
					if (reflectionContainer == null)
					{
						reflectionContainer = new ReflectionContainer();
					}
					PopulateReflectionContainer(shapeInfo, boundsWithOffset, reflectionContainer, i);
				}
				groupShapeInfo.UpdateTransformedBoundsWithEffects(transformedGeometryBoundsWithEffects, boundsWithOffset.TopLeft, rotationInfo);
				shapeInfo.Update(groupShapeInfo, boundsWithOffset);
			}
			ProcessShadowAndReflection(groupShapeInfo, rotationInfo, containerVisual, reflectionContainer);
		}

		private void ProcessMainVisual(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, Rect bounds)
		{
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = shapeInfo.Renderer.CreateMainEffectsVisual();
			if (containerVisual != null)
			{
				CurrentContainer.Insert(0, CreateVisualHost(containerVisual, bounds, shapeInfo.Transform));
			}
			shapeInfo.MainVisuals.Add(containerVisual);
		}

		private void PopulateShadowContainer(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, Rect bounds, ContainerVisual container)
		{
			List<ContainerVisual> mainVisuals = shapeInfo.MainVisuals;
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = null;
			for (int num = mainVisuals.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ContainerVisual containerVisual2 = mainVisuals[num];
				if (containerVisual2 != null)
				{
					containerVisual = ShapeRenderer.Clone(containerVisual2);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (containerVisual != null)
			{
				container.Children.Add(CreateVisualHost(containerVisual, bounds, shapeInfo.Transform));
			}
		}

		private void PopulateReflectionContainer(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, Rect bounds, ReflectionContainer container, int shapeIndex)
		{
			List<ContainerVisual> mainVisuals = shapeInfo.MainVisuals;
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform = shapeInfo.Transform;
			int num = mainVisuals.Count - 1;
			DrawingVisual container2 = ShapeRenderer.Clone(mainVisuals[num]);
			container.CurrentVisuals.Insert(shapeIndex, CreateVisualHost(container2, bounds, transform));
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				DrawingVisual container3 = ShapeRenderer.Clone(mainVisuals[num - 1 - i]);
				container.ChildVisuals.Insert(shapeIndex + i, CreateVisualHost(container3, bounds, transform));
			}
		}

		private void ProcessShadowAndReflection(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo, RotationInfo rotationInfo, ContainerVisual shadowContainer, ReflectionContainer reflectionContainer)
		{
			Rect bounds = groupShapeInfo.Bounds;
			Rect transformedBoundsWithEffects = groupShapeInfo.TransformedBoundsWithEffects;
			WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor effectVisitor = groupShapeInfo.ShapeInfos[0].Renderer.EffectVisitor;
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = null;
			if (shadowContainer != null)
			{
				DrawingVisual container = effectVisitor.CalculateGroupShadow(shadowContainer, transformedBoundsWithEffects, rotationInfo.Transform);
				containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
				containerVisual.Children.Add(CreateVisualHost(container, new Rect(bounds.Size), System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Identity));
				CurrentContainer.Insert(0, containerVisual);
			}
			if (reflectionContainer != null)
			{
				ContainerVisual parent = reflectionContainer.Combine(containerVisual);
				DrawingVisual container2 = effectVisitor.CalculateGroupReflection(parent, bounds, transformedBoundsWithEffects, rotationInfo.Transform);
				CurrentContainer.Insert(0, CreateVisualHost(container2, new Rect(bounds.Size), System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Identity));
			}
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(Picture picture)
		{
			RenderShape((IDrawingObject)(object)picture);
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(ModelShape shape)
		{
			RenderShape((IDrawingObject)(object)shape);
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(GroupShape groupShape)
		{
			RenderGroup();
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(ConnectionShape connectionShape)
		{
			RenderShape((IDrawingObject)(object)connectionShape);
		}

		private void RenderShape(IDrawingObject drawing)
		{
			ShapeInfo nextInfo = provider.GetNextInfo();
			Rect bounds = nextInfo.Bounds;
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform = (nextInfo.Transform = DrawingTransformHelper.GetTransformMatrix(bounds, drawing.DrawingObject.Transform2D));
			nextInfo.Offset = default(System.Windows.Point);
			DrawingRendererBase renderer = nextInfo.Renderer;
			ApplyGroupFill(bounds, transform, renderer);
			ContainerVisual container = renderer.CreateVisual(RenderEffects);
			if (RenderEffects)
			{
				nextInfo.MainVisuals.Add(renderer.MainVisual);
			}
			CurrentParentGroup.ShapeInfos.Add(nextInfo);
			CurrentContainer.Add(CreateVisualHost(container, bounds, transform));
		}

		private void ApplyGroupFill(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform, DrawingRendererBase renderer)
		{
			GroupFill current = groupFills.Current;
			if (!current.IsEmpty && renderer.ApplyGroupFill)
			{
				DrawingVisual visual = CreateGroupFillVisual(current, bounds, transform);
				VisualBrush visualBrush = new VisualBrush(visual);
				visualBrush.Stretch = Stretch.None;
				renderer.Brush = visualBrush;
			}
		}

		private DrawingVisual CreateGroupFillVisual(GroupFill groupFill, Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform)
		{
			RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(bounds.Size));
			transform.Translate(bounds.X, bounds.Y);
			transform = System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Multiply(transform, groupFill.Transform);
			rectangleGeometry.Transform = new MatrixTransform(transform);
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			drawingVisual.Clip = rectangleGeometry;
			using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
			{
				drawingContext.DrawGeometry(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, null, rectangleGeometry);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(groupFill.Fill, null, groupFill.Bounds);
			}
			transform.Invert();
			drawingVisual.Transform = new MatrixTransform(transform);
			return drawingVisual;
		}

		private void RenderGroup()
		{
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			GroupShapeInfo nextGroupInfo = provider.GetNextGroupInfo();
			RenderCore(nextGroupInfo, drawingVisual.Children);
			CurrentParentGroup.UpdateFrom(nextGroupInfo);
			CurrentContainer.Add(CreateVisualHost(drawingVisual, nextGroupInfo.Bounds, nextGroupInfo.Transform));
		}

		private DrawingVisualHost CreateVisualHost(ContainerVisual container, Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform)
		{
			DrawingVisualHost drawingVisualHost = new DrawingVisualHost();
			if (!transform.IsIdentity)
			{
				drawingVisualHost.RenderTransform = new MatrixTransform(transform);
			}
			drawingVisualHost.Items.Add(container);
			drawingVisualHost.Measure(bounds.Size);
			drawingVisualHost.Arrange(bounds);
			return drawingVisualHost;
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(Chart chart)
		{
			RenderChart((IChartBase)(object)chart);
		}

		private void RenderChart(IChartBase chart)
		{
			DocumentModel documentModel = chart.DocumentModel;
			if (documentModel.CompatibilityOptions.EnhancedLayout && documentModel.PrintLayoutUnitManager != null)
			{
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.DisableHistory();
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).BeginUpdate();
				((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.SuppressRaiseOperationComplete = true;
				documentModel.DeferredChanges.SkipChangeActions = true;
				try
				{
					IChartBase val = ((ICloneable<IChartBase>)(object)chart).Clone();
					try
					{
						RenderChartCore(val);
						return;
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).EndUpdate();
					((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).History.EnableHistory();
				}
			}
			RenderChartCore(chart);
		}

		private void RenderChartCore(IChartBase chart)
		{
			Rect bounds = provider.CalculateDrawingBounds((IDrawingObject)(object)chart, CurrentParentGroup);
			ChartRenderer chartRenderer = new ChartRenderer(chart, bounds.Size, groupFills.GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode, ImageServiceMode);
			ContainerVisual container = chartRenderer.CreateVisual(RenderEffects);
			if (chartRenderer.RenderSuccess)
			{
				CurrentContainer.Add(CreateVisualHost(container, bounds, System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Identity));
			}
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(FormControlBase formControl)
		{
			DrawPlaceholder((IDrawingObject)(object)formControl, (XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2438);
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(SmartArtDiagram smartArt)

		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(SlicerFloatingObject slicerFloatingObject)
		{
			DrawPlaceholder((IDrawingObject)(object)slicerFloatingObject, (XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2436);
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(TimelineFloatingObject timelineFloatingObject)
		{
			DrawPlaceholder((IDrawingObject)(object)timelineFloatingObject, (XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2437);
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(ChartEx chartEx)
		{
			if (chartEx.Controller == null)
			{
				DrawPlaceholder((IDrawingObject)(object)chartEx, (XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2434);
			}
			else
			{
				RenderChart((IChartBase)(object)chartEx);
			}
		}

		void IDrawingObjectVisitor.Visit(SimpleTextBox simpleTextBox)
		{
		}

		private void DrawPlaceholder(IDrawingObject drawing, XtraSpreadsheetStringId errorMessageId)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (renderUnsupportedItems)
			{
				Rect finalRect = provider.CalculateDrawingBounds(drawing, CurrentParentGroup);
				PlaceholderPanel placeholderPanel = new PlaceholderPanel(((InternalSheetBase)drawing.Worksheet).Workbook, errorMessageId);
				placeholderPanel.Measure(finalRect.Size);
				placeholderPanel.Arrange(finalRect);
				placeholderPanel.UpdateLayout();
				CurrentContainer.Add(placeholderPanel);
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct RotationInfo
	{
		public System.Windows.Media.Matrix Transform { get; private set; }

		public System.Windows.Media.Matrix InverseTransform { get; private set; }

		public RotationInfo(float totalAngle, System.Windows.Point center)
		{
			this = default(RotationInfo);
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix matrix = default(System.Windows.Media.Matrix);
			matrix.RotateAt(totalAngle, center.X, center.Y);
			Transform = matrix;
			matrix.Invert();
			InverseTransform = matrix;
		}
	}
	internal class ShapeInfo
	{
		private readonly DrawingRendererBase renderer;

		private readonly List<ContainerVisual> mainVisuals;

		private System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform;

		private System.Windows.Point offset;

		private Rect bounds;

		public DrawingRendererBase Renderer => renderer;

		public List<ContainerVisual> MainVisuals => mainVisuals;

		public System.Windows.Media.Matrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return transform;
			}
			set
			{
				transform = value;
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Point Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				offset = value;
			}
		}

		public Rect Bounds => bounds;

		public ShapeInfo(DrawingRendererBase renderer, System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform, Rect bounds)
		{
			mainVisuals = new List<ContainerVisual>();
			this.transform = transform;
			this.renderer = renderer;
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		public Rect GetBoundsWithOffset()
		{
			Rect result = bounds;
			result.Offset(offset.X, offset.Y);
			return result;
		}

		public void PrepareVisitor(GroupShape parent)
		{
			WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor effectVisitor = renderer.EffectVisitor;
			effectVisitor.Clear();
			renderer.PopulateEffects(effectVisitor, parent.GroupShapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects);
		}

		public void Update(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo, Rect bounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Point center = groupShapeInfo.Center;
			transform = System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Multiply(trans2: groupShapeInfo.GetTransformMatrix(new System.Windows.Point(center.X - bounds.X, center.Y - bounds.Y)), trans1: transform);
			System.Windows.Point topLeft = groupShapeInfo.Bounds.TopLeft;
			topLeft.Offset(offset.X, offset.Y);
			offset = topLeft;
		}

		public Rect GetTransformedGeometryBoundsWithEffects(System.Windows.Media.Matrix rotateTransform)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix matrix = System.Windows.Media.Matrix.Multiply(transform, rotateTransform);
			return renderer.EffectVisitor.GetTransformedGeometryBoundsWithEffects(matrix);
		}

		public Rect GetTransformedGeometryBounds()
		{
			return renderer.EffectVisitor.GetTransformedGeometryBounds(transform);
		}
	}
	internal class GroupShapeInfo
	{
		private readonly GroupShape shape;

		private readonly List<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos;

		private Rect bounds;

		private Rect transformedBounds;

		private Rect transformedBoundsWithEffects;

		private float rotationAngle;

		private float totalAngle;

		private System.Windows.Media.Matrix transform;

		private System.Windows.Point center;

		public GroupShape Shape => shape;

		public List<ShapeInfo> ShapeInfos => shapeInfos;

		public float RotationAngle => rotationAngle;

		public Rect Bounds => bounds;

		public System.Windows.Point Center => center;

		public System.Windows.Media.Matrix Transform => transform;

		public Rect TransformedBounds => transformedBounds;

		public Rect TransformedBoundsWithEffects => transformedBoundsWithEffects;

		public GroupShapeInfo(GroupShape shape, Rect bounds, float totalAngle)
		{
			this.shape = shape;
			shapeInfos = new List<ShapeInfo>();
			this.bounds = bounds;
			transformedBounds = Rect.Empty;
			transformedBoundsWithEffects = Rect.Empty;
			rotationAngle = ((FloatingObjectBase<GroupShapeInfo>)(object)shape).DrawingObject.Transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees();
			center = new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Width / 2.0, bounds.Height / 2.0);
			transform = GetTransformMatrix(center);
			this.totalAngle = totalAngle;
		}

		public void UpdateFrom(GroupShapeInfo childGroup)
		{
			shapeInfos.AddRange(childGroup.ShapeInfos);
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Matrix GetTransformMatrix(System.Windows.Point center)
		{
			Transform2D transform2D = ((FloatingObjectBase<GroupShapeInfo>)(object)shape).DrawingObject.Transform2D;
			return DrawingTransformHelper.GetTransformMatrix(center, rotationAngle, transform2D.FlipH, transform2D.FlipV);
		}

		public RotationInfo CreateRotationInfo()
		{
			return new RotationInfo((totalAngle + rotationAngle) % 360f, center);
		}

		public void UpdateTransformedBoundsWithEffects(Rect boundsPart, System.Windows.Point offset, RotationInfo rotationInfo)
		{
			System.Windows.Point topLeft = boundsPart.TopLeft;
			topLeft = rotationInfo.InverseTransform.Transform(topLeft);
			topLeft.Offset(offset.X, offset.Y);
			topLeft = rotationInfo.Transform.Transform(topLeft);
			transformedBoundsWithEffects.Union(new Rect(topLeft, boundsPart.Size));
		}

		public void UpdateTransformedBounds(Rect boundsPart, System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			System.Windows.Point topLeft = boundsPart.TopLeft;
			topLeft.Offset(offset.X, offset.Y);
			transformedBounds.Union(new Rect(topLeft, boundsPart.Size));
		}
	}
	internal class GroupShapeInfoProvider : IDrawingObjectVisitor
	{
		private readonly Stack<GroupShapeInfo> parentGroups;

		private readonly List<GroupShapeInfo> groupShapeInfos;

		private readonly List<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos;

		private int groupShapeIndex;

		private int shapeIndex;

		private float totalRotationAngle;

		private GroupShapeInfo CurrentParentGroup => parentGroups.Peek();

		public GroupShapeInfoProvider()
		{
			parentGroups = new Stack<GroupShapeInfo>();
			groupShapeInfos = new List<GroupShapeInfo>();
			shapeInfos = new List<ShapeInfo>();
		}

		public void Calculate(GroupShape groupShape, Rect bounds)
		{
			GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo = new GroupShapeInfo(groupShape, bounds, 0f);
			CalculateCore(groupShapeInfo);
			groupShapeInfo.ShapeInfos.Clear();
		}

		public GroupShapeInfo GetNextGroupInfo()
		{
			GroupShapeInfo result = groupShapeInfos[groupShapeIndex];
			groupShapeIndex++;
			return result;
		}

		public ShapeInfo GetNextInfo()
		{
			ShapeInfo result = shapeInfos[shapeIndex];
			shapeIndex++;
			return result;
		}

		private void CalculateCore(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo)
		{
			float rotationAngle = groupShapeInfo.RotationAngle;
			groupShapeInfos.Add(groupShapeInfo);
			try
			{
				totalRotationAngle += rotationAngle;
				parentGroups.Push(groupShapeInfo);
				foreach (IDrawingObject drawingObjectsByZOrderCollection in groupShapeInfo.Shape.DrawingObjectsByZOrderCollections)
				{
					drawingObjectsByZOrderCollection.Visit((IDrawingObjectVisitor)(object)this);
				}
				CalculateTransformedBounds(groupShapeInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				parentGroups.Pop();
				totalRotationAngle -= rotationAngle;
			}
		}

		private void CalculateTransformedBounds(GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo)
		{
			List<ShapeInfo> list = groupShapeInfo.ShapeInfos;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				ShapeInfo shapeInfo = list[i];
				Rect transformedGeometryBounds = shapeInfo.GetTransformedGeometryBounds();
				Rect boundsWithOffset = shapeInfo.GetBoundsWithOffset();
				groupShapeInfo.UpdateTransformedBounds(transformedGeometryBounds, boundsWithOffset.TopLeft);
				shapeInfo.Update(groupShapeInfo, boundsWithOffset);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(Picture picture)
		{
			Rect bounds = CalculateDrawingBounds((IDrawingObject)(object)picture);
			PictureRenderer renderer = new PictureRenderer(picture, bounds.Size, totalRotationAngle, groupShapeInfos[0].Shape.GroupShapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
			AddShapeInfoCore((IDrawingObject)(object)picture, renderer, bounds);
		}

		public void Visit(ModelShape shape)
		{
			AddShapeInfo((ModelShapeBase)(object)shape);
		}

		public void Visit(ConnectionShape connectionShape)
		{
			AddShapeInfo((ModelShapeBase)(object)connectionShape);
		}

		public void Visit(GroupShape groupShape)
		{
			Rect bounds = CalculateDrawingBounds((IDrawingObject)(object)groupShape);
			GroupShapeInfo groupShapeInfo = new GroupShapeInfo(groupShape, bounds, totalRotationAngle);
			CalculateCore(groupShapeInfo);
			CurrentParentGroup.UpdateFrom(groupShapeInfo);
			groupShapeInfo.ShapeInfos.Clear();
		}

		private void AddShapeInfo(ModelShapeBase shape)
		{
			Rect bounds = CalculateDrawingBounds((IDrawingObject)(object)shape);
			ShapeRenderer renderer = new ShapeRenderer(shape, bounds.Size, totalRotationAngle, groupShapeInfos[0].Shape.GroupShapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode);
			AddShapeInfoCore((IDrawingObject)(object)shape, renderer, bounds);
		}

		private void AddShapeInfoCore(IDrawingObject drawing, DrawingRendererBase renderer, Rect bounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix transformMatrix = DrawingTransformHelper.GetTransformMatrix(bounds, drawing.DrawingObject.Transform2D);
			ShapeInfo item = new ShapeInfo(renderer, transformMatrix, bounds);
			shapeInfos.Add(item);
			CurrentParentGroup.ShapeInfos.Add(item);
		}

		public void Visit(Chart chart)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(FormControlBase formControl)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(SmartArtDiagram smartArt)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(SlicerFloatingObject slicerFloatingObject)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(TimelineFloatingObject timelineFloatingObject)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(ChartEx chartEx)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(SimpleTextBox simpleTextBox)
		{
		}

		private Rect CalculateDrawingBounds(IDrawingObject drawing)
		{
			return CalculateDrawingBounds(drawing, CurrentParentGroup);
		}

		public Rect CalculateDrawingBounds(IDrawingObject drawing, GroupShapeInfo groupInfo)
		{
			GroupShape shape = groupInfo.Shape;
			Rect rect = new Rect(groupInfo.Bounds.Size);
			DrawingObject drawingObject = drawing.DrawingObject;
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)drawingObject.DocumentModel).ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float num = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits((float)rect.Width);
			float num2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits((float)rect.Height);
			float num3 = shape.CalculateChildScaleX(num);
			float num4 = shape.CalculateChildScaleY(num2);
			float x = drawingObject.Transform2D.OffsetX - shape.GroupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.OffsetX;
			float y = drawingObject.Transform2D.OffsetY - shape.GroupShapeProperties.ChildTransform2D.OffsetY;
			float cx = drawingObject.Transform2D.Cx;
			float cy = drawingObject.Transform2D.Cy;
			RectangleF rectangle = new RectangleF(x, y, cx, cy);
			bool flag = AnchorData.NeedToSwap(drawingObject.Transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees());
			if (flag)
			{
				rectangle = RectangleUtils.SwapWidthAndHeight(rectangle);
			}
			rectangle = new RectangleF(rectangle.X * num3, rectangle.Y * num4, rectangle.Width * num3, rectangle.Height * num4);
			if (flag)
			{
				rectangle = RectangleUtils.SwapWidthAndHeight(rectangle);
			}
			double x2 = rect.Left + (double)toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.X);
			double y2 = rect.Top + (double)toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.Y);
			double val = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.Width);
			double val2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(rectangle.Height);
			return new Rect(x2, y2, Math.Max(0.0, val), Math.Max(0.0, val2));
		}
	}
	public abstract class DrawingRendererBase
	{
		private readonly Rect bounds;

		private IShapeGeometryInfo geometryInfo;

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush brush;

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen pen;

		private WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor visitor;

		private ContainerVisual mainVisual;

		private float rotationAngle;

		private float containerRotationAngle;

		private bool groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode;

		protected Rect Bounds => bounds;

		protected abstract DrawingObject DrawingObject { get; }

		protected abstract ShapeProperties ShapeProperties { get; }

		protected abstract ShapeStyle ShapeStyle { get; }

		protected internal WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor EffectVisitor
		{
			get
			{
				if (visitor == null)
				{
					visitor = CreateEffectsVisitor();
				}
				return visitor;
			}
		}

		protected internal ContainerVisual MainVisual => mainVisual;

		protected internal System.Windows.Media.Brush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return brush;
			}
			set
			{
				brush = value;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ApplyGroupFill
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsConnectorShape)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IDrawingFill fill = ShapeProperties.Fill;
				if (fill != null)
				{
					return fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Group;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsConnectorShape => false;

		protected float RotationAngle => rotationAngle;

		protected bool IsBlackAndWhitePrintMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
				{
					return groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode => groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode;

		protected DrawingRendererBase(System.Windows.Size size, float rotationAngle, float containerRotationAngle, bool groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode)
		{
			bounds = new Rect(size);
			this.rotationAngle = rotationAngle;
			this.containerRotationAngle = containerRotationAngle;
			this.groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode = groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode;
		}

		protected ModelShapeCustomGeometry GetCalculatedGeometry(IDrawingObject drawing, Func<float, float, ModelShapeCustomGeometry> calculate)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)drawing.DrawingObject.DocumentModel).ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float arg = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits((float)bounds.Width);
			float arg2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToModelUnits((float)bounds.Height);
			return calculate(arg, arg2);
		}

		protected void InitializeCore(IShapeGeometryInfo geometryInfo, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Media.Brush blackAndWhiteModeBrush)
		{
			if (IsBlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				if (brush != null)
				{
					brush = blackAndWhiteModeBrush;
				}
				if (pen != null)
				{
					pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black, pen.Thickness);
				}
			}
			InitializeCore(geometryInfo, brush, pen);
		}

		protected void InitializeCore(IShapeGeometryInfo geometryInfo, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen)
		{
			this.geometryInfo = geometryInfo;
			this.brush = brush;
			this.pen = pen;
		}

		public ContainerVisual CreateVisual(bool renderEffects)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Brush finalBrush = GetFinalBrush(bounds);
			if (renderEffects)
			{
				return CreateVisualWithEffects(finalBrush, EffectVisitor);
			}
			return CreateVisualCore(bounds, finalBrush, pen, geometryInfo, parentIsRendered: false);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Media.Brush GetFinalBrush(Rect bounds)
		{
			return brush;
		}

		private WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor CreateEffectsVisitor()
		{
			Transform2D transform2D = DrawingObject.Transform2D;
			float num = (rotationAngle + containerRotationAngle) % 360f;
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix transformMatrix = DrawingTransformHelper.GetTransformMatrix(bounds, num, transform2D.FlipH, transform2D.FlipV);
			WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor wPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor = new WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor(transform2D.DocumentModel, geometryInfo, pen, transformMatrix);
			wPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor.IsConnectorShape = IsConnectorShape;
			return wPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor;
		}

		private void PopulateEffects(WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor effectVisitor, ShapeProperties shapeProperties, ShapeStyle shapeStyle)
		{
			DrawingEffectCollection drawingEffectCollection = null;
			ContainerEffect containerEffect = shapeProperties.EffectStyle.ContainerEffect;
			if (containerEffect.ApplyEffectList)
			{
				drawingEffectCollection = containerEffect.Effects;
			}
			else if (shapeStyle != null)
			{
				DrawingEffectStyle effectStyle = shapeProperties.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FormatScheme.GetEffectStyle(shapeStyle.EffectReferenceIdx);
				if (effectStyle != null && effectStyle.ContainerEffect.ApplyEffectList)
				{
					drawingEffectCollection = effectStyle.ContainerEffect.Effects;
				}
			}
			if (drawingEffectCollection != null)
			{
				PopulateEffects(effectVisitor, drawingEffectCollection);
			}
		}

		internal void PopulateEffects(WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor effectVisitor, DrawingEffectCollection effects)
		{
			List<IDrawingEffect> list = new List<IDrawingEffect>(effects.InnerList);
			list.Sort(new ShapeEffectComparer());
			foreach (IDrawingEffect item in list)
			{
				item.Visit(effectVisitor);
			}
		}

		private ContainerVisual CreateVisualWithEffects(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, WPFShapeEffectRenderVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.ParentFillBrush = brush;
			visitor.BlackAndWhitePrintMode = IsBlackAndWhitePrintMode;
			PopulateEffects(visitor, ShapeProperties, ShapeStyle);
			mainVisual = CreateMainVisual(brush);
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
			Visual visual = visitor.CalculateShadow(mainVisual);
			if (visual != null)
			{
				containerVisual.Children.Add(visual);
			}
			containerVisual.Children.Add(mainVisual);
			return CreateReflectionVisual(containerVisual);
		}

		protected virtual ContainerVisual CreateReflectionVisual(ContainerVisual shadowContainer)
		{
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
			Visual visual = visitor.CalculateReflection(shadowContainer);
			if (visual != null)
			{
				containerVisual.Children.Add(visual);
			}
			containerVisual.Children.Add(shadowContainer);
			return containerVisual;
		}

		private ContainerVisual CreateMainVisual(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush)
		{
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
			ContainerVisual containerVisual2 = CreateMainEffectsVisual();
			if (containerVisual2 != null)
			{
				containerVisual.Children.Add(containerVisual2);
			}
			containerVisual.Children.Add(CreateVisualCore(bounds, brush, pen, geometryInfo, visitor.ParentIsRendered));
			return containerVisual;
		}

		protected internal ContainerVisual CreateMainEffectsVisual()
		{
			if (visitor.Effects.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ContainerVisual containerVisual = new ContainerVisual();
			foreach (DrawingVisual effect in visitor.Effects)
			{
				containerVisual.Children.Add(effect);
			}
			return containerVisual;
		}

		protected abstract DrawingVisual CreateVisualCore(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, IShapeGeometryInfo geometryInfo, bool parentIsRendered);
	}
	public class ShapeRenderer : DrawingRendererBase
	{
		private class FormattedTextRunProperties
		{
			internal FontWeight FontWeight { get; set; }

			internal System.Windows.FontStyle FontStyle { get; set; }

			internal float FontSize { get; set; }

			internal CultureInfo CultureInfo { get; set; }

			internal string FontFamily { get; set; }

			internal System.Windows.Media.Brush Foreground { get; set; }

			internal System.Windows.Media.Pen OutlinePen { get; set; }

			internal TextAlignment TextAlignment { get; set; }
		}

		private readonly ModelShapeBase shape;

		private AdjustableRect textBounds;

		private bool isConnectorShape;

		protected override DrawingObject DrawingObject => ((FloatingObjectBase<ModelShapeInfo>)(object)shape).DrawingObject;

		protected override ShapeProperties ShapeProperties => shape.ShapeProperties;

		protected override ShapeStyle ShapeStyle => shape.ShapeStyle;

		protected override bool IsConnectorShape => isConnectorShape;

		public static void Render(ModelShapeBase shape, Rect bounds, VisualCollection container, bool renderEffects)
		{
			ContainerVisual visual = CreateVisual(shape, bounds.Size, renderEffects);
			container.Add(visual);
		}

		public static ContainerVisual CreateVisual(ModelShapeBase shape, System.Windows.Size size, bool renderEffects)
		{
			ShapeRenderer shapeRenderer = new ShapeRenderer(shape, size);
			return shapeRenderer.CreateVisual(renderEffects);
		}

		public static DrawingVisual Clone(ContainerVisual container)
		{
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			if (container != null)
			{
				Rect descendantBounds = container.DescendantBounds;
				VisualBrush visualBrush = new VisualBrush(container);
				visualBrush.Stretch = Stretch.None;
				visualBrush.Viewbox = descendantBounds;
				visualBrush.ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
				using DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen();
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(visualBrush, null, descendantBounds);
			}
			return drawingVisual;
		}

		public ShapeRenderer(ModelShapeBase shape, System.Windows.Size size)
			: this(shape, size, 0f, groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode: false)
		{
		}

		public ShapeRenderer(ModelShapeBase shape, System.Windows.Size size, float containerRotationAngle)
			: this(shape, size, containerRotationAngle, groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode: false)
		{
		}

		public ShapeRenderer(ModelShapeBase shape, System.Windows.Size size, float containerRotationAngle, bool groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			: base(size, ((FloatingObjectBase<ModelShapeInfo>)(object)shape).GetRotationAngleInDegrees(), containerRotationAngle, groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode)
		{
			this.shape = shape;
			isConnectorShape = shape.ShapeProperties.IsConnectionShape();
			Initialize(base.Bounds, shape.ShapeProperties, shape.ShapeStyle);
		}

		private void Initialize(Rect bounds, ShapeProperties properties, ShapeStyle style)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry calculatedGeometry = GetCalculatedGeometry((IDrawingObject)(object)shape, (Func<float, float, ModelShapeCustomGeometry>)((FloatingObjectBase<ModelShapeInfo>)(object)shape).GetCalculatedGeometry);
			PathGeometry geometry = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateShapeLayoutInfo(properties, calculatedGeometry, bounds);
			textBounds = calculatedGeometry.ShapeTextRectangle;
			if (!WpfDrawingShapeHelper.HasArrows(properties))
			{
				InitializeShape(geometry, bounds, properties, style);
			}
			else if (isConnectorShape)
			{
				InitializeConnector(geometry, bounds, properties, style);
			}
			else
			{
				InitializeShapeWithArrows(geometry, calculatedGeometry, bounds, properties, style);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeShape(PathGeometry geometry, Rect bounds, ShapeProperties properties, ShapeStyle style)
		{
			IShapeGeometryInfo shapeGeometryInfo = new ShapeGeometryInfo(geometry);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateFillBrush(properties, properties.ShapeType, style, bounds, base.RotationAngle, geometry);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateLinePen(properties.Outline, style, bounds, properties.ShapeType);
			InitializeCore(shapeGeometryInfo, brush, pen, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White);
		}

		private void InitializeConnector(PathGeometry geometry, Rect bounds, ShapeProperties properties, ShapeStyle style)
		{
			WpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator wpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator = new WpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator();
			PathGeometry fillGeometry = wpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator.CreateArrowGeometry(geometry, properties, style, bounds);
			IShapeGeometryInfo shapeGeometryInfo = new ConnectorShapeGeometryInfo(fillGeometry, wpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator.BoundingGeometry);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateLineBrush(properties.Outline, style, bounds, properties.ShapeType);
			InitializeCore(shapeGeometryInfo, brush, null, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black);
		}

		private void InitializeShapeWithArrows(PathGeometry geometry, ModelShapeCustomGeometry modelGeometry, Rect bounds, ShapeProperties properties, ShapeStyle style)
		{
			PathGeometry pathGeometry = new PathGeometry();
			PathGeometry pathGeometry2 = new PathGeometry();
			WpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator wpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator = new WpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator();
			List<PathGeometry> list = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateShapeLayoutInfoWithOpenGeometries(properties, modelGeometry, bounds);
			foreach (PathGeometry item in list)
			{
				PathGeometry geometry2 = wpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator.CreateArrowGeometry(item, properties, style, bounds);
				pathGeometry = Geometry.Combine(pathGeometry, geometry2, GeometryCombineMode.Union, Transform.Identity);
				pathGeometry2 = Geometry.Combine(pathGeometry2, wpfHeadTailArrowGeometryCreator.BoundingGeometry, GeometryCombineMode.Union, Transform.Identity);
			}
			IShapeGeometryInfo shapeGeometryInfo = new ShapeGeometryWithArrowsInfo(geometry, pathGeometry, pathGeometry2);
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateFillBrush(properties, properties.ShapeType, style, bounds, base.RotationAngle, geometry);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateLinePen(properties.Outline, style, bounds, properties.ShapeType);
			InitializeCore(shapeGeometryInfo, brush, pen, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.White);
		}

		protected override DrawingVisual CreateVisualCore(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, IShapeGeometryInfo geometryInfo, bool parentIsRendered)
		{
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			using (DrawingContext dc = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
			{
				if (!parentIsRendered)
				{
					geometryInfo.Draw(dc, pen, brush);
				}
				if (shape.HasTextProperties && !isConnectorShape)
				{
					ModelShapeBase obj = shape;
					ModelShape val = (ModelShape)(object)((obj is ModelShape) ? obj : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						RenderText(val, bounds, textBounds, dc);
					}
				}
			}
			return drawingVisual;
		}

		private void RenderText(ModelShape modelShape, Rect bounds, AdjustableRect textBounds, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			DrawingTextParagraphCollection paragraphs = modelShape.TextProperties.Paragraphs;
			Rect rect = ShapeRenderHelper.CalculateTextRect(textBounds, bounds.ToRectangle(), (IDocumentModel)((SpreadsheetUndoableIndexBasedObject<ModelShapeInfo>)(object)modelShape).DocumentModel).ToRect();
			DrawingTextBodyProperties bodyProperties = modelShape.TextProperties.BodyProperties;
			rect = CalculateActualTextBounds(rect, bodyProperties.Inset);
			Tuple<FormattedText, System.Windows.Media.Brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen> tuple = BuildText(paragraphs, modelShape, rect);
			if (tuple == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FormattedText item = tuple.Item1;
			RotateTransform rotateTransform = null;
			float num = CalculateTextRotationAngle(bodyProperties.VerticalText);
			if (num != 0f)
			{
				rotateTransform = new RotateTransform(0f - num, rect.X + rect.Width / 2.0, rect.Y + rect.Height / 2.0);
				rect = rotateTransform.TransformBounds(rect);
			}
			bool flag = bodyProperties.TextWrapping == DrawingTextWrappingType.Square;
			if (flag)
			{
				item.MaxTextWidth = rect.Width;
			}
			item.Trimming = TextTrimming.None;
			bool flag2 = bodyProperties.HorizontalOverflow == DrawingTextHorizontalOverflowType.Clip || bodyProperties.VerticalOverflow == DrawingTextVerticalOverflowType.Clip;
			if (flag2)
			{
				RectangleGeometry clipGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(bounds);
				dc.PushClip(clipGeometry);
			}
			try
			{
				System.Windows.Point origin = CalculateRenderPoint(item, rect, bodyProperties.Anchor, flag);
				try
				{
					if (num != 0f)
					{
						rotateTransform.Angle = num;
						dc.PushTransform(rotateTransform);
					}
					System.Windows.Media.Brush item2 = tuple.Item2;
					System.Windows.Media.Pen item3 = tuple.Item3;
					if (item3 != null)
					{
						Geometry geometry = item.BuildGeometry(origin);
						dc.DrawGeometry(item2, item3, geometry);
					}
					else
					{
						dc.DrawText(item, origin);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (num != 0f)
					{
						dc.Pop();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					dc.Pop();
				}
			}
		}

		private Tuple<FormattedText, System.Windows.Media.Brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen> BuildText(DrawingTextParagraphCollection paragraphs, ModelShape modelShape, Rect textRect)
		{
			List<Tuple<int, int, FormattedTextRunProperties>> list = new List<Tuple<int, int, FormattedTextRunProperties>>();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DrawingTextParagraph paragraph in paragraphs)
			{
				DrawingTextRunCollection runs = paragraph.Runs;
				foreach (IDrawingTextRun item5 in runs)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(item5.Text);
				}
				string newLine = Environment.NewLine;
				FormattedTextRunProperties firstRunFormatting = GetFirstRunFormatting(paragraph, modelShape, textRect);
				if (firstRunFormatting != null)
				{
					int num2 = stringBuilder.Length - num;
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("\u00a0");
						num2 = newLine.Length;
					}
					list.Add(new Tuple<int, int, FormattedTextRunProperties>(num, num2, firstRunFormatting));
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(newLine);
				num = stringBuilder.Length;
			}
			string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormattedTextRunProperties item = list[0].Item3;
			double num3 = item.FontSize;
			if (num3 <= 0.0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(text, item.CultureInfo, System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(item.FontFamily), item.FontStyle, item.FontWeight, FontStretches.Normal), num3, item.Foreground, null, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			formattedText.TextAlignment = item.TextAlignment;
			for (int i = 1; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				Tuple<int, int, FormattedTextRunProperties> tuple = list[i];
				int item2 = tuple.Item1;
				int item3 = tuple.Item2;
				FormattedTextRunProperties item4 = tuple.Item3;
				formattedText.SetCulture(item4.CultureInfo, item2, item3);
				formattedText.SetFontFamily(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(item4.FontFamily), item2, item3);
				formattedText.SetFontSize(item4.FontSize, item2, item3);
				formattedText.SetFontStyle(item4.FontStyle, item2, item3);
				formattedText.SetFontWeight(item4.FontWeight, item2, item3);
				formattedText.SetForegroundBrush(item4.Foreground, item2, item3);
			}
			return new Tuple<FormattedText, System.Windows.Media.Brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen>(formattedText, item.Foreground, item.OutlinePen);
		}

		private FormattedTextRunProperties GetFirstRunFormatting(DrawingTextParagraph paragraph, ModelShape modelShape, Rect textRect)
		{
			if (paragraph == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IDrawingTextRun drawingTextRun = null;
			foreach (IDrawingTextRun run in paragraph.Runs)
			{
				drawingTextRun = run;
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(run.Text))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			DrawingTextCharacterProperties drawingTextCharacterProperties = ((drawingTextRun != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(drawingTextRun.Text)) ? drawingTextRun.RunProperties : paragraph.EndRunProperties);
			if (drawingTextCharacterProperties == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetFormattedTextRunProperties(drawingTextCharacterProperties, modelShape, paragraph.ParagraphProperties.TextAlignment, textRect);
		}

		private FormattedTextRunProperties GetFormattedTextRunProperties(DrawingTextCharacterProperties runProperties, ModelShape modelShape, DrawingTextAlignmentType alignment, Rect textRect)
		{
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ShapeStyle shapeStyle = ((ModelShapeBase)modelShape).ShapeStyle;
			FormattedTextRunProperties formattedTextRunProperties = new FormattedTextRunProperties();
			formattedTextRunProperties.FontWeight = (runProperties.Bold ? FontWeights.Bold : FontWeights.Normal);
			formattedTextRunProperties.FontStyle = (runProperties.Italic ? FontStyles.Italic : FontStyles.Normal);
			float value = (runProperties.Options.HasFontSize ? ((float)runProperties.FontSize / 100f) : 11f);
			formattedTextRunProperties.FontSize = runProperties.DocumentModel.LayoutUnitConverter.PointsToLayoutUnitsF(value);
			CultureInfo currentUICulture = (formattedTextRunProperties.CultureInfo = runProperties.Language);
			string typeface = runProperties.Latin.Typeface;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(typeface) || typeface.StartsWith("+mn"))
			{
				XlFontSchemeStyles val = shapeStyle.FontReferenceIdx;
				if ((int)val == 0)
				{
					val = (XlFontSchemeStyles)1;
				}
				typeface = runProperties.DocumentModel.OfficeTheme.FontScheme.GetTypeface(val, currentUICulture);
			}
			formattedTextRunProperties.FontFamily = typeface;
			if (((ModelShapeBase)modelShape).ShapeProperties.BlackAndWhitePrintMode)
			{
				formattedTextRunProperties.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
				formattedTextRunProperties.OutlinePen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black, WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculatePenWidth(runProperties.Outline, shapeStyle));
			}
			else
			{
				formattedTextRunProperties.Foreground = CalculateTextFillBrush(runProperties.Fill, shapeStyle, textRect);
				formattedTextRunProperties.OutlinePen = CalculateTextOutlinePen(runProperties.Outline, shapeStyle, textRect);
			}
			formattedTextRunProperties.TextAlignment = CalculateTextAlignment(alignment);
			return formattedTextRunProperties;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush CalculateTextFillBrush(IDrawingFill fill, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, Rect runBounds)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Windows.Media.Color? defaultColor = null;
			if (!shapeStyle.FontColor.IsEmpty && (int)shapeStyle.FontReferenceIdx != 0)
			{
				defaultColor = shapeStyle.FontColor.FinalColor.ToWpfColor();
			}
			if (fill.FillType == DrawingFillType.Automatic)
			{
				if (!defaultColor.HasValue)
				{
					DrawingColor drawingColor = DrawingColor.Create(shapeStyle.DocumentModel, DrawingColorModelInfo.CreateScheme(SchemeColorValues.Text1));
					defaultColor = drawingColor.FinalColor.ToWpfColor();
				}
				SolidColorBrush solidColorBrush = new SolidColorBrush(defaultColor.Value);
				solidColorBrush.Freeze();
				return solidColorBrush;
			}
			System.Windows.Media.Color styleColor = System.Drawing.Color.Empty.ToWpfColor();
			WPFShapeFillRenderVisitor wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor = new WPFShapeFillRenderVisitor(styleColor, defaultColor, runBounds, ShapePreset.Rect, 0f);
			fill.Visit(wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor);
			return wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor.Result;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen CalculateTextOutlinePen(Outline outline, ShapeStyle shapeStyle, Rect runBounds)
		{
			if (outline.IsDefault)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateLinePen(outline, shapeStyle, runBounds, ShapePreset.Rect);
		}

		private TextAlignment CalculateTextAlignment(DrawingTextAlignmentType alignment)
		{
			switch (alignment)
			{
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Left:
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Justified:
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.JustifiedLow:
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Distributed:
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.ThaiDistributed:
				return TextAlignment.Left;
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Center:
				return TextAlignment.Center;
			case DrawingTextAlignmentType.Right:
				return TextAlignment.Right;
			default:
				return TextAlignment.Left;
			}
		}

		private Rect CalculateActualTextBounds(Rect bounds, DrawingTextInset inset)
		{
			DocumentModelUnitToLayoutUnitConverter toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter = inset.DocumentModel.ToDocumentLayoutUnitConverter;
			float num = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Left);
			float num2 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Top);
			float num3 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Right);
			float num4 = toDocumentLayoutUnitConverter.ToLayoutUnits(inset.Bottom);
			double num5 = bounds.Left + (double)num;
			double num6 = bounds.Top + (double)num2;
			double num7 = Math.Max(num5, bounds.Right - (double)num3);
			double num8 = Math.Max(num6, bounds.Bottom - (double)num4);
			return new Rect(num5, num6, num7 - num5, num8 - num6);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point CalculateRenderPoint(FormattedText fText, Rect textBounds, DrawingTextAnchoringType vAlignment, bool wrapText)
		{
			double num = textBounds.X;
			double width = fText.Width;
			if (!wrapText)
			{
				if (fText.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Center)
				{
					num += textBounds.Width / 2.0;
				}
				else if (fText.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Right)
				{
					num = textBounds.Right;
				}
			}
			double num2 = textBounds.Y;
			double height = fText.Height;
			switch (vAlignment)
			{
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Center:
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Distributed:
				num2 += Math.Max(0.0, textBounds.Height / 2.0 - height / 2.0);
				break;
			case DrawingTextAnchoringType.Bottom:
				num2 = textBounds.Bottom - height;
				break;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(num, num2);
		}

		private float CalculateTextRotationAngle(DrawingTextVerticalTextType verticalTextType)
		{
			switch (verticalTextType)
			{
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.Horizontal:
				return 0f;
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.EastAsianVertical:
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.MongolianVertical:
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.Vertical:
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.WordArtVertical:
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.VerticalWordArtRightToLeft:
				return 90f;
			case DrawingTextVerticalTextType.Vertical270:
				return 270f;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Unknown DrawingTextVerticalTextType");
			}
		}
	}

			wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor.GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode = base.GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode;

			return wPFShapeFillRenderVisitor.Result;

		{

			visualBrush.Stretch = Stretch.None;
			visualBrush.Viewbox = bounds;
			visualBrush.ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
			return visualBrush;
		}

		{

			{
				using DrawingContext dc = drawingVisual.RenderOpen();
				geometryInfo.Draw(dc, pen, brush);
			}
			return drawingVisual;
		}

		public ChartRenderer(IChartBase chart, System.Windows.Size size, bool groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode, bool imageServiceMode)
			: base(size, 0f, 0f, groupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
			ImageServiceMode = imageServiceMode;
			Initialize(base.Bounds);
		}

		private void Initialize(Rect bounds)
		{
			ModelShapeCustomGeometry calculatedGeometry = GetCalculatedGeometry((IDrawingObject)(object)chart, (Func<float, float, ModelShapeCustomGeometry>)chart.GetCalculatedGeometry);
			PathGeometry geometry = WpfDrawingShapeHelper.CalculateShapeLayoutInfo(chart.ShapeProperties, calculatedGeometry, bounds);
			ShapeGeometryInfo shapeGeometryInfo = new ShapeGeometryInfo(geometry);
			InitializeCore(shapeGeometryInfo, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Transparent, null);
		}

		protected override ContainerVisual CreateReflectionVisual(ContainerVisual shadowContainer)
		{
			return shadowContainer;
		}

		protected override DrawingVisual CreateVisualCore(Rect bounds, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, IShapeGeometryInfo geometryInfo, bool parentIsRendered)
		{
			bool blackAndWhiteMode = chart.BlackAndWhiteMode;
			IChartBase obj = chart;
			obj.BlackAndWhiteMode |= base.GroupShapeBlackAndWhitePrintMode;
			try
			{
				DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
				Rect rect = bounds;
				DocumentModel documentModel = chart.DocumentModel;
				if (ImageServiceMode && ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnit != DocumentLayoutUnit.Pixel)
				{
					double num = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).LayoutUnitConverter.Dpi / DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi;
					contentPresenter.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(num, num);
					rect.Scale(1.0 / num, 1.0 / num);
				}
				if (FloatingObjectsContainer.ChartBoxHelper.TryMeasureChartCore(chart, rect, contentPresenter))
				{
					contentPresenter.Measure(bounds.Size);
					contentPresenter.Arrange(bounds);
					contentPresenter.UpdateLayout();
					RenderSuccess = true;
				}
				drawingVisual.Children.Add(contentPresenter);
				return drawingVisual;
			}
			finally
			{
				chart.BlackAndWhiteMode = blackAndWhiteMode;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class ClipboardWithDelayedRenderingBehavior : Behavior<SpreadsheetControl>
	{
		private HwndSource source;

		private SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering clipboardProvider;

		protected override void OnAttached()
		{
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnAttached();
			source = PresentationSource.FromVisual(base.AssociatedObject) as HwndSource;
			if (source != null)
			{
				source.AddHook(WndProc);
				if (clipboardProvider == null)
				{
					ICopiedRangeDataForClipboard service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)base.AssociatedObject.DocumentModel).GetService<ICopiedRangeDataForClipboard>();
					clipboardProvider = new SpreadsheetClipboardWithDelayedRendering(source.Handle, service);
					base.AssociatedObject.DocumentModel.Clipboard = (IClipboard)(object)clipboardProvider;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDetaching()
		{
			source?.RemoveHook(WndProc);
			source = null;
			if (clipboardProvider != null)
			{
				clipboardProvider.LeaveCopiedDataInClipboard();
				if (base.AssociatedObject != null && base.AssociatedObject.DocumentModel != null)
				{
					base.AssociatedObject.DocumentModel.Clipboard = null;
				}
				clipboardProvider = null;
			}
			((AttachableObjectBase)this).OnDetaching();
		}

		private IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, ref bool handled)
		{
			if (clipboardProvider != null && clipboardProvider.IsClipboardMessage(msg))
			{
				clipboardProvider.HandleWndProc(msg, (int)wParam);
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}
	}

			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<XpfCommentInplaceEditor>(this);
			base.TextSettings = WorksheetCommentPanel.CreateTextSetting();
			SetVisible(visible: false);
		}

		private void SetVisible(bool visible)
		{
			base.Visibility = ((!visible) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.Activate()
		{
			SetVisible(visible: true);
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.Deactivate()
		{
			SetVisible(visible: false);
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.SetBackColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			base.Background = new SolidColorBrush(color.ToWpfColor());
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.SetBounds(System.Drawing.Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Rect rect = bounds.ToRect();
			rect.Offset(-1.0, -1.0);
			SetValue(Canvas.LeftProperty, rect.Left);
			SetValue(Canvas.TopProperty, rect.Top);
			base.Width = rect.Width;
			base.Height = rect.Height;
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.SetFocus()
		{
			textBox.Focus();
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.SetSelection()
		{
			int length = textBox.Text.Length;
			textBox.Select(length, length);
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.Cut()
		{
			textBox.Cut();
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.Copy()
		{
			textBox.Copy();
		}

		void ICommentInplaceEditor.Paste()
		{
			textBox.Paste();
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			textBox = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_CommentBox") as System.Windows.Controls.TextBox;
			textBox.SelectionChanged += delegate
			{
				RaiseSelectionChanged();
			};
		}

	public static class CursorsProvider
	{
		private static Dictionary<IPortableCursor, System.Windows.Input.Cursor> cursorsTable;

		private static string officeCursorsPath;

		private const string corePath = "DevExpress.XtraSpreadsheet.Cursors.";

		static CursorsProvider()
		{
			officeCursorsPath = "DevExpress.Office.Cursors.";
			PopulateCursorsTable();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static System.Windows.Input.Cursor GetCursor(IPortableCursor cursor)
		{
			if (cursorsTable.ContainsKey(cursor))
			{
				return cursorsTable[cursor];
			}
			return System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
		}

		public static IPortableCursor GetPlatformIndependentCursor(System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor)
		{
			foreach (IPortableCursor key in cursorsTable.Keys)
			{
				if (cursorsTable[key] == cursor)
				{
					return key;
				}
			}
			return PortableCursors.Default;
		}

		private static void PopulateCursorsTable()
		{
			cursorsTable = new Dictionary<IPortableCursor, System.Windows.Input.Cursor>();
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.Default, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.Hand, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Hand);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.SizeNESW, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNESW);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.SizeNS, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNS);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.SizeNWSE, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeNWSE);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.SizeWE, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeWE);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.AppStarting, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.AppStarting);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.Cross, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Cross);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.Help, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Help);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.No, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.No);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanEast, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollE);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanNE, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollNE);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanNorth, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollN);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanNW, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollNW);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanSE, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollSE);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanSouth, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollS);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanSW, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollSW);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.PanWest, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.ScrollW);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.SizeAll, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.SizeAll);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.UpArrow, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.UpArrow);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.WaitCursor, System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Wait);
			cursorsTable.Add(PortableCursors.IBeam, CreateIBeamCursor());
			int defaultDeviceDpi = OfficeCursors.DefaultDeviceDpi;
			cursorsTable.Add(OfficeCursors.LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType.ResizeRow, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateResizeRowCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(OfficeCursors.LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType.ResizeColumn, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateResizeColumnCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(OfficeCursors.LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType.BeginRotate, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateBeginRotateCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(OfficeCursors.LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType.Rotate, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateRotateCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(OfficeCursors.LoadCursor(OfficeCursorType.SelectColumn, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateSelectColumnCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)1, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateSelectRowCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)2, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateDragRangeCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)3, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateResizeNWSECursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)4, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateResizeNESWCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)0, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateSmallCrossCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)5, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateDragItemNoneCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)6, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateDragItemMoveCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)7, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateDragItemRemoveCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)8, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateUnhideColumnCursor());
			cursorsTable.Add(SpreadsheetCursors.LoadCursor((SpreadsheetCursorType)9, defaultDeviceDpi, defaultDeviceDpi), CreateUnhideRowCursor());
		}

		private static System.Windows.Input.Cursor CreateCursorFromResources(string resourcePath, Assembly asm)
		{
			try
			{
				return new System.Windows.Input.Cursor(asm.GetManifestResourceStream(resourcePath));
			}
			catch
			{
				return System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		protected int GetSelectionStart()
		{
			BaseEdit obj = edit;
			TextEdit val = (TextEdit)(object)((obj is TextEdit) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return val.SelectionStart;
		}

		protected int GetSelectionLength()
		{
			BaseEdit obj = edit;
			TextEdit val = (TextEdit)(object)((obj is TextEdit) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return val.SelectionLength;
		}

		private string GetText()
		{
			edit.DoValidate();
			if (edit is IDateTimeProvider { DateTime: var dateTime })
			{
				return dateTime.ToString(control.Options.Culture);
			}
			if (edit.EditValue == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return edit.EditValue.ToString();
		}

		private void SetText(string text)
		{
			if (edit is IDateTimeProvider dateTimeProvider)
			{
				if (DateTime.TryParse(text, control.Options.Culture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
				{
					dateTimeProvider.DateTime = result;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				edit.EditValue = text;
			}
		}

		void ICellInplaceEditor.ActualizeText()
		{
			edit.DoValidate();
			if (edit is ICustomCellEdit customCellEdit)
			{
				customCellEdit.EnsureActualEditValue();
			}
		}

		internal void SetSettings(BaseEditSettings settings, CustomCellInplaceEditorType type)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			edit = CreateEditor(settings, type);
			edit.EditValuePostMode = (PostMode)0;
			edit.ValidateOnTextInput = true;
			edit.ShowBorder = false;
			SetForceInitialText(settings);
			SubscribeEditorEvents();
		}

		private void SetForceInitialText(BaseEditSettings settings)
		{
			ButtonEditSettings val = (ButtonEditSettings)(object)((settings is ButtonEditSettings) ? settings : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				bool? isTextEditable = val.IsTextEditable;
				forceInitialText = !isTextEditable.HasValue || isTextEditable.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				forceInitialText = true;
			}
		}

		private BaseEdit CreateEditor(BaseEditSettings settings, CustomCellInplaceEditorType type)
		{
			if (settings is CheckEditSettings)
			{
				IBaseEdit obj = settings.CreateEditor((EditorOptimizationMode)0);
				CheckEdit val = (CheckEdit)(object)((obj is CheckEdit) ? obj : null);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val).VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val).HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
				((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)val).Padding = new Thickness(0.0);
				return (BaseEdit)(object)val;
			}
			if (settings is ComboBoxEditSettings)
			{
				ComboBoxCellInplaceEditor comboBoxCellInplaceEditor = new ComboBoxCellInplaceEditor();
				settings.ApplyToEdit((IBaseEdit)(object)comboBoxCellInplaceEditor, true, (IDefaultEditorViewInfo)(object)EmptyDefaultEditorViewInfo.Instance);
				return (BaseEdit)(object)comboBoxCellInplaceEditor;
			}
			if (settings is DateEditSettings)
			{
				DateEditCellInplaceEditor dateEditCellInplaceEditor = new DateEditCellInplaceEditor();
				settings.ApplyToEdit((IBaseEdit)(object)dateEditCellInplaceEditor, true, (IDefaultEditorViewInfo)(object)EmptyDefaultEditorViewInfo.Instance);
				return (BaseEdit)(object)dateEditCellInplaceEditor;
			}
			IBaseEdit obj2 = settings.CreateEditor((EditorOptimizationMode)0);
			return (BaseEdit)(object)((obj2 is BaseEdit) ? obj2 : null);
		}

		private void SubscribeEditorEvents()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((UIElement)(object)edit).GotFocus += OnGotFocus;
			edit.EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnEditValueChanged);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((UIElement)(object)edit).GotFocus -= OnGotFocus;
			edit.EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(OnEditValueChanged);
		}

			control.Focus();

		public void SetBounds(InplaceEditorBoundsInfo boundsInfo)
		{
			editorRect = boundsInfo.EditorBounds.ToRect();
			double num = editorRect.Left - 2.0;
			double num2 = editorRect.Top;
			double num3 = editorRect.Width + 4.0;
			double num4 = editorRect.Height;
			double num5 = 1.0 / HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedSizeD(control.ViewControl.WorksheetControl.ScaleFactor, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
			if (num5 != 1.0)
			{
				num *= num5;
				num2 *= num5;
				num3 *= num5;
				num4 *= num5;
			}
			SetValue(Canvas.LeftProperty, num);
			SetValue(Canvas.TopProperty, num2);
			base.Width = num3;
			base.Height = num4;
			editorRect = new Rect(num, num2, num3, num4);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (edit != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)edit).Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, editorRect.Width, editorRect.Height));
			}
			return base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (edit != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)edit).Measure(editorRect.Size);
			}
			return base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
		}

			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)edit).FontSize = textSettings.FontSize;
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)edit).FontStyle = textSettings.FontStyle;
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)edit).FontWeight = textSettings.FontWeight;
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)edit).FontStretch = textSettings.FontStretch;
			((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)edit).Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(textSettings.Foreground);
		}

		public void SetSelection(int start, int length)
		{
			BaseEdit obj = edit;
			TextEdit val = (TextEdit)(object)((obj is TextEdit) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (((UIElement)(object)edit).IsFocused)
				{
					val.Select(start, length);
					ResetSelectionProperties();
				}
				else
				{
					selectionStart = start;
					selectionLength = length;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetSelectionProperties()
		{
			selectionStart = -1;
			selectionLength = -1;
		}

		private void OnGotFocus(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (selectionStart != -1 && selectionLength != -1)
				{
					BaseEdit obj = edit;
					TextEdit val = (TextEdit)(object)((obj is TextEdit) ? obj : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.Select(selectionStart, selectionLength);
						ResetSelectionProperties();
					}
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void OnEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BaseEdit obj = edit;

			}

			if (HasCustomFooter)

			}
		}

		private void InitializeFooter()
		{

			{
				Grid grid = ((DXDialog)this).Footer.Parent as Grid;
				((DXDialog)this).Footer.Children.Clear();
				grid.Children.Remove(((DXDialog)this).Footer);
				footerGrid = new Grid();
				footerGrid.Margin = new Thickness(12.0);
				footerGrid.SetValue(Grid.RowProperty, 1);
				if (!grid.Children.Contains(footerGrid))
				{
					grid.Children.Add(footerGrid);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void InitializeButtons(System.Windows.Controls.Button button)
		{
			if (HasCustomFooter && footerGrid != null)
			{
				button.HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;
				button.Margin = new Thickness(0.0);
				StackPanel stackPanel = new StackPanel();
				stackPanel.Orientation = System.Windows.Controls.Orientation.Horizontal;
				stackPanel.HorizontalAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
				stackPanel.Children.Add(((DXDialog)this).OkButton);
				stackPanel.Children.Add(((DXDialog)this).CancelButton);
				footerGrid.Children.Add(button);
				footerGrid.Children.Add(stackPanel);
			}
		}

	public static class SpreadsheetFormHelper
	{
		internal static void ShowDXDialog(System.Windows.Controls.UserControl form, DialogClosedDelegate onDialogClosed, string title, DependencyObject owner, Func<bool> onOkClickDelegate = null)
		{
			CustomDXDialog customDXDialog = new CustomDXDialog(title, (DialogButtons)1);
			SetupDXDialog(customDXDialog, form, owner, onDialogClosed, onOkClickDelegate);
			((Window)(object)customDXDialog).ShowDialog();
		}

		internal static void SetupDXDialog(CustomDXDialog dialog, System.Windows.Controls.UserControl form, DependencyObject owner, DialogClosedDelegate onDialogClosed, Func<bool> onOkClickDelegate = null, Action extraAction = null)
		{
			SetupDXWindow((DXWindow)(object)dialog, owner, SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight, WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner, ResizeMode.NoResize, extraAction);
			((ContentControl)(object)dialog).Content = form;
			if (onDialogClosed != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)dialog).Closed += delegate
				{
					onDialogClosed.Invoke(dialog.DialogResult);
				};
			}
			if (onOkClickDelegate != null)
			{
				((DXDialog)dialog).OkButtonClick += delegate(object s, CancelEventArgs e)
				{
					e.Cancel = !onOkClickDelegate();
				};
			}
		}

		internal static void SetupDXWindow(DXWindow window, DependencyObject owner, SizeToContent sizeToContent, WindowStartupLocation startupLocation, ResizeMode resizeMode, Action extraAction)
		{
			((Window)(object)window).SizeToContent = sizeToContent;
			((Window)(object)window).ResizeMode = resizeMode;
			((Window)(object)window).WindowStartupLocation = startupLocation;
			TrySetDialogOwnerWindow(window, owner);
			ApplyDialogThemeName(window, owner);
			window.ShowIcon = false;
			extraAction?.Invoke();
		}

		private static void ApplyDialogThemeName(DXWindow window, DependencyObject owner)
		{
			if (!CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				string value = owner.GetValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty) as string;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)window).SetValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty, (object)value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void TrySetDialogOwnerWindow(DXWindow window, DependencyObject owner)
		{
			Window window2 = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>(owner);
			if (window2 != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)window).Owner = window2;
			}
		}
	}

		{

			DefaultForeground = base.Foreground;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab || e.Key == Key.Decimal || e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			int caretIndex = base.CaretIndex;
			if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Alt && Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.Return))
			{
				base.SelectedText = Environment.NewLine;
				base.CaretIndex = caretIndex + 1;
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				PortableKeyEventArgs e2 = KeyEventArgsExtensions.ToPortable(e);
				InnerEditor.OnKeyDown(e2);
				KeyEventArgsExtensions.CopyFrom(e, e2);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyUp(System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewKeyUp(e);
			PortableKeyEventArgs e2 = KeyEventArgsExtensions.ToPortable(e);
			InnerEditor.OnKeyUp(e2);
			KeyEventArgsExtensions.CopyFrom(e, e2);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewTextInput(TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{

			OnTextInputCore(e);
		}

		protected override void OnSelectionChanged(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			InnerCellInplaceEditor innerEditor = InnerEditor;
			if (innerEditor != null && (int)innerEditor.Mode == 1 && base.SelectionLength != 0 && InputMethod.Current.ImeState != InputMethodState.On)
			{
				base.SelectionStart = base.Text.Length;
				base.SelectionLength = 0;
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			base.OnSelectionChanged(e);
			SyncronizeCaretPosition();
			if (!lockTextChanged)
			{
				RaiseSelectionChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
