		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			char[] array = e.Text.ToCharArray();
			if (InnerEditor != null && array.Length != 0)
			{
				InnerEditor.OnKeyPress(new PortableKeyPressEventArgs(array[0]));
			}
		}

		protected override void OnTextChanged(TextChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnTextChanged(e);
			if (lockTextChanged || InnerEditor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lockTextChanged = true;
			try
			{
				InnerEditor.InputPercentage();
				RaiseTextChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				lockTextChanged = false;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, (Action)delegate
			{
				if (InnerEditor != null && InnerEditor.IsActive)
				{
					int num = Math.Min(base.Text.Length, InnerEditor.SelectionStart + InnerEditor.SelectionLength);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						int lineIndexFromCharacterIndex = GetLineIndexFromCharacterIndex(num);
						if (lineIndexFromCharacterIndex >= 0)
						{
							ScrollToLine(lineIndexFromCharacterIndex);
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}

		{
			if (formulaAutoCompletePresenter == null && InnerEditor != null)
			{
				formulaAutoCompletePresenter = (IFormulaAutoCompletePresenter)(object)new WpfFormulaAutoCompletePresenter(this, KeepOpenFormulaPresenter);
			}
			return formulaAutoCompletePresenter;
		}

		}

			if (base.TextWrapping != TextWrapping.NoWrap)
			{
				Measure(new System.Windows.Size(size.Width, double.PositiveInfinity));
				measuredSize = new System.Windows.Size(size.Width, Math.Max(size.Height, base.DesiredSize.Height + 1.0));
			}
			else

				Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, size.Height));
				measuredSize = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(size.Width, base.DesiredSize.Width + 1.0), size.Height);
			}
			if (measuredSize.Width >= size.Width || measuredSize.Height >= size.Height)

	public class XpfScrollBarAdapter : IPlatformSpecificScrollBarAdapter
	{
		public virtual void OnScroll(ScrollBarAdapter adapter, object sender, PortableScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			adapter.RaiseScroll(e);
		}

		public virtual void ApplyValuesToScrollBarCore(ScrollBarAdapter adapter)
		{
			DoScrollBarAction(adapter, delegate
			{
				IOfficeScrollbar scrollBar = adapter.ScrollBar;
				int num = (scrollBar.LargeChange = (int)Math.Round(adapter.Factor * (double)adapter.LargeChange));
				scrollBar.SmallChange = 1;
				int num3 = (scrollBar.Minimum = (int)Math.Round(adapter.Factor * (double)adapter.Minimum));
				int num5 = (int)Math.Round(adapter.Factor * (double)adapter.Maximum);
				scrollBar.Maximum = ((num5 > num3) ? (num5 - num + 1) : num3);
				scrollBar.Value = (int)Math.Round(adapter.Factor * (double)adapter.Value);
				scrollBar.Enabled = adapter.Enabled;
				if (scrollBar is IXpfOfficeScrollbar xpfOfficeScrollbar)
				{
					xpfOfficeScrollbar.ViewportSize = num;
				}
			}, waitForCompletion: false);
		}

		protected void DoScrollBarAction(ScrollBarAdapter adapter, Action a, bool waitForCompletion)
		{
			if (!(adapter.ScrollBar is IXpfOfficeScrollbar { Dispatcher: var dispatcher }))
			{
				a();
			}
			else if (!dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				if (waitForCompletion)
				{
					AutoResetEvent wait = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
					Action method = delegate
					{
						a();
						wait.Set();
					};
					dispatcher.BeginInvoke(method);
					wait.WaitOne();
				}
				else
				{
					dispatcher.BeginInvoke(a);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				a();
			}
		}

		public int GetRawScrollBarValue(ScrollBarAdapter adapter)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			DoScrollBarAction(adapter, delegate
			{
				result = adapter.ScrollBar.Value;
			}, waitForCompletion: true);
			return (int)result;
		}

		public bool SetRawScrollBarValue(ScrollBarAdapter adapter, int value)
		{
			if (adapter.GetRawScrollBarValue() != value)
			{
				DoScrollBarAction(adapter, delegate
				{
					adapter.ScrollBar.Value = value;
				}, waitForCompletion: false);
				adapter.Value = (long)Math.Round((double)value / adapter.Factor);
				return true;
			}
			long num = (long)Math.Round((double)value / adapter.Factor);
			bool result = num != adapter.Value;
			adapter.Value = num;
			return result;
		}

		public virtual int GetPageUpRawScrollBarValue(ScrollBarAdapter adapter)
		{
			int result = 0;
			DoScrollBarAction(adapter, delegate
			{
				result = adapter.ScrollBar.Value - adapter.ScrollBar.LargeChange;
				int minimum = adapter.ScrollBar.Minimum;
				if (result < minimum)
				{
					result = minimum;
				}
			}, waitForCompletion: true);
			return result;
		}

		public virtual int GetPageDownRawScrollBarValue(ScrollBarAdapter adapter)
		{
			int result = 0;
			DoScrollBarAction(adapter, delegate
			{
				result = adapter.ScrollBar.Value + adapter.ScrollBar.LargeChange;
				int maximum = adapter.ScrollBar.Maximum;
				if (result > maximum)
				{
					result = maximum;
				}
			}, waitForCompletion: true);
			return result;
		}

		public virtual PortableScrollEventArgs CreateLastScrollEventArgs(ScrollBarAdapter adapter)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new PortableScrollEventArgs(XpfOfficeScrollbar.ConvertScrollEventType(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.Last), XpfOfficeScrollbar.ConvertScrollBarValue(adapter.ScrollBar.Maximum));
		}
	}

		{
			RepeatButton repeatButton = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)base.ScrollBar, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement e) => e.GetType() == typeof(RepeatButton) && (e as RepeatButton).Command == System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar.LineDownCommand)) as RepeatButton;
			RepeatButton repeatButton2 = LayoutHelper.FindElement((FrameworkElement)base.ScrollBar, (Predicate<FrameworkElement>)((FrameworkElement e) => e.GetType() == typeof(RepeatButton) && (e as RepeatButton).Command == System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar.LineRightCommand)) as RepeatButton;
			if (repeatButton != null)
			{
				repeatButton.Click += OnClick;
			}
			if (repeatButton2 != null)

				repeatButton2.Click += OnClick;
			}
		}

				double num = (double)DependencyObjectExtensions.GetCoerceOldValue((DependencyObject)base.ScrollBar, RangeBase.ValueProperty);
				RaiseScroll(ConvertEventArgs(new System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement, base.ScrollBar.Value), (int)num));
			}
		}
	}

	public enum ManipulationTypes
	{
		None,
		HorizontalPan,
		VerticalPan,
		Zoom
	}
	public interface IGestureClient
	{
		void OnManipulationStarting(ManipulationStartingEventArgs e);

		void OnManipulationDelta(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e, ManipulationTypes type);

		bool ShouldProcessGesture(TouchEventArgs e);

		void OnTap(TouchEventArgs e);

		void OnTouchDown(TouchEventArgs e);

		void OnTouchUp(TouchEventArgs e);
	}
	public class GestureHelper
	{
		private bool stopManipulation;

		private TimeSpan MinTapTime = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 300);

		private DateTime touchDownTime;

		private IGestureClient Client { get; set; }

		private UIElement ManipulationOwner { get; set; }

		private int TouchCount { get; set; }

		private bool IsMultiTouch => TouchCount > 1;

		private ManipulationTypes Type { get; set; }

		public GestureHelper(IGestureClient client, UIElement manipulationOwner)
		{
			Client = client;
			ManipulationOwner = manipulationOwner;
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			ManipulationOwner.TouchDown += OnTouchDown;
			ManipulationOwner.TouchUp += OnTouchUp;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationStarting += OnManipulationStarting;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationInertiaStarting += OnManipulationInertiaStarting;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationDelta += OnManipulationDelta;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationCompleted += OnManipulationCompleted;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			ManipulationOwner.TouchDown -= OnTouchDown;
			ManipulationOwner.TouchUp -= OnTouchUp;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationStarting -= OnManipulationStarting;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationInertiaStarting -= OnManipulationInertiaStarting;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationDelta -= OnManipulationDelta;
			ManipulationOwner.ManipulationCompleted -= OnManipulationCompleted;
		}

		private void OnTouchDown(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			Client.OnTouchDown(e);
			Reset();
			TouchCount++;
			touchDownTime = DateTime.Now;
			if (!Client.ShouldProcessGesture(e))
			{
				stopManipulation = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnTouchUp(object sender, TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsMultiTouch && DateTime.Now - touchDownTime < MinTapTime)
			{
				Client.OnTap(e);
			}
			TouchCount = Math.Max(0, TouchCount - 1);
			Client.OnTouchUp(e);
		}

		private void OnManipulationStarting(object sender, ManipulationStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (stopManipulation)
			{
				e.Cancel();
				e.Handled = true;
				Reset();
			}
			else
			{
				Client.OnManipulationStarting(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnManipulationInertiaStarting(object sender, ManipulationInertiaStartingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.TranslationBehavior.DesiredDeceleration = 0.001;
		}

		private void OnManipulationDelta(object sender, ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Type == ManipulationTypes.None)
			{
				DeterminateState(e);
			}
			ProcessManipulationDelta(e);
		}

		private void ProcessManipulationDelta(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Type == ManipulationTypes.Zoom && e.IsInertial)
			{
				e.Complete();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				Client.OnManipulationDelta(e, Type);
			}
		}

		private void DeterminateState(ManipulationDeltaEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsMultiTouch)
			{
				Type = ManipulationTypes.Zoom;
				return;
			}
			ManipulationDelta deltaManipulation = e.DeltaManipulation;
			double num = Math.Abs(deltaManipulation.Translation.X);
			double num2 = Math.Abs(deltaManipulation.Translation.Y);
			if (num != 0.0 && num > num2)
			{
				Type = ManipulationTypes.HorizontalPan;
			}
			else if (num2 != 0.0 && num2 > num)
			{
				Type = ManipulationTypes.VerticalPan;
			}
		}

		private void OnManipulationCompleted(object sender, ManipulationCompletedEventArgs e)
		{
			TouchCount = 0;
			Reset();
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			stopManipulation = false;
			Type = ManipulationTypes.None;
		}
	}
	internal class PostponeAction
	{
		public Delegate Action { get; private set; }

		public object[] Parameters { get; private set; }

		public PostponeAction(Delegate action, object[] parameters)
		{
			Action = action;
			Parameters = parameters;
		}
	}
	public class PostponedActionHelper
	{
		private Queue<PostponeAction> queue;

		public PostponedActionHelper()
		{
			queue = new Queue<PostponeAction>();
		}

		public void EnqueuePostponed(Delegate action, object[] parameters)
		{
			queue.Enqueue(new PostponeAction(action, parameters));
		}

		public void EnqueuePostponed(Delegate action)
		{
			queue.Enqueue(new PostponeAction(action, null));
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			while (queue.Count > 0)
			{
				PostponeAction postponeAction = queue.Dequeue();
				postponeAction.Action.DynamicInvoke(postponeAction.Parameters);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class TextInfoCalculator
	{
		public static TextSettings PrepareTextInfo(CellForegroundDisplayFormat displayFormat, DXStringFormat stringFormat, System.Windows.Media.Brush defaultForeground)
		{
			return PrepareTextInfo(displayFormat.Text, displayFormat.FontInfo, stringFormat, displayFormat.TextColor, defaultForeground);
		}

		public static TextSettings PrepareTextInfo(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, DXStringFormat stringFormat, System.Drawing.Color textColor, System.Windows.Media.Brush defaultForeground)
		{
			TextSettings textSettings = SetText(text, fontInfo, textColor, defaultForeground);
			if (stringFormat != null)
			{
				textSettings = SetTextAlignment(stringFormat, textSettings);
			}
			return textSettings;
		}

		public static TextSettings PrepareRichTextInfo(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, System.Drawing.Color textColor, System.Windows.Media.Brush defaultForeground, double scaleFactor)
		{
			return SetRichText(text, fontInfo, textColor, defaultForeground, scaleFactor);
		}

		public static TextSettings SetText(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, System.Windows.Media.Brush defalutForeground)
		{
			TextSettings textSettings = CalculateTextSettings(fontInfo, foreColor, ((SolidColorBrush)defalutForeground).Color);
			textSettings.Text = text;
			return textSettings;
		}

		public static TextSettings SetRichText(string text, FontInfo fontInfo, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, System.Windows.Media.Brush defalutForeground, double scaleFactor)
		{
			TextSettings textSettings = CalculateRichTextSettings(fontInfo, foreColor, ((SolidColorBrush)defalutForeground).Color, scaleFactor);
			textSettings.Text = text;
			textSettings.TextWrapping = TextWrapping.NoWrap;
			return textSettings;
		}

		public static TextSettings CalculateTextSettings(FontInfo fontInfo, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, System.Windows.Media.Color defalutForeColor)
		{
			return CalculateTextSettingsCore(fontInfo, foreColor, defalutForeColor, null);
		}

		public static TextSettings CalculateRichTextSettings(FontInfo fontInfo, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, System.Windows.Media.Color defalutForeColor, double scaleFactor)
		{
			return CalculateTextSettingsCore(fontInfo, foreColor, defalutForeColor, scaleFactor);
		}

		public static TextSettings CalculateTextSettingsCore(FontInfo fontInfo, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, System.Windows.Media.Color defalutForeColor, double? scaleFactor)
		{
			TextSettings textSettings = new TextSettings();
			WpfFontInfo wpfFontInfo = (WpfFontInfo)fontInfo;
			textSettings.FontFamily = wpfFontInfo.FontFamily;
			textSettings.FontStyle = wpfFontInfo.Typeface.Style;
			textSettings.FontWeight = wpfFontInfo.Typeface.Weight;
			textSettings.FontStretch = wpfFontInfo.Typeface.Stretch;
			if (scaleFactor.HasValue)
			{
				textSettings.FontSize = CalculateFontSize((float)((double)wpfFontInfo.Size / scaleFactor.Value));
			}
			else
			{
				textSettings.FontSize = CalculateFontSize(wpfFontInfo.SizeInPoints);
			}
			textSettings.TextDecorations = GetTextDecorations(fontInfo.Font);
			textSettings.Foreground = ((!DXColor.IsEmpty(foreColor)) ? XpfTypeConverter.ToPlatformColor(foreColor) : defalutForeColor);
			textSettings.TextRotation = wpfFontInfo.TextRotation;
			textSettings.Font = wpfFontInfo.Font;
			return textSettings;
		}

		public static double CalculateFontSize(float sizeInPoints)
		{
			return CalculateFontSize(sizeInPoints, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi);
		}

		public static double CalculateFontSize(float sizeInPoints, float dpi)
		{
			return Units.DocumentsToPixelsF(Units.PointsToDocumentsF(sizeInPoints), dpi);
		}

		public static CommentTextSettings CalculateCommentTextSettings(DXFont font, System.Drawing.Color foreColor)
		{
			CommentTextSettings commentTextSettings = new CommentTextSettings();
			TypefaceResolver typefaceResolver = new TypefaceResolver();
			Typeface typeface = typefaceResolver.GetTypeface(font.Name, font.Bold, font.Italic);
			commentTextSettings.FontFamily = typeface.FontFamily;
			commentTextSettings.FontSize = CalculateFontSize(font.SizeInPoints);
			commentTextSettings.FontStyle = typeface.Style;
			commentTextSettings.FontWeight = typeface.Weight;
			commentTextSettings.FontStretch = typeface.Stretch;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(foreColor.ToWpfColor());
			brush.Freeze();
			commentTextSettings.Foreground = brush;
			commentTextSettings.TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap;
			return commentTextSettings;
		}

		public static CellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings CalculateCellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings(Font font, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, XlHorizontalAlignment hAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings = new CellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings();
			TypefaceResolver typefaceResolver = new TypefaceResolver();
			Typeface typeface = typefaceResolver.GetTypeface(font.FontFamily.Name, font.Bold, font.Italic);
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.FontFamily = typeface.FontFamily;
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.FontSize = CalculateFontSize(font.SizeInPoints, 96f);
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.FontStyle = typeface.Style;
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.FontWeight = typeface.Weight;
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.FontStretch = typeface.Stretch;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(foreColor.ToWpfColor());
			brush.Freeze();
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.Foreground = brush;
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.TextDecorations = GetTextDecorations(font);
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.HorizontalAlignment = GetHorizontalAlignment(hAlignment);
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.TextWrapping = TextWrapping.NoWrap;
			cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings.TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis;
			return cellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings;
		}

		private static TextDecorationCollection GetTextDecorations(Font font)
		{
			if (font == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool underline = font.Underline;
			bool strikeout = font.Strikeout;
			if (!underline && !strikeout)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TextDecorationCollection textDecorationCollection = new TextDecorationCollection();
			if (underline)
			{
				textDecorationCollection.Add(TextDecorations.Underline);
			}
			if (strikeout)
			{
				textDecorationCollection.Add(TextDecorations.Strikethrough);
			}
			textDecorationCollection.Freeze();
			return textDecorationCollection;
		}

		public static TextSettings SetTextAlignment(DXStringFormat stringFormat, TextSettings info)
		{
			info.TextAlignment = GetTextAlignment(stringFormat.Alignment);
			info.VerticalAlignment = GetVerticalAlignment(stringFormat.LineAlignment);
			info.TextTrimming = GetTextTrimming(stringFormat.Trimming);
			info.TextWrapping = GetTextWrapping(stringFormat.FormatFlags);
			return info;
		}

		private static System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment GetHorizontalAlignment(XlHorizontalAlignment hAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)hAlignment != 2)
			{
				if ((int)hAlignment == 3)
				{
					return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Right;
				}
				return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}
			return System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
		}

		private static TextWrapping GetTextWrapping(DXStringFormatFlags stringFormatFlags)
		{
			if ((stringFormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap) != 0)
			{
				return TextWrapping.NoWrap;
			}
			return TextWrapping.Wrap;
		}

		private static TextTrimming GetTextTrimming(DXStringTrimming stringTrimming)
		{
			return stringTrimming switch
			{
				DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter => TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis, 
				DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord => TextTrimming.WordEllipsis, 
				_ => TextTrimming.None, 
			};
		}

		private static VerticalAlignment GetVerticalAlignment(DXStringAlignment stringAlignment)
		{
			return stringAlignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => VerticalAlignment.Center, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => VerticalAlignment.Bottom, 
				DXStringAlignment.Near => VerticalAlignment.Top, 
				_ => VerticalAlignment.Top, 
			};
		}

		private static TextAlignment GetTextAlignment(DXStringAlignment stringAlignment)
		{
			return stringAlignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => TextAlignment.Center, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => TextAlignment.Right, 
				DXStringAlignment.Near => TextAlignment.Left, 
				_ => TextAlignment.Left, 
			};
		}

		public static XlHorizontalAlignment GetXlHorizontalAlignment(TextAlignment alignment)
		{
			return (XlHorizontalAlignment)(alignment switch
			{
				TextAlignment.Center => 2, 
				TextAlignment.Justify => 5, 
				TextAlignment.Left => 1, 
				TextAlignment.Right => 3, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Inknown TextAlignment " + alignment), 
			});
		}

		public static XlVerticalAlignment GetXlVerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment alignment)
		{
			return (XlVerticalAlignment)(alignment switch
			{
				VerticalAlignment.Bottom => 2, 
				VerticalAlignment.Center => 1, 
				VerticalAlignment.Top => 0, 
				VerticalAlignment.Stretch => 3, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("Inknown VerticalAlignment " + alignment), 
			});
		}
	}

	public static class DrawingTransformHelper
	{
		public static void ApplyTransform(UIElement child, Rect bounds, Transform2D transform2D)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix transformMatrix = GetTransformMatrix(bounds, transform2D);
			child.RenderTransform = new MatrixTransform(transformMatrix);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Matrix GetTransformMatrix(Rect bounds, Transform2D transform2D)
		{
			double rotationAngle = transform2D.GetRotationAngleInDegrees();
			return GetTransformMatrix(bounds, rotationAngle, transform2D.FlipH, transform2D.FlipV);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Matrix GetTransformMatrix(Rect bounds, double rotationAngle, bool flipH, bool flipV)
		{
			return GetTransformMatrix(new System.Windows.Point(bounds.Width / 2.0, bounds.Height / 2.0), rotationAngle, flipH, flipV);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Matrix GetTransformMatrix(System.Windows.Point center, double rotationAngle, bool flipH, bool flipV)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Matrix result = default(System.Windows.Media.Matrix);
			result.ScaleAt(flipH ? (-1.0) : 1.0, flipV ? (-1.0) : 1.0, center.X, center.Y);
			result.RotateAt(rotationAngle, center.X, center.Y);
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal static class StringFormatProvider
	{
		private static Dictionary<int, DXStringFormat> stringFormats = PopulateStringFormats();

		public static Dictionary<int, DXStringFormat> StringFormats => stringFormats;

		private static Dictionary<int, DXStringFormat> PopulateStringFormats()
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Dictionary<int, DXStringFormat> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, DXStringFormat>();
			for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++)
			{
				for (XlHorizontalAlignment val = (XlHorizontalAlignment)0; (int)val <= 7; val = (XlHorizontalAlignment)(val + 1))
				{
					for (XlVerticalAlignment val2 = (XlVerticalAlignment)0; (int)val2 <= 4; val2 = (XlVerticalAlignment)(val2 + 1))
					{
						int key = CalculateAlignmentHash(val, val2, i != 0);
						DXStringFormat value = CreateStringFormat(val, val2, i != 0);
						dictionary.Add(key, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static DXStringFormat CreateStringFormat(XlHorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment, XlVerticalAlignment verticalAlignment, bool wrapText)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic();
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoClip;
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags &= ~DXStringFormatFlags.LineLimit;
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = ConvertHorizontalAlignment(horizontalAlignment);
			dXStringFormat.LineAlignment = ConvertVerticalAlignment(verticalAlignment);
			if (!wrapText)
			{
				dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			}
			return dXStringFormat;
		}

		public static int CalculateAlignmentHash(XlHorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment, XlVerticalAlignment verticalAlignment, bool wrapText)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)((horizontalAlignment << 3) | verticalAlignment | (((!wrapText) ? 1u : 0u) << 6));
		}

		private static DXStringAlignment ConvertHorizontalAlignment(XlHorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)horizontalAlignment)
			{
			default:
				return DXStringAlignment.Near;
			case 2:
			case 6:
				return DXStringAlignment.Center;
			case 3:
				return DXStringAlignment.Far;
			}
		}

		private static DXStringAlignment ConvertVerticalAlignment(XlVerticalAlignment verticalAlignment)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)verticalAlignment switch
			{
				1 => DXStringAlignment.Center, 
				0 => DXStringAlignment.Near, 
				_ => DXStringAlignment.Far, 
			};
		}
	}

	public enum TabSelectorItemState
	{
		Normal,
		Active,
		Selected
	}
	public class TabSelectorItem : System.Windows.Controls.Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty StateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColorProperty;

		public TabSelectorItemState State
		{
			get
			{
				return (TabSelectorItemState)GetValue(StateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(StateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(TextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return (System.Windows.Media.Color)GetValue(ColorProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ColorProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHidden { get; set; }

		static TabSelectorItem()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TabSelectorItem);
			StateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("State", typeof(TabSelectorItemState), typeFromHandle);
			TextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Text", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty));
			ColorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Color", typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color), typeFromHandle);
		}

		public TabSelectorItem()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<TabSelectorItem>(this);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new TabSelectorItemAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	public class TabSelectorPanel : System.Windows.Controls.Panel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty AddButtonTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplateProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TabSelectorItemColoredTemplateProperty;

		private SpreadsheetTabSelector owner;

		public double Viewport { get; set; }

		internal int FirstTabIndex { get; private set; }

		internal int LastTabIndex { get; private set; }

		private int AddButtonIndex => base.Children.Count - 1;

		private int ActiveTabIndex { get; set; }

		private int FirstFullyVisibleTabIndex { get; set; }

		private int LastFullyVisibleTabIndex { get; set; }

		private bool MakeVisbleMeasureMode { get; set; }

		private ContentPresenter AddButtonContainer => base.Children[AddButtonIndex] as ContentPresenter;

		public DataTemplate AddButtonTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataTemplate)GetValue(AddButtonTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AddButtonTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate TabSelectorItemColoredTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(TabSelectorItemColoredTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(TabSelectorItemColoredTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static TabSelectorPanel()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TabSelectorPanel);
			AddButtonTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AddButtonTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeFromHandle);
			TabSelectorItemColoredTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TabSelectorItemColoredTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeFromHandle);
		}

		public TabSelectorPanel()
		{
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			contentPresenter.SetBinding(ContentPresenter.ContentTemplateProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("AddButtonTemplate")
			{
				Source = this
			});
			base.Children.Add(contentPresenter);
		}

		internal void SetOwner(SpreadsheetTabSelector owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			List<string> tabItems = owner.GetTabItems();
			if (tabItems == null)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			EqualizeItemCount(tabItems, availableSize);
			ValidateIndexes();
			MeasureAddButton(availableSize);
			if (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Height))
			{
				availableSize.Height = AddButtonContainer.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			if (double.IsInfinity(availableSize.Width))
			{
				availableSize.Width = AddButtonContainer.DesiredSize.Width;
			}
			if (FirstTabIndex == -1)
			{
				MeasureFromLast();
			}
			else
			{
				MeasureFromFirst();
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		private void ValidateIndexes()
		{
			FirstTabIndex = Math.Min(FirstTabIndex, Math.Max(0, AddButtonIndex - 1));
			LastTabIndex = Math.Min(LastTabIndex, AddButtonIndex);
		}

		private void EqualizeItemCount(List<string> items, System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = Math.Min(items.Count, AddButtonIndex); i < num; i++)
			{
				MeasureTab(base.Children[i] as TabSelectorItem, items[i], availableSize, i);
			}
			for (; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				TabSelectorItem tabSelectorItem = new TabSelectorItem();
				MeasureTab(tabSelectorItem, items[i], availableSize, i);
				base.Children.Insert(AddButtonIndex, tabSelectorItem);
			}
			base.Children.RemoveRange(i, AddButtonIndex - i);
		}

		private TabSelectorItem MeasureTab(TabSelectorItem item, string tabName, System.Windows.Size availableSize, int index)
		{
			item.Text = tabName;
			item.State = owner.GetItemState(tabName);
			if (item.State == TabSelectorItemState.Active)
			{
				ActiveTabIndex = index;
			}
			System.Drawing.Color tabColor = owner.GetTabColor(tabName);
			if (DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(tabColor))
			{
				item.Color = tabColor.ToWpfColor();
				item.Template = TabSelectorItemDefaultTemplate;
			}
			else
			{
				item.Color = System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(byte.MaxValue, tabColor.R, tabColor.G, tabColor.B);
				item.Template = TabSelectorItemColoredTemplate;
			}
			item.Measure(availableSize);
			return item;
		}

		private void MeasureAddButton(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			ContentPresenter addButtonContainer = AddButtonContainer;
			if (addButtonContainer.Content == null)
			{
				addButtonContainer.Content = owner;
			}
			addButtonContainer.Measure(availableSize);
		}

		private void MeasureFromFirst()
		{
			FirstFullyVisibleTabIndex = FirstTabIndex;
			LastTabIndex = CalcLastTabIndex(FirstTabIndex);
			LastFullyVisibleTabIndex = Math.Max(FirstFullyVisibleTabIndex, LastTabIndex - 1);
		}

		private int CalcLastTabIndex(int firstIndex)
		{
			double num = Viewport;
			int result = firstIndex;
			for (int i = firstIndex; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				num -= base.Children[i].DesiredSize.Width;
				result = i;
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void MeasureFromLast()
		{
			FirstTabIndex = AddButtonIndex;
			if (!MakeVisbleMeasureMode)
			{
				LastTabIndex = AddButtonIndex;
			}
			double num = Viewport;
			for (int num2 = LastTabIndex; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				num -= base.Children[num2].DesiredSize.Width;
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
				FirstTabIndex = num2;
			}
			if (MakeVisbleMeasureMode)
			{
				LastTabIndex = CalcLastTabIndex(FirstTabIndex);
			}
			FirstFullyVisibleTabIndex = Math.Min(FirstTabIndex, AddButtonIndex - 1);
			LastFullyVisibleTabIndex = Math.Max(FirstFullyVisibleTabIndex, LastTabIndex - 1);
			MakeVisbleMeasureMode = false;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < FirstTabIndex; i++)
			{
				HideUiElement(i, num);
			}
			for (; i <= LastTabIndex; i++)
			{
				num += ArrangeUIElement(i, num, finalSize);
			}
			for (; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				HideUiElement(i, num);
			}
			if (Math.Sign(Viewport) > 0)
			{
				base.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, Viewport, base.ActualHeight));
			}
			owner.OnSelectorPanelArrangeFinished();
			return finalSize;
		}

		private void HideUiElement(int index, double x)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[index];
			uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(x, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0));
			if (uIElement is TabSelectorItem tabSelectorItem)
			{
				tabSelectorItem.IsHidden = true;
			}
		}

		private double ArrangeUIElement(int index, double x, System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = base.Children[index];
			Rect finalRect = new Rect(x, 0.0, uIElement.DesiredSize.Width, finalSize.Height);
			uIElement.Arrange(finalRect);
			if (uIElement is TabSelectorItem tabSelectorItem)
			{
				tabSelectorItem.IsHidden = false;
			}
			return finalRect.Width;
		}

		internal string GetTextByHitTest(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is TabSelectorItem { IsHidden: false } tabSelectorItem)
				{
					Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, tabSelectorItem.ActualWidth, tabSelectorItem.ActualHeight);
					if (tabSelectorItem.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(rect).Contains(point))
					{
						return tabSelectorItem.Text;
					}
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal void ChangeItemSelectedState(string sheetName)
		{
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (child is TabSelectorItem tabSelectorItem && tabSelectorItem.Text == sheetName)
				{
					tabSelectorItem.State = owner.GetItemState(sheetName);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ScrollToFirstTab()
		{
			FirstTabIndex = 0;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		internal void ScrollToLastTab()
		{
			FirstTabIndex = -1;
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		internal void ScrollToPreviousTab()
		{
			FirstTabIndex = Math.Max(FirstTabIndex - 1, 0);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		internal void ScrollToNextTab()
		{
			FirstTabIndex = Math.Min(FirstTabIndex + 1, AddButtonIndex);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		internal bool CanScrollToPreviousTab()
		{
			return FirstTabIndex > 0;
		}

		internal bool CanScrollToNextTab()
		{
			if (FirstTabIndex == AddButtonIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (LastTabIndex < AddButtonIndex)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return AddButtonContainer.TransformToVisual(this).TransformBounds(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, AddButtonContainer.ActualWidth, AddButtonContainer.ActualHeight)).Right > Viewport;
		}

		internal void MakeVisibleActiveSheet()
		{
			if (ActiveTabIndex < FirstFullyVisibleTabIndex)
			{
				FirstTabIndex = ActiveTabIndex;
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			else if (ActiveTabIndex > LastFullyVisibleTabIndex)
			{
				FirstTabIndex = -1;
				LastTabIndex = ActiveTabIndex;
				MakeVisbleMeasureMode = true;
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}
	}

		private void SubcribeMouseEvents()
		{
			selectorPanel.MouseDown += selectorPanel_MouseDown;
			navButtonsContainer.MouseDown += navButtonsContainer_MouseDown;
		}

		private void UnSubcribeMouseEvents()
		{
			if (selectorPanel != null)
			{
				selectorPanel.MouseDown -= selectorPanel_MouseDown;
			}
			if (navButtonsContainer != null)
			{
				navButtonsContainer.MouseDown -= navButtonsContainer_MouseDown;
			}
		}

		private void selectorPanel_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ClickCount == 1)
			{
				HandleMouseClick(e);
			}
			else if (e.ClickCount == 2)
			{
				HandleMouseDoubleClick(e);
			}
		}

		private void HandleMouseClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			string tabNameByPoint = GetTabNameByPoint(e);
			if (tabNameByPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			e.Handled = true;
			if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Right)
			{
				if (tabNameByPoint == SelectedTabName)
				{
					return;
				}
				selectedTabName = tabNameByPoint;
				List<InternalSheetBase> selectedSheets = DocumentModel.GetSelectedSheets();
				bool flag = selectedSheets.Contains(((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[tabNameByPoint]);
				OnSelectedTabChanged(measurePanel: false);
				if (flag)
				{
					foreach (InternalSheetBase item in selectedSheets)
					{
						item.IsSelected = true;
					}
				}
				MeasureSelectorPanel();
			}
			else if (KeyboardHandler.IsControlPressed)
			{
				if (tabNameByPoint != SelectedTabName)
				{
					InternalSheetBase val = ((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[tabNameByPoint];
					val.IsSelected = !val.IsSelected;
					MeasureSelectorPanel();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SelectTabByName(tabNameByPoint);
			}
		}

		private void HandleMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string tabNameByPoint = GetTabNameByPoint(e);
			if (tabNameByPoint != null)
			{
				SpreadsheetCommand val = spreadsheetControl.CreateCommand(SpreadsheetCommandId.RenameSheet);
				if (val != null)
				{
					((Command)val).Execute();
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetTabNameByPoint(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			string textByHitTest = selectorPanel.GetTextByHitTest(e.GetPosition(selectorPanel));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(textByHitTest) || !IsTabNameValid(textByHitTest))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return textByHitTest;
		}

		private void navButtonsContainer_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.RightButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				SpreadsheetCommand obj = spreadsheetControl.CreateCommand(SpreadsheetCommandId.SheetActivation);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					((Command)obj).Execute();
				}
			}
		}

		private double GetViewport()
		{
			if (AllowStretch)
			{
				return base.ActualWidth - navButtonsContainer.ActualWidth;
			}
			return VisibleWidth - navButtonsContainer.ActualWidth;
		}

		private void FindButtons()
		{
			if (navButtonsContainer != null)
			{
				prevBtn = PrepareButton("PART_PrevButton", SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToPrevious, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToPreviousDescription);
				nextBtn = PrepareButton("PART_NextButton", SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToNext, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToNextDescription);
				lastBtn = PrepareButton("PART_LastButton", SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToLast, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToLastDescription);
				firstBtn = PrepareButton("PART_FirstButton", SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToFirst, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_SheetTabScrollToFirstDescription);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button PrepareButton(string name, SpreadsheetControlStringId automantionNameId, SpreadsheetControlStringId automationHelpTextId)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.Button button = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)navButtonsContainer, name) as System.Windows.Controls.Button;
			AutomationHelper.SetupUIElement(button, automantionNameId, automationHelpTextId);
			return button;
		}

		private void OnSelectedTabChanged()
		{
			OnSelectedTabChanged(measurePanel: true);
		}

		private void OnSelectedTabChanged(bool measurePanel)
		{
			RaiseSelectedTabChanging();
			ChangeActiveSheet();
			if (measurePanel)
			{
				MeasureSelectorPanel();
			}
			TrySetFocusToInplaceEditor();
		}

		private void TrySetFocusToInplaceEditor()
		{
			InnerSpreadsheetControl val = spreadsheetControl?.InnerControl;
			if (val == null || !val.IsInplaceEditorActive)
			{
				return;
			}
			ICellInplaceEditor cellInplaceEditor = (ICellInplaceEditor)(object)spreadsheetControl.ViewControl.GetEditor();
			if (cellInplaceEditor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Worksheet initialWorksheet = val.InplaceEditor.InitialWorksheet;
			bool flag = ((initialWorksheet != null) ? ((SheetBase)initialWorksheet).Name : null) == SelectedTabName;
			object service = spreadsheetControl.GetService(typeof(IFormulaBarControl));
			IFormulaBarControl val2 = (IFormulaBarControl)((service is IFormulaBarControl) ? service : null);
			ICellInplaceEditor val3 = ((val2 != null) ? val2.InplaceEditor : null);
			if (val3 == null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
					{
						cellInplaceEditor.SetFocus();
					}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				if (needRestoreCellEditorEditable)
				{
					ChangeEditableInplaceEditors(val3, cellInplaceEditor);
					needRestoreCellEditorEditable = false;
				}
			}
			else if (!val3.CurrentEditable)
			{
				ChangeEditableInplaceEditors(cellInplaceEditor, val3);
				needRestoreCellEditorEditable = true;
			}
		}

		private void ChangeEditableInplaceEditors(ICellInplaceEditor currentEditable, ICellInplaceEditor nextEditable)
		{
			currentEditable.CurrentEditable = false;
			nextEditable.CurrentEditable = true;
			nextEditable.SetSelection(currentEditable.SelectionStart, currentEditable.SelectionLength);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				nextEditable.SetFocus();
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void ChangeActiveSheet()
		{
			DocumentModel.BeginUpdateFromUI();
			try
			{
				DocumentModel.SetActiveSheetCore(((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[SelectedTabName]);
			}
			finally
			{
				DocumentModel.EndUpdateFromUI();
			}
		}

		private void MeasureSelectorPanel()
		{
			if (selectorPanel != null)
			{
				selectorPanel.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseSelectedTabChanging()
		{
			if (this.ActiveTabChanging != null)
			{
				this.ActiveTabChanging(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		}

		{

			prevBtn.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
			firstBtn.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
			isEnabled = selectorPanel.CanScrollToNextTab();
			nextBtn.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
			lastBtn.IsEnabled = isEnabled;
		}

			selectorPanel.ScrollToNextTab();
		}

		internal void ScrollToFirstTab()
		{
			selectorPanel.ScrollToFirstTab();
		}

		internal void PopulateTabs()
		{
			MeasureSelectorPanel();
		}

		internal void OnAddNewItem()
		{
			addNewItemInProcess = true;
			SpreadsheetCommand val = CreateAddNewWorksheetCommand();
			if (val != null)
			{
				((Command)val).Execute();
			}
			selectorPanel.ScrollToLastTab();
		}

		private SpreadsheetCommand CreateAddNewWorksheetCommand()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return spreadsheetControl.CreateCommand(SpreadsheetCommandId.AddNewWorksheet);
		}

		internal string GetTabText(int i, out bool isSelected)
		{
			IWorksheet sheetByIndex = DocumentModel.GetSheetByIndex(i);
			isSelected = (object)sheetByIndex == DocumentModel.ActiveSheet;
			return ((ICellTable)sheetByIndex).Name;
		}

		private bool IsTabNameValid(string value)
		{
			return ((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[value] != null;
		}

		internal bool CanGetText(int index)
		{
			return DocumentModel.GetVisibleSheets().Count > index;
		}

		internal void OnSelectorPanelArrangeFinished()
		{
			UpdateButtonsVisibility();
		}

		public void SwitchNextWorksheet()
		{
			NextTabCommand.Execute(this);
		}

		public void SwitchPreviousWorksheet()
		{
			PrevTabCommand.Execute(this);
		}

		internal List<string> GetTabItems()
		{
			if (spreadsheetControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DocumentModel.GetVisibleSheetNames();
		}

		internal TabSelectorItemState GetItemState(string tabName)
		{
			if (((SheetBase)DocumentModel.GetActiveSheetCore()).Name == tabName)
			{
				return TabSelectorItemState.Active;
			}
			if (((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[tabName].IsSelected)
			{
				return TabSelectorItemState.Selected;
			}
			return TabSelectorItemState.Normal;
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Color GetTabColor(string tabName)
		{
			return ((NamedItemCollection<InternalSheetBase>)(object)DocumentModel.SheetOrderCollection)[tabName].GetTabColor();
		}

		internal string GetTabNameByPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point2 = TransformToVisual(selectorPanel).Transform(point);
			return selectorPanel.GetTextByHitTest(point2);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new SpreadsheetTabSelectorAutomationPeer(this);
		}
	}
	public class SpreadsheetCategoryUICommand : SpreadsheetUICommand
	{
		public SpreadsheetCategoryUICommand(SpreadsheetControl spreadsheet, SpreadsheetCommandId id)
			: base(spreadsheet, id)
		{
		}//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)


		public void UpdateRibbonPageCategoryState()
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.Spreadsheet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IncCanExecuteCount();
			try
			{
				SpreadsheetCommand val = base.Spreadsheet.CreateCommand(base.CommandId);
				if (val != null)
				{
					ICommandUIState val2 = ((Command)val).CreateDefaultCommandUIState();
					((Command)val).UpdateUIState(val2);
					base.IsVisible = val2.Visible && val2.Enabled;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DecCanExecuteCount();
			}
		}
	}
}

	public class ChangeChartTypeControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private ChangeChartTypeViewModel viewModel;

		internal ListBoxEdit lbGroups;

		internal Gallery gallery;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public bool IsSvgAllowed => MenuItemHelper.AllowUseSvgImages(viewModel.Control as SpreadsheetControl);

		public ChangeChartTypeControl(ChangeChartTypeViewModel viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			InitializeGalleryControl();
			InitializeListBoxControl();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void InitializeGalleryControl()
		{
			PopulateGallery();
			UpdateGallery();
		}

		private void InitializeListBoxControl()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups).Count; i++)
			{
				lbGroups.Items.Add((object)CreateListBoxItem(((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups)[i] as CommandGalleryItemGroup));
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.Unloaded += OnChangeChartTypeControlUnloaded;
			lbGroups.SelectedIndexChanged += OnLbGroupsSelectedIndexChanged;
			gallery.ItemClick += new GalleryItemEventHandler(OnGalleryItemClick);
			gallery.ItemChecked += new GalleryItemEventHandler(OnGalleryItemChecked);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Expected O, but got Unknown
			base.Unloaded -= OnChangeChartTypeControlUnloaded;
			lbGroups.SelectedIndexChanged -= OnLbGroupsSelectedIndexChanged;
			gallery.ItemClick -= new GalleryItemEventHandler(OnGalleryItemClick);
			gallery.ItemChecked -= new GalleryItemEventHandler(OnGalleryItemChecked);
		}

		private void OnChangeChartTypeControlUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			foreach (GalleryItemGroup item in (Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups)
			{
				((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)item.Items).Clear();
			}
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups).Clear();
			gallery = null;
		}

		private void PopulateGallery()
		{
			GalleryItemGroupCollection groups = gallery.Groups;
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateColumnsGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateLineGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulatePieGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateBarGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateAreaGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateScatterGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateStockGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateDoughnutGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateBubbleGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add((GalleryItemGroup)(object)PopulateRadarGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add(PopulateTreemapGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add(PopulateSunburstGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add(PopulateHistogramGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add(PopulateBoxAndWhiskerGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add(PopulateWaterfallGalleryGroup());
			((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Add(PopulateFunnelGalleryGroup());
		}

		private CommandGalleryItemGroup PopulateColumnsGalleryGroup()
		{
			CommandGalleryItemGroup commandGalleryItemGroup = new CommandGalleryItemGroup(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartColumnCommandGroup);
			GalleryItemCollection items = ((GalleryItemGroup)commandGalleryItemGroup).Items;
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartColumnClustered2D));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartColumnStacked2D));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartColumnPercentStacked2D));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartColumnClustered3D));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartColumn3D));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartCylinderClustered));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartCylinder));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartConeClustered));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartCone));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartPyramidClustered));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartPyramid));
			return commandGalleryItemGroup;
		}

		private CommandGalleryItemGroup PopulateLineGalleryGroup()
		{
			CommandGalleryItemGroup commandGalleryItemGroup = new CommandGalleryItemGroup(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartLineCommandGroup);
			GalleryItemCollection items = ((GalleryItemGroup)commandGalleryItemGroup).Items;
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartLine));
			((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)items).Add(CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand.InsertChartStackedLine));

		private void UpdateGallery()
		{
			int count = ((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				CommandGalleryItemGroup commandGalleryItemGroup = ((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups)[i] as CommandGalleryItemGroup;
				UpdateGalleryItemGroup(commandGalleryItemGroup);
				int count2 = ((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)((GalleryItemGroup)commandGalleryItemGroup).Items).Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					GalleryItem galleryItem = ((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)((GalleryItemGroup)commandGalleryItemGroup).Items)[j];
					UpdateGalleryItem(galleryItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGalleryItemGroup(CommandGalleryItemGroup galleryItemGroup)
		{
			Command val = CreateCommand(galleryItemGroup.Command);
			((GalleryItemGroup)galleryItemGroup).Caption = val.MenuCaption;
		}

		private void UpdateGalleryItem(GalleryItem galleryItem)
		{
			Command val = CreateCommand(galleryItem.Command as SpreadsheetUICommand);
			galleryItem.Caption = val.MenuCaption;
			galleryItem.Hint = val.Description;
			System.Drawing.Image image = (IsSvgAllowed ? GetSvgImage(val.SvgImage, isGalleryItem: true) : val.Image);
			galleryItem.Glyph = ImageHelper.CreatePlatformImage(image).Source;
			((DependencyObject)(object)galleryItem).SetValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, (object)val.MenuCaption);
			((DependencyObject)(object)galleryItem).SetValue(AutomationProperties.HelpTextProperty, (object)val.Description);
		}

		private GalleryItem CreateGalleryItem(SpreadsheetUICommand command)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			GalleryItem val = new GalleryItem();
			val.Command = command;
			return val;
		}

		private GalleryGroupListBoxItem CreateListBoxItem(CommandGalleryItemGroup galleryItemGroup)
		{
			Command val = CreateCommand(galleryItemGroup.Command);
			System.Drawing.Image image = (IsSvgAllowed ? GetSvgImage(val.SvgImage, isGalleryItem: false) : val.Image);
			return new GalleryGroupListBoxItem(val.MenuCaption, ImageHelper.CreatePlatformImage(image).Source);
		}

		private Command CreateCommand(SpreadsheetUICommand itemCommand)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SpreadsheetCommandId commandId = itemCommand.CommandId;
			return ((ICommandAwareControl<SpreadsheetCommandId>)(object)viewModel.Control).CreateCommand(commandId);
		}

		private void OnLbGroupsSelectedIndexChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			int index = -1;
			if (lbGroups.SelectedIndex != -1)
			{
				index = lbGroups.SelectedIndex;
			}
			GalleryItemGroup val = ((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups)[index];
			if (val != null && ((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)val.Items).Count > 0)
			{
				((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups)[index].Items)[0].IsChecked = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnGalleryItemClick(object sender, GalleryItemEventArgs e)
		{
			AssignCommandId(e.Item);
		}

		private void OnGalleryItemChecked(object sender, GalleryItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Item.IsChecked)
			{
				AssignCommandId(e.Item);
			}
		}

		private bool AssignCommandId(GalleryItem galleryItem)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (galleryItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			viewModel.CommandId = (galleryItem.Command as SpreadsheetUICommand).CommandId;
			return true;
		}

		private static System.Drawing.Image GetSvgImage(SvgImage svgImage, bool isGalleryItem)
		{
			double num = (isGalleryItem ? 1.0 : 0.5);
			SvgBitmap svgBitmap = SvgBitmap.Create(svgImage);
			return svgBitmap.Render(null, HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetScaleFactor(DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi) * num, (DefaultBoolean)2, (DefaultBoolean)2);
		}

	public class ConditionalFormattingFormatCellsFontControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector

		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		private void OnStrikethroughChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Add(TextDecorations.Strikethrough);
		}

		private void OnStrikethroughUnchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (TextDecoration item in TextDecorations.Strikethrough)
			{
				if (textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Contains(item))
				{
					textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnUnderlineEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (TextDecoration item in TextDecorations.Underline)
			{
				if (e.NewValue.ToString() != "None")
				{
					if (!textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Contains(item))
					{
						textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Add(TextDecorations.Underline);
					}
				}
				else if (textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Contains(item))
				{
					textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]

		{

		}

	public class ConditionalFormattingRulesManagerControl : ReferenceEditBaseControl, IComponentConnector, IStyleConnector
	{
		private ConditionalFormattingRulesManagerViewModel viewModel;

		private CollectionView viewSource;

		private Window parentWindow;

		private ReferenceEdit activeReferenceEdit;

		private bool skipReferenceEditorUnloadingAfterExpand;

		internal Grid Root;

		internal Grid PART_Visual;

		internal SpreadsheetComboBoxEdit edtSourceFormattingRules;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnNewRule;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnEditRule;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnDeleteRule;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnUp;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnDown;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.ListView grid;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		protected override bool AllowSubscribeEventsOnLoaded => false;

		private SpreadsheetControl Control => (SpreadsheetControl)(object)base.SpreadsheetControl;

		public ConditionalFormattingRulesManagerControl(ConditionalFormattingRulesManagerViewModel viewModel)
			: base((IReferenceEditViewModel)(object)viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			UpdateGridAndButtons();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			((ViewModelBase)viewModel).PropertyChanged += OnPropertyChanged;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtSourceFormattingRules).TargetUpdated += OnTargetUpdated;
		}

		private void OnTargetUpdated(object sender, DataTransferEventArgs e)
		{
			WidthMeasurer.ItemTextAccessor getText = delegate(object item)
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				ConditionalFormattingRuleSource val = (ConditionalFormattingRuleSource)item;
				return ((ConditionalFormattingRuleSource)(ref val)).Caption;
			};
			WidthMeasurer.SetDesiredWidth((ComboBoxEdit)(object)edtSourceFormattingRules, viewModel.RuleSourceList, getText);
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "CurrentRuleSourceIndex")
			{
				UpdateGridAndButtons();
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			parentWindow = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)this);
			BindCancelButtonCaption();
			SetButtonWidths();
		}

		private void SetButtonWidths()
		{
			double width = Math.Max(Math.Max(btnNewRule.ActualWidth, btnEditRule.ActualWidth), btnDeleteRule.ActualWidth);
			btnNewRule.Width = width;
			btnEditRule.Width = width;
			btnDeleteRule.Width = width;
			width = Math.Max(btnUp.ActualWidth, btnDown.ActualWidth);
			btnUp.Width = width;
			btnDown.Width = width;
		}

		private void OnBtnNewRuleClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			parentWindow.Hide();
			ShowNewRuleForm();
		}

		private void OnBtnEditRuleClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			parentWindow.Hide();
			ShowEditRuleForm();
		}

		private void OnBtnDeleteRuleClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DeleteCFRule();
			grid.Focus();
		}

		private void OnBtnUpClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			int directionExchange = -1;
			ExchangeCFRules(directionExchange);
		}

		private void OnBtnDownClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			int directionExchange = 1;
			ExchangeCFRules(directionExchange);
		}

		private void OnGridSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateUpDownButtons();
		}

		private void OnGridMouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource;
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != grid && !(dependencyObject.GetType() == typeof(ReferenceEdit)))
			{
				if (dependencyObject.GetType() == typeof(System.Windows.Controls.ListViewItem))
				{
					parentWindow.Hide();
					ShowEditRuleForm();
					break;
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private void OnGridKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			IConditionalFormattingViewInfo viewInfoFromGridView = GetViewInfoFromGridView(grid.SelectedIndex);
			if (viewModel == null || viewInfoFromGridView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				if (base.Parent is ModelessDXDialog modelessDXDialog)
				{
					modelessDXDialog.DialogResult = true;
					((Window)(object)modelessDXDialog).Close();
				}
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Delete)
			{
				DeleteCFRule();
				grid.Focus();
			}
		}

		private void OnChildFormClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ModelessDXDialog { DialogResult: var dialogResult } modelessDXDialog)
			{
				if (dialogResult.HasValue && modelessDXDialog.DialogResult.Value)
				{
					ApplyChildFormChanges(GetNewEditConditionalFormattingRuleControl((DependencyObject)(object)modelessDXDialog).ViewModel);
				}
				((Window)(object)modelessDXDialog).Closed -= OnChildFormClosed;
			}
			parentWindow.Show();
			grid.Focus();
		}

		private void OnConditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControlLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ConditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl conditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl = (ConditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl)sender;
			conditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl.ViewInfo = (IConditionalFormattingViewInfo)conditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl.DataContext;
			conditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl.Control = ((ReferenceEditViewModel)viewModel).Control;
			conditionalFormattingRulesManagerPreviewControl.InvalidateVisual();
		}

		private void OnReferenceEditLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ReferenceEdit referenceEdit = (ReferenceEdit)sender;
			referenceEdit.SpreadsheetControl = ((ReferenceEditViewModel)viewModel).Control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(referenceEdit, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", !viewModel.CurrentSheetIsInitial, suppressActiveSheetChanging: true);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(referenceEdit);
			DisableActiveReferenceEdit();
			IConditionalFormattingViewInfo viewInfo = (IConditionalFormattingViewInfo)((FrameworkElement)(object)referenceEdit).DataContext;
			((BaseEdit)referenceEdit).EditValue = GetFormattedReference(viewInfo);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)referenceEdit).Loaded -= OnReferenceEditLoaded;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)referenceEdit).Unloaded += OnReferenceEditUnloaded;
			referenceEdit.CollapsedChanged += OnReferenceEditCollapsedChanged;
		}

		private void DisableActiveReferenceEdit()
		{
			if (activeReferenceEdit != null)
			{
				grid.Focus();
			}
		}

		private void ExchangeCFRules(int directionExchange)

			IConditionalFormattingViewInfo viewInfoFromGridView2 = GetViewInfoFromGridView(num);
			viewModel.ExchangeRules(viewInfoFromGridView, viewInfoFromGridView2);
			viewSource.Refresh();
			SelectItem(num);
			UpdateUpDownButtons();
		}

		private void DeleteCFRule()
		{

			viewSource.Refresh();

			UpdateUpDownButtons();
			UpdateEditDeleteButtons();
		}

			}
			val = viewInfo.FourthCustomIcon;
			if (((CustomIconViewInfo)(ref val)).IsValid)
			{
				val = viewInfo.FifthCustomIcon;
				if (!((CustomIconViewInfo)(ref val)).IsValid)
				{
					iconCount = 4;
				}
			}
			val = viewInfo.FourthCustomIcon;
			if (!((CustomIconViewInfo)(ref val)).IsValid)
			{
				val = viewInfo.FifthCustomIcon;
				if (!((CustomIconViewInfo)(ref val)).IsValid)
				{
					iconCount = 3;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DrawFormulaConditionalFormattngPreview : DrawConditionalFormattingPreviewBase
	{
		private ISpreadsheetControl control;

		private MergedDifferentialFormat format;

		private DocumentModel DocumentModel => ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)control.InnerControl).DocumentModel;

		public System.Drawing.Color SkinForeColor => DocumentModel.SkinForeColor;

		public MergedFillInfo Fill => format.Fill;

		public MergedBorderInfo Border => format.Border;

		public MergedFontInfo Font => format.Font;

		public DrawFormulaConditionalFormattngPreview(ISpreadsheetControl control, MergedDifferentialFormat format, DrawingContext drawingContext, Rect drawingRectangle)
			: base(drawingContext, drawingRectangle)
		{
			this.control = control;
			this.format = format;
		}

		public override void Draw()
		{
			DrawFill();
			DrawBorder();
			DrawText();
		}

		private void DrawFill()
		{
			if (format != null && !format.IsDefault)
			{
				FillPreviewPainter.DrawFill(DocumentModel, drawingContext, format.Fill, drawingRectangle);
			}
		}

		private void DrawBorder()
		{
			if (format != null && !format.IsDefault)
			{
				DrawLeftBorder(drawingContext);
				DrawRightBorder(drawingContext);
				DrawTopBorder(drawingContext);
				DrawBottomBorder(drawingContext);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLeftBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.LeftLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.X, drawingRectangle.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.BottomLeft.X, drawingRectangle.BottomLeft.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.LeftColor, Border.LeftLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRightBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.RightLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.TopRight.X, drawingRectangle.TopRight.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.BottomRight.X, drawingRectangle.BottomRight.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.RightColor, Border.RightLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private void DrawTopBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.TopLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.X, drawingRectangle.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.TopRight.X, drawingRectangle.TopRight.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.TopColor, Border.TopLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private void DrawBottomBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.BottomLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.BottomLeft.X, drawingRectangle.BottomLeft.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.BottomRight.X, drawingRectangle.BottomRight.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.BottomColor, Border.BottomLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen GetBorderPen(System.Drawing.Color? bordrerColor, XlBorderLineStyle? borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XlBorderLineStyle nonNullBorderStyle = GetNonNullBorderStyle(borderStyle);
			System.Drawing.Color notEmptyColor = GetNotEmptyColor(bordrerColor);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(notEmptyColor.ToWpfColor()), 1.0);
			double[] dashes = ToDoubleArray(LinePatternProvider.GetPattern(nonNullBorderStyle));
			pen.DashStyle = new System.Windows.Media.DashStyle(dashes, 0.0);
			return pen;
		}

		private XlBorderLineStyle GetNonNullBorderStyle(XlBorderLineStyle? borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (borderStyle.HasValue)
			{
				return borderStyle.Value;
			}
			return (XlBorderLineStyle)0;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color GetNotEmptyColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			if (!DXColor.IsEmpty(color))
			{
				return color;
			}
			return SkinForeColor;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color GetNotEmptyColor(System.Drawing.Color? color)
		{
			if (!color.HasValue)
			{
				return SkinForeColor;
			}
			return GetNotEmptyColor(color.Value);
		}

		private double[] ToDoubleArray(float[] p)
		{
			double[] array = new double[p.Length];
			p.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		private void PatchPoints(ref System.Windows.Point from, ref System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			double num = 0.5;
			to = new System.Windows.Point(to.X - num, to.Y - num);
			from = new System.Windows.Point(from.X - num, from.Y - num);
		}

		private void DrawLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, from, to);
		}

		private void DrawText()
		{
			//IL_0129: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0132: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string typefaceName = "Calibri";
			float sizeInPoints = 11f;
			string textToFormat;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color;
			if (format == null || format.IsDefault)
			{
				textToFormat = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2301);
				color = SkinForeColor.ToWpfColor();
			}
			else
			{
				textToFormat = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2302);
				color = GetNotEmptyColor(Font.Color).ToWpfColor();
			}
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(textToFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface(typefaceName), ConditionalFormattingPreview.CalculateFontSize(sizeInPoints), new SolidColorBrush(color), null, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			SetFontOptions(formattedText);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(drawingRectangle.Width / 2.0 - formattedText.Width / 2.0, drawingRectangle.Y + (drawingRectangle.Height / 2.0 - formattedText.Height / 2.0));
			drawingContext.DrawText(formattedText, point);
			if (format != null && format.Font.Underline.HasValue && format.Font.Underline != (XlUnderlineType?)0)
			{
				DrawUnderline(drawingContext, point, formattedText, color);
			}
		}

		private void SetFontOptions(FormattedText text)
		{
			if (format != null)
			{
				if (Font.Bold.HasValue && Font.Bold.Value)
				{
					text.SetFontWeight(FontWeights.Bold);
				}
				if (Font.Italic.HasValue && Font.Italic.Value)
				{
					text.SetFontStyle(FontStyles.Italic);
				}
				if (Font.StrikeThrough.HasValue && Font.StrikeThrough.Value)
				{
					text.SetTextDecorations(TextDecorations.Strikethrough);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawUnderline(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Point topLeft, FormattedText textSize, System.Windows.Media.Color drawingColor)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)format.Font.Underline.Value == 1)
			{
				DrawUnderlineCore(drawingContext, topLeft, textSize, drawingColor, 2);
			}
			else if ((int)format.Font.Underline.Value == 2)
			{
				DrawUnderlineCore(drawingContext, topLeft, textSize, drawingColor, 0);
				DrawUnderlineCore(drawingContext, topLeft, textSize, drawingColor, 2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawUnderlineCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Point topLeft, FormattedText textSize, System.Windows.Media.Color drawingColor, int yOffset)
		{
			System.Windows.Point from = new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X, topLeft.Y + textSize.Height - (double)yOffset);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X + textSize.Width, topLeft.Y + textSize.Height - (double)yOffset);
			PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			drawingContext.DrawLine(new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(drawingColor), 1.0), from, to);
		}
	}

		private void UpdateMarginsState()
		{

				marginsType = MarginsType.Normal;
			}
			else if (CalculateIsChecked(SpreadsheetCommandId.PageSetupMarginsWide))
