		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			link.CreateDocumentStarted += OnCreateDocumentStarted;
			link.CreateDocumentFinished += OnCreateDocumentFinished;
			((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).StartPrint += new PrintDocumentEventHandler(OnStartPrint);
			if (spreadsheet != null)
			{
				spreadsheet.ContentChanged += OnDocumentContentChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			link.CreateDocumentStarted -= OnCreateDocumentStarted;
			link.CreateDocumentFinished -= OnCreateDocumentFinished;
			((PrintingSystemBase)link.PrintingSystem).StartPrint -= new PrintDocumentEventHandler(OnStartPrint);
			if (spreadsheet != null)
			{
				spreadsheet.ContentChanged -= OnDocumentContentChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnCreateDocumentStarted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IsEnabled = false;
			savedPageNumber = CurrentPageNumber;
		}

		private void OnCreateDocumentFinished(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCurrentSheetName();
			IsEnabled = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentSheetName);
			MaxPageCount = ((PrintingSystemBase)((LegacyPrintableComponentLink)sender).PrintingSystem).PageCount;
			CurrentPageNumber = Math.Min(savedPageNumber, MaxPageCount);
		}

		private void OnStartPrint(object sender, PrintDocumentEventArgs e)
		{
			PrinterSettings printerSettings = e.PrintDocument.PrinterSettings;
			PrintPreviewPrinterSettingsHelper.SetSettings(e.PrintDocument, Copies, Collate, PagesFrom, PagesTo, MinPageCount, MaxPageCount);
		}

		private void OnDocumentContentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsEnabled)
			{
				UpdatePreview();
				((ViewModelBase)this).OnPropertyChanged("Orientation");
				UpdatePaperKindState();
				UpdateMarginsState();
				UpdateScalingState();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentSheetName()
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				CurrentSheetName = DocumentModel.PrintInfoProvider.GetSheetNameByPageIndex(CurrentPageNumber - 1);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePreview()
		{
			link.CreateDocument(buildForInstantPreview: true);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				UnsubscribeEvents();
				spreadsheet = null;
				link = null;
				pageSetupFormProvider = null;
				isDisposed = true;
			}
		}

	internal static class PrintPreviewPrinterSettingsHelper
	{
		internal static void SetSettings(PrintDocument printDocument, short copies, bool collate, int? from, int? to, int minPageCount, int maxPageCount)
		{
			PrinterSettings printerSettings = printDocument.PrinterSettings;
			printerSettings.Copies = copies;
			printerSettings.Collate = collate;
			Tuple<int, int> tuple = CalculatePageRange(from, to, minPageCount);
			PageScope pageScope;
			if (tuple != null)
			{
				printerSettings.PrintRange = PrintRange.SomePages;
				printerSettings.FromPage = tuple.Item1;
				printerSettings.ToPage = tuple.Item2;
				pageScope = new PageScope(tuple.Item1, tuple.Item2);
			}
			else
			{
				printerSettings.PrintRange = PrintRange.AllPages;
				printerSettings.FromPage = 1;
				printerSettings.ToPage = maxPageCount;
				pageScope = new PageScope(1, maxPageCount);
			}
			IPrintDocumentExtension val = (IPrintDocumentExtension)(object)((printDocument is IPrintDocumentExtension) ? printDocument : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.PageRange = pageScope.PageRange;
			}
		}

		private static Tuple<int, int> CalculatePageRange(int? pagesFrom, int? pagesTo, int minPageCount)
		{
			if (pagesFrom.HasValue || pagesTo.HasValue)
			{
				int num = (pagesFrom.HasValue ? Math.Max(minPageCount, pagesFrom.Value) : minPageCount);
				int item = (pagesTo.HasValue ? Math.Max(num, pagesTo.Value) : num);
				return new Tuple<int, int>(num, item);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public static class FillPreviewPainter
	{
		public static void DrawFill(DocumentModel documentModel, DrawingContext drawingContext, MergedFillInfo fill, Rect bounds)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ModelFillType? fillType = fill.FillType;
			if (fillType.HasValue)
			{
				if ((int)fillType.Value == 0)
				{
					DrawPatternFill(drawingContext, fill.PatternFill, bounds);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawGradientFill(documentModel, drawingContext, fill.GradientFill, bounds);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DrawPatternFill(DrawingContext drawingContext, MergedPatternFill patternFill, Rect bounds)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XlPatternType? patternType = patternFill.PatternType;
			System.Drawing.Color? foreColor = patternFill.ForeColor;
			System.Drawing.Color? backColor = patternFill.BackColor;
			if (foreColor.HasValue && backColor.HasValue && patternType.HasValue && patternType != (XlPatternType?)0)
			{
				DrawPatternFill(drawingContext, bounds, patternType.Value, foreColor.Value, backColor.Value);
			}
		}

		private static void DrawPatternFill(DrawingContext drawingContext, Rect bounds, XlPatternType patternType, System.Drawing.Color foreColor, System.Drawing.Color backColor)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(backColor))
			{
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(ToMediaColor(backColor)), null, bounds);
			}
			if ((int)patternType != 1)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush patternFillBrush = PatternFillProvider.GetPatternFillBrush(patternType, ToMediaColor(foreColor));
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(patternFillBrush, null, bounds);
			}
		}

		private static void DrawGradientFill(DocumentModel documentModel, DrawingContext drawingContext, MergedGradientFill gradientFill, Rect bounds)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			System.Drawing.Color firstStopColor = gradientFill.GetFirstStopColor(documentModel);
			System.Drawing.Color secondStopColor = gradientFill.GetSecondStopColor(documentModel);
			GradientVariantInfo gradientInfo = new GradientVariantInfo(gradientFill);
			DrawGradientFill(drawingContext, gradientInfo, bounds, firstStopColor, secondStopColor);
		}

		private static System.Windows.Media.Color ToMediaColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			if (color.IsEmpty)
			{
				color = System.Drawing.Color.Black;
			}
			return color.ToWpfColor();
		}

		public static void DrawGradientFill(DrawingContext drawingContext, GradientVariantInfo gradientInfo, Rect bounds, System.Drawing.Color firstColor, System.Drawing.Color secondColor)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (gradientInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((int)gradientInfo.GradientType == 0)
			{
				System.Windows.Media.GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new System.Windows.Media.GradientStopCollection();
				if (gradientInfo.IsSingleColorBothEnds)
				{
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(firstColor.ToWpfColor(), 0.0));
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(secondColor.ToWpfColor(), 0.5));
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(firstColor.ToWpfColor(), 1.0));
				}
				else
				{
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(firstColor.ToWpfColor(), 0.0));
					gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(secondColor.ToWpfColor(), 1.0));
				}
				System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection);
				System.Windows.Point[] array = WorksheetBackgroundControl.CalculateLinearBrushPoints(bounds, gradientInfo.Degree);
				linearGradientBrush.MappingMode = BrushMappingMode.Absolute;
				linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = array[0];
				linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = array[1];
				linearGradientBrush.Freeze();
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(linearGradientBrush, null, bounds);
			}
			else
			{
				IConvergenceInfo convergence = (IConvergenceInfo)(object)gradientInfo.Convergence;
				System.Windows.Media.GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection2 = new System.Windows.Media.GradientStopCollection();
				gradientStopCollection2.Add(new GradientStop(firstColor.ToWpfColor(), 0.0));
				gradientStopCollection2.Add(new GradientStop(secondColor.ToWpfColor(), 1.0));
				RadialGradientBrush radialGradientBrush = new RadialGradientBrush(gradientStopCollection2);
				radialGradientBrush.GradientOrigin = new System.Windows.Point((convergence.Left + convergence.Right) / 2f, (convergence.Top + convergence.Bottom) / 2f);
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(radialGradientBrush, null, bounds);
			}
		}
	}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush errorForegroundBrush;

		internal Grid argumentGrid;

		internal TextBlock lblName;

		internal ReferenceEdit editReference;

		internal TextBlock lblResult;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public ReferenceEdit Editor => editReference;

		public FunctionArgumentControl(FunctionArgumentViewModel viewModel)
		{
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			InitializeComponent();
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			SetupNameFontWeight();
			((ViewModelBase)viewModel).PropertyChanged += OnIsInvalidOrErrorChanged;
		}

		private void OnControlLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeErrorForegroundBrush();
			SetFontWeightAndColor(viewModel.Value);
		}

		private void OnIsInvalidOrErrorChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "ValueOrType")
			{
				SetFontWeightAndColor(viewModel.Value);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeErrorForegroundBrush()
		{
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				CaptionControl captionControl = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(FindLayoutPanel(this), "PART_Caption") as CaptionControl;
				errorForegroundBrush = captionControl.Foreground;
			}
		}

		private FrameworkElement FindLayoutPanel(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			if (element is LayoutPanel)
			{
				return element;
			}
			return FindLayoutPanel(element.Parent as FrameworkElement);
		}

		private void SetupNameFontWeight()
		{
			if (viewModel.IsRequired)
			{
				lblName.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
			}
		}

		private void SetFontWeightAndColor(object value)
		{
			if (value == ((BaseEdit)editReference).NullValue)
			{
				lblResult.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
				lblResult.Foreground = errorForegroundBrush;
			}
			else if (viewModel.IsInvalidOrError)
			{
				lblResult.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold;
				lblResult.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Red;
			}
			else
			{
				lblResult.FontWeight = FontWeights.Normal;
				lblResult.Foreground = lblName.Foreground;
			}
		}

				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

	public class FunctionArgumentsControl : ReferenceEditBaseControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private readonly SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl formulaBar;

		private readonly XpfCellInplaceEditor xpfInplaceEditor;

		private readonly FunctionArgumentsViewModel viewModel;

		internal Grid Root;

		internal Grid PART_Visual;

		internal LayoutPanel argumentPanel;

		internal FunctionArgumentsGroup argumentGroup;

		internal TextBlock argumentDescription;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public FunctionArgumentsControl(FunctionArgumentsViewModel viewModel)
			: base((IReferenceEditViewModel)(object)viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			formulaBar = (SpreadsheetFormulaBarControl)((IServiceProvider)base.SpreadsheetControl).GetService(typeof(IFormulaBarControl));
			xpfInplaceEditor = ((SpreadsheetControl)(object)base.SpreadsheetControl).ViewControl.GetEditor();
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
		}

		private void ReferenceEditBaseControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			argumentPanel.Caption = viewModel.FunctionName;
			((ViewModelBase)viewModel).PropertyChanged += OnFunctionChanged;
			argumentGroup.Items.CollectionChanged += OnArgumentsCollectionChanged;
			SubscribeFormulaBarEvents();
			SetFormulaBarAsActiveEditor();
			xpfInplaceEditor.Focusable = false;
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
		}

		private void ReferenceEditBaseControl_Unloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((ViewModelBase)viewModel).PropertyChanged -= OnFunctionChanged;
			argumentGroup.Items.CollectionChanged -= OnArgumentsCollectionChanged;
			UnSubscribeFormulaBarEvents();
			xpfInplaceEditor.Focusable = true;
		}

		private void SetFormulaBarAsActiveEditor()
		{
			ICellInplaceEditor inplaceEditor = ((IFormulaBarControl)formulaBar).InplaceEditor;
			if (!inplaceEditor.CurrentEditable)
			{
				inplaceEditor.CurrentEditable = true;
				xpfInplaceEditor.CurrentEditable = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnArgumentsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add && e.NewItems.Count != 0)
			{
				ReferenceEdit referenceEditor = argumentGroup.GetReferenceEditor(e.NewStartingIndex);
				referenceEditor.SpreadsheetControl = viewModel.SpreadsheetControl;
				SetInitialSheetIndexToReferenceEdit(referenceEditor);
				referenceEditor.ForceEditValueChanged();
				SetUpReferenceEditor(referenceEditor, (ReferenceEditPositionType)4, null, includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
				SubscribeReferenceEdit(referenceEditor);
			}
		}

		private void SetInitialSheetIndexToReferenceEdit(ReferenceEdit edit)
		{
			ISpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl = edit.SpreadsheetControl;
			object obj;
			if (spreadsheetControl == null)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				InnerSpreadsheetControl innerControl = spreadsheetControl.InnerControl;
				obj = ((innerControl != null) ? innerControl.InplaceEditor : null);
			}
			InnerCellInplaceEditor val = (InnerCellInplaceEditor)obj;
			if (val != null && val.IsActive)
			{
				edit.InitialSheetIndex = val.InitialSheetIndex;
			}
		}

		private void OnFunctionChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "FunctionName" && string.Compare((string)argumentPanel.Caption, viewModel.FunctionName) != 0)
			{
				argumentPanel.Caption = viewModel.FunctionName;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeFormulaBarEvents()
		{
			formulaBar.SubscribeFunctionArgumentsControlEvents(OnFormulaBarOkClick, OnFormulaBarCancelClick, OnFormulaBarEditorKeyDown);
			formulaBar.PreviewGotKeyboardFocus += OnFormulaBarPreviewGotKeyboardFocus;
			formulaBar.PreviewLostKeyboardFocus += OnFormulaBarPreviewLostKeyboardFocus;
		}

		private void UnSubscribeFormulaBarEvents()
		{
			formulaBar.UnSubscribeFunctionArgumentsControlEvents(OnFormulaBarOkClick, OnFormulaBarCancelClick, OnFormulaBarEditorKeyDown);
			formulaBar.PreviewGotKeyboardFocus -= OnFormulaBarPreviewGotKeyboardFocus;
			formulaBar.PreviewLostKeyboardFocus -= OnFormulaBarPreviewLostKeyboardFocus;
		}

		private void OnFormulaBarPreviewGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewFocus.IsMouseOver)
			{
				argumentGroup.DeactivateAllEditors();
			}
			else
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnFormulaBarPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewFocus is System.Windows.Controls.TextBox textBox)
			{
				ReferenceEdit referenceEdit = DependencyObjectExtensions.FindElementByTypeInParents<ReferenceEdit>((DependencyObject)textBox, (DependencyObject)this);
				if (referenceEdit != null)
				{
					referenceEdit.Activated = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnFormulaBarOkClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Close(true);
		}

		private void OnFormulaBarCancelClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Close(false);
		}

		private void OnFormulaBarEditorKeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Return)
			{
				Close(true);
			}
			else if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
			{
				Close(false);
			}
		}

		private void Close(bool? dialogResult)
		{
			if (base.Parent is CustomDXDialog customDXDialog)
			{
				customDXDialog.DialogResult = dialogResult;
				((Window)(object)customDXDialog).Close();
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.v23.2;component/forms/functionargumentscontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		internal Delegate _CreateDelegate(Type delegateType, string handler)
		{
			return Delegate.CreateDelegate(delegateType, this, handler);
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			switch (connectionId)
			{
			case 1:
				Root = (Grid)target;
				break;
			case 2:
				PART_Visual = (Grid)target;
				break;
			case 3:
				argumentPanel = (LayoutPanel)target;
				break;
			case 4:
				argumentGroup = (FunctionArgumentsGroup)target;
				break;
			case 5:
				argumentDescription = (TextBlock)target;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}

	public class FunctionArgumentsGroup : LayoutGroup
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty CurrentItemIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CurrentItemIndex", typeof(int), typeof(FunctionArgumentsGroup));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty UnlimitedArgumentsProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("UnlimitedArguments", typeof(bool), typeof(FunctionArgumentsGroup));

		public int CurrentItemIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(CurrentItemIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(CurrentItemIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public bool UnlimitedArguments
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(UnlimitedArgumentsProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(UnlimitedArgumentsProperty, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDataContextChanged(object value)
		{
			base.OnDataContextChanged(value);
			ObservableCollection<FunctionArgumentViewModel> argumentViews = GetArgumentViews();
			argumentViews.CollectionChanged += OnCollectionChanged;
			CreateAllLayoutItems(argumentViews);
			((UIElement)(object)GetReferenceEditor(CurrentItemIndex)).Focus();
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
				if (e.NewStartingIndex >= base.Items.Count)
				{
					AddLayoutItems(e.NewItems);
				}
				break;
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
				CreateAllLayoutItems(GetArgumentViews());
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CreateAllLayoutItems(ObservableCollection<FunctionArgumentViewModel> argumentViews)
		{
			ClearLayoutItems();
			AddLayoutItems(argumentViews);
		}

		private void AddLayoutItems(IEnumerable collection)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (FunctionArgumentViewModel item in collection)
			{
				FunctionArgumentViewModel val = item;
				((ViewModelBase)val).PropertyChanged += OnArgumentVisibilityChanged;
				if (val.IsVisible)
				{
					AddLayoutItem(val);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddLayoutItem(FunctionArgumentViewModel argumentView)
		{
			LayoutControlItem item = CreateLayoutItem(argumentView);
			base.Items.Add(item);
		}

		private void ClearLayoutItems()
		{
			for (int num = base.Items.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveLayoutItem((LayoutControlItem)base.Items[num]);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveLayoutItem(LayoutControlItem layoutItem)
		{
			FunctionArgumentControl functionArgumentControl = (FunctionArgumentControl)layoutItem.Content;
			functionArgumentControl.Editor.SpreadsheetControl = null;
			base.Items.Remove(layoutItem);
		}

		private LayoutControlItem CreateLayoutItem(FunctionArgumentViewModel argumentView)
		{
			LayoutControlItem layoutControlItem = new LayoutControlItem();
			layoutControlItem.Content = new FunctionArgumentControl(argumentView);
			layoutControlItem.Name = argumentView.Name;
			layoutControlItem.GotFocus += OnLayoutItemGotFocus;
			return layoutControlItem;
		}

		private void OnArgumentVisibilityChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "IsVisible")
			{
				FunctionArgumentViewModel val = (FunctionArgumentViewModel)((sender is FunctionArgumentViewModel) ? sender : null);
				BaseLayoutItem item = base.Items[val.Name];
				if (UnlimitedArguments)
				{
					ProcessUnlimitedArgumentVisibility(val, item);
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessArgumentVisibility(val, item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessUnlimitedArgumentVisibility(FunctionArgumentViewModel argumentView, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (argumentView.IsVisible)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					AddLayoutItem(argumentView);
				}
			}
			else if (item != null)
			{
				RemoveLayoutItem((LayoutControlItem)item);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessArgumentVisibility(FunctionArgumentViewModel argumentView, BaseLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (argumentView.IsVisible)
			{
				item.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				return;
			}
			ReferenceEdit referenceEditor = GetReferenceEditor((LayoutControlItem)item);
			((BaseEdit)referenceEditor).EditValue = null;
			argumentView.SetValueCore(string.Empty);
			item.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		private void OnLayoutItemGotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			LayoutControlItem layoutControlItem = (LayoutControlItem)sender;
			layoutControlItem.BringIntoView();
			CurrentItemIndex = base.Items.IndexOf(layoutControlItem);
		}

		private ObservableCollection<FunctionArgumentViewModel> GetArgumentViews()
		{
			object dataContext = base.DataContext;
			FunctionArgumentsViewModel val = (FunctionArgumentsViewModel)((dataContext is FunctionArgumentsViewModel) ? dataContext : null);
			return val.Arguments;
		}

		public void DeactivateAllEditors()
		{
			int count = base.Items.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				GetReferenceEditor(i).Activated = false;
			}
		}

		public ReferenceEdit GetReferenceEditor(int itemIndex)
		{
			LayoutControlItem item = (LayoutControlItem)base.Items[itemIndex];
			return GetReferenceEditor(item);
		}

		private ReferenceEdit GetReferenceEditor(LayoutControlItem item)
		{
			return ((FunctionArgumentControl)item.Content).Editor;
		}
	}

	public class InsertSymbolDXDialog : ModelessDXDialog
	{
		private EventHandler onInsertButtonClick;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button InsertButton => ((DXDialog)this).OkButton;

		public event EventHandler InsertButtonClick
		{
			add
			{
				onInsertButtonClick = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(onInsertButtonClick, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				onInsertButtonClick = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(onInsertButtonClick, value);
			}
		}

		public InsertSymbolDXDialog(string title)
			: base(title, (DialogButtons)1)
		{
		}

		private void RaiseInsertButtonClick()
		{
			if (onInsertButtonClick != null)
			{
				onInsertButtonClick(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnButtonClick(bool? result, MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult)
		{
			if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.OK && InsertButton != null)
			{
				InsertButton.Focus();
				RaiseInsertButtonClick();
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnButtonClick(result, messageBoxResult);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SetupInsertButton(InsertButton, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_InsertSymbolFormFindButton);
		}

		private void SetupInsertButton(System.Windows.Controls.Button button, SpreadsheetControlStringId stringId)
		{
			if (button != null)
			{
				button.Content = XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(stringId);
				button.IsDefault = false;
				button.IsCancel = false;
			}
		}
	}

		{
			firstValueRangeOperators = formatCellsThatContain.edtFirstValueRangeOperators;
			firstValueRangeOperators.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(firstValueRangeOperators, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(firstValueRangeOperators);
			secondValueRangeOperators = formatCellsThatContain.edtSecondValueRangeOperators;
			secondValueRangeOperators.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(secondValueRangeOperators, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(secondValueRangeOperators);
			valueCompareOperators = formatCellsThatContain.edtValueCompareOperators;
			valueCompareOperators.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(valueCompareOperators, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(valueCompareOperators);
			specificText = formatCellsThatContain.edtSpecificText;
			specificText.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(specificText, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(specificText);
			formula = formulaDetermineWhichCellsFormat.edtFormula;
			formula.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(formula, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(formula);
		}

		protected override void OnWindowClosed()
		{
			firstValueRangeOperators.SpreadsheetControl = null;
			secondValueRangeOperators.SpreadsheetControl = null;
			valueCompareOperators.SpreadsheetControl = null;
			specificText.SpreadsheetControl = null;
			formula.SpreadsheetControl = null;
			base.OnWindowClosed();
		}

		public void Update(ConditionalFormattingDataBarNegativeValueAndAxisViewModel viewModel)
		{
			this.viewModel.IsNegativeFillColorSameAsPositive = !viewModel.IsNegativeFillColorHasDifferentFromPositive;
			if (viewModel.IsNegativeFillColorHasDifferentFromPositive)
			{
				this.viewModel.NegativeValueFillColor = viewModel.NegativeValueFillColor;
			}
			this.viewModel.IsNegativeBorderColorSameAsPositive = !viewModel.IsNegativeBorderColorHasDifferentFromPositive;
			if (viewModel.IsNegativeBorderColorHasDifferentFromPositive)
			{
				this.viewModel.NegativeValueBorderColor = viewModel.NegativeValueBorderColor;
			}
			if (viewModel.IsAutomaticAxisPosition)
			{
				this.viewModel.AxisPosition = (ConditionalFormattingDataBarAxisPosition)1;
			}
			else if (viewModel.IsCellMidpointAxisPosition)
			{
				this.viewModel.AxisPosition = (ConditionalFormattingDataBarAxisPosition)2;
			}
			else if (viewModel.IsNoneAxisPosition)
			{
				this.viewModel.AxisPosition = (ConditionalFormattingDataBarAxisPosition)0;
			}
			this.viewModel.AxisColor = viewModel.AxisColor;
		}

			WidthMeasurer.SetDesiredWidth((ComboBoxEdit[])(object)new ComboBoxEdit[3] { edtLowPointValueType, edtMidPointValueType, edtHighPointValueType }, new IEnumerable<object>[3] { ViewModel.LowPointValueTypeList, ViewModel.MiddlePointValueTypeList, ViewModel.HighPointValueTypeList });
			double width = ((FrameworkElement)(object)edtLowPointValueType).Width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtLowPointValue).Width = width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtMidPointValue).Width = width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtHighPointValue).Width = width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtLowPointColor).Width = width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtMidPointColor).Width = width;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edtHighPointColor).Width = width;
		}

			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		{
			ViewModel.FormatCellsBasedOnValuesTypeChanged += OnFormatCellsBasedOnValuesTypeChanged;
		}

		private void OnFormatCellsBasedOnValuesTypeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)ViewModel.FormatCellsBasedOnValuesType == 0 || (int)ViewModel.FormatCellsBasedOnValuesType == 1)
			{
				ViewModel.UpdatePointsColorValues();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			drawingContext.DrawRectangle(rectangle: new Rect(GetPosition(preview), new System.Windows.Size(preview.ActualWidth, preview.ActualHeight)), brush: GetGradientBrush(), pen: null);
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush GetGradientBrush()
		{
			if (!ViewModel.ConditionalFormattingHasMiddlePointColorScale)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush(ToMediaColor(ViewModel.LowPointColor), ToMediaColor(ViewModel.HighPointColor), new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5), new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5));
			}
			return GetGradientBrushCore();
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush GetGradientBrushCore()
		{
			System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5);
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(ToMediaColor(ViewModel.LowPointColor), 0.0));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(ToMediaColor(ViewModel.MiddlePointColor), 0.5));
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(ToMediaColor(ViewModel.HighPointColor), 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private GradientStop CreateGradientStop(System.Windows.Media.Color pointColor, double offset)
		{
			GradientStop gradientStop = new GradientStop();
			gradientStop.Color = pointColor;
			gradientStop.Offset = offset;
			return gradientStop;
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPosition(Visual element)
		{
			GeneralTransform generalTransform = element.TransformToAncestor(this);
			return generalTransform.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Color ToMediaColor(System.Drawing.Color? color)
		{
			if (color.GetValueOrDefault().IsEmpty)
			{
				return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(System.Drawing.Color.Black.A, System.Drawing.Color.Black.R, System.Drawing.Color.Black.G, System.Drawing.Color.Black.B);
			}
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(color.Value.A, color.Value.R, color.Value.G, color.Value.B);
		}

		{
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		{
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		private void HighPointColorChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

			DrawBackground(drawingContext, offset, fillBounds);
			DrawPreviewContent(drawingContext, offset, fillBounds);
		}

		private void DrawBackground(DrawingContext drawingContext, int offset, Rect fillBounds)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.Color color = ToMediaColor(((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)((ReferenceEditViewModel)ViewModel).Control.InnerControl).DocumentModel.SkinBackColor);
			System.Windows.Point topLeft = fillBounds.TopLeft;
			System.Windows.Point bottomRight = fillBounds.BottomRight;
			Rect rectangle = fillBounds;
			topLeft = new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X + (double)offset, topLeft.Y + (double)offset);
			bottomRight = new System.Windows.Point(bottomRight.X - (double)offset, bottomRight.Y - (double)offset);
			Rect rectangle2 = new Rect(topLeft, bottomRight);

		private void DrawPreviewContent(DrawingContext drawingContext, int offset, Rect fillBounds)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			bool isRightToLeft = ((ISpreadsheetComponent)((ReferenceEditViewModel)ViewModel).Control.Document).Options.Culture.TextInfo.IsRightToLeft;
			if ((int)ViewModel.DataBarDirection == 2 || ((int)ViewModel.DataBarDirection == 0 && isRightToLeft))
			{

				bottomRight = new System.Windows.Point(bottomRight.X - (double)offset, bottomRight.Y - (double)offset);
			}
			else
			{
				topLeft = new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X + (double)offset, topLeft.Y + (double)offset);
				bottomRight = new System.Windows.Point(bottomRight.X - num - (double)offset, bottomRight.Y - (double)offset);
			}
			Rect rectangle = new Rect(topLeft, bottomRight);
			if (ViewModel.GradientFill)
			{
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(GetGradientBrush(isRightToLeft), null, rectangle);
			}
			else
			{
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(GetSolidBrush(ViewModel.FillColor), null, rectangle);
			}
			if (ViewModel.HaveBorder)
			{
				drawingContext.DrawRectangle(null, new System.Windows.Media.Pen(GetSolidBrush(ViewModel.BorderColor), 1.0), rectangle);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush GetGradientBrushCore(System.Windows.Media.Color first, System.Windows.Media.Color second, bool isRightAlignment)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new System.Windows.Media.LinearGradientBrush();
			linearGradientBrush.StartPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);
			linearGradientBrush.EndPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5);
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(first, 0.0));
			if (isRightAlignment)
			{
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(second, 0.75));
			}
			else
			{
				linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(first, 0.25));
			}
			linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Add(CreateGradientStop(second, 1.0));
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

	public class ConditionalFormattingPreview : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector

		public ConditionalFormattingRuleViewModelBase ViewModel => (ConditionalFormattingRuleViewModelBase)base.DataContext;

		private DocumentModel DocumentModel => ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)((ReferenceEditViewModel)ViewModel).Control.InnerControl).DocumentModel;

		public System.Drawing.Color SkinForeColor => DocumentModel.SkinForeColor;

		public MergedFillInfo Fill => ViewModel.Format.Fill;

		public MergedBorderInfo Border => ViewModel.Format.Border;

		public MergedFontInfo Font => ViewModel.Format.Font;

		public ConditionalFormattingPreview()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		public void RefreshPreview()
		{
			InvalidateVisual();
		}

		protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			base.OnRender(drawingContext);
			control = ((ReferenceEditViewModel)ViewModel).Control;
			format = ViewModel.Format;
			fillBounds = new Rect(GetPosition(preview), new System.Windows.Size(preview.ActualWidth - (double)(offset * 2), preview.ActualHeight - (double)(offset * 2)));
			DrawFill(drawingContext);
			DrawBorder(drawingContext);
			DrawText(drawingContext);
		}

		private void DrawFill(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (format != null && !format.IsDefault)
			{
				FillPreviewPainter.DrawFill(DocumentModel, drawingContext, format.Fill, fillBounds);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetPosition(Visual element)
		{
			GeneralTransform generalTransform = element.TransformToAncestor(this);
			return generalTransform.Transform(new System.Windows.Point(offset, offset));
		}

		private void DrawBorder(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			if (format != null && !format.IsDefault)
			{
				DrawLeftBorder(drawingContext);
				DrawRightBorder(drawingContext);
				DrawTopBorder(drawingContext);
				DrawBottomBorder(drawingContext);
			}
		}

		private void DrawLeftBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.LeftLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.X, fillBounds.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.BottomLeft.X, fillBounds.BottomLeft.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.LeftColor, Border.LeftLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRightBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.RightLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.TopRight.X, fillBounds.TopRight.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.BottomRight.X, fillBounds.BottomRight.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.RightColor, Border.RightLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private void DrawTopBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.TopLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.X, fillBounds.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.TopRight.X, fillBounds.TopRight.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.TopColor, Border.TopLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private void DrawBottomBorder(DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (Border.BottomLineStyle.HasValue)
			{
				System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.BottomLeft.X, fillBounds.BottomLeft.Y);
				System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.BottomRight.X, fillBounds.BottomRight.Y);
				DrawLine(dc, GetBorderPen(Border.BottomColor, Border.BottomLineStyle), point, to);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Pen GetBorderPen(System.Drawing.Color? bordrerColor, XlBorderLineStyle? borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XlBorderLineStyle nonNullBorderStyle = GetNonNullBorderStyle(borderStyle);
			System.Drawing.Color notEmptyColor = GetNotEmptyColor(bordrerColor);
			System.Windows.Media.Pen pen = new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(notEmptyColor.ToWpfColor()), 1.0);
			double[] dashes = ToDoubleArray(LinePatternProvider.GetPattern(nonNullBorderStyle));
			pen.DashStyle = new System.Windows.Media.DashStyle(dashes, 0.0);
			return pen;
		}

		private XlBorderLineStyle GetNonNullBorderStyle(XlBorderLineStyle? borderStyle)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (borderStyle.HasValue)
			{
				return borderStyle.Value;
			}
			return (XlBorderLineStyle)0;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color GetNotEmptyColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			if (!DXColor.IsEmpty(color))
			{
				return color;
			}
			return SkinForeColor;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color GetNotEmptyColor(System.Drawing.Color? color)
		{
			if (!color.HasValue)
			{
				return SkinForeColor;
			}
			return GetNotEmptyColor(color.Value);
		}

		private double[] ToDoubleArray(float[] p)
		{
			double[] array = new double[p.Length];
			p.CopyTo(array, 0);
			return array;
		}

		private void PatchPoints(ref System.Windows.Point from, ref System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			double num = 0.5;
			to = new System.Windows.Point(to.X - num, to.Y - num);
			from = new System.Windows.Point(from.X - num, from.Y - num);
		}

		private void DrawLine(DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point from, System.Windows.Point to)
		{
			PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			dc.DrawLine(pen, from, to);
		}

		private void DrawText(DrawingContext drawingContext)
		{
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0128: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string typefaceName = "Calibri";
			float sizeInPoints = 11f;
			string textToFormat;
			System.Windows.Media.Color color;
			if (format == null || format.IsDefault)
			{
				textToFormat = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2301);
				color = SkinForeColor.ToWpfColor();
			}
			else
			{
				textToFormat = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)2302);
				color = GetNotEmptyColor(Font.Color).ToWpfColor();
			}
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(textToFormat, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight, new Typeface(typefaceName), CalculateFontSize(sizeInPoints), new SolidColorBrush(color), null, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			SetFontOptions(formattedText);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(fillBounds.Width / 2.0 - formattedText.Width / 2.0, fillBounds.Y + (fillBounds.Height / 2.0 - formattedText.Height / 2.0));
			drawingContext.DrawText(formattedText, point);
			if (format != null && format.Font.Underline.HasValue && format.Font.Underline != (XlUnderlineType?)0)
			{
				DrawUnderline(drawingContext, point, formattedText, color);
			}
		}

		private void SetFontOptions(FormattedText text)
		{
			if (format != null)
			{
				if (Font.Bold.HasValue && Font.Bold.Value)
				{
					text.SetFontWeight(FontWeights.Bold);
				}
				if (Font.Italic.HasValue && Font.Italic.Value)
				{
					text.SetFontStyle(FontStyles.Italic);
				}
				if (Font.StrikeThrough.HasValue && Font.StrikeThrough.Value)
				{
					text.SetTextDecorations(TextDecorations.Strikethrough);
				}
			}
		}

		public static double CalculateFontSize(float sizeInPoints)
		{
			return (double)Units.DocumentsToPixelsF(Units.PointsToDocumentsF(sizeInPoints), DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY) * 96.0 / (double)DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.Dpi;
		}

		private void DrawUnderline(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Point topLeft, FormattedText textSize, System.Windows.Media.Color drawingColor)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)format.Font.Underline.Value == 1)
			{
				DrawUnderlineCore(drawingContext, topLeft, textSize, drawingColor, 2);
			}
			else if ((int)format.Font.Underline.Value == 2)
			{
				DrawUnderlineCore(drawingContext, topLeft, textSize, drawingColor, 0);
				DrawUnderlineCore(drawingContext, topLeft, textSize, drawingColor, 2);
			}
		}

		private void DrawUnderlineCore(DrawingContext drawingContext, System.Windows.Point topLeft, FormattedText textSize, System.Windows.Media.Color drawingColor, int yOffset)
		{
			System.Windows.Point from = new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X, topLeft.Y + textSize.Height - (double)yOffset);
			System.Windows.Point to = new System.Windows.Point(topLeft.X + textSize.Width, topLeft.Y + textSize.Height - (double)yOffset);
			PatchPoints(ref from, ref to);
			drawingContext.DrawLine(new System.Windows.Media.Pen(new SolidColorBrush(drawingColor), 1.0), from, to);
		}

			}
		}

			if (viewModelField != null)
			{
				SetBindingsCalculatedField();
				SubscribeEventCalculatedField();
			}
			else
			{
				viewModelItem = (PivotTableCalculatedItemViewModel)(object)((viewModel is PivotTableCalculatedItemViewModel) ? viewModel : null);
				SetBindingsCalculatedItem();
				SubscribeEventsCalculatedItem();
			}
			viewModel.PivotTable.BeginTransaction(viewModel.ErrorHandler);
		}

		private PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel GetViewModel()
		{
			if (viewModelField != null)
			{
				return (PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)(object)viewModelField;
			}
			return (PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)(object)viewModelItem;
		}

		private void OnBtnInsertFieldClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SetFormulaField();
			SetFocusOnEdtFormula();
		}

		private void OnLbFieldsDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				btnInsertField.RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ButtonBase.ClickEvent));
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void SetFieldBindings()
		{
			lbFields.ItemsSource = GetViewModel().FieldNameValues;
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = GetViewModel();
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("FieldName");
			((FrameworkElement)(object)lbFields).SetBinding(BaseEdit.EditValueProperty, (BindingBase)binding);
		}

		private void SetFormulaField()
		{
			if (GetViewModel().Formula == "= 0" || GetViewModel().Formula == "= " || string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetViewModel().Formula))
			{
				GetViewModel().Formula = "=";
			}
			string text = GetViewModel().FieldName;
			if (!ParserIdentifiers.IsValidIdentifier(text))
			{
				text = "'" + text + "'";
			}
			PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel viewModel = GetViewModel();
			viewModel.Formula = viewModel.Formula + " " + text;
		}

		private void SetFocusOnEdtFormula()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)edtFormula).Focus();
			edtFormula.CaretIndex = ((TextEditBase)edtFormula).Text.Length;
		}

		private void SetBindingsCalculatedField()
		{

			SetFieldBindings();
		}

		private void OnCalculatedFieldBtnAddClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PivotAddCalculatedFieldCommand val = new PivotAddCalculatedFieldCommand(((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelField).PivotTable, viewModelField.NewFieldName, ((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelField).Formula, ((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelField).ErrorHandler);

		private void SetFormulaItem()
		{
			if (((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelItem).Formula == "= 0" || ((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelItem).Formula == "= " || string.IsNullOrEmpty(((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelItem).Formula))
			{
				((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)viewModelItem).Formula = "=";
			}
			string text = viewModelItem.ItemName;
			if (!ParserIdentifiers.IsValidIdentifier(text))
			{
				text = "'" + text + "'";
			}
			PivotTableCalculatedItemViewModel obj = viewModelItem;
			((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)obj).Formula = ((PivotTableCalculatedFieldItemViewModel)obj).Formula + " " + text;
		}

	public class PivotCalculatedItemSolveOrderDXDialog : CustomDXDialog
	{
		private PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderViewModel viewModel;

		private ListBoxEdit lbCalculatedItems;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button MoveUpButton => ((DXDialog)this).YesButton;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button MoveDownButton => ((DXDialog)this).NoButton;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button DeleteButton => ((DXDialog)this).OkButton;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button CloseButton => ((DXDialog)this).CancelButton;

		public PivotCalculatedItemSolveOrderDXDialog(string title, PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderControl control, PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderViewModel viewModel)
			: base(title)
		{
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			lbCalculatedItems = control.lbCalculatedItems;
			this.viewModel.PivotTable.BeginTransaction(viewModel.ErrorHandler);
		}

		protected override void ApplyDialogButtonProperty()
		{
			((DXDialog)this).ApplyDialogButtonProperty();
			((DXDialog)this).SetButtonVisibilities(true, true, true, true, true);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SetupButton(MoveUpButton, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderMoveUpButton);
			SetupButton(MoveDownButton, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderMoveDownButton);
			MoveDownButton.IsCancel = false;
			SetupButton(DeleteButton, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderDeleteButton);
			SetupButton(CloseButton, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_PivotTableCalculatedItemSolveOrderCloseButton);
			SetBindings();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		protected override void OnButtonClick(bool? result, MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult)
		{
			if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Yes && MoveUpButton != null)
			{
				MoveUpButton.Focus();
			}
			else if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.No && MoveDownButton != null)
			{
				MoveDownButton.Focus();
			}
			else if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.OK && DeleteButton != null)
			{
				DeleteButton.Focus();
			}
			else
			{
				((DXDialog)this).OnButtonClick(result, messageBoxResult);
			}
		}

		private void SetBindings()
		{
			SetCalculatedItemsBindinds();
			MoveUpButtonBinding();
			MoveDownButtonBinding();
			DeleteButtonBinding();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			MoveUpButton.Click += MoveUpButton_Click;
			MoveDownButton.Click += MoveDownButton_Click;
			DeleteButton.Click += DeleteButton_Click;
		}

		private void SetupButton(System.Windows.Controls.Button button, SpreadsheetControlStringId stringId)
		{
			if (button != null)
			{
				button.Content = XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(stringId);
			}
		}

		private void MoveUpButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MoveCalculatedItemCore(viewModel.CalculatedItem, -1);
		}

		private void MoveDownButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			MoveCalculatedItemCore(viewModel.CalculatedItem, 1);
		}

		private void DeleteButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			DeleteCalculatedItemCore();
		}

		private void SetCalculatedItemsBindinds()
		{
			lbCalculatedItems.ItemsSource = viewModel.CalculatedItems;
			viewModel.CalculatedItems = viewModel.GetCalculatedItems(viewModel.PivotTable);
			CalculateItemBinding();
		}

		private void MoveCalculatedItemCore(string selectedItem, int offset)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int selectedIndex = lbCalculatedItems.SelectedIndex;
			((ModelCommand)new PivotMoveCalculatedItemCommand(viewModel.PivotTable.Cache, viewModel.CalculatedItemIndex, offset, viewModel.ErrorHandler)).Execute();
			viewModel.CalculatedItems = null;
			viewModel.CalculatedItem = null;
			viewModel.CalculatedItems = viewModel.GetCalculatedItems(viewModel.PivotTable);
			viewModel.CalculatedItem = selectedItem;
			SetCalculatedItemsBindinds();
			lbCalculatedItems.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex + offset;
		}

		private void DeleteCalculatedItemCore()
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int selectedIndex = lbCalculatedItems.SelectedIndex;
			((ModelCommand)new PivotRemoveCalculatedItemCommand(viewModel.PivotTable.Cache, viewModel.CalculatedItemIndex, viewModel.ErrorHandler)).Execute();
			viewModel.CalculatedItems = null;
			viewModel.CalculatedItem = null;
			viewModel.CalculatedItems = viewModel.GetCalculatedItems(viewModel.PivotTable);
			SetCalculatedItemsBindinds();
			if (selectedIndex != 0)
			{
				viewModel.CalculatedItem = viewModel.CalculatedItems[selectedIndex - 1];
			}
			else if (viewModel.CalculatedItems.Count > 0)
			{
				viewModel.CalculatedItem = viewModel.CalculatedItems[0];
			}
		}

		private void CalculateItemBinding()
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = viewModel;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("CalculatedItem");
			((FrameworkElement)(object)lbCalculatedItems).SetBinding(ListBoxEdit.SelectedItemProperty, (BindingBase)binding);
		}

		private void MoveUpButtonBinding()
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = viewModel;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("MoveUpEnabled");
			MoveUpButton.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
		}

		private void MoveDownButtonBinding()
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = viewModel;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("MoveDownEnabled");
			MoveDownButton.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
		}

		private void DeleteButtonBinding()
		{
			System.Windows.Data.Binding binding = new System.Windows.Data.Binding();
			binding.Source = viewModel;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath("DeleteEnabled");
			DeleteButton.SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, binding);
		}
	}

		private void InitializeTimeType()
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			lbTimeType.UnSelectAll();
			foreach (PivotCacheGroupValuesBy value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(PivotCacheGroupValuesBy)))
			{
				if (((Enum)viewModel.GroupBy).HasFlag((Enum)(object)value) && (int)value != 0)
				{
					lbTimeType.SelectedItems.Add(viewModel.GroupByTable[value]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTimeTypeEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			int num = 3;
			viewModel.IsAnyTimeTypeSelected = lbTimeType.SelectedItems.Count != 0;
			viewModel.NumberOfDaysEnabled = lbTimeType.SelectedItems.Count == 1 && lbTimeType.SelectedIndex == num;
		}

			//IL_0099: Expected O, but got Unknown

			if (e.PropertyName == "StartingAt" && viewModel.StartingAt)
			{

				viewModel.StartValue = viewModel.DefaultMinValue;

			}
		}

		{
			if (onClearAllButtonClick != null)
			{
				onClearAllButtonClick(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyDialogButtonProperty()
		{
			((DXDialog)this).ApplyDialogButtonProperty();
			((DXDialog)this).SetButtonVisibilities(true, true, true, false, false);
		}

		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SetupCheckAllButton(ClearAllButton);
			InitializeButtons(ClearAllButton);
		}

		protected override void OnButtonClick(bool? result, MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult)
		{
			if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Yes && ClearAllButton != null)
			{
				ClearAllButton.Focus();
				RaiseClearAllButtonClick();
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnButtonClick(result, messageBoxResult);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAppearanceNameCustomPropertyControl(DocumentNameCustomPropertyControl control)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel val = (CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel)control.DataContext;
			bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.LinkDefinedName);

		}

		private void InitializeLstPredefinedPropertiesSelectedIndex()

		private void SetLstPredefinedPropertiesSelectedIndexSettings()
		{
			//IL_012d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00fb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				viewModel.ApplyPredefinedProperty(lstPredefinedProperties.SelectedIndex);
				CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel documentCustomProperty = GetDocumentCustomProperty(grid.SelectedIndex);
				DefinedName val = null;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel documentCustomProperty2 = GetDocumentCustomProperty(viewModel.PropertyIndex);
				bool flag3 = false;
				bool flag4 = false;
				if (documentCustomProperty != null)
				{
					flag = IsCustomDocumentPropertyHasLinkDefinedName(documentCustomProperty);
					if (flag)
					{
						val = viewModel.FindSelectedDefinedName(documentCustomProperty.LinkDefinedName);
						flag2 = val == null;
					}
				}
				if (documentCustomProperty2 != null && IsCustomDocumentPropertyHasLinkDefinedName(documentCustomProperty2))

					}
				}

					viewModel.LinkToContent = true;
					viewModel.PropertyType = documentCustomProperty.Type;
					viewModel.SelectedDefinedName = val;
				}
			}
			((BaseEdit)edtName).SelectAll();
			((UIElement)(object)edtName).Focus();
		}

		private void SetCustomPropertiesDefaultSettings(string propertyValue)
		{
			viewModel.LinkToContent = false;
			viewModel.SelectedDefinedName = ((viewModel.DefinedNamesDataSource.Count > 0) ? viewModel.DefinedNamesDataSource.Keys.First() : null);
			viewModel.PropertyValue = propertyValue;
			((UIElement)(object)edtType).IsEnabled = true;
			((UIElement)(object)edtPropertyValue).IsEnabled = true;
			((UIElement)(object)edtDefinedNames).IsEnabled = true;
			if (viewModel.DefinedNamesDataSource.Count > 0)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)chkLinkToContent).IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void SetOptionsDefinedNameCPRow()
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel documentCustomProperty = GetDocumentCustomProperty(viewModel.PropertyIndex);
			bool flag = IsCustomDocumentPropertyHasLinkDefinedName(documentCustomProperty);
			if (documentCustomProperty != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					SetVisibilityControlsDefinedNameCP(viewModel.FindSelectedDefinedName(documentCustomProperty.LinkDefinedName) != null, flag);
					return;
				}
				SetVisibilityControlsDefinedNameCP(visibleState: true, flag);
				viewModel.PropertyType = documentCustomProperty.Type;
				viewModel.SelectedDefinedName = ((viewModel.DefinedNamesDataSource.Count > 0) ? viewModel.DefinedNamesDataSource.Keys.First() : null);
			}
		}

		private void SetVisibilityControlsDefinedNameCP(bool visibleState, bool isPropertyContainsLinkDefinedName)

			((UIElement)(object)edtDefinedNames).IsEnabled = visibleState;
			((UIElement)(object)chkLinkToContent).IsEnabled = visibleState;
			chkLinkToContent.IsChecked = isPropertyContainsLinkDefinedName;
			((UIElement)(object)edtType).IsEnabled = !isPropertyContainsLinkDefinedName;
		}

		private CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel GetDocumentCustomProperty(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return viewModel.CustomPropertiesDataSource[index];
		}

		private bool IsCustomDocumentPropertyHasLinkDefinedName(CustomDocumentPropertyViewModel documentProperty)
		{
			if (documentProperty == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string linkDefinedName = documentProperty.LinkDefinedName;
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(linkDefinedName);
		}

		private DataFieldSettingsPivotTableViewModel viewModelDFS;

		public override bool HasCustomFooter => true;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Button ShowNumberFormatDialog => ((DXDialog)this).YesButton;

		private IPivotCacheField pivotCacheField => ((UndoableCollection<IPivotCacheField>)(object)viewModelFS.PivotTable.Cache.CacheFields)[viewModelFS.FieldIndex];

		public PivotFieldsNumberFormatDXDialog(string title, PivotTableNumberFormatViewModel viewModelNF, FieldSettingsPivotTableViewModel viewModelFS, DataFieldSettingsPivotTableViewModel viewModelDFS)
			: base(title)
		{
			this.viewModelNF = viewModelNF;
			this.viewModelFS = viewModelFS;
			this.viewModelDFS = viewModelDFS;
		}

		protected override void ApplyDialogButtonProperty()
		{
			((DXDialog)this).ApplyDialogButtonProperty();
			((DXDialog)this).SetButtonVisibilities(true, true, true, false, false);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			SetupButton(ShowNumberFormatDialog, SpreadsheetControlStringId.Caption_PivotTableFieldsNumberFormat);
			InitializeBtnNumberFormat();
			InitializeButtons(ShowNumberFormatDialog);
		}

		private void SetupButton(System.Windows.Controls.Button button, SpreadsheetControlStringId stringId)
		{
			if (button != null)
			{
				button.Content = XpfSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(stringId);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeBtnNumberFormat()
		{
			if (viewModelFS != null)
			{
				ShowNumberFormatDialog.Visibility = (pivotCacheField.SharedItems.ContainsSemiMixedTypes ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnButtonClick(bool? result, MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult)
		{
			if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Yes && ShowNumberFormatDialog != null)
			{
				if (viewModelFS != null)
				{
					viewModelFS.NumberFormatIndex = ShowPivotTableNumberFormatForm(((FormatCellsViewModelBase)viewModelNF).Control, viewModelFS.NumberFormatIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					viewModelDFS.NumberFormatIndex = ShowPivotTableNumberFormatForm(((FormatCellsViewModelBase)viewModelNF).Control, viewModelDFS.NumberFormatIndex);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((DXDialog)this).OnButtonClick(result, messageBoxResult);
			}
		}

		private int ShowPivotTableNumberFormatForm(ISpreadsheetControl control, int numberFormatIndex)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PivotTableNumberFormatCommand val = new PivotTableNumberFormatCommand(control, numberFormatIndex);
			((Command)val).Execute();
			return val.NumberFormatIndex;
		}
	}

		private void PopulateBoxes()
		{
			viewModel.BeginCalculateFieldCaptions();
			PopulateBox(lstFilters, viewModel.GetFilterInfos());
			PopulateBox(lstColumns, viewModel.GetColumnInfos());
			PopulateBox(lstRows, viewModel.GetRowInfos());
			PopulateBox(lstValues, viewModel.GetValueInfos());
			PopulateBox(lstFields, viewModel.EndCalculateFieldCaptions());
		}

		private void PopulateBox(ListBoxEdit box, List<PivotFieldViewInfo> infos)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			box.SelectionMode = System.Windows.Controls.SelectionMode.Multiple;
			((CollectionBase)(object)box.Items).Clear();
			foreach (PivotFieldViewInfo info in infos)
			{
				PivotFieldViewInfo current = info;
				ListBoxEditItem val = new ListBoxEditItem();
				((ContentControl)(object)val).Content = current;
				box.Items.Add((object)val);
				if (((PivotFieldViewInfo)(ref current)).IsSelected)
				{
					box.SelectedItems.Add(val);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		void IPivotTableFieldsPanel.ChangeViewModel(FieldListPanelPivotTableViewModel viewModel)

		}

		private void ChangeViewModel(FieldListPanelPivotTableViewModel viewModel)
		{
			if (!viewModel.Equals(this.viewModel))
			{
				DisposeViewModel();
				this.viewModel = viewModel;
				((FrameworkElement)this).DataContext = viewModel;
				PopulateBoxes();
				SubscribeEvents();
			}
		}

		void IPivotTableFieldsPanel.Hide()
		{
			((Window)this).Close();
		}

		private void DisposeViewModel()
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				viewModel.Dispose();
				viewModel = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnIndentValidate(object sender, ValidationEventArgs e)
		{

			double num2 = 250.0;
			if (e.Value != null)

				if ((double)result < num || (double)result > num2)
				{
					e.IsValid = false;

				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTextRotationValidate(object sender, ValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			double num = -90.0;
			double num2 = 90.0;
			if (e.Value != null)
			{
				int.TryParse(e.Value.ToString(), out var result);
				if ((double)result > num2)
				{
					previewTextBlock.LayoutTransform.SetCurrentValue(RotateTransform.AngleProperty, num);
					e.IsValid = false;
					e.SetError((object)string.Format(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)1874), num, num2));
				}
				else if ((double)result < num)
				{
					previewTextBlock.LayoutTransform.SetCurrentValue(RotateTransform.AngleProperty, num2);
					e.IsValid = false;
					e.SetError((object)string.Format(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)1874), num, num2));
				}
				else
				{
					previewTextBlock.LayoutTransform.SetCurrentValue(RotateTransform.AngleProperty, 0.0 - (double)result);
				}
			}
		}

	public class FormatCellsFontControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private double normalScaleFactor = 1.0;

		private double superSubScriptScaleFactor = 0.75;

		internal SpreadsheetPopupColorEdit ceFontColor;

		internal CheckEdit super;

		internal CheckEdit sub;

		internal TextBlock textBlockPreview;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public FormatCellsFontControl()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		private void OnSuperscriptChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool? isChecked = sub.IsChecked;
			bool flag = false;
			if (isChecked == true != flag || !isChecked.HasValue || super.IsChecked != false)
			{
				sub.IsChecked = !super.IsChecked;
				SetTextScriptType(superSubScriptScaleFactor, (0.0 - textBlockPreview.FontSize) / 4.0);
			}
		}

		private void OnSuperscriptUnchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool? isChecked = sub.IsChecked;
			bool flag = false;
			if (isChecked == true == flag && isChecked.HasValue && super.IsChecked == false)
			{
				SetTextScriptType(normalScaleFactor, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private void OnSubscriptChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool? isChecked = sub.IsChecked;
			bool flag = false;
			if (isChecked == true != flag || !isChecked.HasValue || super.IsChecked != false)
			{
				super.IsChecked = !sub.IsChecked;
				SetTextScriptType(superSubScriptScaleFactor, textBlockPreview.FontSize / 4.0);
			}
		}

		private void OnSubscriptUnchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool? isChecked = sub.IsChecked;
			bool flag = false;
			if (isChecked == true == flag && isChecked.HasValue && super.IsChecked == false)
			{
				SetTextScriptType(normalScaleFactor, 0.0);
			}
		}

		private void OnStrikethroughChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Add(TextDecorations.Strikethrough);
		}

		private void OnStrikethroughUnchecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (TextDecoration item in TextDecorations.Strikethrough)
			{
				if (textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Contains(item))
				{
					textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnUnderlineEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			foreach (TextDecoration item in TextDecorations.Underline)
			{
				if (e.NewValue.ToString() != "None")
				{
					if (!textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Contains(item))
					{
						textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Add(TextDecorations.Underline);
					}
				}
				else if (textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Contains(item))
				{
					textBlockPreview.TextDecorations.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetTextScriptType(double scaleFactor, double yOffset)
		{
			textBlockPreview.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(scaleFactor, scaleFactor);
			textBlockPreview.RenderTransform = new TranslateTransform(0.0, yOffset);
		}

			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.v23.2;component/forms/formatcells/formatcellsfontcontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);

	public class FormatNumberDecimalControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		internal SpreadsheetSpinEdit edtDecimalPlaces;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public FormatNumberDecimalControl()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		public bool ValidateDecimalPlaces()
		{
			return ((BaseEdit)edtDecimalPlaces).DoValidate();
		}

		private void OnDecimalPlacesValidate(object sender, ValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 30.0;
			if (e.Value != null)
			{
				int.TryParse(e.Value.ToString(), out var result);
				if ((double)result < num || (double)result > num2)
				{
					e.IsValid = false;
					e.SetError((object)string.Format(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)1874), num, num2));
				}
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.v23.2;component/forms/formatcells/formatnumberdecimalcontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

	public class HeaderFooterControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private readonly HeaderFooterViewModel viewModel;

		internal DXTabControl tabControl;

		internal DXTabItem tabHeaderFooter;

		internal DXTabItem tabFirstHeaderFooter;

		internal HeaderFooterEditControl firstHeaderFooterControl;

		internal DXTabItem tabOddHeaderFooter;

		internal HeaderFooterEditControl oddHeaderFooterControl;

		internal DXTabItem tabEvenHeaderFooter;

		internal HeaderFooterEditControl evenHeaderFooterControl;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		private bool OddHeaderSelected
		{
			get
			{
				if (((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedIndex != 0)
				{
					return ((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedIndex == 2;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool FirstHeaderSelected => ((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedIndex == 1;

		public HeaderFooterControl(HeaderFooterViewModel viewModel)
		{
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			InitializeComponent();
			InitializeTabPage();
		}

		private void InitializeTabPage()
		{
			if (!viewModel.DifferentFirstPage && !viewModel.DifferentOddEven)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)tabFirstHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)tabOddHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)tabEvenHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (!viewModel.DifferentFirstPage && viewModel.DifferentOddEven)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)tabHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)tabFirstHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((SelectorItemBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabOddHeaderFooter).IsSelected = true;
			}
			if (viewModel.DifferentFirstPage && !viewModel.DifferentOddEven)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)tabOddHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)tabEvenHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (viewModel.DifferentFirstPage && viewModel.DifferentOddEven)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)tabHeaderFooter).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((SelectorItemBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabFirstHeaderFooter).IsSelected = true;
			}
		}

		private void tabControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			GetSelectedEditControl()?.SelectLeftHeader();
		}

		private void tabControl_SelectionChanged(object sender, TabControlSelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			GetSelectedEditControl()?.SelectLeftHeaderWithoutFocus();
		}

		private HeaderFooterEditControl GetSelectedEditControl()
		{
			if (OddHeaderSelected)
			{
				if (!viewModel.DifferentOddEven)
				{
					return headerFooterControl;
				}
				return oddHeaderFooterControl;
			}
			if (FirstHeaderSelected)
			{
				return firstHeaderFooterControl;
			}
			return evenHeaderFooterControl;
		}

		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)

				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.v23.2;component/forms/headerfootercontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

			itemLevelCore.IsSelected = true;
		}

		internal TreeViewItem AddRootNode(string caption)
		{

		{

		}

		internal TreeViewItem TreeViewAppendNode(string caption, TreeViewItem parentNode)
		{
			parentNode.Items.Add(new TreeViewItem
			{
				Header = caption
			});
			return parentNode;
		}

		internal void TreeViewFocus()
		{
		}

		internal void TreeViewExpandAll()
		{
			TreeViewExpandAllCore(treeView.Items);
		}

		private void TreeViewExpandAllCore(ItemCollection itemCollection)
		{
			foreach (TreeViewItem item in (IEnumerable)itemCollection)
			{
				TreeViewExpandAllCore(item.Items);
				item.IsExpanded = true;
			}
		}

		internal int GetItemLevel(TreeViewItem treeViewItem)
		{
			int level = -1;
			GetItemLevelCore(treeViewItem, treeView.Items, ref level);
			return level;
		}

		private TreeViewItem GetItemLevelCore(TreeViewItem searchItem, ItemCollection itemCollection, ref int level)
		{
			foreach (TreeViewItem item in (IEnumerable)itemCollection)
			{
				if (item == searchItem)
				{
					level++;
					return item;
				}
				TreeViewItem itemLevelCore = GetItemLevelCore(searchItem, item.Items, ref level);
				if (itemLevelCore != null)
				{
					level++;
					return itemLevelCore;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}

		public HyperlinkControl(HyperlinkFormControllerParameters controllerParameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)controllerParameters, "controllerParameters");
			controller = CreateController(controllerParameters);
			worksheetNames = new Dictionary<string, TreeViewItem>();
			definedNames = new List<TreeViewItem>();
			nodeCellReferencesCaption = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)860);
			nodeDefinedNameCaption = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)861);
			isNewHyperlink = string.IsNullOrEmpty(Controller.TargetUri);
			defaultRange = CreateDefaultRange();

		}

		private void HyperlinkControl_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsDataInitialized)
			{
				Dialog = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DXDialog>((DependencyObject)this);
				InitializeData();
				InitializeForm();
				IsDataInitialized = true;
				SubscribeControlsEvents();
				SynchonizeDisplayText();
				if (postponedAction != null)

					postponedAction();
					postponedAction = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeData()
		{
			isSynchonizeDisplayText = GetInitialIsSynchonizeDisplayText();
			nodeCategory = GetInitialNodeCategory();
			linkTo = GetInitialLinkTo();
			emailEdited = false;
			lastFileOrWebPage = string.Empty;
			lastCell = string.Empty;
			lastSheet = string.Empty;
			lastEmail = string.Empty;
			lastSubject = string.Empty;
			if (Controller.IsExternal)
			{
				if (Controller.TargetUri.Contains("mailto:"))
				{
					SetEmailAndSubjectFromTargetUri();
				}
				else
				{
					lastFileOrWebPage = Controller.TargetUri;
				}
			}
			SetCellAndSheetFromTargetUri();
		}

		private NodeCategory GetInitialNodeCategory()
		{
			NodeCategory result = NodeCategory.WorksheetName;
			ParsedExpression expression = Controller.Hyperlink.Expression;
			if (expression != null && ((List<IParsedThing>)(object)expression).Count == 1)
			{
				IParsedThing val = ((List<IParsedThing>)(object)expression)[0];
				if (val is ParsedThingName || val is ParsedThingNameX)
				{
					result = NodeCategory.DefinedName;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void SetCellAndSheetFromTargetUri()
		{
			CellRange val = defaultRange;
			if (!Controller.IsExternal && nodeCategory == NodeCategory.DefinedName)
			{
				lastCell = Controller.Hyperlink.TargetUri;
				return;
			}
			if (!Controller.IsExternal && nodeCategory == NodeCategory.WorksheetName)
			{
				CellRangeBase targetRange = Controller.Hyperlink.GetTargetRange();
				CellRange val2 = (CellRange)(object)((targetRange is CellRange) ? targetRange : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					val = val2;
				}
			}
			lastCell = ((CellRangeBase)val).ToString(Controller.Hyperlink.Workbook.DataContext);
			lastSheet = ((CellRangeBase)val).Worksheet.Name;
		}

		private void SetEmailAndSubjectFromTargetUri()
		{
			string targetUri = controller.TargetUri;
			if (targetUri.Contains("mailto:"))
			{
				lastEmail = (targetUri.Contains("?") ? targetUri.Remove(targetUri.IndexOf("?")) : targetUri);
			}
			if (targetUri.Contains("="))
			{
				lastSubject = targetUri.Remove(0, targetUri.IndexOf("=") + 1);
			}
		}

		private HyperlinkType GetInitialLinkTo()
		{
			if (!IsNewHyperlink)
			{
				return GetLinkToCore(Controller.Hyperlink);
			}
			return lastLinkTo;
		}

		private HyperlinkType GetLinkToCore(IHyperlinkViewInfo hyperlink)
		{
			if (!hyperlink.IsExternal)
			{
				return HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument;
			}
			if (hyperlink.TargetUri.Contains("mailto:"))
			{
				return HyperlinkType.EmailAddress;
			}
			return HyperlinkType.ExistingFileOrWebPage;
		}

		private CellRange CreateDefaultRange()

			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			}
			else
			{

			return new CellRange((ICellTable)(object)Controller.Hyperlink.Workbook.ActiveSheet, val, val);
		}

		private bool GetInitialIsSynchonizeDisplayText()
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{

			}

			{
				VariantValue value = ((CellBase)val).Value;

				{
					value = ((CellBase)val).Value;

			}

		}

		private void InitializeDisplayText()
		{

			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!DisplayTextEnabled)

				((UIElement)(object)teDisplayText).IsEnabled = false;

			string editValue;

					editValue = val.Text;
					goto IL_005d;
