		}

		private void PopulateBookmark()
		{
			PopulateColumns();
			PopulateRows();
			cellReferenceAddress.TreeViewExpandAll();
			if (linkTo == HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument)
			{
				FocusPlaceInThisDocumentNode();
			}
		}

		private void PopulateRows()
		{
			TreeViewItem rootNode = cellReferenceAddress.AddRootNode(nodeCellReferencesCaption);
			TreeViewItem rootNode2 = cellReferenceAddress.AddRootNode(nodeDefinedNameCaption);
			PopulateWorksheetNames(rootNode);
			PopulateDefinedNameFromWorksheets(rootNode2);
			PopulateDefinedNameFromWorkbook(rootNode2);
		}

		private void PopulateColumns()
		{
		}

		private void PopulateDefinedNameFromWorkbook(TreeViewItem rootNode)
		{
			foreach (DefinedName item2 in (SimpleCollection<DefinedName>)(object)Workbook.DefinedNames)
			{
				TreeViewItem item = cellReferenceAddress.TreeViewAppendNode(((DefinedNameBase)item2).Name, rootNode);
				DefinedNames.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void PopulateDefinedNameFromWorksheets(TreeViewItem rootNode)
		{
			foreach (Worksheet item2 in (SimpleCollection<Worksheet>)(object)Workbook.Sheets)
			{
				foreach (DefinedNameBase definedName in item2.DefinedNames)
				{
					string caption = ((SheetBase)item2).Name + "!" + definedName.Name;
					TreeViewItem item = cellReferenceAddress.TreeViewAppendNode(caption, rootNode);
					DefinedNames.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PopulateWorksheetNames(TreeViewItem rootNode)
		{
			foreach (Worksheet item in (SimpleCollection<Worksheet>)(object)Workbook.Sheets)
			{
				TreeViewItem value = cellReferenceAddress.TreeViewAppendNode(((SheetBase)item).Name, rootNode);
				WorksheetNames.Add(((SheetBase)item).Name, value);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTeCellReferenceEnabling(NodeCategory nodeCategory)
		{
		}

		private void FocusPlaceInThisDocumentNode()
		{
			TreeViewItem treeViewItem = null;
			treeViewItem = nodeCategory switch
			{
				NodeCategory.DefinedName => GetExistingDefinedNameNode(), 
				NodeCategory.WorksheetName => WorksheetNames[lastSheet], 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("Invalid NodeCategory:" + nodeCategory), 
			};
			if (treeViewItem != null)
			{
				cellReferenceAddress.TreeListFocusedNode = treeViewItem;
			}
		}

		private TreeViewItem GetExistingDefinedNameNode()
		{
			foreach (TreeViewItem definedName in DefinedNames)
			{
				if (definedName.Header.ToString() == lastCell)
				{
					return definedName;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetDisplayText(HyperlinkType linkTo)
		{
			return linkTo switch
			{
				HyperlinkType.ExistingFileOrWebPage => externalAddress.Text, 
				HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument => GetDisplayTextFromPlaceInThisDocument(), 
				_ => GetDisplayTextFromEmail(), 
			};
		}

		private string GetDisplayTextFromEmail()
		{
			string text = emailAddress.EmailText;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(emailAddress.SubjectText))
			{
				text = text + "?subject=" + emailAddress.SubjectText;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetDisplayTextFromPlaceInThisDocument()
		{
			return nodeCategory switch
			{
				NodeCategory.Root => cellReferenceAddress.Text, 
				NodeCategory.WorksheetName => GetDisplayTextFromPlaceInThisDocumentForSheet(lastSheet, cellReferenceAddress.Text), 
				_ => cellReferenceAddress.TreeListFocusedNode.Header.ToString(), 
			};
		}

		private string GetDisplayTextFromPlaceInThisDocumentForSheet(string sheetName, string cellReference)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellReference))
			{
				return sheetName;
			}
			WorkbookDataContext dataContext = Controller.Hyperlink.Workbook.DataContext;
			ParsedExpression val = HyperlinkExpressionParser.ValidateCellRefExpression(dataContext, lastSheet, cellReference, false);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.BuildExpressionString(dataContext);
			}
			SheetDefinition val2 = new SheetDefinition();
			val2.SheetNameStart = sheetName;
			return val2.ToString(dataContext) + cellReference;
		}

		private void FillCurrentPanel(HyperlinkType linkTo)
		{
			switch (linkTo)
			{
			case HyperlinkType.ExistingFileOrWebPage:
				FillExistingFileOrWebPagePanel();
				break;
			case HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument:
				FillPlaceInThisDocumentPanel();
				break;
			default:
				FillEmailPanel();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void FillExistingFileOrWebPagePanel()
		{
			externalAddress.Text = lastFileOrWebPage;
			UpdateCursorPosition((TextEdit)(object)externalAddress.TextEdit, externalAddress.TextEditSelectionStart);
		}

		private void FillPlaceInThisDocumentPanel()
		{
			cellReferenceAddress.Text = lastCell;
			UpdateTeCellReferenceEnabling(nodeCategory);
			FocusPlaceInThisDocumentNode();
			UpdateCursorPosition(cellReferenceAddress.TextEdit, cellReferenceAddress.TextEditSelectionStart);
		}

		private void FillEmailPanel()
		{
			emailAddress.SubjectText = lastSubject;
			emailAddress.EmailText = lastEmail;
			UpdateCursorPosition(emailAddress.EmailTextEdit, emailAddress.EmailSelectionStart);
		}

		private string CreateTargetUri()
		{
			return linkTo switch
			{
				HyperlinkType.ExistingFileOrWebPage => CreateExistingFileOrWebPageTargetUri(), 
				HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument => CreatePlaceInThisDocumentTargetUri(), 
				HyperlinkType.EmailAddress => CreateEmailTargetUri(), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown LinkTo:" + LinkTo), 
			};
		}

		private string CreatePlaceInThisDocumentTargetUri()
		{
			return nodeCategory switch
			{
				NodeCategory.Root => null, 
				NodeCategory.WorksheetName => CreatePlaceInThisDocumentTargetUriForSheet(lastSheet, lastCell), 
				_ => cellReferenceAddress.TreeListFocusedNode.Header.ToString(), 
			};
		}

		private string CreatePlaceInThisDocumentTargetUriForSheet(string sheetName, string cellReference)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			WorkbookDataContext dataContext = Controller.Hyperlink.Workbook.DataContext;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellReference))
			{
				SheetDefinition val = new SheetDefinition();
				val.SheetNameStart = sheetName;
				return val.ToString(dataContext) + GetDefaultRange();
			}
			ParsedExpression val2 = HyperlinkExpressionParser.ValidateCellRefExpression(dataContext, lastSheet, cellReference, true);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val2.BuildExpressionString(dataContext);
		}

		private string CreateEmailTargetUri()
		{
			string text = lastEmail;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastSubject))
			{
				text = text + "?subject=" + lastSubject;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string CreateExistingFileOrWebPageTargetUri()
		{
			return lastFileOrWebPage.Trim();
		}

		private void UpdatePanelsVisibility(HyperlinkType linkTo)
		{
		}

		private void TeDisplayText_EditValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			isSynchonizeDisplayText = false;
			if ((((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValue != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValue.ToString())) || (IsNewHyperlink && Controller.IsExternal))
			{
				Controller.DisplayText = ((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValue.ToString();
			}
		}

		private void TeEmail_EditValueChanging(object sender, EditValueChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			TeEmailChangeText();
			SynchonizeDisplayText();
			UpdateOKButtonEnabling(HyperlinkType.EmailAddress);
			UpdateCursorPosition(emailAddress.EmailTextEdit, (emailEdited && emailAddress.EmailSelectionStart != 0) ? emailAddress.EmailSelectionStart : emailAddress.EmailText.Length);
			emailEdited = true;
		}

		private void UpdateCursorPosition(TextEdit textEdit, int selectionStart)
		{
			UpdateFocusAndSelectionLength(textEdit);
			textEdit.SelectionStart = selectionStart;
		}

		private void TeSubject_EditValueChanging(object sender, EditValueChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			lastSubject = emailAddress.SubjectText;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(emailAddress.EmailText))
			{
				SynchonizeDisplayText();
				UpdateOKButtonEnabling(HyperlinkType.EmailAddress);
			}
		}

		private void TeEmailChangeText()
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				((BaseEdit)emailAddress.EmailTextEdit).EditValueChanging -= new EditValueChangingEventHandler(TeEmail_EditValueChanging);
				bool flag = emailAddress.EmailText.Length > lastEmail.Length;
				bool flag2 = lastEmail.StartsWith("mailto:") && lastEmail != "mailto:";
				if (!emailAddress.EmailText.StartsWith("mailto:") && (flag || (flag2 && emailAddress.EmailText != string.Empty)))
				{
					emailAddress.EmailText = "mailto:" + emailAddress.EmailText;
				}
				lastEmail = emailAddress.EmailText;
			}
			finally
			{
				((BaseEdit)emailAddress.EmailTextEdit).EditValueChanging += new EditValueChangingEventHandler(TeEmail_EditValueChanging);
			}
		}

		private void TeTooltip_EditValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Controller.TooltipText = ((TextEditBase)teTooltip).Text;
		}

		private void BtnEditAddress_EditValueChanging(object sender, EditValueChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = (string)e.NewValue;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				Dialog.OkButton.IsEnabled = false;
				return;
			}
			string text2 = text.ToLower();
			if (HyperlinkExpressionParser.IsWebPage(text2))
			{
				Dialog.OkButton.IsEnabled = HyperlinkExpressionParser.IsValidateWebPageUri(text2);
			}
			else
			{
				Dialog.OkButton.IsEnabled = HyperlinkExpressionParser.IsValidateFileUri(text2);
			}
		}

		private void BtnEditAddress_EditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = externalAddress.Text;
			if (text.StartsWith("www."))
			{
				text = text.Insert(0, "http://");
				try
				{
					((BaseEdit)externalAddress.TextEdit).EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(BtnEditAddress_EditValueChanged);
					externalAddress.Text = text;
					externalAddress.TextEditSelectionStart = text.Length;
				}
				finally
				{
					((BaseEdit)externalAddress.TextEdit).EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(BtnEditAddress_EditValueChanged);
				}
			}
			SynchonizeDisplayText();
			lastFileOrWebPage = text;
		}

		private void UpdateOKButtonEnabling(HyperlinkType linkTo)
		{
			switch (linkTo)
			{
			case HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument:
				Dialog.OkButton.IsEnabled = nodeCategory != NodeCategory.Root;
				break;
			case HyperlinkType.ExistingFileOrWebPage:
				Dialog.OkButton.IsEnabled = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(externalAddress.Text);
				break;
			default:
				Dialog.OkButton.IsEnabled = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(emailAddress.EmailText);
				break;
			}
		}

		{
		}

		private void btnOk_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!ApplyChanges())
			{
				if (DisplayTextEnabled)
				{
					((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(TeDisplayText_EditValueChanged);
					((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValue = string.Empty;
					((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(TeDisplayText_EditValueChanged);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				btnOk_ClickCore();
			}
		}

		private bool ApplyChanges()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = CreateTargetUri();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				Controller.Control.ShowWarningMessage(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)139));
				return false;
			}
			controller.TargetUri = text;
			if (isSynchonizeDisplayText)
			{
				controller.DisplayText = text;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void btnOk_ClickCore()
		{
			((FormController)controller).ApplyChanges();
		}

		private void BtnEditAddress_ButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			OpenFileDialogService val = new OpenFileDialogService();
			string arg = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)329);
			((FileDialogServiceBase)val).Filter = $"{arg}|*.*";

			}
		}

		private string PrepareTargetUri()
		{
			if (LinkTo == HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument)
			{
				return PrepareTargetUriPlaceInThisDocument(cellReferenceAddress.Text);
			}
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private string PrepareTargetUriPlaceInThisDocument(string cellReference)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellReference))
			{
				WorkbookDataContext dataContext = Controller.Hyperlink.Workbook.DataContext;
				ParsedExpression val = HyperlinkExpressionParser.ValidateCellRefExpression(dataContext, lastSheet, cellReference, true);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val.BuildExpressionString(dataContext);
				}
			}
			return cellReference;
		}

		private void SynchonizeDisplayText()
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (isSynchonizeDisplayText && DisplayTextEnabled)
			{
				string displayText = GetDisplayText(LinkTo);
				((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValueChanged -= new EditValueChangedEventHandler(TeDisplayText_EditValueChanged);
				Controller.DisplayText = displayText;
				((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValue = displayText;
				((BaseEdit)teDisplayText).EditValueChanged += new EditValueChangedEventHandler(TeDisplayText_EditValueChanged);
			}
		}

		private bool IsNeedAddCell()
		{
			if (LinkTo == HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument && cellReferenceAddress.TextEditEnabled)
			{
				return string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellReferenceAddress.Text);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void TlCellReference_FocusedNodeChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e)
		{
			nodeCategory = GetNodeCategory();
			UpdatePlaceInThisDocumentTargetUriCore();
			UpdateOKButtonEnabling(HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument);
			SynchonizeDisplayText();
		}

		private NodeCategory GetNodeCategory()
		{
			TreeViewItem treeListFocusedNode = cellReferenceAddress.TreeListFocusedNode;
			if (cellReferenceAddress.GetItemLevel(cellReferenceAddress.TreeListFocusedNode) == 0)
			{
				return NodeCategory.Root;
			}
			if (DefinedNames.Contains(treeListFocusedNode))
			{
				return NodeCategory.DefinedName;
			}
			return NodeCategory.WorksheetName;
		}

		private void UpdatePlaceInThisDocumentTargetUriCore()
		{
			UpdateTeCellReferenceEnabling(nodeCategory);
			lastCell = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellReferenceAddress.Text)) ? cellReferenceAddress.Text : GetDefaultRange());
			lastSheet = ((nodeCategory == NodeCategory.WorksheetName) ? cellReferenceAddress.TreeListFocusedNode.Header.ToString() : lastSheet);
			Controller.IsExternal = false;
		}

		private void TeCellReference_EditValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellReferenceAddress.Text))
			{
				lastCell = GetDefaultRange();
			}
			else
			{
				lastCell = cellReferenceAddress.Text;
			}
			SynchonizeDisplayText();
		}

		private void HyperlinkForm_Shown(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			switch (LinkTo)
			{
			case HyperlinkType.ExistingFileOrWebPage:
				UpdateFocusAndSelectionLength((TextEdit)(object)externalAddress.TextEdit);
				break;
			case HyperlinkType.PlaceInThisDocument:
				UpdateTeCellReferenceCursorPosition();
				break;
			case HyperlinkType.EmailAddress:
				UpdateTeEmailCursorPosition();
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Unknown LinkTo:" + LinkTo);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTeEmailCursorPosition()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(emailAddress.SubjectText))
			{
				UpdateFocusAndSelectionLength(emailAddress.EmailTextEdit);
				return;
			}
			UpdateFocusAndSelectionLength(emailAddress.SubjectTextEdit);
			emailAddress.SubjectSelectionStart = emailAddress.SubjectText.Length;
		}

		private void UpdateTeCellReferenceCursorPosition()
		{
			if (cellReferenceAddress.TextEditEnabled)
			{
				UpdateFocusAndSelectionLength(cellReferenceAddress.TextEdit);
			}
			else
			{
				cellReferenceAddress.TreeViewFocus();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFocusAndSelectionLength(TextEdit textEdit)
		{
			((UIElement)(object)textEdit).Focus();
			textEdit.SelectionLength = 0;
		}

		private void HyperlinkForm_SizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			lastWidth = (int)base.Width;
			lastHeight = (int)base.Height;
		}

	public class NameManagerControl : ReferenceEditBaseControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private NameManagerViewModel viewModel;

		private Window parentWindow;

		internal Grid Root;

		internal Grid PART_Visual;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnNew;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnEdit;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnDelete;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.ListView grid;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnCancelReferenceChange;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Image btnCancelReferenceChangeImage;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Button btnApplyReferenceChange;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.Image btnApplyReferenceChangeImage;

		internal ReferenceEdit edtReference;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public NameManagerControl(NameManagerViewModel viewModel)
			: base((IReferenceEditViewModel)(object)viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			edtReference.SpreadsheetControl = viewModel.Control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(edtReference, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, "=", includeSheetName: true, suppressActiveSheetChanging: false);
			SetSvgImagesToButtons();
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			((ViewModelBase)viewModel).PropertyChanged += ViewModel_PropertyChanged;
			grid.SelectionChanged += OnGridSelectionChanged;
		}

		private void ViewModel_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "CurrentNameIndex" && viewModel.CurrentNameIndex != -1)
			{
				grid.SelectedIndex = viewModel.CurrentNameIndex;
			}
		}

		private void OnGridSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (grid.SelectedItems.Count > 1)
			{
				viewModel.CurrentNameIndex = -1;
				viewModel.NameIndicesForDelete = new int[grid.SelectedItems.Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < grid.SelectedItems.Count; i++)
				{
					object item = grid.SelectedItems[i];
					viewModel.NameIndicesForDelete[i] = grid.Items.IndexOf(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				viewModel.CurrentNameIndex = grid.SelectedIndex;
				viewModel.NameIndicesForDelete = null;
			}
		}

		private void SetSvgImagesToButtons()
		{
			if (MenuItemHelper.AllowUseSvgImages(viewModel.Control as SpreadsheetControl))
			{
				IExternalImageLoadingService service = ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)viewModel.Control.InnerControl).GetService<IExternalImageLoadingService>();
				btnApplyReferenceChangeImage.Source = NameManagerImages.GetSvgApplyReferenceChangeDXImage(service).ToImageSource();
				btnApplyReferenceChangeImage.Stretch = Stretch.Fill;
				btnCancelReferenceChangeImage.Source = NameManagerImages.GetSvgCancelReferenceChangeDXImage(service).ToImageSource();
				btnCancelReferenceChangeImage.Stretch = Stretch.Fill;
			}
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			grid.SelectedIndex = viewModel.CurrentNameIndex;
			parentWindow = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)this);
		}

		private void btnNew_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				parentWindow.Hide();
				ShowNewDefinedNameForm();
			}
		}

		private void btnEdit_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				parentWindow.Hide();
				ShowEditDefinedNameForm();
			}
		}

		private void ShowNewDefinedNameForm()
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DefineNameCommand val = new DefineNameCommand(viewModel.Control);
			ShowDefineNameForm(val.CreateViewModel());
		}

		private void ShowEditDefinedNameForm()
		{
			DefineNameViewModel val = ((List<DefineNameViewModel>)(object)viewModel.NamesDataSource)[viewModel.CurrentNameIndex].Clone();
			if (!DefinedNameEditingCancelled(val))
			{
				val.NewNameMode = false;
				val.IsScopeChangeAllowed = false;
				ShowDefineNameForm(val);
			}
		}

		private bool DefinedNameEditingCancelled(DefineNameViewModel nameViewModel)
		{
			return viewModel.Control.InnerControl.RaiseDefinedNameEditing(nameViewModel.Name, nameViewModel.OriginalName, nameViewModel.Scope, nameViewModel.ScopeIndex, nameViewModel.Reference, nameViewModel.Comment);
		}

		private void ShowDefineNameForm(DefineNameViewModel nameViewModel)
		{
			if (viewModel != null && viewModel.Control is SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl)
			{
				spreadsheetControl.ShowDefineNameForm(nameViewModel, OnChildFormClosed);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateGridSelectedIndices()
		{
			if (viewModel.IsCurrentNameValid)
			{
				grid.SelectedIndex = viewModel.CurrentNameIndex;
			}
			else if (viewModel.NameIndicesForDelete != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < viewModel.NameIndicesForDelete.Length; i++)
				{
					int index = viewModel.NameIndicesForDelete[i];
					grid.SelectedItems.Add(grid.Items[index]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnChildFormClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DXDialog val = (DXDialog)((sender is DXDialog) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((Window)(object)val).Closed -= OnChildFormClosed;
			}
			grid.SelectionChanged -= OnGridSelectionChanged;
			viewModel.UpdateDefinedNames();
			parentWindow.Show();
			grid.Focus();
			UpdateGridSelectedIndices();
			grid.SelectionChanged += OnGridSelectionChanged;
		}

		private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			grid.SelectionChanged -= OnGridSelectionChanged;
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				viewModel.DeleteDefinedName();
				grid.Focus();
			}
			grid.UnselectAll();
			grid.SelectionChanged += OnGridSelectionChanged;
		}

		private void btnCancelReferenceChange_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				viewModel.CancelReferenceChange();
			}
		}

		private void btnApplyReferenceChange_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				viewModel.ApplyReferenceChange();
			}
		}

		private void grid_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource;
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != grid)
			{
				if (dependencyObject.GetType() == typeof(System.Windows.Controls.ListViewItem))
				{
					ShowEditDefinedNameForm();
					break;
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private void grid_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null && viewModel.IsCurrentNameValid)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Return)
				{
					ShowEditDefinedNameForm();
				}
				else if (e.Key == Key.Delete)
				{
					viewModel.DeleteDefinedName();
					grid.Focus();
				}
			}
		}

				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			InitializeReferenceEditors(((ReferenceEditViewModel)viewModel).Control);
		}

		private void InitializeReferenceEditors(ISpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			ReferenceEdit edtPrintAria = sheetControl.edtPrintAria;
			edtPrintAria.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(edtPrintAria, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, null, includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: true);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(edtPrintAria);
			ReferenceEdit edtRowsToRepeat = sheetControl.edtRowsToRepeat;
			edtRowsToRepeat.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(edtRowsToRepeat, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, null, includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: true, (ReferenceEditSelectionMode)2);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(edtRowsToRepeat);
			ReferenceEdit edtColumnsToRepeat = sheetControl.edtColumnsToRepeat;
			edtColumnsToRepeat.SpreadsheetControl = control;
			SetUpReferenceEditor(edtColumnsToRepeat, (ReferenceEditPositionType)1, null, includeSheetName: false, suppressActiveSheetChanging: true, (ReferenceEditSelectionMode)1);
			SubscribeReferenceEdit(edtColumnsToRepeat);
		}

		protected override void OnWindowClosed()
		{
			base.OnWindowClosed();
			sheetControl.edtPrintAria.Dispose();
			sheetControl.edtRowsToRepeat.Dispose();
			sheetControl.edtColumnsToRepeat.Dispose();
		}

		private void tabControl_SelectionChanging(object sender, TabControlSelectionChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			object dataContext = base.DataContext;
			ValidatePageSetupSelectionChanging((PageSetupViewModel)((dataContext is PageSetupViewModel) ? dataContext : null), e);
		}

		public bool ValidatePageSetupChanges()
		{
			object dataContext = base.DataContext;
			PageSetupViewModel val = (PageSetupViewModel)((dataContext is PageSetupViewModel) ? dataContext : null);
			if (((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedValue.Equals(tabPage) && !val.PageValidate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedValue.Equals(tabMargins) && !val.MarginsValidate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedValue.Equals(tabHeaderFooter) && !val.HeaderFooterValidate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedValue.Equals(tabSheet) && !val.SheetValidate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((SelectorBase<DXTabControl, DXTabItem>)(object)tabControl).SelectedValue.Equals(tabChart) && !val.ChartsheetValidate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ValidatePageSetupSelectionChanging(PageSetupViewModel viewModel, TabControlSelectionChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldSelectedItem != null)
			{
				if (e.OldSelectedItem.Equals(tabPage) && !viewModel.PageValidate())
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				}
				else if (e.OldSelectedItem.Equals(tabMargins) && !viewModel.MarginsValidate())
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				}
				else if (e.OldSelectedItem.Equals(tabHeaderFooter) && !viewModel.HeaderFooterValidate())
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				}
				else if (e.OldSelectedItem.Equals(tabSheet) && !viewModel.SheetValidate())
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				}
				else if (e.OldSelectedItem.Equals(tabChart) && !viewModel.ChartsheetValidate())
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				}
				else
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = false;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			WidthMeasurer.SetDesiredTabWidth(new Grid[5] { tabPageGrid, tabMarginsGrid, tabHeaderFooterGrid, tabSheetGrid, tabChartsheetGrid });
		}

		public PivotTableDateFilterControl(PivotTableDateFiltersViewModel viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			InitizlizeDateEdits();
			WidthMeasurer.SetDesiredWidth((ComboBoxEdit)(object)edtFilterType, ((PivotTableFiltersViewModelBase)viewModel).FilterTypesDataSource);
		}

		private void InitizlizeDateEdits()
		{
			((TextEdit)dateEdit).Mask = "G";
			((TextEdit)dateEdit1).Mask = "G";
			((TextEdit)dateEdit2).Mask = "G";
		}

		private void OnDateEditEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CorrectDateEditText((DateEdit)((sender is DateEdit) ? sender : null));
		}

		private void OnDateEdit1EditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CorrectDateEditText((DateEdit)((sender is DateEdit) ? sender : null));
		}

		private void OnDateEdit2EditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CorrectDateEditText((DateEdit)((sender is DateEdit) ? sender : null));
		}

		private void CorrectDateEditText(DateEdit dateEdit)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = dateEdit.DateTime;
			if (dateTime.Year < 1900)
			{
				((TextEditBase)dateEdit).Text = null;
				return;
			}
			string displayFormatString = ((dateTime.Hour > 0 || dateTime.Minute > 0 || dateTime.Second > 0) ? "G" : "d");
			((BaseEdit)dateEdit).DisplayFormatString = displayFormatString;
		}

		public void SetViewModelStringValues()
		{
			if (((PivotTableFiltersViewModelBase)viewModel).IsOneValueFilter)
			{
				((PivotTableFiltersViewModelBase)viewModel).FirstStringValue = GetStringValue(dateEdit);
				return;
			}
			((PivotTableFiltersViewModelBase)viewModel).FirstStringValue = GetStringValue(dateEdit1);
			((PivotTableFiltersViewModelBase)viewModel).SecondStringValue = GetStringValue(dateEdit2);
		}

		private string GetStringValue(DateEdit dateEdit)
		{
			if (((BaseEdit)dateEdit).EditValue != null)
			{
				return ((TextEditBase)dateEdit).Text;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

	public class PivotTableFieldsFilterItemsControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private PivotTableFieldsFilterItemsViewModel viewModel;

		private bool isAllSelected;

		internal SearchButtonEdit edtSearch;

		internal CheckEdit chkAddSelectionToFilter;

		internal ListBoxEdit lbItems;

		internal CheckedListBoxEditStyleSettings chkListBoxItems;

		internal CheckEdit chkSelectMultipleItems;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		private bool PageAxis => (int)viewModel.Axis == 4;

		public PivotTableFieldsFilterItemsControl(PivotTableFieldsFilterItemsViewModel viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			InitializeCheckedItems();
			SubscribeEvents();
			if (PageAxis)
			{
				SubscribeEventsPageAxis();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeCheckedItems()
		{
			((CollectionBase)(object)lbItems.Items).Clear();
			lbItems.Items.AddRange((object[])viewModel.Items.ToArray());
			for (int i = 0; i < viewModel.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (viewModel.Items[i].IsVisible)
				{
					lbItems.SelectedItems.Add(viewModel.Items[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			((ViewModelBase)viewModel).PropertyChanged += OnViewModelPropertyChanged;
			((ButtonEdit)edtSearch).DefaultButtonClick += OnEdtSearchDefaultButtonClick;
		}

		private void SubscribeEventsPageAxis()
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			viewModel.SelectMultipleItemsChanged += OnSelectMultipleItemsChanged;
			((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging += new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
		}

		private void OnViewModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "SearchText")
			{
				ToggleFilterMode();
			}
		}

		private void OnLbItemsEditValueChanging(object sender, EditValueChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			isAllSelected = false;
			object selectedItem = FindSelectedItem(e.NewValue as List<object>, e.OldValue as List<object>);
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectItem(selectedItem);
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void OnEdtSearchDefaultButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel.IsSearchMode)
			{
				viewModel.SearchText = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectMultipleItemsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging -= new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(viewModel.SearchText))
			{
				if (!viewModel.SelectMultipleItems && lbItems.SelectedItems.Count > 1)
				{
					((BaseEdit)lbItems).SelectAll();
				}
			}
			else if (viewModel.SelectMultipleItems)
			{
				((BaseEdit)lbItems).SelectAll();
			}
			else
			{
				lbItems.UnSelectAll();
				lbItems.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
			((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging += new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
		}

		private void ToggleFilterMode()
		{
			if (viewModel.IsSearchMode)
			{
				ToggleFilterModeCore(PopulateFoundItems, InitializeFoundCheckedItems);
			}
			else
			{
				ToggleFilterModeCore(null, InitializeCheckedItems);
			}
		}

		private void ToggleFilterModeCore(Action populate, Action initialize)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (PageAxis)
			{
				((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging -= new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
			}
			lbItems.UnSelectAll();
			((Collection<ButtonInfoBase>)(object)((ButtonEdit)edtSearch).Buttons)[0].Visibility = ((!viewModel.IsClearButtonVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			populate?.Invoke();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(viewModel.SearchText))
			{
				viewModel.AddSelectionToFilter = false;
			}
			initialize();
			if (PageAxis)
			{
				((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging += new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
			}
		}

		private void PopulateFoundItems()
		{
			viewModel.PopulateFoundItems(viewModel.SearchText);
			((CollectionBase)(object)lbItems.Items).Clear();
			lbItems.Items.AddRange((object[])viewModel.FoundItems.ToArray());
		}

		private void InitializeFoundCheckedItems()
		{
			if (!PageAxis)
			{
				InitializeAllFoundItems();
			}
			else if (chkSelectMultipleItems.IsChecked.HasValue && chkSelectMultipleItems.IsChecked.Value)
			{
				InitializeAllFoundItems();
			}
			else
			{
				InitializeOneFoundItems();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeAllFoundItems()
		{
			((BaseEdit)lbItems).SelectAll();
		}

		private void InitializeOneFoundItems()
		{
			if (viewModel.FoundItems.Count > 0)
			{
				lbItems.SelectedIndex = 0;
			}
		}

		private void SelectItem(object selectedItem)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging -= new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
			try
			{
				if (viewModel.SelectMultipleItems)
				{
					return;
				}
				lbItems.UnSelectAll();
				if (selectedItem == null)
				{
					if (isAllSelected)
					{
						((BaseEdit)lbItems).SelectAll();
					}
					else
					{
						lbItems.SelectedIndex = -1;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					lbItems.SelectedIndex = lbItems.Items.IndexOf(selectedItem);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((BaseEdit)lbItems).EditValueChanging += new EditValueChangingEventHandler(OnLbItemsEditValueChanging);
			}
		}

		private object FindSelectedItem(List<object> newValue, List<object> oldValue)
		{
			if (newValue != null && newValue.Count == viewModel.Items.Count)
			{
				isAllSelected = true;
				return null;
			}
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (oldValue == null)
			{
				return newValue[0];
			}
			if (newValue.Count <= oldValue.Count)
			{
				return GetExceptedItem(oldValue, newValue);
			}
			return GetExceptedItem(newValue, oldValue);
		}

		private object GetExceptedItem(List<object> first, List<object> second)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
			{
				object obj = first[i];
				if (!second.Contains(obj))
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool UpdateViewModel()
		{
			if (viewModel.AddSelectionToFilter)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < ((CollectionBase)(object)lbItems.Items).Count; i++)
				{
					List<PivotItemFilterInfo> items = viewModel.Items;
					object obj = lbItems.Items[i];
					int index = items.IndexOf((PivotItemFilterInfo)((obj is PivotItemFilterInfo) ? obj : null));
					viewModel.Items[index].IsVisible = IsItemSelected(lbItems.Items[i]);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (viewModel.SelectMultipleItems && lbItems.SelectedItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (PivotItemFilterInfo item in viewModel.Items)
			{
				item.IsVisible = false;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < lbItems.SelectedItems.Count; j++)
			{
				List<PivotItemFilterInfo> items2 = viewModel.Items;
				object obj2 = lbItems.SelectedItems[j];
				int index2 = items2.IndexOf((PivotItemFilterInfo)((obj2 is PivotItemFilterInfo) ? obj2 : null));
				viewModel.Items[index2].IsVisible = true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsItemSelected(object item)
		{
			return lbItems.SelectedItems.Contains(item);
		}

		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.v23.2;component/forms/pivottablefieldsfilteritemscontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			parentWindow = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<Window>((DependencyObject)this);
		}

		private void btnNew_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				Hide();
				ShowNewProtectedRangeForm();
			}
		}

		private void btnModify_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				Hide();
				ShowEditProtectedRangeForm();
			}
		}

		private void btnDelete_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				viewModel.DeleteCurrentProtectedRange();
			}
		}

		private void btnPermissions_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			viewModel.EditCurrentRangePermissions();
		}

		private void ShowNewProtectedRangeForm()
		{
			ProtectedRangeViewModel rangeViewModel = viewModel.CreateNewRangeViewModel();
			ShowProtectedRangeForm(rangeViewModel);
		}

		private void ShowEditProtectedRangeForm()
		{
			ProtectedRangeViewModel rangeViewModel = viewModel.CreateEditCurrentRangeViewModel();
			ShowProtectedRangeForm(rangeViewModel);
		}

		private void ShowProtectedRangeForm(ProtectedRangeViewModel rangeViewModel)
		{
			if (viewModel != null && viewModel.Control is SpreadsheetControl spreadsheetControl)
			{
				spreadsheetControl.ShowProtectedRangeForm(rangeViewModel, OnChildFormClosed);
			}
		}

		private void OnChildFormClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is CustomDXDialog customDXDialog)
			{
				((Window)(object)customDXDialog).Closed -= OnChildFormClosed;
				if (customDXDialog.DialogResult == true)
				{
					ProtectedRangeViewModel protectedRangeViewModel = GetProtectedRangeViewModel(customDXDialog);
					if (protectedRangeViewModel != null)
					{
						viewModel.ApplyRangeChange(protectedRangeViewModel);
						if (!protectedRangeViewModel.IsNew)
						{
							((PasswordViewModelBase)protectedRangeViewModel).Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ProtectedRangeViewModel protectedRangeViewModel2 = GetProtectedRangeViewModel(customDXDialog);
					if (protectedRangeViewModel2 != null)
					{
						((PasswordViewModelBase)protectedRangeViewModel2).Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			Show();
		}

		private ProtectedRangeViewModel GetProtectedRangeViewModel(CustomDXDialog form)
		{
			object obj = ((((ContentControl)(object)form).Content is FrameworkElement frameworkElement) ? frameworkElement.DataContext : null);
			return (ProtectedRangeViewModel)((obj is ProtectedRangeViewModel) ? obj : null);
		}

		private void Hide()
		{
			parentWindow.Hide();
		}

		private void Show()
		{
			parentWindow.ShowDialog();
		}

		private void grid_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = (DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource;
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != grid)
			{
				if (dependencyObject.GetType() == typeof(System.Windows.Controls.ListViewItem))
				{
					ShowEditProtectedRangeForm();
					break;
				}
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private void grid_KeyDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewModel != null && viewModel.IsCurrentRangeValid)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Return)
				{
					ShowEditProtectedRangeForm();
				}

			}
		}

	public class SimpleFilterControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector, IStyleConnector
	{
		private SimpleFilterViewModel viewModel;

		internal SearchButtonEdit edtSearch;

		internal CheckEdit chkAddSelectionToFilter;

		internal System.Windows.Controls.TreeView treeView;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public ObservableCollection<Node> Nodes { get; private set; }

		public SimpleFilterViewModel ViewModel
		{
			get
			{
				return viewModel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (viewModel != value)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "viewModel");
					viewModel = value;
					PopulateTreeView(viewModel.Root);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsValid { get; set; }

		public SimpleFilterControl(SimpleFilterViewModel viewModel)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			base.DataContext = viewModel;
			ViewModel = viewModel;
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			((ViewModelBase)ViewModel).PropertyChanged += OnViewModelPropertyChanged;
			((ButtonEdit)edtSearch).DefaultButtonClick += OnEdtSearchDefaultButtonClick;
		}

		private void PopulateTreeView(FilterValueNode value)
		{
			Nodes = new ObservableCollection<Node>();
			Nodes.Clear();
			bool isCheckedNode = false;
			bool isNotCheckedNode = false;
			if (value != null)
			{
				foreach (FilterValueNode child in value.Children)
				{
					Node node = CreateNode(child);
					CheckNodeState(child, ref isCheckedNode, ref isNotCheckedNode);
					RecursivePopulateTreeView(node, child.Children, ref isCheckedNode, ref isNotCheckedNode);
					Nodes.Add(node);
				}
			}
			treeView.ItemsSource = Nodes;
		}

		private void RecursivePopulateTreeView(Node previousNode, List<FilterValueNode> list, ref bool isCheckedNode, ref bool isNotCheckedNode)
		{
			foreach (FilterValueNode item in list)
			{
				Node node = CreateNode(item);
				CheckNodeState(item, ref isCheckedNode, ref isNotCheckedNode);
				node.Parent.Add(previousNode);
				previousNode.Children.Add(node);
				if (node.IsChecked != previousNode.IsChecked)
				{
					node.CheckedTreeChildMiddle(node.Parent, node.Children, node.IsChecked);
				}
				RecursivePopulateTreeView(node, item.Children, ref isCheckedNode, ref isNotCheckedNode);
			}
		}

		private Node CreateNode(FilterValueNode value)
		{
			if (value.Text == viewModel.BlankValue)
			{
				return new BlankNode(value, viewModel)
				{
					Text = value.Text,
					IsChecked = value.IsChecked
				};
			}
			return new Node(value)
			{
				Text = value.Text,
				IsChecked = value.IsChecked
			};
		}

		private void CheckNodeState(FilterValueNode node, ref bool isCheckedNode, ref bool isNotCheckedNode)
		{
			if (node.IsChecked)
			{
				isCheckedNode = true;
			}
			else
			{
				isNotCheckedNode = true;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateViewModelState()
		{
			if (!ViewModel.IsSearchMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!viewModel.AddSelectionToFilter)
			{
				ViewModel.DataSource.ForEach(delegate(FilterValueNode node)
				{
					node.IsChecked = false;
				});
				UpdateViewModelTreeRecursive(Nodes);
			}
			else
			{
				CorrectionRootState(viewModel.Root);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateViewModelTreeRecursive(ObservableCollection<Node> nodes)
		{
			foreach (Node node in nodes)
			{
				node.ItemModel.IsChecked = node.IsChecked ?? true;
				UpdateViewModelTreeRecursive(node.Children);
			}
		}

		private void CorrectionRootState(FilterValueNode node)
		{
			if (node.Children.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FilterValueNode child in node.Children)
			{
				CorrectionRootState(child);
				if (child.IsChecked)
				{
					node.IsChecked = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox checkBox = (System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox)sender;
			CheckBoxId.checkBoxId = checkBox.Uid;
		}

		public void CheckedTree(ObservableCollection<Node> items, bool isChecked)
		{
			foreach (Node item in items)
			{
				if (item.Children.Count != 0)
				{
					CheckedTree(item.Children, isChecked);
				}
				item.IsChecked = isChecked;
				item.ItemModel.IsChecked = isChecked;
			}
		}

		private void OnViewModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "SearchText")
			{
				ToggleFilterMode();
			}
		}

		private void OnEdtSearchDefaultButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ViewModel.IsSearchMode)
			{
				ViewModel.SearchText = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void ToggleFilterMode()
		{
			((Collection<ButtonInfoBase>)(object)((ButtonEdit)edtSearch).Buttons)[0].Visibility = ((!ViewModel.IsClearButtonVisible) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			if (ViewModel.IsSearchMode)
			{
				ViewModel.PopulateFoundItems(ViewModel.SearchText);
				PopulateTreeView(ViewModel.FoundRoot);
			}
			else
			{
				ViewModel.AddSelectionToFilter = false;
				PopulateTreeView(ViewModel.Root);
			}
		}

		public void ValidateForm()
		{
			if (ViewModel.AddSelectionToFilter && Nodes.Count > 0)
			{
				IsValid = true;
				return;
			}
			foreach (Node node in Nodes)
			{
				if (node.IsChecked.HasValue && node.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					IsValid = true;
					break;
				}
				IsTreeListHasCheckedNodesRecursive(node.Children);
			}
		}

		public void IsTreeListHasCheckedNodesRecursive(ObservableCollection<Node> nodes)
		{
			foreach (Node node in nodes)
			{
				if (node.IsChecked.HasValue && node.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					IsValid = true;
					break;
				}
				IsTreeListHasCheckedNodesRecursive(node.Children);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/DevExpress.Xpf.Spreadsheet.v23.2;component/forms/simplefiltercontrol.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		internal Delegate _CreateDelegate(Type delegateType, string handler)
		{
			return Delegate.CreateDelegate(delegateType, this, handler);
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			switch (connectionId)
			{
			case 2:
				edtSearch = (SearchButtonEdit)target;
				break;
			case 3:
				chkAddSelectionToFilter = (CheckEdit)target;
				break;
			case 4:
				treeView = (System.Windows.Controls.TreeView)target;
				break;
			default:
				_contentLoaded = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IStyleConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{

			{
				((System.Windows.Controls.CheckBox)target).PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown += OnMouseLeftButtonDown;
			}
		}

				button.HorizontalContentAlignment = System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
			}
		}
	}
	public class Node : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private ObservableCollection<Node> children = new ObservableCollection<Node>();

		private ObservableCollection<Node> parent = new ObservableCollection<Node>();

		private string text;

		private string id;

		private bool? isChecked = true;

		private bool isExpanded;

		private FilterValueNode itemModel;

		public ObservableCollection<Node> Children => children;

		public ObservableCollection<Node> Parent => parent;

		public bool? IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return isChecked;
			}
			set
			{
				isChecked = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged("IsChecked");
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				text = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged("Text");
			}
		}

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return isExpanded;
			}
			set
			{
				isExpanded = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged("IsExpanded");
			}
		}

		public FilterValueNode ItemModel
		{
			get
			{
				return itemModel;
			}
			set
			{
				itemModel = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged("IsChecked");
			}
		}

		public string Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				id = value;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public Node(FilterValueNode item)
		{
			id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
			itemModel = item;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
			int countCheck = 0;
			if (propertyName == "IsChecked" && Id == CheckBoxId.checkBoxId)
			{
				if (Parent.Count == 0 && Children.Count != 0)
				{
					CheckedTreeParent(Children, IsChecked);
				}
				else if (Parent.Count > 0 && Children.Count > 0)
				{
					CheckedTreeChildMiddle(Parent, Children, IsChecked);
				}
				else if (Parent.Count > 0 && Children.Count == 0)
				{
					CheckedTreeChild(Parent, countCheck);
				}
				CheckTreeLeaf(IsChecked ?? true);
			}
		}

		public void CheckedTreeChildMiddle(ObservableCollection<Node> itemsParent, ObservableCollection<Node> itemsChild, bool? isChecked)
		{
			int countCheck = 0;
			CheckedTreeParent(itemsChild, isChecked);
			CheckedTreeChild(itemsParent, countCheck);
		}

		private void CheckedTreeParent(ObservableCollection<Node> items, bool? isChecked)
		{
			foreach (Node item in items)
			{
				item.IsChecked = isChecked;
				item.ItemModel.IsChecked = !isChecked.HasValue || isChecked.Value;
				if (item.Children.Count != 0)
				{
					CheckedTreeParent(item.Children, isChecked);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckedTreeChild(ObservableCollection<Node> items, int countCheck)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Node item in items)
			{
				foreach (Node child in item.Children)
				{
					if (child.IsChecked == true || !child.IsChecked.HasValue)
					{
						countCheck++;
						if (!child.IsChecked.HasValue)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (countCheck != item.Children.Count && countCheck != 0)
				{
					item.IsChecked = null;
					item.ItemModel.IsChecked = true;
				}
				else if (countCheck == 0)
				{
					item.IsChecked = false;
					item.ItemModel.IsChecked = false;
				}
				else if (countCheck == item.Children.Count && flag)
				{
					item.IsChecked = null;
					item.ItemModel.IsChecked = true;
				}
				else if (countCheck == item.Children.Count && !flag)
				{
					item.IsChecked = true;
					item.ItemModel.IsChecked = true;
				}
				if (item.Parent.Count != 0)
				{
					CheckedTreeChild(item.Parent, 0);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CheckTreeLeaf(bool isChecked)
		{
			ItemModel.IsChecked = isChecked;
		}
	}
	public class BlankNode : Node
	{
		private readonly SimpleFilterViewModel viewModel;

			: base(item)
		{
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
		}

		protected override void CheckTreeLeaf(bool isChecked)
		{
			base.CheckTreeLeaf(isChecked);
			if (base.Text == viewModel.BlankValue)
			{
				viewModel.BlankValueChecked = isChecked;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ReferenceEditBaseControl : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl
	{
		private readonly IReferenceEditViewModel viewModel;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Panel root;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Panel visualContainer;

		private System.Windows.Controls.Panel parentContainer;

		private CustomDXDialog dialog;

		private Thickness editMargins;

		private double editMinWidth;

		private double minHeight;

		private double height;

		protected IReferenceEditViewModel ViewModel => viewModel;

		protected ISpreadsheetControl SpreadsheetControl => ViewModel.Control;

		protected DocumentModel DocumentModel => ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)SpreadsheetControl.InnerControl).DocumentModel;

		protected virtual bool AllowSubscribeEventsOnLoaded => true;

		protected virtual bool AllowUnsubscribeEventsOnClosed => true;

		private bool ShowReferenceSelection
		{
			get
			{
				return DocumentModel.ShowReferenceSelection;
			}
			set
			{
				DocumentModel.ShowReferenceSelection = value;
			}
		}

		public ReferenceEditBaseControl(IReferenceEditViewModel viewModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)viewModel, "viewModel");
			this.viewModel = viewModel;
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			base.Loaded += OnLoaded;
			base.IsVisibleChanged += OnVisibleChanged;
		}

		private void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (AllowSubscribeEventsOnLoaded)
			{
				SubscribeReferenceEditEvents();
			}
			root = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "Root") as Grid;
			visualContainer = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)this, "PART_Visual") as Grid;
			dialog = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<CustomDXDialog>((DependencyObject)this);
			Window window = Window.GetWindow(this);
			if (window != null)
			{
				window.Closed += delegate
				{
					OnWindowClosed();
				};
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeReferenceEditEvents()
		{
			Action<ReferenceEdit> action = delegate(ReferenceEdit edit)
			{
				SubscribeReferenceEdit(edit);
			};
			ForEachReferenceEdit(action);
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeAndDisposeReferenceEditEvents()
		{
			Action<ReferenceEdit> action = delegate(ReferenceEdit edit)
			{
				UnsubscribeReferenceEdit(edit);
				edit.Dispose();
			};
			ForEachReferenceEdit(action);
		}

		protected void ForEachReferenceEdit(Action<ReferenceEdit> action)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator((DependencyObject)this);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				if (val.Current is ReferenceEdit obj)
				{
					action(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SubscribeReferenceEdit(ReferenceEdit referenceEdit)
		{
			referenceEdit.ActivatedChanged += OnReferenceEditActivatedChanged;
			referenceEdit.CollapsedChanged += OnReferenceEditCollapsedChanged;
		}

		protected void UnsubscribeReferenceEdit(ReferenceEdit referenceEdit)
		{
			referenceEdit.ActivatedChanged -= OnReferenceEditActivatedChanged;
			referenceEdit.CollapsedChanged -= OnReferenceEditCollapsedChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void OnWindowClosed()
		{
			if (AllowUnsubscribeEventsOnClosed)
			{
				UnsubscribeAndDisposeReferenceEditEvents();
			}
			ShowReferenceSelection = false;
		}

		private void OnReferenceEditActivatedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ReferenceEdit referenceEdit = sender as ReferenceEdit;
			ShowReferenceSelection = referenceEdit.Activated;
			RedrawSpreadsheetControl();
		}

		private void RedrawSpreadsheetControl()
		{
			if (SpreadsheetControl.InnerControl.Owner != null)
			{
				SpreadsheetControl.InnerControl.Owner.Redraw();
			}
		}

		private void OnReferenceEditCollapsedChanged(object sender, CollapsedChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(sender is ReferenceEdit referenceEdit) || root == null || visualContainer == null || dialog == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.IsCollapsed)
			{
				parentContainer = ((FrameworkElement)(object)referenceEdit).Parent as System.Windows.Controls.Panel;
				if (parentContainer != null)
				{
					parentContainer.Children.Remove((UIElement)(object)referenceEdit);
					ModifyParameters(referenceEdit);
					root.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)referenceEdit);
					visualContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					dialog.SetFooterVisibility(Visibility.Collapsed);
				}
			}
			else if (parentContainer != null)
			{
				root.Children.Remove((UIElement)(object)referenceEdit);
				RestoreParameters(referenceEdit);
				parentContainer.Children.Add((UIElement)(object)referenceEdit);
				visualContainer.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				dialog.SetFooterVisibility(Visibility.Visible);
				parentContainer = null;
			}
		}

		private void ModifyParameters(ReferenceEdit edit)
		{
			editMargins = ((FrameworkElement)(object)edit).Margin;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edit).Margin = new Thickness(0.0);
			editMinWidth = ((FrameworkElement)(object)edit).MinWidth;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edit).MinWidth = base.ActualWidth;
			minHeight = base.MinHeight;
			base.MinHeight = 0.0;
			height = base.Height;
			base.Height = double.NaN;
		}

		private void RestoreParameters(ReferenceEdit edit)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edit).Margin = editMargins;
			((FrameworkElement)(object)edit).MinWidth = editMinWidth;
			base.MinHeight = minHeight;
			base.Height = height;
		}

		private void OnVisibleChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DocumentModel.ReferenceEditMode = (bool)e.NewValue;
			((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)SpreadsheetControl.InnerControl).OnUpdateUI();
		}

		protected void SetUpReferenceEditor(ReferenceEdit edit, ReferenceEditPositionType posType, string prefix, bool includeSheetName, bool suppressActiveSheetChanging)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SetUpReferenceEditor(edit, posType, prefix, includeSheetName, suppressActiveSheetChanging, (ReferenceEditSelectionMode)0);
		}

		protected void SetUpReferenceEditor(ReferenceEdit edit, ReferenceEditPositionType posType, string prefix, bool includeSheetName, bool suppressActiveSheetChanging, ReferenceEditSelectionMode selectionMode)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			edit.PositionType = posType;
			edit.EditValuePrefix = prefix;
			edit.IncludeSheetName = includeSheetName;
			edit.SuppressActiveSheetChanging = suppressActiveSheetChanging;
			edit.Controller.SelectionMode = selectionMode;
		}
	}

	{

		private ChartPresetCategory presetCategory;

		public string Caption { get; set; }

		public ObservableCollection<ChartLayoutGalleryItemInfo> Items { get; private set; }

		public ChartLayoutGalleryGroupInfo()
		{
			Items = new ObservableCollection<ChartLayoutGalleryItemInfo>();
		}

		public void Initialize(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)control, "control");
			this.control = control;
			PopulateItems();
			SubscribeControlEvents();
		}

		public void Release()
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UnsubscribeControlEvents();
			Items.Clear();
			control = null;
			presetCategory = (ChartPresetCategory)0;
		}

		private void SubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			if (control != null)
			{
				control.UpdateUI += OnUpdateUI;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			if (control != null)
			{
				control.UpdateUI -= OnUpdateUI;
			}
		}

		private void OnUpdateUI(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (control == null || control.CommandBarStyle != CommandBarStyle.Empty || control.Ribbon != null || control.BarManager != null)
			{
				if (control == null || control.InnerControl == null || ((InnerSpreadsheetDocumentServer)control.InnerControl).IsDisposed)
				{
					Release();
				}
				else
				{
					PopulateItems();
				}
			}
		}

		private void PopulateItems()
		{

	public class CellStyleGalleryBarItem : RibbonGalleryBarItem, IEditValueBarItem, ICellStyleBarItemOwner

		private class ItemInfoComparer : IComparer<CellStyleGalleryItemInfo>
		{
			public virtual int Compare(CellStyleGalleryItemInfo x, CellStyleGalleryItemInfo y)
			{
				return x.Text.CompareTo(y.Text);
			}
		}

		private class GoodBadNormalItemInfoComparer : ItemInfoComparer
		{
			private int normalStyleIndex;

			internal GoodBadNormalItemInfoComparer(int normalStyleIndex)
			{
				this.normalStyleIndex = normalStyleIndex;
			}

			public override int Compare(CellStyleGalleryItemInfo x, CellStyleGalleryItemInfo y)
			{
				if (IsNormalText(x.StyleIndex))
				{
					if (IsNormalText(y.StyleIndex))
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (IsNormalText(y.StyleIndex))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return base.Compare(x, y);
			}

			private bool IsNormalText(int styleIndex)
			{
				return styleIndex == normalStyleIndex;
			}
		}

		private void CheckItems(object newValue)
		{
			((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				object obj = newValue;
				CellStyleBase val = (CellStyleBase)((obj is CellStyleBase) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					CheckItem(base.Gallery, val);
					CheckItem(base.DropDownGallery, val);
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void CheckItem(Gallery gallery, CellStyleBase style)
		{
			if (gallery == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GalleryItemGroup item in (Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)gallery.Groups)
			{
				foreach (GalleryItem item2 in (Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)item.Items)
				{
					if (item2.Caption is CellStyleGalleryItemInfo cellStyleGalleryItemInfo && cellStyleGalleryItemInfo.StyleIndex == style.StyleIndex)
					{
						item2.IsChecked = true;
					}
					else
					{
						item2.IsChecked = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

			cellStyleGalleryGroupInfo.Caption = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(stringId);
			return cellStyleGalleryGroupInfo;
		}

		private void InitializeGallery(Gallery oldValue, Gallery newValue, ObservableCollection<CellStyleGalleryGroupInfo> groupSource)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.ItemClick -= new GalleryItemEventHandler(OnGalleryItemClick);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue.GroupsSource = groupSource;
				newValue.ItemClick += new GalleryItemEventHandler(OnGalleryItemClick);
			}
		}

		private void OnGalleryItemClick(object sender, GalleryItemEventArgs e)
		{

		}

		{
			itemProvider.ChangeControl(spreadsheet?.InnerControl);
		}

		void ICellStyleBarItemOwner.BeginUpdate()
		{
		}

		void ICellStyleBarItemOwner.EndUpdate()
		{
			ItemInfoComparer comparer = new ItemInfoComparer();
			MergeGroupInfos(customInfo, comparer);
			MergeGroupInfos(goodBadAndNeutralInfo, new GoodBadNormalItemInfoComparer((SpreadsheetControl != null) ? SpreadsheetControl.DocumentModel.StyleSheet.CellStyles.Normal.StyleIndex : (-1)));
			MergeGroupInfos(dataAndModelInfo, comparer);
			MergeGroupInfos(titlesAndHeadingsInfo, comparer);
			MergeGroupInfos(themedCellStylesInfo, comparer);
			MergeGroupInfos(numberFormatInfo, comparer);
			commonGroupInfos.Add(commonInfo);
			CheckItems(EditValue);
		}

		void ICellStyleBarItemOwner.AddItem(CellStyleBase item)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			CellStyleGalleryItemInfo item2 = new CellStyleGalleryItemInfo(item);
			StyleCategory styleCategory = BuiltInCellStyleCalculator.GetStyleCategory(item);
			if ((int)styleCategory == 0)
			{
				if (customInfo.Items.Count < 960)
				{
					customInfo.AddItem(item2);
				}
			}
			else if ((int)styleCategory == 1)
			{
				goodBadAndNeutralInfo.AddItem(item2);
			}
			else if ((int)styleCategory == 2)
			{
				dataAndModelInfo.AddItem(item2);
			}
			else if ((int)styleCategory == 3)
			{
				titlesAndHeadingsInfo.AddItem(item2);
			}
			else if ((int)styleCategory == 4)
			{
				themedCellStylesInfo.AddItem(item2);
			}
			else if ((int)styleCategory == 5)
			{
				numberFormatInfo.AddItem(item2);
			}
		}

		void ICellStyleBarItemOwner.ClearItems()
		{
			commonGroupInfos.Clear();
			commonInfo.ClearItems();
			dropDownGroupInfos.Clear();
			customInfo.ClearItems();
			goodBadAndNeutralInfo.ClearItems();
			dataAndModelInfo.ClearItems();
			titlesAndHeadingsInfo.ClearItems();
			themedCellStylesInfo.ClearItems();
			numberFormatInfo.ClearItems();
		}

		private void MergeGroupInfos(CellStyleGalleryGroupInfo groupInfo, IComparer<CellStyleGalleryItemInfo> comparer)
		{
			if (groupInfo.Items.Count != 0)
			{
				groupInfo.SortItems(comparer);
				dropDownGroupInfos.Add(groupInfo);
				commonInfo.AddRange(groupInfo.Items);
			}
		}
	}

		internal CellStyleGalleryItemInfo(CellStyleBase style)
		{
			styleIndex = style.StyleIndex;
			UpdateProperties(style);
		}

		private void UpdateProperties(CellStyleBase style)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0129: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Text = (style.IsBuiltIn ? BuiltInCellStyleLocalizer.GetLocalizedName(((BuiltInCellStyle)style).BuiltInId) : style.Name);
			IActualFillInfo actualFill = style.ActualFill;
			System.Drawing.Color color = (style.ApplyFill ? Cell.GetBackgroundColor(actualFill) : DXColor.Empty);
			if ((int)actualFill.FillType == 0)
			{
				if ((int)actualFill.PatternType == 1)
				{
					if (!DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(color))
					{
						System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(color.ToWpfColor());
						brush.Freeze();
						Background = brush;
					}
				}
				else if ((int)actualFill.PatternType != 0)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.Color foreColor = (DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(actualFill.ForeColor) ? style.DocumentModel.SkinForeColor.ToWpfColor() : actualFill.ForeColor.ToWpfColor());
					System.Windows.Media.Color backColor = color.ToWpfColor();
					System.Windows.Media.Brush patternFillBrushStyleGallery = PatternFillProvider.GetPatternFillBrushStyleGallery(actualFill.PatternType, foreColor, backColor);
					patternFillBrushStyleGallery.Freeze();
					Background = patternFillBrushStyleGallery;
				}
			}
			Font font = style.ActualFont.GetFontInfo().Font;
			System.Drawing.Color color2 = (style.ApplyFont ? style.Font.Color : DXColor.Black);
			if (DXColor.IsEmpty(color2))
			{
				color2 = DXColor.Black;
			}
			XlHorizontalAlignment hAlignment = (XlHorizontalAlignment)((!style.ApplyAlignment) ? 1 : ((int)style.Alignment.Horizontal));
			TextSettings = TextInfoCalculator.CalculateCellStyleGalleryItemTextSettings(font, color2, hAlignment);
		}

		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

	public abstract class TableStyleGalleryGroupsBase : ObservableCollection<TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo>
	{
		protected const string nameIsNone = "None";

		protected const string customPrefix = "Custom";

		protected const string lightPrefix = "Light";

		protected const string mediumPrefix = "Medium";

		protected const string darkPrefix = "Dark";

		private SpreadsheetControl control;

		protected abstract string StyleNamePrefix { get; }

		protected abstract XtraSpreadsheetStringId StyleNameLocalizedPrefix { get; }

		internal void Initialize(SpreadsheetControl control)
		{
			this.control = control;
			OnCollectionChanged(null, EventArgs.Empty);
			SubscribeControlEvents();
		}

		private void SubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			if (control != null && control.DocumentModel != null)
			{
				control.EmptyDocumentCreated += OnCollectionChanged;
				control.DocumentLoaded += OnCollectionChanged;
				control.DocumentModel.DocumentCleared += OnCollectionChanged;
				control.DocumentModel.StyleSheet.TableStyles.CollectionChanged += OnCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			if (control != null && control.DocumentModel != null)
			{
				control.EmptyDocumentCreated -= OnCollectionChanged;
				control.DocumentLoaded -= OnCollectionChanged;
				control.DocumentModel.DocumentCleared -= OnCollectionChanged;
				control.DocumentModel.StyleSheet.TableStyles.CollectionChanged -= OnCollectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (control != null && control.DocumentModel != null && !control.DocumentModel.IsSetContentMode)
			{
				Clear();
				PopulateGroups(GetCustomStyleNames(control.DocumentModel));
			}
		}

		protected abstract IList<string> GetCustomStyleNames(DocumentModel model);

		protected abstract void PopulateGroups(IList<string> customStyleNames);

		protected TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo CreateGroupInfo(XtraSpreadsheetStringId stringId)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo tableStyleGalleryGroupInfo = new TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo();
			tableStyleGalleryGroupInfo.Caption = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(stringId);
			return tableStyleGalleryGroupInfo;
		}

		protected void AddGalleryItemGroup(TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo groupInfo)
		{
			if (groupInfo.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				Add(groupInfo);
			}
		}

		protected void PopulateCustomGalleryItems(IList<string> customStyleNames, TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo group)
		{
			if (customStyleNames == null || customStyleNames.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string customStyleName in customStyleNames)
			{
				group.Items.Add(CreateGalleryItemCore(customStyleName, customStyleName));
			}
		}

		protected void PopulateGalleryItems(TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo group, string groupPrefix, XtraSpreadsheetStringId groupPrefixId, int presetsCount)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (groupPrefix == "Light")
			{
				group.Items.Add(CreateGalleryItemCore(XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString((XtraSpreadsheetStringId)410), "None"));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < presetsCount; i++)
			{
				group.Items.Add(CreateGalleryItem(groupPrefix, groupPrefixId, i));
			}
		}

		protected void PopulateGalleryItems(XtraSpreadsheetStringId categoryId, string groupPrefix, XtraSpreadsheetStringId namePartId, int presetsCount)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo tableStyleGalleryGroupInfo = CreateGroupInfo(categoryId);
			PopulateGalleryItems(tableStyleGalleryGroupInfo, groupPrefix, namePartId, presetsCount);
			AddGalleryItemGroup(tableStyleGalleryGroupInfo);
		}

		private TableStyleGalleryItemInfo CreateGalleryItem(string groupPrefix, XtraSpreadsheetStringId groupPrefixId, int index)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string text = (index + 1).ToString();
			string text2 = XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(StyleNameLocalizedPrefix) + " " + XtraSpreadsheetLocalizer.GetString(groupPrefixId) + " " + text;
			string styleName = StyleNamePrefix + groupPrefix + text;
			return CreateGalleryItemCore(text2, styleName);
		}

		private TableStyleGalleryItemInfo CreateGalleryItemCore(string text, string styleName)
		{
			TableStyleGalleryItemInfo tableStyleGalleryItemInfo = new TableStyleGalleryItemInfo();
			tableStyleGalleryItemInfo.Text = text;
			tableStyleGalleryItemInfo.Spreadsheet = control;
			tableStyleGalleryItemInfo.StyleName = styleName;
			return tableStyleGalleryItemInfo;
		}

		internal void Release()
		{
			UnsubscribeControlEvents();
			using (IEnumerator<TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					TableStyleGalleryGroupInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					foreach (TableStyleGalleryItemInfo item in current.Items)
					{
						item.Spreadsheet = null;
					}
				}
			}
			Clear();
			control = null;
		}
	}

	public class DisplayFillPainter
	{
		public void Draw(DocumentModel documentModel, Rect fillBounds, DisplayFill fill, DrawingContext dc)
		{

		public void Draw(DocumentModel documentModel, Rect fillBounds, DisplayGradientFill fill, DrawingContext dc)

		}

		public void Draw(DocumentModel documentModel, Rect fillBounds, DisplayPatternFill fill, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (!fill.ShouldUseForeColor)
			{
				int colorIndex = ColorModelInfo.GetColorIndex(documentModel.Cache.ColorModelInfoCache, fill.BackColor);
				int defaultBackgroundColorIndex = ColorModelInfo.GetDefaultBackgroundColorIndex(documentModel.Cache.ColorModelInfoCache);
				ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo = documentModel.Cache.ColorModelInfoCache[colorIndex];
				ColorModelInfo colorModelInfo2 = documentModel.Cache.ColorModelInfoCache[defaultBackgroundColorIndex];
				System.Drawing.Color color = colorModelInfo.ToRgb(documentModel.StyleSheet.Palette, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).OfficeTheme.Colors);
				System.Drawing.Color color2 = colorModelInfo2.ToRgb(documentModel.StyleSheet.Palette, ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).OfficeTheme.Colors);
				if (color == color2)
				{
					fill.BackColor = documentModel.SkinBackColor;
				}
			}
			DrawCore(documentModel, fill.BackColor, fillBounds, dc);
		}

		private void DrawCore(DocumentModel documentModel, System.Drawing.Color backColor, Rect fillBounds, DrawingContext dc)
		{
			if (!DXColor.IsTransparentOrEmpty(backColor))
			{
				System.Windows.Media.Brush brush = new SolidColorBrush(backColor.ToWpfColor());
				brush.Freeze();
				dc.DrawRectangle(brush, null, fillBounds);
			}
		}

			set
			{
				if (!(caption == value))
				{
					caption = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Caption");
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ChartStyleGalleryGroupInfo()
		{
			Items = new ObservableCollection<ChartStyleGalleryItemInfo>();
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
