	public class ChartStyleImageCreator
	{
		private readonly DocumentModel documentModel;

		private static System.Windows.Size imageSize = new System.Windows.Size(72.0, 56.0);

		public static System.Windows.Size ImageSize => imageSize;

		public ChartStyleImageCreator(DocumentModel documentModel)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)documentModel, "documentModel");
			this.documentModel = documentModel;
		}

		public ImageSource CreateChartImage(Chart chart)
		{
			if (chart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IController controller = chart.Controller;
			if (controller == null || controller.ChartModel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IChartControllerFactoryService service = ((DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>)(object)documentModel).GetService<IChartControllerFactoryService>();
			ModelControllerFactoryBase modelControllerFactoryBase = ((service != null) ? service.CreateFactory((IChartBase)(object)chart) : null);
			if (modelControllerFactoryBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ContentPresenter contentPresenter = new ContentPresenter();
			ModelRect bounds = new ModelRect(0.0, 0.0, ImageSize.Width, ImageSize.Height);
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++)
				{
					chart.Style = i + 1;
					chart.Controller.RenderChart(modelControllerFactoryBase.CreateRenderContext(bounds, contentPresenter));
					ImageSource imageSource = ConvertChartToImageSource(contentPresenter, new Rect(0.0, 0.0, ImageSize.Width, ImageSize.Height));
					drawingContext.DrawImage(imageSource, new Rect(ImageSize.Width * (double)i, 0.0, ImageSize.Width, ImageSize.Height));
					if (System.Windows.Application.Current != null)
					{
						System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
						{
						});
					}
				}
			}
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)(ImageSize.Width * 48.0), (int)ImageSize.Height, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(drawingVisual);
			return renderTargetBitmap;
		}

		private ImageSource ConvertChartToImageSource(ContentPresenter chartContainer, Rect bounds)
		{
			int correctedWidth = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedWidth(bounds.Width, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX);
			int correctedHeight = HighDpiUnitCalculator.GetCorrectedHeight(bounds.Height, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY);
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap(correctedWidth, correctedHeight, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiX, DocumentModelBase<DocumentFormat>.DpiY, PixelFormats.Default);
			chartContainer.Measure(bounds.Size);
			chartContainer.Arrange(bounds);
			chartContainer.ApplyTemplate();
			chartContainer.UpdateLayout();
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(chartContainer);
			return renderTargetBitmap;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Office.Printing
{
	public class OfficeRectBrickXamlExporter : VisualBrickXamlExporter
	{
		protected override XamlBrickExportMode GetBrickExportMode()
		{
			return XamlBrickExportMode.Content;
		}

		protected override RectangleF GetBorderBoundsInPixels(VisualBrick brick)
		{
			RectangleF borderBoundsInPixels = base.GetBorderBoundsInPixels(brick);
			borderBoundsInPixels.Width = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(borderBoundsInPixels.Width));
			borderBoundsInPixels.Height = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(borderBoundsInPixels.Height));
			return borderBoundsInPixels;
		}
	}

	public class WpfFontInfo : WindowsPlatformFontInfo
	{
		private Typeface typeface;

		public Typeface Typeface => typeface;

		public System.Windows.Media.FontFamily FontFamily => Typeface.FontFamily;

		public WpfFontInfo(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline, bool allowCjkCorrection, int textRotation, bool useSystemFontQuality, FontInfo baselineFontInfo)
			: base(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline, allowCjkCorrection, textRotation, useSystemFontQuality, baselineFontInfo)
		{
		}

		protected override void CreateFont(FontInfoMeasurer measurer, string fontName, int doubleFontSize, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic, bool fontStrikeout, bool fontUnderline)
		{
			base.CreateFont(measurer, fontName, doubleFontSize, fontBold, fontItalic, fontStrikeout, fontUnderline);
			if (!DXFontRepository.Instance.IsEmpty && TryCreateCustomFont(fontName, out var fontFamily))
			{
				System.Windows.FontStyle style = (fontItalic ? FontStyles.Italic : FontStyles.Normal);
				FontWeight weight = (fontBold ? FontWeights.Bold : FontWeights.Normal);
				typeface = new Typeface(fontFamily, style, weight, FontStretches.Normal);
			}
			else
			{
				TypefaceResolver typefaceResolver = new TypefaceResolver();
				typeface = typefaceResolver.GetTypeface(Font.Name, fontBold, fontItalic);
			}
		}

		private bool TryCreateCustomFont(string fontName, out System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily)
		{
			SpreadsheetCustomFontProvider fontProvider = DXFontRepository.Instance.GetFontProvider<SpreadsheetCustomFontProvider>();
			fontFamily = fontProvider.CreateFontFamily(fontName);
			return fontFamily != null;
		}
	}
	public class SpreadsheetCustomFontProvider : IFontProvider, IDisposable
	{
		private object lockObj = new object();

		private HashSet<string> fontFolders;

		private HashSet<string> unknownFontNames;

		public SpreadsheetCustomFontProvider()
		{
			fontFolders = new HashSet<string>();
			unknownFontNames = new HashSet<string>();
		}

		public void AddFontSource(string fontFileName)
		{
			lock (lockObj)
			{
				string directoryName = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(fontFileName));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(directoryName))
				{
					directoryName = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(System.Windows.Forms.Application.ExecutablePath);
				}
				string item = directoryName.Replace("\\", "/");
				if (!fontFolders.Contains(item))
				{
					fontFolders.Add(item);
					unknownFontNames.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		public string[] AddFontSource(byte[] fontData)
		{
			return new string[0];
		}

		public System.Windows.Media.FontFamily CreateFontFamily(string fontName)
		{
			lock (lockObj)
			{
				if (unknownFontNames.Contains(fontName))
				{
					return null;
				}
				foreach (string fontFolder in fontFolders)
				{
					System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily = CreateFontFamily(fontFolder, fontName);
					if (fontFamily != null)
					{
						return fontFamily;
					}
				}
				unknownFontNames.Add(fontName);
				return null;
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.FontFamily CreateFontFamily(string path, string fontName)
		{
			System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily($"{path}/#{fontName}");
			foreach (string value in fontFamily.FamilyNames.Values)
			{
				if (string.Compare(value, fontName) == 0)
				{
					return fontFamily;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (lockObj)
			{
				ClearCore();
			}
		}

		private void ClearCore()
		{
			fontFolders.Clear();
			unknownFontNames.Clear();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (lockObj)
			{
				ClearCore();
				fontFolders = null;
				unknownFontNames = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TypefaceResolver
	{
		private static readonly List<string> fontFamilyNames;

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, Typeface> knownTypefaces;

		private static readonly StringComparer comparer;

		static TypefaceResolver()
		{
			comparer = StringComparer.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase;
			fontFamilyNames = new List<string>();
			foreach (string fontFamilyName in FontManager.GetFontFamilyNames())
			{
				fontFamilyNames.Add(fontFamilyName);
			}
			fontFamilyNames.Sort(comparer);
			knownTypefaces = new Dictionary<string, Typeface>(comparer);
		}

		public Typeface GetTypeface(string fontName, bool fontBold, bool fontItalic)
		{
			if (!FontFamilyExist(fontName, out var index))
			{
				Typeface typeface = FindTypeface(fontName, index);
				if (typeface != null)
				{
					System.Windows.FontStyle actualFontStyle = GetActualFontStyle(fontItalic, typeface.Style);
					FontWeight actualFontWeigth = GetActualFontWeigth(fontBold, typeface.Weight);
					FontStretch stretch = typeface.Stretch;
					return new Typeface(typeface.FontFamily, actualFontStyle, actualFontWeigth, stretch);
				}
			}
			System.Windows.FontStyle style = (fontItalic ? FontStyles.Italic : FontStyles.Normal);
			FontWeight weight = (fontBold ? FontWeights.Bold : FontWeights.Normal);
			FontStretch normal = FontStretches.Normal;
			return new Typeface(new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(fontName), style, weight, normal);
		}

		private Typeface FindTypeface(string fontName, int fontFamilyIndex)
		{
			if (knownTypefaces.TryGetValue(fontName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = FindTypefaceCore(fontName, fontFamilyIndex);
			knownTypefaces.Add(fontName, value);
			return value;
		}

		private Typeface FindTypefaceCore(string fontName, int fontFamilyIndex)
		{
			foreach (string fontFamily2 in GetFontFamilies(fontName, fontFamilyIndex))
			{
				System.Windows.Media.FontFamily fontFamily = new System.Windows.Media.FontFamily(fontFamily2);
				foreach (Typeface typeface in fontFamily.GetTypefaces())
				{
					if (typeface.TryGetGlyphTypeface(out var glyphTypeface) && ContainsWin32FamilyNames(glyphTypeface, fontName))
					{
						return typeface;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private FontWeight GetActualFontWeigth(bool fontBold, FontWeight fontWeight)
		{
			if (fontBold && fontWeight <= FontWeights.Bold)
			{
				return FontWeights.Bold;
			}
			return fontWeight;
		}

		private System.Windows.FontStyle GetActualFontStyle(bool fontItalic, System.Windows.FontStyle typefaceFontStyle)
		{
			if (fontItalic && typefaceFontStyle == FontStyles.Normal)
			{
				return FontStyles.Italic;
			}
			return typefaceFontStyle;
		}

		private bool ContainsWin32FamilyNames(GlyphTypeface glyphTypeface, string fontName)
		{
			foreach (string value in glyphTypeface.Win32FamilyNames.Values)
			{
				if (comparer.Compare((value.Length >= 32) ? value.Substring(0, fontName.Length) : value, fontName) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool FontFamilyExist(string fontName, out int index)
		{
			index = fontFamilyNames.BinarySearch(fontName, comparer);
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			index = ~index - 1;
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetFontFamilies(string fontName, int fontFamilyIndex)
		{
			foreach (string fontFamily in GetFontFamilies(fontName, fontFamilyIndex, isReverseOrder: true))
			{
				yield return fontFamily;
			}
			foreach (string fontFamily2 in GetFontFamilies(fontName, fontFamilyIndex, isReverseOrder: false))
			{
				yield return fontFamily2;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetFontFamilies(string fontName, int fontFamilyIndex, bool isReverseOrder)
		{
			int step = ((!isReverseOrder) ? 1 : (-1));
			for (int i = (isReverseOrder ? fontFamilyIndex : (fontFamilyIndex + 1)); isReverseOrder ? (i >= 0) : (i < fontFamilyNames.Count); i += step)
			{
				string text = fontFamilyNames[i];
				if (EqualStartOfStrings(fontName, text))
				{
					yield return text;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool EqualStartOfStrings(string strA, string strB)
		{
			if (strA.StartsWith(strB, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(strA.Length, strB.Length);
			char[] array = strB.ToCharArray();
			int num2 = num;
			while (--num2 >= 0)
			{
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(array[num2]))
				{
					string value = strB.Substring(0, num2);
					if (strA.StartsWith(value, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

				bitmap = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ControlBarCommandManager<TControl, TCommand, TCommandId> where TControl : ICommandAwareControl<TCommandId> where TCommandId : struct
	{
		private readonly TControl control;

		private readonly BarItemCaptionConverter captionConverter;

		protected TControl Control => control;

		protected abstract object ControlAccessor { get; }

		protected abstract BarManager BarManager { get; }

		protected abstract RibbonControl Ribbon { get; }

		protected abstract TCommandId EmptyCommandId { get; }

		protected ControlBarCommandManager(TControl control)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)control, "control");
			this.control = control;
			captionConverter = new BarItemCaptionConverter();
		}

		protected abstract TCommandId GetCommandId(ICommand command);

		protected abstract void SetFocus();

		protected abstract bool IsControlProvider(object value);

		protected abstract BarItemCommandUIState CreateBarItemUIState(BarItem item);

		protected internal virtual void UpdateBarItemsDefaultValues()
		{
			if (BarManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BarItem item in BarNameScope.GetService<IElementRegistratorService>((object)BarManager).GetElements<IFrameworkInputElement>().OfType<BarItem>())
			{
				UpdateBarItemDefaultValues(item);
				UpdateInnerGalleryItemsDefaultValues(item as RibbonGalleryBarItem);
				UpdateDropDownGalleryItemsDefaultValues((BarSplitButtonItem)(object)((item is BarSplitButtonItem) ? item : null));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateBarItemDefaultValues(BarItem item)
		{
			Command val = CreateCommand(item.Command);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BarItemDefaultProperties.SetContent((DependencyObject)(object)item, (object)ReplaceShortcuts(val.MenuCaption));
			BarItemDefaultProperties.SetDescription((DependencyObject)(object)item, val.Description);
			BarItemDefaultProperties.SetHelpText((DependencyObject)(object)item, val.Description);
			SetItemKeyTip(item, val.KeyTip);
			try
			{
				SetItemGlyphs(item, val);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			BarItemDefaultProperties.SetHint((DependencyObject)(object)item, GenerateHint(val));
			if (item.SuperTip == null)
			{
				TCommandId commandId = GetCommandId(item.Command);
				try
				{
					item.SuperTip = CreateCommandSuperTip(commandId);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (!IsControlProvider(item.CommandParameter))
			{
				item.CommandParameter = ControlAccessor;
			}
			UnsubscribeBarItemEvents(item);
			SubscribeBarItemEvents(item);
		}

		private void SetItemKeyTip(BarItem item, string keyTip)
		{
			item.KeyTip = keyTip;
		}

		protected internal virtual Command CreateCommand(ICommand barItemCommand)
		{
			TCommandId commandId = GetCommandId(barItemCommand);
			if (object.Equals(commandId, EmptyCommandId))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ((ICommandAwareControl<?>)Control/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CreateCommand(commandId);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateInnerGalleryItemsDefaultValues(RibbonGalleryBarItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnsubscribeBarItemEvents((BarItem)(object)item);
			try
			{
				UpdateGalleryItemsDefaultValues(item.Gallery);
			}
			finally
			{
				SubscribeBarItemEvents((BarItem)(object)item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetItemGlyphs(BarItem item, Command command)
		{
			if (command.Image != null)
			{
				BarItemDefaultProperties.SetGlyph((DependencyObject)(object)item, ImageHelper.CreatePlatformImage(command.Image).Source);
			}
			if (command.LargeImage != null)
			{
				BarItemDefaultProperties.SetLargeGlyph((DependencyObject)(object)item, ImageHelper.CreatePlatformImage(command.LargeImage).Source);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDropDownGalleryItemsDefaultValues(BarSplitButtonItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnsubscribeBarItemEvents((BarItem)(object)item);
			try
			{
				if (item.PopupControl is GalleryDropDownPopupMenu galleryDropDownPopupMenu)
				{
					UpdateGalleryItemsDefaultValues(galleryDropDownPopupMenu.Gallery);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SubscribeBarItemEvents((BarItem)(object)item);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateGalleryItemsDefaultValues(Gallery gallery)
		{
			if (gallery == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GalleryItemGroupCollection groups = gallery.Groups;
			int count = ((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups).Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				GalleryItemGroup val = ((Collection<GalleryItemGroup>)(object)groups)[i];
				int count2 = ((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)val.Items).Count;
				for (int num = count2 - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					GalleryItem item = ((Collection<GalleryItem>)(object)val.Items)[num];
					UpdateGalleryItemDefaultValue(item);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateGalleryItemDefaultValue(GalleryItem item)
		{
			TCommandId commandId = GetCommandId(item.Command);
			if (object.Equals(commandId, EmptyCommandId))
			{
				return;
			}
			Command val = ((ICommandAwareControl<?>)Control/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CreateCommand(commandId);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (item.Caption == null)
				{
					item.Caption = ReplaceShortcuts(val.MenuCaption);
				}
				if (item.Description == null)
				{
					item.Description = val.Description;
				}
				if (val.LargeImage != null && item.Glyph == null)
				{
					item.Glyph = ImageHelper.CreatePlatformImage(val.LargeImage).Source;
				}
				item.Hint = GenerateHint(val);
				item.SuperTip = CreateCommandSuperTip(commandId);
				((DependencyObject)(object)item).SetValue(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, (object)val.MenuCaption);
				((DependencyObject)(object)item).SetValue(AutomationProperties.HelpTextProperty, (object)val.Description);
				if (!IsControlProvider(item.CommandParameter))
				{
					item.CommandParameter = ControlAccessor;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateRibbonItemsDefaultValues()
		{
			if (Ribbon != null)
			{
				IList<RibbonPageGroup> list = ObtainRibbonPageGroups(Ribbon);
				int count = list.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UpdateRibbonPageGroupDefaultValues(list[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateRibbonPageGroupDefaultValues(RibbonPageGroup group)
		{
			TCommandId commandId = GetCommandId(group.CaptionButtonCommand);
			if (object.Equals(commandId, EmptyCommandId))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsControlProvider(group.CaptionButtonCommandParameter))
			{
				group.CaptionButtonCommandParameter = ControlAccessor;
			}
			if (group.SuperTip == null)
			{
				SuperTip val = CreateCommandSuperTip(commandId);
				if (val != null)
				{
					group.SuperTip = val;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual SuperTip CreateCommandSuperTip(TCommandId commandId)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Command val = ((ICommandAwareControl<?>)Control/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CreateCommand(commandId);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SuperTipHeaderItem val2 = new SuperTipHeaderItem();
			((SuperTipItem)val2).Content = GetCaptionWithShortcuts(commandId, val.MenuCaption);
			SuperTipItem val3 = new SuperTipItem();
			val3.Content = RemoveShortcuts(val.Description);
			SuperTip val4 = new SuperTip();
			val4.Items.Add((SuperTipItemBase)(object)val2);
			val4.Items.Add((SuperTipItemBase)(object)val3);
			return val4;
		}

		public string GetCaptionWithShortcuts(TCommandId commandId)
		{
			Command val = ((ICommandAwareControl<?>)Control/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).CreateCommand(commandId);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return GetCaptionWithShortcuts(commandId, val.MenuCaption);
		}

		public string GetCaptionWithShortcuts(TCommandId commandId, string menuCaption)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PortableKeys keys = (PortableKeys)0;
			if (((ICommandAwareControl<?>)control).KeyboardHandler != null)
			{
				keys = ((CommandBasedKeyboardHandler<?>)(object)((ICommandAwareControl<?>)control).KeyboardHandler).GetKeys(commandId);
			}
			string text = ConvertKeysToString(keys);
			string value = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? menuCaption : $"{menuCaption} ({text})");
			return RemoveShortcuts(value);
		}

		public string ConvertKeysToString(PortableKeys keys)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return KeysConverter.ToString(keys);
		}

		protected internal virtual IList<RibbonPageGroup> ObtainRibbonPageGroups(RibbonControl ribbon)
		{
			IList<RibbonPageGroup> result = new List<RibbonPageGroup>();
			IList selfCategories = ribbon.SelfCategories;

		protected internal virtual void ExecuteParametrizedCommand(Command command, object parameter)
		{
			if (command != null)
			{
				ICommandUIState val = CreateCommandUIState(command, parameter);
				if (val != null && command.CanExecute())
				{
					command.ForceExecute(val);
				}
				if (ShouldSetFocus(command))
				{
					SetFocus();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldSetFocus(Command command)
		{
			return !command.ShowsModalDialog;
		}

		protected internal ICommandUIState CreateCommandUIState(Command command, object parameter)
		{
			try
			{
				ICommandUIState val = command.CreateDefaultCommandUIState();
				command.UpdateUIState(val);
				if (parameter != null)
				{
					try
					{
						val.EditValue = parameter;
					}
					catch
					{
						if (parameter == null || !(parameter.GetType() == typeof(System.Windows.Media.Color)) || val.EditValue == null || !(val.EditValue.GetType() == typeof(System.Drawing.Color)))
						{
							throw;
						}
						System.Windows.Media.Color color = (System.Windows.Media.Color)parameter;
						if (color.A == 0 && color.R == 0 && color.G == 0 && color.B == 0)
						{
							val.EditValue = DXColor.Empty;
						}
						else
						{
							val.EditValue = DXColor.FromArgb((int)color.A, (int)color.R, (int)color.G, (int)color.B);
						}
					}
				}
				return val;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		}

		public static string ToString(PortableKeys keys)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{

			}
			if ((val2 & 0x40000) != 0)

				text = GetModifiedText(text, AltText);
			}
			if ((val2 & 0x10000) != 0)

				text = GetModifiedText(text, ShiftText);
			}
			string text2 = ConvertKeyToString(val);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text2;
			}
			return text + text2;
		}

		private static string GetModifiedText(string currentText, string text)
		{
			return currentText + text + "+";
		}

	public class BarItemCaptionConverter
	{
		public string RemoveShortcuts(string value)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
			int length = value.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = value[i];
				if (c == '&')
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public enum InvokerType
	{
		MouseMove,
		Refresh,
		Any
	}
	public static class XpfBackgroundWorker
	{
		private static System.Windows.Controls.Button control;

		private static ManualResetEvent reseter;

		private static ManualResetEvent uiThreadWaiter;

		private static Thread Thread { get; set; }

		private static List<Action> Invoker { get; set; }

		private static List<InvokerType> InvokerTypes { get; set; }

		public static void CheckIsWorkerThread()
		{
			if (Thread.CurrentThread != Thread)
			{
				throw new AccessViolationException("Invalid thread access!");
			}
		}

		public static void Invoke(Action m, InvokerType type)
		{
			lock (Invoker)
			{
				if (type != InvokerType.MouseMove)
				{
					if (type == InvokerType.Refresh)
					{
						while (InvokerTypes.Count > 0 && InvokerTypes[InvokerTypes.Count - 1] == type)
						{
							InvokerTypes.RemoveAt(InvokerTypes.Count - 1);
							Invoker.RemoveAt(Invoker.Count - 1);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					while (InvokerTypes.Count > 0 && InvokerTypes[InvokerTypes.Count - 1] == type)
					{
						InvokerTypes.RemoveAt(InvokerTypes.Count - 1);
						Invoker.RemoveAt(Invoker.Count - 1);
					}
				}
				Invoker.Add(m);
				InvokerTypes.Add(type);
				reseter.Set();
			}
		}

		public static void Invoke(Action m)
		{
			lock (Invoker)
			{
				Invoker.Add(m);
				InvokerTypes.Add(InvokerType.Any);
				reseter.Set();
			}
		}

		public static void InvokeInUIThread(Action m, InvokerType type)
		{
			Invoke(delegate
			{
				uiThreadWaiter.Reset();
				Action method = delegate
				{
					m();
					uiThreadWaiter.Set();
				};
				control.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(method);
				uiThreadWaiter.WaitOne();
			}, type);
		}

		static XpfBackgroundWorker()
		{
			control = new System.Windows.Controls.Button();
			Invoker = new List<Action>();
			InvokerTypes = new List<InvokerType>();
			reseter = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
			uiThreadWaiter = new ManualResetEvent(initialState: false);
			Thread = new Thread(Worker);
			Thread.IsBackground = true;
			Thread.Start();
		}

		private static void Worker()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				if (Invoker.Count > 0)
				{
					Action action;
					lock (Invoker)
					{
						action = Invoker[0];
						Invoker.RemoveAt(0);
						InvokerTypes.RemoveAt(0);
						if (Invoker.Count == 0)
						{
							reseter.Reset();
						}
					}
					action();
				}
				else
				{
					reseter.WaitOne();
				}
			}
		}
	}

			dictionary.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement, (PortableScrollEventType)0);

			dictionary.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement, (PortableScrollEventType)2);
			dictionary.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition, (PortableScrollEventType)4);
			dictionary.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack, (PortableScrollEventType)6);
			dictionary.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.Last, (PortableScrollEventType)7);
			dictionary.Add(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType.EndScroll, (PortableScrollEventType)8);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public XpfOfficeScrollbar(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollBar scrollBar)
		{
			this.scrollBar = scrollBar;
			scrollBar.ValueChanged += OnValueChanged;
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseScroll(PortableScrollEventArgs args)
		{
			if (onScroll != null)
			{
				onScroll.Invoke((object)this, args);
			}
		}

			catch

				translateTransform.X = 0.0;
				translateTransform.Y = 0.0;
				return translateTransform;
			}
		}

		private void OnValueChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int num = ConvertScrollBarValue(e.OldValue);
			int num2 = ConvertScrollBarValue(e.NewValue);
			if (num != num2)
			{
				PortableScrollEventArgs args = new PortableScrollEventArgs((PortableScrollEventType)5, num, num2);
				RaiseScroll(args);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected PortableScrollEventArgs ConvertEventArgs(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventArgs e, int oldValue)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int num = ConvertScrollBarValue(e.NewValue);
			PortableScrollEventType val = ConvertScrollEventType(e.ScrollEventType);
			return new PortableScrollEventArgs(val, oldValue, num);
		}

		public static PortableScrollEventType ConvertScrollEventType(System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.ScrollEventType value)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return scrollEventTypeTable[value];
		}

		public static int ConvertScrollBarValue(double value)
		{
			return (int)Math.Round(value);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Color ToPlatformColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			return System.Windows.Media.Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Color ToPlatformIndependentColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}

		public static IPortableCursor ToPlatformIndependentCursor(System.Windows.Input.Cursor cursor)
		{
			if (cursor == null)
			{
				return Default;
			}
			if (cursorTable.TryGetValue(cursor, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return Default;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Input.Cursor ToPlatformCursor(IPortableCursor cursor)
		{
			if (cursor == null)
			{
				return System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
			}
			foreach (System.Windows.Input.Cursor key in cursorTable.Keys)
			{
				if (cursorTable[key] == cursor)
				{
					return key;
				}
			}
			return System.Windows.Input.Cursors.Arrow;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush ToPlatformBrush(System.Drawing.Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush is SolidBrush solidBrush)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(ToPlatformColor(solidBrush.Color));
			}
			if (brush is HatchBrush hatchBrush)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(ToPlatformColor(hatchBrush.BackgroundColor));
			}
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Media.Brush ToPlatformBrush(DXBrush brush)
		{
			if (brush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(ToPlatformColor(dXSolidBrush.Color));
			}
			if (brush is DXHatchBrush dXHatchBrush)
			{
				return new SolidColorBrush(ToPlatformColor(dXHatchBrush.BackgroundColor));
			}
			return System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point ToPlatformPoint(System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			return new System.Windows.Point(point.X, point.Y);
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point ToPlatformPoint(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return point;
		}

	public static class WidthMeasurer
	{
		public delegate string ItemTextAccessor(object item);

		public static void SetDesiredTabWidth(Grid[] tabGrids)
		{
			double desiredTabWidth = GetDesiredTabWidth(tabGrids);
			foreach (Grid grid in tabGrids)
			{
				grid.Width = desiredTabWidth;
			}
		}

		private static double GetDesiredTabWidth(Grid[] tabGrids)
		{
			int num = tabGrids.Length;
			if (num <= 1)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Incorrect items count!");
			}
			double num2 = tabGrids[0].ActualWidth;
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				Grid grid = tabGrids[i];
				grid.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, grid.DesiredSize.Width);
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public static void SetDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit comboBox, IEnumerable itemSource)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)comboBox).Width = MeasureDesiredWidth(comboBox, itemSource);
		}

		public static void SetDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit comboBox, IEnumerable itemSource, ItemTextAccessor getText)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)comboBox).Width = MeasureDesiredWidth(comboBox, itemSource, getText);
		}

		public static void SetDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit comboBox1, ComboBoxEdit comboBox2, IEnumerable itemSource1, IEnumerable itemSource2)
		{
			SetDesiredWidth((ComboBoxEdit[])(object)new ComboBoxEdit[2] { comboBox1, comboBox2 }, new IEnumerable[2] { itemSource1, itemSource2 });
		}

		public static void SetDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit[] comboBoxes, IEnumerable[] itemSources)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = comboBoxes.Length;
			if (num2 != itemSources.Length)
			{
				Exceptions.ThrowInvalidOperationException("Incorrect items count!");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, MeasureDesiredWidth(comboBoxes[i], itemSources[i]));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)comboBoxes[j]).Width = num;
			}
		}

		public static void SetDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit[] comboBoxes, IEnumerable itemSource)
		{
			double width = MeasureDesiredWidth(comboBoxes[0], itemSource);
			foreach (ComboBoxEdit val in comboBoxes)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Width = width;
			}
		}

		private static double MeasureDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit comboBox, IEnumerable itemSource)
		{
			return MeasureDesiredWidth(comboBox, itemSource, (object item) => item.ToString());
		}

		private static double MeasureDesiredWidth(ComboBoxEdit comboBox, IEnumerable itemSource, ItemTextAccessor getText)
		{
			((LookUpEditBase)comboBox).SelectedItem = FindBiggestItem(comboBox, itemSource, getText);
			((UIElement)(object)comboBox).Measure(new System.Windows.Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
			return Math.Max(((FrameworkElement)(object)comboBox).MinWidth, ((UIElement)(object)comboBox).DesiredSize.Width);
		}

		public static double MeasureTextWidth(System.Windows.Controls.Control control, string text)
		{
			Typeface typeface = new Typeface(control.FontFamily, control.FontStyle, control.FontWeight, control.FontStretch);
			FormattedText formattedText = new FormattedText(text, CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight, typeface, control.FontSize, System.Windows.Media.Brushes.Black, null, TextFormattingMode.Display);
			return formattedText.Width;
		}

		private static object FindBiggestItem(ComboBoxEdit comboBox, IEnumerable itemSource, ItemTextAccessor getText)
		{
			object result = null;
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (object item in itemSource)
			{
				double num2 = MeasureTextWidth((System.Windows.Controls.Control)(object)comboBox, getText(item));
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					result = item;
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class RichEditStreamProvider : StreamProvider
	{
		public override Stream GetStream(object source)
		{
			if (source is byte[] buffer)
			{
				return new MemoryStream(buffer);
			}
			if (source is FileInfo fileInfo)
			{
				return fileInfo.Open(FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
			}
			return ((StreamProvider)this).GetStream(source);
		}

		protected override Stream GetStream(string path)
		{
			try
			{
				return new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
			}
			catch
			{
				if (Uri.TryCreate(path, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out var result))
				{
					return ((StreamProvider)this).GetStream(result);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public static class DrawingContextExtensions
	{
		public static void DrawRotatedString(this DrawingContext drawing_context, FormattedText formatted_text, System.Windows.Point origin, double angle, VerticalAlignment valign, TextAlignment halign)
		{
			double num = formatted_text.Width - formatted_text.OverhangLeading;
			double height = formatted_text.Height;
			TranslateTransform translateTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			translateTransform.Y = (0.0 - height) / 2.0;
			if (formatted_text.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Left || formatted_text.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Justify)
			{
				translateTransform.X = (0.0 - num) / 2.0;
			}
			else if (formatted_text.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Right)
			{
				translateTransform.X = num / 2.0;
			}
			else
			{
				translateTransform.X = 0.0;
			}
			RotateTransform rotateTransform = new RotateTransform(angle);
			Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, num, height);
			if (formatted_text.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Center)
			{
				rect.X -= num / 2.0;
			}
			else if (formatted_text.TextAlignment == TextAlignment.Right)
			{
				rect.X -= num;
			}
			Rect rect2 = rotateTransform.TransformBounds(rect);
			TranslateTransform translateTransform2 = new TranslateTransform(origin.X, origin.Y);
			switch (halign)
			{
			case TextAlignment.Left:
				translateTransform2.X += rect2.Width / 2.0;
				break;
			case TextAlignment.Right:
				translateTransform2.X -= rect2.Width / 2.0;
				break;
			}
			switch (valign)
			{
			case VerticalAlignment.Top:
				translateTransform2.Y += rect2.Height / 2.0;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
				translateTransform2.Y -= rect2.Height / 2.0 - height;
				break;
			case VerticalAlignment.Center:
				translateTransform2.Y += height / 2.0;
				break;
			}
			drawing_context.PushTransform(translateTransform2);
			drawing_context.PushTransform(rotateTransform);
			drawing_context.PushTransform(translateTransform);
			try
			{
				drawing_context.DrawText(formatted_text, new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0));
			}
			finally
			{
				drawing_context.Pop();
				drawing_context.Pop();
				drawing_context.Pop();
			}
		}

		public static void DrawSnapToPixels(DrawingContext dc, double x1, double x2, double y1, double y2, Action<DrawingContext> draw)
		{
			GuidelineSet guidelineSet = new GuidelineSet();
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(x1);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesX.Add(x2);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(y1);
			guidelineSet.GuidelinesY.Add(y2);
			guidelineSet.Freeze();
			dc.PushGuidelineSet(guidelineSet);
			try
			{
				draw(dc);
			}
			finally
			{
				dc.Pop();
			}
		}

		public static void DrawLineSnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point start, System.Windows.Point end)
		{
			DrawSnapToPixels(dc, start.X, end.X, start.Y, end.Y, delegate(DrawingContext e)
			{
				e.DrawLine(pen, start, end);
			});
		}

		public static void DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Rect rect)
		{
			dc.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(brush, null, rect);
		}

		public static void DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect rect)
		{
			dc.DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(null, pen, rect);
		}

		public static void DrawRectangleSnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Rect rect)
		{
			DrawSnapToPixels(dc, rect.Left, rect.Right, rect.Top, rect.Bottom, delegate(DrawingContext e)
			{
				e.DrawRectangle(brush, pen, rect);
			});
		}

		public static void DrawEllipseSnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, System.Windows.Point center, double radiusX, double radiusY)
		{
			DrawSnapToPixels(dc, center.X, center.X, center.Y, center.Y, delegate(DrawingContext e)
			{
				e.DrawEllipse(brush, pen, center, radiusX, radiusY);
			});
		}

		public static void DrawGeometrySnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, Geometry geometry)
		{
			Rect bounds = geometry.Bounds;
			DrawSnapToPixels(dc, bounds.Left, bounds.Right, bounds.Top, bounds.Bottom, delegate(DrawingContext e)
			{
				e.DrawGeometry(brush, null, geometry);
			});
		}

		public static void DrawGeometrySnapToPixels(this DrawingContext dc, System.Windows.Media.Pen pen, Geometry geometry)
		{
			Rect bounds = geometry.Bounds;
			DrawSnapToPixels(dc, bounds.Left, bounds.Right, bounds.Top, bounds.Bottom, delegate(DrawingContext e)
			{
				e.DrawGeometry(null, pen, geometry);
			});
		}
	}
	public static class DependencyObjectExtensions
	{
		public static void InheritTheme(this DependencyObject obj, DependencyObject owner)
		{
			if (!CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				ThemeTreeWalker treeWalker = ThemeManager.GetTreeWalker(owner);
				string text = ((treeWalker != null) ? treeWalker.ThemeName : (owner.GetValue(ThemeManager.ThemeNameProperty) as string));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					ThemeManager.SetThemeName(obj, text);
				}
			}
		}
	}
